cls.zh: 血小板抑制剂（抗血小板药）

hook.en: Stops platelets from clumping together into a clot.
hook.zh: 不让血小板抱团结成血栓。

how.en: Platelets are the blood cells that clump together to form a clot. ASA stops them from clumping. A clot that has started finds it harder to grow.
how.zh: 血小板是会聚在一起形成血栓的血细胞。ASA 阿司匹林不让它们聚集。已经开始形成的血栓就更难长大。

use.en: Chest pain consistent with cardiac ischemia or AMI
use.zh: 符合心肌缺血或 AMI（急性心肌梗死）的胸痛

use.en: Atypical symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia or AMI
use.zh: 符合心肌缺血或 AMI 的不典型症状

no.en: Inability to swallow
no.zh: 无法吞咽

no.en: Allergy to Aspirin
no.zh: 对 ASA 阿司匹林过敏

no.en: Active peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding
no.zh: 活动性消化性溃疡或胃肠道出血

no.en: Patient already took their recommended Aspirin dose before you arrived
no.zh: 你到达之前病人已经吃过推荐剂量的 ASA 阿司匹林

no.en: History of asthma induced by salicylates or NSAIDs
no.zh: 有水杨酸类或 NSAIDs 诱发哮喘的病史

no.en: Pediatric patients with viral symptoms
no.zh: 有病毒感染症状的儿童

care.en: Recent internal bleeding.
care.zh: 近期有内出血。

care.en: Known bleeding diseases.
care.zh: 已知的出血性疾病。

care.en: Patient is currently taking anticoagulant agents.
care.zh: 病人正在吃抗凝药。

care.en: Recent surgery.
care.zh: 近期做过手术。

care.en: Possibility of pregnancy.
care.zh: 可能怀孕。

dose.en: 160 mg PO. Chew and swallow it (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
dose.zh: 160 mg 口服。嚼碎后吞下（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

dose.en: Give it after the RBS. No vital signs are required first.
dose.zh: 在 RBS（快速全身检查）之后给。不需要先量生命体征。

dose.en: One time only. If the pain returns, nitroglycerin may restart but the Aspirin component is not repeated (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain)
dose.zh: 只给一次。疼痛复发时可以重新开始 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，但 ASA 阿司匹林这一步不重复（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）

dose.en: Pediatric patients with viral symptoms: contraindicated. No pediatric dose is given in the exam monograph.
dose.zh: 有病毒感染症状的儿童：禁用。考试专论没有给出儿童剂量。

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: Works in 20 minutes to one hour if chewed.
pk.zh: 嚼服后 20 分钟到一小时起效。

pearl.en: ASA is the only drug that needs no vitals first. It still needs questions. Can you swallow? Any allergy? Ulcer or GI bleed? Asthma set off by ASA or NSAIDs? Did you already take it today?
pearl.zh: ASA 阿司匹林是唯一不用先量生命体征的药。但还是要先问。能吞咽吗？过敏吗？有溃疡或消化道出血吗？ASA 阿司匹林或 NSAIDs 引发过哮喘吗？今天已经吃过了吗？

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the dose is 162 mg, two 81 mg chewable tablets, not 160 mg. Any active or recent bleeding, head injury included, is a contraindication there. The exam lists recent internal bleeding only as a caution. BCEHS requires a CliniCall consult before giving it to a child.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：剂量是 162 mg，也就是两片 81 mg 咀嚼片，不是 160 mg。任何活动性或近期出血（包括头部外伤）在 BCEHS 都是禁忌。考试只把近期内出血列为注意事项。BCEHS 给儿童用药前必须先咨询 CliniCall。

stem.en: Ana, 57, chest pressure at a Burnaby gym. She has asthma and takes ibuprofen for her knees with no breathing trouble. No ASA today. Swallows fine.
stem.zh: Ana，57 岁，在 Burnaby 的健身房胸口发闷。她有哮喘，平时吃 ibuprofen 布洛芬治膝盖痛，呼吸从没出过问题。今天没吃 ASA 阿司匹林。吞咽正常。

why.en: Only asthma induced by salicylates or NSAIDs is a contraindication. Hers has never reacted to them. Give 160 mg PO, chewed.
why.zh: 只有水杨酸类或 NSAIDs 诱发的哮喘才是禁忌。她的哮喘从没因为这些药发作过。给 160 mg 口服，嚼碎。

bad.en: She misses the one early drug that slows the clot in her coronary artery.
bad.zh: 她错过了能在早期拖慢冠状动脉里血栓的那一个药。

stem.en: Doris, 74, chest tightness at home in Kerrisdale. The 911 call-taker told her to chew her ASA, and she did, ten minutes ago.
stem.zh: Doris，74 岁，在 Kerrisdale 家中胸口发紧。911 接线员让她嚼服 ASA 阿司匹林，她十分钟前已经照做。

why.en: She already took her recommended Aspirin dose before you arrived. That is a contraindication.
why.zh: 你到达之前她已经吃过推荐剂量的 ASA 阿司匹林。这是禁忌。

bad.en: She gets a second dose for no gain and a little more bleeding risk.
bad.zh: 她多吃一剂，没有额外好处，出血风险反而多一点。

stem.en: Frank, 66, chest pain on a fishing boat in Steveston. He is being treated for a stomach ulcer and has passed black, tarry stools for three days.
stem.zh: Frank，66 岁，在 Steveston 的渔船上胸痛。他正在治疗胃溃疡，三天来一直拉黑色柏油样便。

why.en: Active peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding is a contraindication.
why.zh: 活动性消化性溃疡或胃肠道出血是禁忌。

bad.en: A platelet blocker makes a bleeding ulcer bleed more.
bad.zh: 抗血小板药会让正在出血的溃疡出得更多。

stem.en: Lin, 58, chest pressure on a Skytrain platform. You have finished the RBS. Your partner is still unpacking the blood pressure cuff.
stem.zh: Lin，58 岁，在 Skytrain 站台上胸口发闷。你刚做完 RBS（快速全身检查）。搭档还在拿血压袖带。

ask.en: When can ASA go in?
ask.zh: ASA 阿司匹林什么时候可以给？

opts.en: Now, once the contraindication questions are clear
opts.zh: 现在，问清楚没有禁忌就给

opts.en: Only after a full set of vital signs
opts.zh: 必须先量完一整套生命体征

opts.en: Only after the first nitroglycerin dose
opts.zh: 必须等第一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油之后

why.en: ASA goes in after the RBS. It is the only medication that needs no vitals first.
why.zh: ASA 阿司匹林在 RBS 之后给。它是唯一不需要先量生命体征的药。

bad.en: She waits for a number that this drug does not need.
bad.zh: 她白白等一个这个药根本不需要的数字。

s.en: ASA is the only medication you may give before taking vital signs.
s.zh: ASA 阿司匹林是唯一可以在量生命体征之前给的药。

why.en: The monograph says vitals are not required before ASA.
why.zh: 专论写明给 ASA 阿司匹林之前不要求先量生命体征。

s.en: Any history of asthma is a contraindication to ASA.
s.zh: 只要有哮喘病史，ASA 阿司匹林就是禁忌。

why.en: Only asthma induced by salicylates or NSAIDs counts.
why.zh: 只有水杨酸类或 NSAIDs 诱发的哮喘才算。

s.en: A patient on an anticoagulant is a caution, not a contraindication.
s.zh: 病人在吃抗凝药，属于注意事项，不是禁忌。

why.en: Anticoagulant use is on the caution list.
why.zh: 抗凝药列在注意事项里。

s.en: If the chest pain goes away and comes back, give ASA again.
s.zh: 胸痛消失后又回来，要再给一次 ASA 阿司匹林。

why.en: You may restart nitroglycerin, but not the Aspirin component (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
why.zh: 可以重新开始 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，但 ASA 阿司匹林这一步不重复（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

q.en: The dose of ASA for cardiac chest pain is…
q.zh: 心源性胸痛时 ASA 阿司匹林的剂量是…

opts.en: 160 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 160 mg 口服，嚼碎吞下

opts.en: 1,600 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 1,600 mg 口服，嚼碎吞下

opts.en: 160 mg SL, every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 160 mg 舌下，每 5 分钟一次

opts.en: 16 mg PO, swallowed whole
opts.zh: 16 mg 口服，整片吞下

why.en: The monograph dose is 160 mg PO. The protocol adds chewed and swallowed (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
why.zh: 专论剂量是 160 mg 口服。protocol 补充要嚼碎吞下（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

q.en: How does ASA help in a suspected heart attack?
q.zh: 怀疑心梗时，ASA 阿司匹林起什么作用？

opts.en: It stops platelets from clumping into clots
opts.zh: 阻止血小板聚集成血栓

opts.en: It dissolves a clot that has already formed
opts.zh: 溶解已经形成的血栓

opts.en: It widens the coronary arteries
opts.zh: 扩张冠状动脉

opts.en: It blocks pain signals in the brain
opts.zh: 在大脑里阻断痛觉信号

why.en: It is a platelet inhibitor. It keeps platelets from clumping together to form clots.
why.zh: 它是血小板抑制剂，不让血小板聚在一起形成血栓。

q.en: Which of these is a caution for ASA, not a contraindication?
q.zh: 下面哪一项是 ASA 阿司匹林的注意事项，而不是禁忌？

opts.en: Possibility of pregnancy
opts.zh: 可能怀孕

opts.en: Active peptic ulcer
opts.zh: 活动性消化性溃疡

opts.en: Inability to swallow
opts.zh: 无法吞咽

opts.en: Pediatric patient with viral symptoms
opts.zh: 有病毒感染症状的儿童

why.en: Possibility of pregnancy, recent surgery, anticoagulants, recent internal bleeding and known bleeding diseases are cautions. The other three are contraindications.
why.zh: 可能怀孕、近期手术、抗凝药、近期内出血和已知的出血性疾病是注意事项。另外三项是禁忌。

cls.zh: 抗心绞痛药，血管扩张药

hook.en: Opens the blood vessels so the heart has less work to do.
hook.zh: 把血管松开，让心脏少干点活。

how.en: It widens blood vessels. Less blood returns to the heart (preload) and the heart pumps against less resistance (afterload), so it needs less oxygen. The coronary arteries widen too, which brings more blood to the heart muscle.
how.zh: 它让血管扩张。回到心脏的血变少（前负荷下降），心脏泵血遇到的阻力也变小（后负荷下降），需要的氧就少了。冠状动脉也会扩张，给心肌送去更多的血。

use.en: Chest discomfort that appears cardiac in nature
use.zh: 看起来是心源性的胸部不适

no.en: Systolic BP below 110 mmHg
no.zh: 收缩压低于 110 mmHg

no.en: Heart rate below 50 or above 150
no.zh: 心率低于 50 或高于 150

no.en: Viagra or Levitra in the past 24 hours
no.zh: 过去 24 小时内用过 Viagra 或 Levitra

no.en: Cialis in the last 48 hours
no.zh: 过去 48 小时内用过 Cialis

no.en: Known allergy or sensitivity to nitrates
no.zh: 已知对硝酸酯类过敏或敏感

noFake.en: A nitro patch already on the patient
noFake.zh: 病人身上已经贴着 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油贴片

noFake.en: Nitro the patient took before you arrived
noFake.zh: 你到之前病人自己用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油
今天已经吃过 ASA 阿司匹林

care.en: Hypotension is frequent, especially in the elderly, so make sure the patient cannot fall.
care.zh: 低血压很常见，老年人尤其如此，所以要确保病人不会摔倒。

care.en: Viagra at any time in the past, even beyond 24 hours: monitor the blood pressure very carefully.
care.zh: 以前任何时候用过 Viagra，哪怕已经超过 24 小时：要非常小心地监测血压。

care.en: With the spray, do not shake the container before use.
care.zh: 用喷雾时，喷之前不要摇瓶子。

care.en: A nitro patch on the patient does not change the protocol.
care.zh: 病人身上贴着 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油贴片，方案照旧不变。

care.en: On Entonox after nitro, with hospital not imminent 20 minutes after the last nitro: stop Entonox, resume high flow oxygen and give more nitro per protocol.
care.zh: 给过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油后改用了 Entonox 笑气，如果最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油过了 20 分钟还到不了医院：停 Entonox 笑气，恢复高流量吸氧，按方案继续给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

dose.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes, until pain free
dose.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟一次，直到不痛

dose.en: Only while systolic BP stays above 110. Repeat the vitals before each dose
dose.zh: 收缩压保持在 110 以上才能给。每次给药前重新量生命体征

dose.en: Maximum 3 doses in any 30-minute period
dose.zh: 任意 30 分钟内最多 3 次

dose.en: Nitro the patient took before your arrival does not count toward the 3
dose.zh: 你到之前病人自己用的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油不算在这 3 次里

dose.en: Pain completely gone for more than 5 minutes, then back: a new episode, and nitro can be given again
dose.zh: 疼痛完全消失超过 5 分钟后又回来：算新的一次发作，可以重新给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

dose.en: Pain persists beyond 3 doses, or SBP falls below 110: Entonox, 5 minutes after the last nitro (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain)
dose.zh: 3 次之后还痛，或收缩压掉到 110 以下：最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油 5 分钟后改用 Entonox 笑气（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain）

pk.en: Works in about 60 seconds under the tongue and lasts 30 minutes.
pk.zh: 舌下大约 60 秒起效，维持 30 分钟。

pearl.en: Count only your own doses: 3 in any 30 minutes. What the patient sprayed before you arrived does not count. A patch changes nothing.
pearl.zh: 只数你自己给的：任意 30 分钟内 3 次。你到之前病人自己喷的不算。贴片也不改变任何规则。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): consult CliniCall before the first dose if the patient has no nitroglycerin prescription, and again if more than 3 doses are needed. BCEHS adds contraindications the exam does not list: right-sided MI, severe anemia, constrictive pericarditis or tamponade, and uncorrected hypovolemia. It has no 30-minute rule.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：病人没有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油处方时，第一次给药前要先咨询 CliniCall，需要超过 3 次时也要咨询。BCEHS 还多了几条考试没列的禁忌：右心室心梗、严重贫血、缩窄性心包炎或心包填塞、未纠正的低血容量。BCEHS 没有 30 分钟的规定。

stem.en: Bill, 67, crushing chest pain while gardening in Kerrisdale. BP 148/90, HR 88. No ED pills. He used his own nitro spray twice before you arrived.
stem.zh: Bill，67 岁，在 Kerrisdale 的院子里干活时胸口压榨样疼痛。血压 148/90，心率 88。没用过壮阳药。你到之前他已经自己喷了两次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

why.en: SBP above 110, HR between 50 and 150, no ED pills. The nitro he took before your arrival does not count against your 3 doses.
why.zh: 收缩压高于 110，心率在 50–150 之间，没用壮阳药。你到之前他自己用的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油不占你的 3 次。

bad.en: He stays in pain while his heart keeps working harder than it has to.
bad.zh: 他继续痛着，心脏继续白白多做功。

stem.en: Marco, 59, chest pain at a Whistler hotel. BP 156/94, HR 90. He took Cialis the night before last, about 36 hours ago.
stem.zh: Marco，59 岁，在 Whistler 的酒店里胸痛。血压 156/94，心率 90。他前天晚上吃了 Cialis，大约 36 小时前。

why.en: Cialis needs 48 hours. Only Viagra and Levitra clear at 24.
why.zh: Cialis 要等 48 小时。只有 Viagra 和 Levitra 是 24 小时。

bad.en: His pressure can crash within minutes and be very hard to bring back.
bad.zh: 他的血压可能几分钟内就垮掉，而且很难拉回来。

stem.en: Ed, 62, had 3 sprays from you, then Entonox. It is 20 minutes since his last nitro. Still pain 6 out of 10, BP 128/80, hospital 30 minutes away.
stem.zh: Ed，62 岁，你已经给他喷了 3 次，之后改用 Entonox 笑气。现在距离最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油已经 20 分钟。疼痛还是 6/10，血压 128/80，离医院还有 30 分钟。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Stop Entonox, high flow oxygen, then more nitro
opts.zh: 停 Entonox 笑气，高流量吸氧，再给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

opts.en: Keep Entonox going until the hospital
opts.zh: 一直用 Entonox 笑气到医院

opts.en: Spray nitro while he keeps breathing Entonox
opts.zh: 一边吸 Entonox 笑气一边喷 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

why.en: Hospital not imminent 20 minutes after the last nitro: discontinue Entonox, resume high flow oxygen and give additional nitro as per protocol.
why.zh: 最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油过了 20 分钟还到不了医院：停 Entonox 笑气，恢复高流量吸氧，按方案继续给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

stem.en: Rosa, 70. One spray at 09:00, and by 09:02 her chest pain was completely gone. At 09:12 the pain is back, 5 out of 10. BP 132/78, HR 76.

ask.en: How do you treat the returning pain?

opts.en: As a new episode. Nitro can be given
opts.zh: 当作新的一次发作，可以给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

opts.en: No more nitro. It was used for this pain
opts.zh: 不能再给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，这次胸痛已经用过了

opts.en: Go straight to Entonox, nitro has failed
opts.zh: 直接改用 Entonox 笑气，nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油已经失效

why.en: Pain completely relieved for more than 5 minutes, then back, is a new episode. Nitro can be given even though she had it for the first one.
why.zh: 疼痛完全缓解超过 5 分钟后又出现，算新的一次发作。即使第一次发作已经用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，也可以再给。

s.en: Two sprays the patient took before you arrived count toward your 3 doses.
s.zh: 你到之前病人自己喷的两次，要算进你的 3 次里。

why.en: The 3 doses in any 30 minutes are counted irrespective of nitro taken before your arrival.
why.zh: 任意 30 分钟内 3 次，不管你到之前病人自己用过多少。

s.en: Shake the nitro spray well before each use.
s.zh: nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油喷雾每次用之前要摇匀。

why.en: The monograph says do not shake the container.
why.zh: 专论写的是不要摇瓶子。

s.en: A nitro patch on the patient does not change the nitroglycerin protocol.
s.zh: 病人身上贴着 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油贴片，不改变 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的方案。

why.en: Patches are not approved for EMA use, and one on the patient changes nothing.
why.zh: 贴片不是 EMA 可以用的剂型，病人身上贴着也不改变任何规则。

s.en: A heart rate above 150 is a contraindication, not only a slow one.
s.zh: 心率高于 150 也是禁忌，不只是心率慢才算。

why.en: Heart rate below 50 or above 150 both stop nitro.
why.zh: 心率低于 50 或高于 150 都不能给。

q.en: The exam dose of nitroglycerin is…
q.zh: 考试里 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的剂量是…

opts.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes, maximum 3 doses in any 30 minutes
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟，任意 30 分钟内最多 3 次

opts.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes, with no maximum
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟，没有上限

opts.en: 4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes, maximum 3 doses in any 30 minutes
opts.zh: 4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟，任意 30 分钟内最多 3 次

opts.en: 0.4 mg SL every 10 minutes, maximum 3 doses in any 30 minutes
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 10 分钟，任意 30 分钟内最多 3 次

why.en: 0.4 mg under the tongue. Repeat every 3 to 5 minutes while systolic BP stays above 110, up to 3 doses in any 30 minutes.
why.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下。收缩压保持在 110 以上时每 3–5 分钟重复，任意 30 分钟内最多 3 次。

q.en: Your patient used Viagra three days ago. What does the monograph say?
q.zh: 病人三天前用过 Viagra。专论怎么说？

opts.en: Nitro is allowed. Monitor blood pressure very carefully
opts.zh: 可以给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，要非常小心地监测血压

opts.en: Nitro is contraindicated for a full week
opts.zh: 一整周内都禁用 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

opts.en: Nitro is allowed at half the dose
opts.zh: 可以给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，剂量减半

opts.en: Nitro is contraindicated from now on
opts.zh: 从此以后都禁用 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

why.en: The contraindication is 24 hours. Beyond that, past Viagra use is a reason for very careful blood pressure monitoring.
why.zh: 禁忌是 24 小时内。超过之后，用过 Viagra 就要非常小心地监测血压。

q.en: How does nitroglycerin lower the heart's oxygen demand?
q.zh: nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油是怎么降低心脏需氧量的？

opts.en: It dilates blood vessels, lowering preload and afterload
opts.zh: 扩张血管，降低前负荷和后负荷

opts.en: It slows the heart rate
opts.zh: 减慢心率

opts.en: It thins the blood
opts.zh: 让血变稀

opts.en: It blocks pain signals in the brain
opts.zh: 在大脑里阻断痛觉信号

why.en: Less blood returning and less resistance to pump against mean less work for the heart.
why.zh: 回心血量少了，泵血的阻力小了，心脏做的功就少。

cls.zh: 直接的葡萄糖来源

hook.en: Sugar by mouth for a patient whose blood sugar is low.
hook.zh: 血糖低了，从嘴里补糖。

how.en: The glucose is absorbed into the bloodstream and the blood glucose level rises. The cells now have more glucose to use. It goes in by mouth, so the patient has to be awake enough to handle it safely.
how.zh: 葡萄糖被吸收进血液，血糖升高。细胞就有更多的葡萄糖可用。因为是从嘴里给，病人必须足够清醒，能安全地含住、咽下。

use.en: Known or suspected hypoglycemia in a conscious patient with no risk of aspiration or choking
use.zh: 清醒、没有误吸或呛噎风险的病人，已知或怀疑低血糖

use.en: Protocol trigger: blood glucose below 4.0 mmol/L (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies)
use.zh: 方案里的触发线：血糖低于 4.0 mmol/L（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies）

no.en: Mentation not sufficient to maintain their own airway
no.zh: 意识状态不足以维持自己的气道

noFake.en: A dose already given five minutes ago
noFake.zh: 五分钟前已经给过一次

care.en: The patient must be able to maintain their own airway.
care.zh: 病人必须能自己维持气道。

care.en: Conscious patients only, with no risk of aspiration or choking.
care.zh: 只给清醒、没有误吸或呛噎风险的病人。

care.en: Mentation not sufficient or airway unprotected: an EMR gives glucagon instead (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
care.zh: 意识状态不够或气道没有保护：EMR 改用 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies）。

care.en: A PCP corrects confirmed hypoglycemia with D10W through an IV, or with glucagon if there is no IV access (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
care.zh: PCP 从静脉给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖纠正已确认的低血糖，建不了静脉通路就用 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies）。

dose.en: 15 g glucose PO
dose.zh: 15 g 葡萄糖，口服

dose.en: Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary
dose.zh: 必要时 5 分钟后重复

dose.en: No limit on repeats
dose.zh: 重复次数没有上限

dose.en: The protocol wording is glucose gel applied to the oral mucosa (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies)
dose.zh: 方案的写法是把葡萄糖凝胶涂在口腔黏膜上（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies）

fx.zh: 可能让气道管理更麻烦

pearl.en: The whole card is one question: can this patient protect their own airway? If yes, 15 g, and again at 5 minutes if needed. If no, the gel stays in the bag.
pearl.zh: 整张卡其实只问一件事：这个病人能不能保护自己的气道？能，就给 15 g，需要的话 5 分钟后再给。不能，凝胶就留在包里。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): same 15 g, same repeat at 5 minutes with no limit. BCEHS lists no contraindication. With altered consciousness it allows gel on a gauze swab between lip and gum. The exam allows oral glucose only when the patient can maintain their airway.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：同样是 15 g，同样 5 分钟后可重复、没有上限。BCEHS 没有列禁忌。病人意识改变时，它允许把凝胶浸在纱布上，放在嘴唇和牙龈之间。考试只允许给能维持气道的病人。

stem.en: Harjit, 58, diabetic, sweaty and shaky at his kitchen table in Surrey. He answers questions and swallows normally. Glucose 2.9.
stem.zh: Harjit，58 岁，糖尿病，在 Surrey 家里的餐桌旁出汗、发抖。能回答问题，吞咽正常。血糖 2.9。

why.en: Hypoglycemia in a conscious patient who can maintain his airway. Give 15 g PO.
why.zh: 清醒、能维持气道的低血糖病人。给 15 g 口服。

bad.en: His sugar keeps falling until he can no longer swallow, and then you need glucagon or an IV.
bad.zh: 他的血糖继续往下掉，掉到咽不了东西，那时就只能用 glucagon 胰高血糖素或静脉了。

stem.en: Grace, 66, diabetic, found on her couch in Richmond. Groans to pain, snoring breaths, saliva pooling in her mouth. Glucose 1.8.
stem.zh: Grace，66 岁，糖尿病，在 Richmond 家里的沙发上被发现。只对疼痛有呻吟，呼吸带鼾声，口水积在嘴里。血糖 1.8。

why.en: She does not have the mentation to maintain her airway. Oral glucose is only for patients who do.
why.zh: 她的意识状态不足以维持气道。oral glucose 口服葡萄糖只给能维持气道的病人。

bad.en: The gel pools at the back of her throat and she aspirates it.
bad.zh: 凝胶积在咽喉后部，被她吸进气道。

stem.en: Elena, 34, type 1 diabetic, after a run on the seawall. She had 15 g five minutes ago. Glucose 3.2, still shaky, alert, swallowing well.
stem.zh: Elena，34 岁，1 型糖尿病，在海堤上跑完步。五分钟前给过 15 g。血糖 3.2，还在发抖，清醒，吞咽没问题。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Another 15 g PO now
opts.zh: 现在再给 15 g 口服

opts.en: Wait 15 minutes, then recheck
opts.zh: 等 15 分钟再测

opts.en: No more, one dose is the limit
opts.zh: 不能再给，只能给一次

why.en: Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary. There is no limit.
why.zh: 必要时 5 分钟后重复，没有上限。

stem.en: Victor, 71, diabetic, glucose 2.0. Eyes closed, gurgling, no response to voice. You are the PCP and your IV is running.
stem.zh: Victor，71 岁，糖尿病，血糖 2.0。闭着眼，喉咙里有咕噜声，叫他没反应。你是 PCP，静脉通路已经建好。

ask.en: How do you correct his sugar?

opts.en: D10W through the IV
opts.zh: 从静脉给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖

opts.en: Oral glucose, a little at a time
opts.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖，一点一点地给

opts.en: Oral glucose rubbed inside the cheek
opts.zh: 把 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖抹在脸颊内侧

why.en: No mentation to maintain an airway means no oral glucose. A PCP corrects confirmed hypoglycemia with D10W (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 意识状态维持不了气道，就不能给 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖。PCP 用 D10W 10% 葡萄糖纠正已确认的低血糖（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies）。

bad.en: Anything you put in his mouth can end up in his lungs.
bad.zh: 你往他嘴里放的任何东西，都可能进到肺里。

s.en: The protocol corrects suspected hypoglycemia only when blood glucose is below 3.0 mmol/L.
s.zh: 方案规定血糖低于 3.0 mmol/L 才纠正疑似低血糖。

why.en: The protocol line is a blood glucose below 4.0 mmol/L (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 方案写的是血糖低于 4.0 mmol/L（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies）。

s.en: There is no limit on repeat doses.
s.zh: 重复给药没有次数上限。

why.en: Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary, with no limit.
why.zh: 必要时 5 分钟后重复，没有上限。

s.en: Oral glucose can make airway management harder.
s.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖可能让气道管理更麻烦。

why.en: That is the one adverse effect the monograph lists.
why.zh: 这是专论列出的唯一一条不良反应。

s.en: A patient who cannot protect their airway can still have gel rubbed inside the cheek.
s.zh: 保护不了自己气道的病人，还是可以把凝胶抹在脸颊内侧。

why.en: On the exam it is only for patients with sufficient mentation to maintain an airway.
why.zh: 考试里它只给意识状态足以维持气道的病人。

q.en: The dose of oral glucose is…
q.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖的剂量是…

opts.en: 15 g PO, repeat at 5 minutes as necessary
opts.zh: 15 g 口服，必要时 5 分钟后重复

opts.en: 15 g PO, repeat at 15 minutes as necessary
opts.zh: 15 g 口服，必要时 15 分钟后重复

opts.en: 1.5 g PO, repeat at 5 minutes as necessary
opts.zh: 1.5 g 口服，必要时 5 分钟后重复

opts.en: 15 g PO, once only
opts.zh: 15 g 口服，只给一次

why.en: 15 g by mouth, repeated at 5 minutes as necessary, with no limit.
why.zh: 15 g 口服，必要时 5 分钟后重复，没有上限。

q.en: Who is oral glucose for?
q.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖是给谁用的？

opts.en: A conscious patient with no risk of aspiration or choking
opts.zh: 清醒、没有误吸或呛噎风险的病人

opts.en: Any patient with a low glucose reading
opts.zh: 任何血糖读数偏低的病人

opts.en: An unconscious diabetic with no IV access
opts.zh: 昏迷、建不了静脉通路的糖尿病病人

opts.en: A seizing patient with a known low sugar
opts.zh: 正在抽搐、已知低血糖的病人

why.en: The patient needs enough mentation to maintain their own airway.
why.zh: 病人的意识状态要足以维持自己的气道。

cls.zh: 升血糖药

hook.en: Tells the liver to release its stored sugar.
hook.zh: 叫肝脏把存着的糖放出来。

how.en: The liver keeps a reserve of sugar in a storage form called glycogen. Glucagon speeds up the breakdown of glycogen into glucose. The glucose enters the blood, and no IV is needed to give the drug.
how.zh: 肝脏以糖原的形式存着一批糖。glucagon 胰高血糖素加快糖原分解成葡萄糖。葡萄糖进入血液，而且给这个药不需要静脉通路。

use.en: Hypoglycemia
use.zh: 低血糖

use.en: Hypoglycemia when IV access attempts have been unsuccessful
use.zh: 低血糖，而且静脉穿刺尝试失败

use.en: Hypoglycemia with insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway (EMR, p.57, Diabetic Emergencies)
use.zh: 低血糖，病人神志不足或气道没有保护（EMR，p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）

no.en: Allergy or hypersensitivity to glucagon
no.zh: 对 glucagon 胰高血糖素过敏

care.en: Onset is 15 minutes, so do not expect the patient to wake at once.
care.zh: 15 分钟才起效，别指望病人马上醒。

care.en: PCP: with IV access the protocol uses D10W, and glucagon is for when IV access cannot be obtained (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
care.zh: PCP：有静脉通路时 protocol 用 D10W 10% 葡萄糖，建不了通路才用 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

care.en: Transport after the glucagon has been given (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
care.zh: 给完 glucagon 胰高血糖素后转运（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

care.en: Its cautions line reads: nausea or vomiting, hypokalemia, urticaria, respiratory distress, hypotension.
care.zh: 它的注意事项一栏写着：恶心或呕吐、低钾血症、荨麻疹、呼吸窘迫、低血压。

dose.en: IM: 0.5 to 1 mg
dose.zh: IM（肌注）：0.5–1 mg

dose.en: IN: 3 mg. Repeat after 15 minutes if there is no clinical response.
dose.zh: IN（鼻内）：3 mg。15 分钟后没有临床反应就重复给药。

dose.en: Route: IM or IN
dose.zh: 途径：IM 或 IN

dose.en: No separate pediatric dose is given in the exam monograph
dose.zh: 考试专论没有单独给出儿童剂量

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: Onset 15 minutes, peak 15 minutes, duration 90 minutes.
pk.zh: 15 分钟起效，15 分钟达峰，维持 90 分钟。

pearl.en: Know the pairs: IM is 0.5 to 1 mg, IN is 3 mg. Then be patient. Onset is 15 minutes, which is also when the IN dose may be repeated.
pearl.zh: 记住两组搭配：IM 是 0.5–1 mg，IN 是 3 mg。然后耐心等。15 分钟才起效，IN 也正好是 15 分钟后才可以重复。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): intranasal only, 3 mg, to a maximum of 6 mg, and a CliniCall consult is required before the second dose. BCEHS adds three contraindications: intranasal use under 4 years of age, pheochromocytoma and insulinoma. The exam also has an IM dose, 0.5 to 1 mg.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：只有鼻内给药，3 mg，最多 6 mg，给第二剂之前必须咨询 CliniCall。BCEHS 多三条禁忌：4 岁以下不能鼻内给药、嗜铬细胞瘤、胰岛素瘤。考试另外还有 IM 剂量 0.5–1 mg。

stem.en: Irene, 79, unresponsive in bed at a Richmond care home. BGL 1.7, snoring breaths. Your crew is EMR level, so no IV.
stem.zh: Irene，79 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院床上叫不醒。BGL 1.7，呼吸带鼾声。你们是 EMR 级别的车组，不能建静脉通路。

why.en: Hypoglycemia with insufficient mentation and an unprotected airway is the glucagon indication (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 低血糖，加上神志不足、气道没有保护，就是 glucagon 胰高血糖素的适应症（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

bad.en: She stays unconscious at a blood sugar of 1.7 for the whole drive.
bad.zh: 一路上她都在 1.7 的血糖下昏迷着。

stem.en: Derek, 50, responds only to pain on a Prince George job site. BGL 2.0. You are a PCP and your IV is running well.
stem.zh: Derek，50 岁，在 Prince George 的工地上只对疼痛有反应。BGL 2.0。你是 PCP，静脉通路滴得很好。

why.en: With IV access, a PCP corrects hypoglycemia with D10W. Glucagon is for when IV access cannot be obtained (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 有静脉通路时，PCP 用 D10W 10% 葡萄糖纠正低血糖。glucagon 胰高血糖素是建不了静脉通路时才用的（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

bad.en: He waits 15 minutes for glucagon to start working when D10W was ready to go.
bad.zh: D10W 10% 葡萄糖明明马上能给，他却要等 15 分钟让 glucagon 胰高血糖素起效。

stem.en: Sofia, 33, type 1 diabetic, too drowsy to swallow on a Tofino beach. BGL 2.2. Her partner says glucagon gave her hives and a tight throat last year.
stem.zh: Sofia，33 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Tofino 的海滩上困得没法吞咽。BGL 2.2。她伴侣说去年打 glucagon 胰高血糖素后她起了荨麻疹，喉咙发紧。

why.en: Allergy or hypersensitivity to glucagon is the contraindication.
why.zh: 对 glucagon 胰高血糖素过敏就是禁忌。

bad.en: You add an allergic reaction to a patient who already cannot protect her airway.
bad.zh: 病人本来就保护不了气道，你又给她加了一场过敏反应。

stem.en: Ali, 61, unresponsive on a fishing boat in Steveston. BGL 1.9. You gave 3 mg IN 15 minutes ago. No change. No IV access.
stem.zh: Ali，61 岁，在 Steveston 的渔船上叫不醒。BGL 1.9。15 分钟前你给了 3 mg 鼻内。没有变化。没有静脉通路。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Repeat 3 mg IN
opts.zh: 再给 3 mg 鼻内

opts.en: Wait another 15 minutes
opts.zh: 再等 15 分钟

opts.en: Put glucose gel in his mouth
opts.zh: 往他嘴里挤 glucose gel 葡萄糖凝胶

why.en: The IN dose is repeated after 15 minutes if there is no clinical response.
why.zh: 鼻内给药后 15 分钟没有临床反应，就重复给药。

s.en: IN glucagon may be repeated after 15 minutes if there is no clinical response.
s.zh: 鼻内 glucagon 胰高血糖素给药 15 分钟后没有临床反应，可以重复。

why.en: That is the repeat rule for the 3 mg IN dose.
why.zh: 这就是 3 mg 鼻内剂量的重复规则。

s.en: The IM dose of glucagon is 3 mg.
s.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素的 IM 剂量是 3 mg。

why.en: IM is 0.5 to 1 mg. The 3 mg dose is intranasal.
why.zh: IM 是 0.5–1 mg。3 mg 是鼻内剂量。

s.en: For a PCP, glucagon is the choice when IV access cannot be obtained.
s.zh: 对 PCP 来说，建不了静脉通路时就用 glucagon 胰高血糖素。

why.en: With an IV, D10W corrects the hypoglycemia (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 有静脉通路时用 D10W 10% 葡萄糖纠正低血糖（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

s.en: An alert hypoglycemic patient who can swallow should get glucagon first.
s.zh: 清醒、能吞咽的低血糖病人，应该先给 glucagon 胰高血糖素。

why.en: With enough mentation to maintain an airway, the protocol uses glucose gel (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 神志足以保护气道时，protocol 用 glucose gel 葡萄糖凝胶（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

q.en: The intranasal dose of glucagon is…
q.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素的鼻内剂量是…

opts.en: 3 mg IN, repeat after 15 minutes if no response
opts.zh: 3 mg 鼻内，15 分钟后没反应就重复

opts.en: 0.3 mg IN, repeat after 15 minutes if no response
opts.zh: 0.3 mg 鼻内，15 分钟后没反应就重复

opts.en: 3 mg IN, repeat every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 3 mg 鼻内，每 5 分钟重复

opts.en: 1 mg IN, one time only
opts.zh: 1 mg 鼻内，只给一次

why.en: IN is 3 mg, repeated after 15 minutes if there is no clinical response. IM is 0.5 to 1 mg.
why.zh: IN 是 3 mg，15 分钟后没有临床反应就重复。IM 是 0.5–1 mg。

q.en: How does glucagon raise blood sugar?
q.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素是怎么升血糖的？

opts.en: It speeds the breakdown of liver glycogen into glucose
opts.zh: 加快肝糖原分解成葡萄糖

opts.en: It puts glucose straight into the blood
opts.zh: 把葡萄糖直接送进血液

opts.en: It makes the gut absorb sugar faster
opts.zh: 让肠道更快吸收糖

opts.en: It makes the kidneys hold on to glucose
opts.zh: 让肾脏留住葡萄糖

why.en: It accelerates the breakdown of glycogen to glucose in the liver.
why.zh: 它加快肝脏里糖原分解成葡萄糖。

q.en: Which of these is on the cautions line for glucagon?
q.zh: 下面哪一项写在 glucagon 胰高血糖素的注意事项里？

opts.en: Nausea or vomiting
opts.zh: 恶心或呕吐

opts.en: Slow heart rate
opts.zh: 心率慢

opts.en: Urinary retention
opts.zh: 尿潴留

opts.en: Dry mouth
opts.zh: 口干

why.en: The line lists nausea or vomiting, hypokalemia, urticaria, respiratory distress and hypotension.
why.zh: 那一栏列的是恶心或呕吐、低钾血症、荨麻疹、呼吸窘迫和低血压。

cls.zh: 抗低血糖药，碳水化合物底物

hook.en: Sugar water into the vein for cells that have run dry.
hook.zh: 把糖水直接送进静脉，喂给断了粮的细胞。

how.en: It is glucose dissolved in water. Given IV, it is an immediate source of glucose and water for cells that have none left. For a short time it also pulls extra water out as urine, which is called osmotic diuresis.
how.zh: 它就是溶在水里的葡萄糖。静脉给药后，立刻给断粮的细胞提供葡萄糖和水。短时间内它还会把多余的水带到尿里排出，这叫渗透性利尿。

use.en: Suspected or known hypoglycemia
use.zh: 怀疑或已知的低血糖

use.en: Altered level of responsiveness
use.zh: 反应水平改变

use.en: Coma or seizure NYD (not yet diagnosed)
use.zh: 原因未明（NYD）的昏迷或抽搐

no.en: None listed in the exam monograph
no.zh: 考试专论没有列出禁忌症

care.en: Extravasation, which is fluid leaking out of the vein, causes tissue necrosis.
care.zh: 外渗（药液漏到血管外）会造成组织坏死。

care.en: The protocol corrects confirmed hypoglycemia, so get a blood glucose level first (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
care.zh: protocol 纠正的是确认的低血糖，所以先测血糖（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

care.en: No IV access: the protocol gives glucagon instead (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
care.zh: 建不了静脉通路：protocol 改用 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

dose.en: 10 to 25 g IV, which is 100 to 250 mL of the 10% solution
Route: IV only
dose.zh: 途径：只能 IV

dose.en: PCP: obtain vascular access, then correct confirmed hypoglycemia (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies)
dose.zh: PCP：先建立静脉通路，再纠正确认的低血糖（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）

dose.en: Transport after the first dose has been given (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies)
dose.zh: 给完第一剂后转运（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）

dose.en: No separate pediatric dose is given in the exam monograph
dose.zh: 考试专论没有单独给出儿童剂量

fx.en: Tissue necrosis if it leaks out of the vein (extravasation)
fx.zh: 漏到血管外（外渗）会造成组织坏死

pk.en: IV onset is immediate.
pk.zh: 静脉给药立即起效。

pearl.en: Contraindications: none. The danger is the IV itself. Dextrose outside the vein kills tissue, so make sure the line is working before you open it.
pearl.zh: 禁忌症：无。危险在静脉通路本身。葡萄糖漏到血管外会让组织坏死，所以开放输液前先确认通路是好的。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): same adult dose, 10 to 25 g IV. BCEHS adds a PCP dose of 5 mL/kg for patients over 12 years old, given over 5 to 15 minutes, repeatable once, and lists hypoglycemia as the only indication.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：成人剂量相同，10–25 g 静脉。BCEHS 另有 PCP 可用的按体重剂量：12 岁以上 5 mL/kg，5–15 分钟输完，可重复一次。BCEHS 的适应症只有低血糖一项。

stem.en: Sam, 47, known diabetic, confused and sweaty at a Kelowna vineyard. BGL 2.1. Your IV in his forearm flushes easily.
stem.zh: Sam，47 岁，已知糖尿病，在 Kelowna 的葡萄园里神志不清、出冷汗。BGL 2.1。你在他前臂建的静脉通路冲管很顺。

why.en: Confirmed hypoglycemia and a working IV. There are no contraindications. Give 10 to 25 g of D10W.
why.zh: 确认低血糖，静脉通路通畅。没有任何禁忌症。给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖 10–25 g。

bad.en: His brain keeps running without fuel while you wait.
bad.zh: 你在等的时候，他的大脑一直在断粮。

stem.en: Mei, 64, drowsy, BGL 2.6. Her only IV, in the hand, is puffy and cool, and the drip has slowed to nothing.
stem.zh: Mei，64 岁，嗜睡，BGL 2.6。她只有手背上这一条静脉通路，穿刺点又肿又凉，滴速已经慢到停了。

why.en: This line is no longer in the vein. Extravasation of D10W causes tissue necrosis, so do not run it through this site. Get new IV access, or give glucagon if you cannot (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 这条通路已经不在血管里了。D10W 10% 葡萄糖外渗会造成组织坏死，不能从这个部位输。重新建立静脉通路，建不了就给 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

bad.en: Dextrose pools under the skin of her hand and the tissue dies.
bad.zh: 葡萄糖积在她手背皮下，组织坏死。

stem.en: Rosa, 70, unresponsive in a Richmond care home. BGL 1.8. Two IV attempts have failed. Her veins are tiny.
stem.zh: Rosa，70 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院里叫不醒。BGL 1.8。两次静脉穿刺都失败了，血管很细。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Give glucagon
opts.zh: 给 glucagon 胰高血糖素

opts.en: Keep trying for an IV until one works
opts.zh: 继续扎，直到扎上为止

opts.en: Squeeze glucose gel into her mouth
opts.zh: 往她嘴里挤 glucose gel 葡萄糖凝胶

why.en: When IV access cannot be obtained, the protocol gives glucagon (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies). Gel needs a patient who can maintain an airway.
why.zh: 建不了静脉通路时，protocol 改用 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。glucose gel 葡萄糖凝胶只能给能自己保护气道的病人。

bad.en: Every failed poke is more time at a blood sugar of 1.8.
bad.zh: 每多扎一针失败，她就在 1.8 的血糖上多耗一会儿。

stem.en: Arjun, 55, BGL 1.9, responds only to pain. IV running well in his left arm.
stem.zh: Arjun，55 岁，BGL 1.9，只对疼痛有反应。左臂静脉通路滴得很好。

ask.en: How much D10W?

opts.en: 10 to 25 mL (1 to 2.5 g)
1,000 mL, run wide open
opts.zh: 1,000 mL，全速滴

why.en: The dose is 10 to 25 g. In the 10% solution that is 100 to 250 mL.
why.zh: 剂量是 10–25 g，换成 10% 溶液就是 100–250 mL。

s.en: D10W has no contraindications in the exam monograph.
s.zh: 考试专论里，D10W 10% 葡萄糖没有禁忌症。

why.en: The contraindications line says none.
why.zh: 禁忌症一栏写的是“无”。

s.en: If the IV fails, D10W can be given IM.
s.zh: 静脉通路失败时，D10W 10% 葡萄糖可以改肌注。

why.en: The route is IV. Without IV access the protocol uses glucagon (p.57, Diabetic Emergencies).
why.zh: 途径是 IV。没有静脉通路时 protocol 用 glucagon 胰高血糖素（p.57，Diabetic Emergencies 糖尿病急症）。

s.en: A seizure with no known cause is an indication for D10W.
s.zh: 原因不明的抽搐是 D10W 10% 葡萄糖的适应症。

why.en: Coma or seizure NYD is on the indication list.
why.zh: 原因未明（NYD）的昏迷或抽搐列在适应症里。

s.en: A little D10W leaking under the skin is harmless.
s.zh: 一点点 D10W 10% 葡萄糖漏到皮下没关系。

why.en: Extravasation causes tissue necrosis.
why.zh: 外渗会造成组织坏死。

q.en: The dose of D10W is…
q.zh: D10W 10% 葡萄糖的剂量是…

opts.en: 10 to 25 g IV (100 to 250 mL)
10 to 25 mL IV (1 to 2.5 g)
100 to 250 g IV (1 to 2.5 L)
10 to 25 g IM (100 to 250 mL)

why.en: 10 to 25 g is 100 to 250 mL of the 10% solution, and the route is IV.
why.zh: 10–25 g 就是 10% 溶液 100–250 mL，途径是 IV。

q.en: What does D10W do?
q.zh: D10W 10% 葡萄糖起什么作用？

opts.en: It gives cells an immediate source of glucose and water
opts.zh: 立刻给细胞提供葡萄糖和水

opts.en: It makes the liver break down stored glycogen
opts.zh: 让肝脏分解储存的糖原

opts.en: It makes the pancreas release insulin
opts.zh: 让胰腺释放胰岛素

opts.en: It slows the absorption of sugar from the gut
opts.zh: 减慢肠道对糖的吸收

why.en: It is the glucose itself, delivered straight into the blood.
why.zh: 它本身就是葡萄糖，直接送进血液。

cls.zh: 麻醉性镇痛药（阿片类）拮抗剂

hook.en: Pushes opioids off their receptors so the patient breathes again.
hook.zh: 把阿片类药物从受体上挤走，让病人重新呼吸。

how.en: Opioids sit on receptors and turn the breathing down. Naloxone competes for the same receptor sites and takes the opioid's place. That reverses the respiratory depression, the sedation and the low blood pressure.
how.zh: 阿片类药物占住受体，把呼吸压下去。naloxone 纳洛酮去抢同一个受体位点，把阿片类药物顶掉。这样就逆转了呼吸抑制、镇静和低血压。

use.en: Respiratory depression or depressed mental status from actual or suspected narcotic use
use.zh: 确定或怀疑用了麻醉性镇痛药（阿片类）之后出现的呼吸抑制或意识受抑制

no.en: Allergy or known hypersensitivity
no.zh: 过敏或已知的超敏反应

noFake.en: You do not know which drug was taken
noFake.zh: 不知道病人用的是什么药

care.en: The patient may become combative.
care.zh: 病人可能变得躁动、有攻击性。

care.en: It may precipitate withdrawal symptoms.
care.zh: 可能诱发戒断症状。

care.en: Airway, ventilation and oxygen come before naloxone (p.56, Suspected Narcotic Overdose).
care.zh: 气道、通气和给氧排在 naloxone 纳洛酮前面（p.56，Suspected Narcotic Overdose）。

care.en: The protocol lists a blood glucose check, with correction at 4 mmol/L or lower, ahead of naloxone (p.56, Suspected Narcotic Overdose).
care.zh: 方案把测血糖排在 naloxone 纳洛酮前面，4 mmol/L 或更低要先纠正（p.56，Suspected Narcotic Overdose）。

dose.en: First dose: 0.4 mg IM or IV
dose.zh: 第一剂：0.4 mg，IM 或 IV

dose.en: After 3 minutes, if SpO2 94% or higher and ventilating more than 10 are not reached: 0.4 mg again
dose.zh: 3 分钟后，如果还没达到 SpO2 94% 或以上、通气超过 10：再给 0.4 mg

dose.en: After 3 more minutes, still not reached: 0.8 mg
dose.zh: 再过 3 分钟还没达到：0.8 mg

dose.en: After 3 more minutes, still not reached: 2 mg
dose.zh: 再过 3 分钟还没达到：2 mg

dose.en: Intranasal: 4 mg IN
dose.zh: 鼻内给药：4 mg IN

dose.en: IV is a PCP step: with continued unconsciousness and apnea, consider vascular access and IV naloxone (p.56, Suspected Narcotic Overdose)
dose.zh: IV 是 PCP 的处置：病人持续昏迷、没有呼吸时，考虑建立静脉通路，从静脉给 naloxone 纳洛酮（p.56，Suspected Narcotic Overdose）

fx.en: Combativeness as the narcotic effect is reversed
fx.zh: 阿片类药物的作用被逆转后，病人躁动、有攻击性

fx.en: Signs and symptoms of severe drug withdrawal
fx.zh: 严重戒断反应的各种表现

pk.en: Onset: 1 minute IV, 3 minutes IM, 3 minutes IN.
pk.zh: 起效：IV 1 分钟，IM 3 分钟，IN 3 分钟。

pearl.en: You are treating the breathing, not the sleeping. The target is SpO2 94% or higher and ventilating more than 10. Stop climbing the ladder when you get there.
pearl.zh: 你治的是呼吸，不是把人叫醒。目标是 SpO2 94% 或以上、通气超过 10。达到了就别再往上加。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the same ladder of 0.4, 0.4, 0.8 and 2 mg every 3 minutes stops at 4 doses, then you consult CliniCall. An EMR gives it IM only. Neonates are a contraindication and a child gets 0.1 mg/kg IM. The exam monograph has no cap and no child dose, and it lists 4 mg IN. BCEHS has IN only as an FR option, with no dose in mg. The exam indication also includes depressed mental status, and BCEHS lists respiratory depression only.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：同样的阶梯（0.4、0.4、0.8、2 mg，每 3 分钟一次）到第 4 剂为止，还要再给就先咨询 CliniCall。EMR 只能 IM。新生儿是禁忌，儿童给 0.1 mg/kg IM。考试专论没有次数上限，没有儿童剂量，并且列了 4 mg IN。BCEHS 只在 FR 一级把 IN 列为可选，没有写 mg 剂量。考试的适应症还包括意识受抑制，BCEHS 只列了呼吸抑制。

stem.en: Tyler, 26, slumped in a Downtown Eastside stairwell. Pinpoint pupils, 6 breaths a minute, SpO2 82%. Your partner is bagging him. Glucose 5.8.
stem.zh: Tyler，26 岁，瘫坐在 Downtown Eastside 的楼梯间里。针尖样瞳孔，每分钟呼吸 6 次，SpO2 82%。你的搭档正在用球囊面罩给他通气。血糖 5.8。

why.en: Suspected narcotic use with respiratory depression. Airway and ventilation are covered and the glucose is fine. Give 0.4 mg IM.
why.zh: 怀疑用了阿片类药物，而且有呼吸抑制。气道和通气有人管，血糖也正常。给 0.4 mg IM。

bad.en: He stays on the bag-valve mask while the opioid keeps his own breathing switched off.
bad.zh: 他只能一直靠球囊面罩，阿片类药物继续压着他自己的呼吸。

stem.en: Dana, 33, got 0.4 mg IM three minutes ago. Now SpO2 96% on oxygen, ventilating at 14. Eyes closed, rouses to voice, then drifts off.
stem.zh: Dana，33 岁，三分钟前打了 0.4 mg IM。现在吸着氧 SpO2 96%，通气 14。闭着眼，叫她能醒，过一会儿又睡过去。

why.en: The target is met: SpO2 94% or higher and ventilating more than 10. The next dose is only for a patient who has not reached it.
why.zh: 目标已经达到：SpO2 94% 或以上，通气超过 10。下一剂只给还没达标的病人。

bad.en: More naloxone can tip her into withdrawal: vomiting, sweating and combative in your ambulance.
bad.zh: 再给 naloxone 纳洛酮可能把她推进戒断反应：在你的救护车里呕吐、出汗、躁动。

stem.en: Sam, 40, blue and not breathing in a Surrey parking lot, a needle beside him. Naloxone is in your hand. The BVM is in the bag at your feet.
stem.zh: Sam，40 岁，在 Surrey 的停车场里发紫、没有呼吸，身边有个针头。naloxone 纳洛酮在你手里，球囊面罩在脚边的包里。

ask.en: What comes first?

opts.en: Open the airway and ventilate him
opts.zh: 开放气道，给他通气

opts.en: Naloxone 0.4 mg IM
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮 0.4 mg IM

opts.en: Naloxone 4 mg IN
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮 4 mg IN

why.en: The protocol puts airway, ventilation and oxygen ahead of naloxone (p.56, Suspected Narcotic Overdose).
why.zh: 方案把气道、通气和给氧排在 naloxone 纳洛酮前面（p.56，Suspected Narcotic Overdose）。

bad.en: Naloxone needs minutes to work. Without ventilation his brain spends those minutes with no oxygen.
bad.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮要几分钟才起效。不通气的话，这几分钟他的大脑一直缺氧。

stem.en: Kim, 29, has had 0.4 mg IM twice, three minutes apart. Three more minutes have passed. With bagging, 4 breaths of her own a minute, SpO2 88%.
stem.zh: Kim，29 岁，已经打过两次 0.4 mg IM，间隔三分钟。现在又过了三分钟。在球囊通气下，她自己每分钟只呼吸 4 次，SpO2 88%。

ask.en: What is the next dose?

opts.en: 0.8 mg IM
opts.zh: 给 0.8 mg IM

opts.en: 0.4 mg IM again
opts.zh: 再给一次 0.4 mg IM

opts.en: 2 mg IM
opts.zh: 给 2 mg IM

why.en: The ladder is 0.4, then 0.4, then 0.8, then 2 mg, with 3 minutes between steps.
why.zh: 阶梯是 0.4、0.4、0.8、2 mg，每一级之间隔 3 分钟。

s.en: Repeat doses of naloxone continue until the patient is awake and talking.
s.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮要一直重复给，直到病人醒过来、能说话。

why.en: A repeat dose is for a patient who has not reached SpO2 94% or higher and ventilating more than 10.
why.zh: 重复给药只针对还没达到 SpO2 94% 或以上、通气超过 10 的病人。

s.en: The second dose is the same size as the first.
s.zh: 第二剂和第一剂一样大。

why.en: 0.4 mg, then 0.4 mg again. The third step is 0.8 mg and the fourth is 2 mg.
why.zh: 0.4 mg，然后再 0.4 mg。第三级是 0.8 mg，第四级是 2 mg。

s.en: You must know which opioid was taken before you give naloxone.
s.zh: 必须先弄清楚用的是哪种阿片类药物，才能给 naloxone 纳洛酮。

why.en: Actual or suspected narcotic use is enough.
why.zh: 确定用了或怀疑用了，都够条件。

s.en: IV naloxone works faster than IM or IN.
s.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮 IV 比 IM 或 IN 起效快。

why.en: Onset is 1 minute IV and 3 minutes IM or IN.
why.zh: IV 1 分钟起效，IM 或 IN 3 分钟。

q.en: The first dose of naloxone IM is…
q.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮 IM 的第一剂是…

opts.en: 0.4 mg
opts.zh: 给 0.4 mg

opts.en: 4 mg
opts.zh: 给 4 mg
给 0.04 mg

opts.en: 2 mg
opts.zh: 给 2 mg

why.en: 0.4 mg IM or IV to start. The 4 mg dose is intranasal.
why.zh: 先给 0.4 mg，IM 或 IV。4 mg 是鼻内给药的剂量。

q.en: How long do you wait before the next dose of naloxone?
q.zh: 下一剂 naloxone 纳洛酮要等多久？

opts.en: 3 minutes
opts.zh: 3 分钟

opts.en: 30 seconds
10 minutes
opts.zh: 10 分钟

opts.en: 1 minute
opts.zh: 1 分钟

why.en: Each step comes after 3 minutes, and only if the breathing target has not been reached.
why.zh: 每一级都隔 3 分钟，而且只在呼吸目标还没达到时才给。

q.en: Which is a listed adverse effect of naloxone?
q.zh: 下面哪一项是 naloxone 纳洛酮列出的不良反应？

opts.en: Combativeness and withdrawal symptoms
opts.zh: 躁动攻击和戒断症状

opts.en: Deeper sedation
opts.zh: 镇静加深

opts.en: A slow heart rate
opts.zh: 心率变慢

opts.en: Low blood sugar
opts.zh: 低血糖

why.en: Reversal can bring combativeness, severe withdrawal, vomiting, sweating and tachycardia.
why.zh: 逆转之后可能出现躁动、严重戒断、呕吐、出汗和心动过速。

cls.zh: 拟交感神经药

hook.en: Tightens the vessels, drives the heart, opens the airways.
hook.zh: 收紧血管，推动心脏，打开气道。

how.en: It switches on three kinds of receptor. α1 tightens the blood vessels. β1 makes the heart beat faster and harder. β2 relaxes the airways so air can move again.
how.zh: 它同时打开三种受体。α1 让血管收紧。β1 让心跳更快、更有力。β2 让气道放松，空气重新进出。

use.en: Anaphylaxis
use.zh: 严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）

use.en: Severe bronchospasm with impending arrest (PCP)
use.zh: 严重支气管痉挛、即将停止呼吸心跳（PCP）

no.en: None listed. The monograph says there are no absolute contraindications to epinephrine in life-threatening situations such as anaphylaxis.
no.zh: 未列出。专论写明：在严重过敏反应这类危及生命的情况下，epinephrine 肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌症。

care.en: Further hypotension if it is administered too quickly.
care.zh: 给得太快会让血压进一步下降。

care.en: The severe bronchospasm dose is PCP only.
care.zh: 严重支气管痉挛的剂量只有 PCP 可以给。

care.en: Bronchospasm: consider it when SpO2 is below 90% or moderate to severe symptoms are unresolved with salbutamol (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD).
care.zh: 支气管痉挛：SpO2 低于 90%，或用了 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇后中到重度症状没有缓解时，考虑使用（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD 哮喘/COPD 呼吸困难）。

care.en: Anaphylaxis: position the patient supine and do not walk them (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
care.zh: 严重过敏反应：让病人平躺，不要让病人走路（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。

care.en: PCP: treat bronchospasm with salbutamol after epinephrine has been given (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
care.zh: PCP：给完 epinephrine 肾上腺素之后，再用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。

dose.en: Anaphylaxis: 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes. May repeat up to 3 times.
dose.zh: 严重过敏反应：0.5 mg 肌注，每 5 分钟一次。最多可重复 3 次。

dose.en: Anaphylaxis: 0.01 mg/kg IM, to a maximum of 0.5 mg. May repeat up to 3 times.
dose.zh: 严重过敏反应：0.01 mg/kg 肌注，上限 0.5 mg。最多可重复 3 次。

dose.en: PCP: severe bronchospasm with impending arrest: 0.5 mg IM every 5 to 20 minutes
dose.zh: PCP：严重支气管痉挛、即将停止呼吸心跳：0.5 mg 肌注，每 5–20 分钟一次

dose.en: PCP: severe bronchospasm with impending arrest: 0.01 mg/kg IM, to a maximum of 0.5 mg
dose.zh: PCP：严重支气管痉挛、即将停止呼吸心跳：0.01 mg/kg 肌注，上限 0.5 mg

dose.en: Route: IM
dose.zh: 途径：IM（肌注）

fx.en: Further hypotension if given too quickly
fx.zh: 给得太快时血压进一步下降

pk.en: IM works in 5 to 15 minutes. IV is immediate.
pk.zh: 肌注 5–15 分钟起效。静脉立即起效。

pearl.en: In anaphylaxis nothing in the history stops you. The monograph gives no absolute contraindications. Know the two clocks: every 5 minutes for anaphylaxis, every 5 to 20 minutes for severe bronchospasm.
pearl.zh: 严重过敏反应时，病史里没有任何一条能拦住你。专论写明没有绝对禁忌症。记住两个钟：严重过敏反应每 5 分钟一次，严重支气管痉挛每 5–20 分钟一次。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the IM doses are the same. BCEHS recommends a CliniCall consult before the bronchospasm dose, and PCPs can also give 5 mg by nebulizer for croup stridor in children over 6 months. The exam monograph has neither.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：肌注剂量相同。BCEHS 建议给支气管痉挛剂量之前先咨询 CliniCall。PCP 还可以给 6 个月以上 croup（哮吼）喘鸣的儿童雾化 5 mg。考试专论两样都没有。

stem.en: George, 72, wasp sting in a Penticton orchard. Hives, wheeze, BP 78/44, HR 118. He has angina and a coronary stent.
stem.zh: George，72 岁，在 Penticton 的果园里被黄蜂蜇了。荨麻疹，喘鸣，血压 78/44，心率 118。他有心绞痛，放过冠脉支架。

why.en: This is unstable anaphylaxis. There are no absolute contraindications in a life-threatening situation. Give 0.5 mg IM.
why.zh: 这是不稳定的严重过敏反应。危及生命时没有绝对禁忌症。肌注 0.5 mg。

bad.en: His pressure keeps falling and his airway keeps closing while you worry about his heart.
bad.zh: 你在担心他的心脏，他的血压继续掉、气道继续关。

stem.en: Ella, 25, bee sting on the forearm at Jericho Beach. A red swollen patch with a few hives around it. Breathing easily, BP 122/76, alert.
stem.zh: Ella，25 岁，在 Jericho Beach 前臂被蜜蜂蜇了。蜇伤处红肿一片，周围有几个风团。呼吸轻松，血压 122/76，清醒。

why.en: The anaphylaxis protocol needs an unstable patient: syncope, decreased LOC, BP below 90 or respiratory distress (p.55, Anaphylaxis). She has none of these.
why.zh: Anaphylaxis（严重过敏反应）protocol 要求病人不稳定：晕厥、意识下降、血压低于 90 或呼吸窘迫（p.55）。她一项都没有。

bad.en: She gets a pounding heart from a drug she did not need.
bad.zh: 她挨了一针不需要的药，换来心跳砰砰。

stem.en: Hana, 30, peanut anaphylaxis at a Burnaby food court. Her first 0.5 mg IM went in 5 minutes ago. Still wheezing, BP 84/50.
stem.zh: Hana，30 岁，在 Burnaby 的美食广场花生过敏。第一针 0.5 mg 肌注是 5 分钟前打的。还在喘，血压 84/50。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Give a second 0.5 mg IM now
opts.zh: 现在肌注第二针 0.5 mg

opts.en: Wait 20 minutes, then repeat
opts.zh: 等 20 分钟再重复

opts.en: Stop epinephrine and give only diphenhydramine
opts.zh: 停用 epinephrine 肾上腺素，只给 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明

why.en: In anaphylaxis the dose is every 5 minutes and may be repeated up to 3 times.
why.zh: 严重过敏反应时每 5 分钟一次，最多可重复 3 次。

bad.en: She stays hypotensive and wheezing for 15 more minutes for no reason.
bad.zh: 她白白多挨 15 分钟的低血压和喘鸣。

stem.en: Mia, 4, 16 kg, swollen face and stridor after cashews at a Vancouver daycare. Pale and floppy.
stem.zh: Mia，4 岁，16 kg，在 Vancouver 的托儿所吃了腰果后脸肿、喘鸣。面色苍白，全身发软。

ask.en: Which dose?

opts.en: 0.16 mg IM
opts.zh: 肌注 0.16 mg

opts.en: 0.5 mg IM
opts.zh: 肌注 0.5 mg

opts.en: 1.6 mg IM
opts.zh: 肌注 1.6 mg

why.en: The child dose is 0.01 mg/kg IM, to a maximum of 0.5 mg.
why.zh: 儿童剂量是 0.01 mg/kg 肌注，上限 0.5 mg。

s.en: In life-threatening anaphylaxis, epinephrine has no absolute contraindications.
s.zh: 危及生命的严重过敏反应中，epinephrine 肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌症。

why.en: The monograph says so directly.
why.zh: 专论就是这么写的。

s.en: The pediatric dose is 0.1 mg/kg IM.
s.zh: 儿童剂量是 0.1 mg/kg 肌注。

why.en: It is 0.01 mg/kg IM, to a maximum of 0.5 mg.
why.zh: 是 0.01 mg/kg 肌注，上限 0.5 mg。

s.en: For severe bronchospasm with impending arrest, a PCP gives an adult 0.5 mg IM every 5 to 20 minutes.
s.zh: 严重支气管痉挛、即将停止呼吸心跳时，PCP 给成人 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5–20 分钟一次。

why.en: That interval is wider than the 5 minutes used in anaphylaxis.
why.zh: 这个间隔比严重过敏反应的 5 分钟要宽。

s.en: In anaphylaxis, treat the wheeze with salbutamol first and give epinephrine after.
s.zh: 严重过敏反应时，先用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇治喘，然后再给 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

why.en: Salbutamol treats bronchospasm after epinephrine has been given (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
why.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇是在给完 epinephrine 肾上腺素之后才用来处理支气管痉挛的（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。

q.en: The adult dose of epinephrine in anaphylaxis is…
q.zh: 严重过敏反应时，epinephrine 肾上腺素的成人剂量是…

opts.en: 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, may repeat up to 3 times
opts.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次

opts.en: 5 mg IM every 5 minutes, may repeat up to 3 times
opts.zh: 5 mg 肌注，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次

opts.en: 0.5 mg IV push every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 0.5 mg 静脉推注，每 5 分钟一次

opts.en: 0.5 mg IM once, with no repeat
opts.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注一次，不重复

why.en: 0.5 mg IM, every 5 minutes, with up to 3 repeats.
why.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次。

q.en: Which receptor effect opens the airways?
q.zh: 哪一种受体作用能打开气道？

opts.en: β2: bronchodilation
opts.zh: β2：支气管扩张

opts.en: α1: vasoconstriction
opts.zh: α1：血管收缩

opts.en: β1: faster heart rate
opts.zh: β1：心率加快

opts.en: β1: stronger heart contraction
opts.zh: β1：心脏收缩更有力

why.en: β2 is bronchodilation. α1 tightens the vessels and β1 drives the heart.
why.zh: β2 是支气管扩张。α1 收紧血管，β1 推动心脏。

q.en: In asthma or COPD, when should a PCP consider IM epinephrine?
q.zh: 哮喘或 COPD 时，PCP 什么时候考虑肌注 epinephrine 肾上腺素？

opts.en: SpO2 below 90% or symptoms unresolved with salbutamol
opts.zh: SpO2 低于 90%，或用了 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇症状没有缓解

opts.en: As the first drug, before any salbutamol
opts.zh: 作为第一个药，在 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇之前

opts.en: Only after dexamethasone has had an hour to work
opts.zh: 必须等 dexamethasone 地塞米松起效一小时之后

opts.en: Whenever a wheeze can be heard
opts.zh: 只要听到喘鸣就给

why.en: The protocol names SpO2 below 90% or moderate to severe bronchospasm unresolved with salbutamol (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD).
why.zh: protocol 写的是 SpO2 低于 90%，或用了 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇后中到重度支气管痉挛没有缓解（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD 哮喘/COPD 呼吸困难）。

cls.zh: 支气管扩张药，拟交感神经药

hook.en: Relaxes the muscle around the airways so air can move.
hook.zh: 让气道周围的肌肉放松，气就能进出了。

how.en: It switches on beta-2 receptors, which relaxes the muscle around the airways. The airways widen and air moves again. Blood vessels widen a little too, and repeated doses begin to reach the beta-1 receptors of the heart.
how.zh: 它激活 β2 受体，让气道周围的肌肉放松。气道变宽，气流恢复。血管也会稍微扩张，反复给药后还会开始影响心脏上的 β1 受体。

use.en: Bronchospasm with asthma, bronchitis or emphysema
use.zh: 哮喘、支气管炎或肺气肿引起的支气管痉挛

use.en: Bronchospasm and wheezing from other causes, such as anaphylaxis
use.zh: 其他原因（比如严重过敏反应）引起的支气管痉挛和喘鸣

no.en: Known hypersensitivity or allergy to salbutamol
no.zh: 已知对 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过敏

noFake.en: An infant under one year (there is a smaller dose)
noFake.zh: 不满一岁的婴儿（有更小的剂量）

noFake.en: Used their own puffer an hour ago
noFake.zh: 一小时前自己用过吸入器

noFake.en: Influenza-like illness (use the MDI and spacer)
noFake.zh: 有流感样症状（改用 MDI 加储雾罐）

care.en: Caution in coronary disease.
care.zh: 冠心病病人慎用。

care.en: Caution in COPD patients with degenerative heart disease.
care.zh: 合并退行性心脏病的 COPD 病人慎用。

care.en: Caution in diabetes.
care.zh: 糖尿病病人慎用。

care.en: In anaphylaxis, salbutamol treats the bronchospasm only after epinephrine has been given, and it is a PCP step (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
care.zh: 严重过敏反应时，要先给了 epinephrine 肾上腺素，才用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛，而且这是 PCP 的处置（p.55，Anaphylaxis）。

care.en: Signs of influenza-like illness or another infectious respiratory condition: MDI and spacer strongly recommended (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD).
care.zh: 有流感样症状或其他呼吸道传染病迹象：强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD）。

dose.en: Nebulizer, age over 1 year: 5 mg, repeat as required
dose.zh: 雾化，1 岁以上：5 mg，按需重复

dose.en: Nebulizer, age under 1 year: 2.5 mg, repeat as required
dose.zh: 雾化，不满 1 岁：2.5 mg，按需重复

dose.en: MDI: 4 sprays of 100 mcg, repeat as required
dose.zh: MDI：4 喷，每喷 100 mcg，按需重复

dose.en: MDI, 10 to 20 kg: 5 sprays of 100 mcg per course, may repeat up to 3 times
dose.zh: MDI，10–20 kg：每个疗程 5 喷，每喷 100 mcg，最多重复 3 次

dose.en: MDI, over 20 kg: 10 sprays of 100 mcg per course, may repeat up to 3 times
dose.zh: MDI，超过 20 kg：每个疗程 10 喷，每喷 100 mcg，最多重复 3 次

dose.en: MDI, under 10 kg: not indicated
dose.zh: MDI，不到 10 kg：不适用

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: Starts working in 5 minutes.
pk.zh: 5 分钟起效。

pearl.en: Salbutamol repeats as required. In anaphylaxis it is never first: epinephrine goes in, then salbutamol for the wheeze.
pearl.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇可以按需重复。严重过敏反应时它永远不是第一个：先给 epinephrine 肾上腺素，再用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇处理喘鸣。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the doses are the same. BCEHS tells you to stop if the heart rate goes above 150 (200 in children), or with severe tremors or ventricular arrhythmias. The exam monograph has no stop rule. It lists coronary disease, diabetes and COPD with heart disease as cautions, which BCEHS does not.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：剂量一样。BCEHS 规定心率超过 150（儿童 200）、出现严重震颤或室性心律失常时要停药。考试专论没有停药规定。考试把冠心病、糖尿病和合并心脏病的 COPD 列为慎用，BCEHS 没有列。

stem.en: Aiden, 9, 30 kg, asthma attack at a Coquitlam hockey rink. Wheezing, short sentences, SpO2 92%. No allergies. No cough or fever.
stem.zh: Aiden，9 岁，30 kg，在 Coquitlam 的冰球馆里哮喘发作。喘鸣，只能说短句，SpO2 92%。没有过敏史。没有咳嗽，也不发烧。

why.en: Bronchospasm with asthma and no allergy to salbutamol. Give 5 mg by nebulizer, then transport after the first dose if not already done (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD).
why.zh: 哮喘引起的支气管痉挛，对 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇不过敏。雾化给 5 mg，还没出发的话第一剂之后就转运（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD）。

bad.en: His airways keep tightening and he tires out.
bad.zh: 他的气道越收越紧，人也越来越累。

stem.en: Hannah, 30, asthma, wheezing at her desk in a Burnaby office. She says Ventolin gave her hives and a swollen face last year.
stem.zh: Hannah，30 岁，哮喘，在 Burnaby 的办公室里喘鸣。她说去年用 Ventolin 后起了荨麻疹，脸也肿了。

why.en: Ventolin is salbutamol. Known hypersensitivity or allergy to salbutamol is the one contraindication.
why.zh: Ventolin 就是 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。已知对 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过敏是唯一的禁忌。

bad.en: You add an allergic reaction, perhaps with airway swelling, to an asthma attack.
bad.zh: 你在哮喘发作上又加了一场过敏反应，气道还可能肿起来。

stem.en: Sophie, 22, stung by a wasp at Jericho Beach. Hives, loud wheeze, BP 84/50. Nothing has been given yet. You are the PCP.
stem.zh: Sophie，22 岁，在 Jericho Beach 被黄蜂蜇了。荨麻疹，喘鸣很响，血压 84/50。还什么药都没给。你是 PCP。

ask.en: What goes in first?

opts.en: Epinephrine
opts.zh: epinephrine 肾上腺素

opts.en: Salbutamol by nebulizer
opts.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇雾化

opts.en: Salbutamol by MDI and spacer
opts.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇，MDI 加储雾罐

why.en: In anaphylaxis, bronchospasm is treated with salbutamol after epinephrine has been administered (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
why.zh: 严重过敏反应时，要先给了 epinephrine 肾上腺素，才用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛（p.55，Anaphylaxis）。

bad.en: Salbutamol does nothing for her blood pressure, and the minutes you spend on it are minutes without epinephrine.
bad.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇救不了她的血压，花在它身上的每一分钟，都是没给 epinephrine 肾上腺素的一分钟。

stem.en: Zoe, 3, 14 kg, wheezing with a runny nose and fever at home in Abbotsford. You choose the MDI and spacer.
stem.zh: Zoe，3 岁，14 kg，在 Abbotsford 的家里喘鸣，还流鼻涕、发烧。你决定用 MDI 加储雾罐。

ask.en: How many sprays in one course?

opts.en: 5 sprays of 100 mcg
opts.zh: 5 喷，每喷 100 mcg

opts.en: 10 sprays of 100 mcg
opts.zh: 10 喷，每喷 100 mcg

opts.en: 4 sprays of 100 mcg
opts.zh: 4 喷，每喷 100 mcg

why.en: From 10 to 20 kg a course is 5 sprays of 100 mcg. It may be repeated up to 3 times.
why.zh: 10–20 kg，一个疗程是 5 喷、每喷 100 mcg。最多重复 3 次。

s.en: Salbutamol by nebulizer may be repeated as required.
s.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇雾化可以按需重复。

why.en: Nebulize, repeat as required. Only ipratropium is a single dose.
why.zh: 雾化，按需重复。只给一次的是 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵。

s.en: Diabetes is a contraindication to salbutamol.
s.zh: 糖尿病是 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的禁忌。

why.en: It is a caution, together with coronary disease.
why.zh: 它是慎用，和冠心病列在一起。

s.en: A baby under 1 year gets 2.5 mg by nebulizer, half the usual dose.
s.zh: 不满 1 岁的婴儿雾化给 2.5 mg，是常规剂量的一半。

why.en: Under 1 year 2.5 mg. Over 1 year 5 mg.
why.zh: 不满 1 岁 2.5 mg。1 岁以上 5 mg。

s.en: Finish three nebulizers on scene before you start to transport.
s.zh: 在现场做完三次雾化再开始转运。

why.en: Transport after the first dose if not already done (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD).
why.zh: 还没出发的话，第一剂之后就转运（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD）。

q.en: The adult MDI dose of salbutamol is…
q.zh: 成人用 MDI 时，salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的剂量是…

opts.en: 4 sprays of 100 mcg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 4 喷，每喷 100 mcg，按需重复

opts.en: 8 sprays of 20 mcg, single dose
opts.zh: 8 喷，每喷 20 mcg，只给一次

opts.en: 4 sprays of 100 mcg, once only
opts.zh: 4 喷，每喷 100 mcg，只给一次

opts.en: 40 sprays of 100 mcg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 40 喷，每喷 100 mcg，按需重复

why.en: 4 x 100 mcg by metered dose inhaler, repeated as required.
why.zh: MDI 4 喷、每喷 100 mcg，按需重复。

q.en: By nebulizer, a patient older than 1 year gets…
q.zh: 雾化时，1 岁以上的病人给…

opts.en: 5 mg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 5 mg，按需重复

opts.en: 2.5 mg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 2.5 mg，按需重复

opts.en: 500 mcg, single dose
opts.zh: 500 mcg，只给一次

opts.en: 50 mg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 50 mg，按需重复

why.en: 5 mg over 1 year of age. 2.5 mg under 1 year.
why.zh: 1 岁以上 5 mg。不满 1 岁 2.5 mg。

q.en: Salbutamol opens the airways by…
q.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇打开气道的方式是…

opts.en: Stimulating beta-2 receptors
opts.zh: 激动 β2 受体

opts.en: Blocking acetylcholine
opts.zh: 阻断乙酰胆碱

opts.en: Blocking histamine
opts.zh: 阻断组胺

opts.en: Reducing inflammation like a steroid
opts.zh: 像激素一样减轻炎症

why.en: Selective beta-2 stimulation relaxes the airway muscle. Repeated doses add some beta-1 effects.
why.zh: 选择性激动 β2 受体，让气道肌肉放松。反复给药会带来一些 β1 效应。

cls.zh: 抗胆碱能支气管扩张药

hook.en: Salbutamol's partner. Opens tight airways in a second way.
hook.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的搭档，用另一种方式把收紧的气道打开。

how.en: Acetylcholine is a signal that tells the muscle around the airways to tighten. Ipratropium blocks that signal in the bronchial smooth muscle. The muscle relaxes and the airways open.
how.zh: 乙酰胆碱是让气道周围肌肉收紧的信号。ipratropium 异丙托溴铵在支气管平滑肌上挡住这个信号。肌肉放松，气道就张开。

use.en: Severe bronchospasm in asthma
use.zh: 哮喘的严重支气管痉挛

use.en: Severe bronchospasm in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
use.zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的严重支气管痉挛

no.en: Known hypersensitivity to ipratropium or any component of the formulation
no.zh: 已知对 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵或制剂里任何成分过敏

no.en: Neonates under 30 days old (stated in the pediatric dose section)
no.zh: 出生不满 30 天的新生儿（写在儿童剂量部分）

noFake.zh: 已经给过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇

noFake.en: Influenza-like illness (use the MDI and spacer)
noFake.zh: 有流感样症状（改用 MDI 加储雾罐）

care.en: It works together with salbutamol and is not indicated alone for acute bronchospasm.
care.zh: 它是和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇配合起效的，急性支气管痉挛不能单独用它。

care.en: Narrow-angle glaucoma: it may increase the pressure inside the eye.
care.zh: 闭角型青光眼：可能升高眼内压。

care.en: Prostatic hyperplasia or bladder neck obstruction: it may cause urinary retention.
care.zh: 前列腺增生或膀胱颈梗阻：可能引起尿潴留。

care.en: It is listed under the PCP interventions, as salbutamol with ipratropium (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD).
care.zh: 它列在 PCP 的处置里，写的是 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇加 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD）。

dose.en: 500 mcg by nebulizer, one dose only
dose.zh: 500 mcg 雾化，只给一次

dose.en: Or 160 mcg by MDI: 8 sprays of 20 mcg
dose.zh: 或者 MDI 160 mcg：8 喷，每喷 20 mcg

dose.en: It can share the nebulizer with salbutamol. Salbutamol may be repeated, ipratropium is a single dose
dose.zh: 可以和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇放进同一个雾化器。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇可以重复，ipratropium 异丙托溴铵只给一次

dose.en: Signs of influenza-like illness or another infectious respiratory condition: MDI and spacer strongly recommended
dose.zh: 有流感样症状或其他呼吸道传染病迹象：强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐

dose.en: PCP, severe bronchospasm in asthma: 250 mcg by nebulizer (half a nebule), or 80 mcg by MDI (4 sprays of 20 mcg)
dose.zh: PCP，哮喘的严重支气管痉挛：雾化 250 mcg（半支），或 MDI 80 mcg（4 喷，每喷 20 mcg）

dose.en: Not for neonates under 30 days old
dose.zh: 出生不满 30 天的新生儿不能用

fx.en: May increase intraocular pressure (the pressure inside the eye)

pk.en: Starts working in 3 to 15 minutes, peaks at 1.5 to 2 hours and lasts 6 hours.
pk.zh: 3–15 分钟起效，1.5–2 小时达到高峰，维持 6 小时。

pearl.en: One dose, and never alone. Salbutamol repeats. Ipratropium does not.
pearl.zh: 只给一次，而且从不单独给。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇可以重复，ipratropium 异丙托溴铵不重复。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the doses, the contraindication and the neonate rule are the same. For a child, a BCEHS PCP must consult CliniCall first. The exam monograph has no consult step.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：剂量、禁忌和新生儿的规定都一样。给儿童用之前，BCEHS 的 PCP 必须先咨询 CliniCall。考试专论没有咨询这一步。

stem.en: Gord, 68, COPD. One-word answers, loud wheeze, SpO2 86%. No allergies. You are the PCP, setting up his salbutamol nebulizer.
stem.zh: Gord，68 岁，COPD。只能一个字一个字地答话，喘鸣音很响，SpO2 86%。没有过敏史。你是 PCP，正在给他准备 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇雾化。

why.en: Severe bronchospasm in COPD and no hypersensitivity. Add 500 mcg to the salbutamol in the same nebulizer, once.
why.zh: COPD 的严重支气管痉挛，没有过敏。在同一个雾化器里给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇加上 500 mcg，只加这一次。

bad.en: He keeps fighting for air on salbutamol alone, and he is tiring.
bad.zh: 他只靠 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇硬撑着喘，体力快耗尽了。

stem.en: Anita, 41, asthma, severe wheeze at a Burnaby gym. Her MedicAlert bracelet reads: allergic to Atrovent.
stem.zh: Anita，41 岁，哮喘，在 Burnaby 的健身房里喘鸣严重。她的 MedicAlert 手环上写着：对 Atrovent 过敏。

why.en: Atrovent is ipratropium. Known hypersensitivity is the contraindication. Keep going with salbutamol.
why.zh: Atrovent 就是 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵。已知过敏就是禁忌。继续用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

bad.en: You add an allergic reaction to an asthma attack.
bad.zh: 你在哮喘发作上又加了一场过敏反应。

stem.en: Noah, 3 weeks old, wheezing and working hard to breathe at a Surrey walk-in clinic. You are the PCP.
stem.zh: Noah，出生 3 周，在 Surrey 的诊所里喘鸣、呼吸很费力。你是 PCP。

why.en: Ipratropium is not for use in neonates under 30 days old.
why.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵不能用于出生不满 30 天的新生儿。

bad.en: You gave a newborn a drug the monograph says is not for him.
bad.zh: 你给新生儿用了专论明说不能给他用的药。

stem.en: Mei, 55, asthma. Fifteen minutes ago she had salbutamol with ipratropium 500 mcg by nebulizer. Still wheezing, SpO2 91%.
stem.zh: Mei，55 岁，哮喘。15 分钟前她做了 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇加 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵 500 mcg 的雾化。现在还在喘，SpO2 91%。

ask.en: What goes in the next nebulizer?

opts.en: Salbutamol only
opts.zh: 只放 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇

opts.en: Salbutamol with ipratropium again
opts.zh: 再放一次 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇加 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

opts.en: Ipratropium only
opts.zh: 只放 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

why.en: Ipratropium is a single dose. Salbutamol may be repeated.
why.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵只给一次。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇可以重复。

s.en: Ipratropium and salbutamol can go in the same nebulizer.
s.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇可以放进同一个雾化器。

why.en: The monograph allows both in one nebulizer for co-administration.
why.zh: 专论允许两种药放在一个雾化器里一起给。

s.en: If salbutamol runs out, ipratropium alone treats acute bronchospasm.
s.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇用完了，可以单用 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵治急性支气管痉挛。

why.en: It is not indicated as monotherapy. It works with salbutamol.
why.zh: 它不能单药使用，要和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇配合。

s.en: Narrow-angle glaucoma is a contraindication to ipratropium.
s.zh: 闭角型青光眼是 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵的禁忌。

why.en: It is a caution, because the drug may raise pressure in the eye.
why.zh: 它是慎用，因为这个药可能升高眼内压。

s.en: A child's nebulizer dose is half the adult dose.
s.zh: 儿童的雾化剂量是成人的一半。

why.en: 250 mcg for a child, 500 mcg for an adult.
why.zh: 儿童 250 mcg，成人 500 mcg。

q.en: The adult dose of ipratropium by nebulizer is…
q.zh: 成人雾化，ipratropium 异丙托溴铵的剂量是…

opts.en: 500 mcg, single dose
opts.zh: 500 mcg，只给一次

opts.en: 500 mcg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 500 mcg，按需重复

opts.en: 5 mg, single dose
opts.zh: 5 mg，只给一次

opts.en: 250 mcg, single dose
opts.zh: 250 mcg，只给一次

why.en: 500 mcg once. Only the salbutamol repeats. The 250 mcg dose is for children.
why.zh: 500 mcg，一次。能重复的只有 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。250 mcg 是儿童剂量。

q.en: By MDI, the adult dose of ipratropium is…
q.zh: 用 MDI 时，成人的 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵剂量是…

opts.en: 160 mcg: 8 sprays of 20 mcg
opts.zh: 160 mcg：8 喷，每喷 20 mcg

opts.en: 80 mcg: 4 sprays of 20 mcg
opts.zh: 80 mcg：4 喷，每喷 20 mcg

opts.en: 400 mcg: 4 sprays of 100 mcg
opts.zh: 400 mcg：4 喷，每喷 100 mcg

opts.en: 800 mcg: 8 sprays of 100 mcg
opts.zh: 800 mcg：8 喷，每喷 100 mcg

why.en: 8 sprays of 20 mcg make 160 mcg. A child gets half: 4 sprays, 80 mcg.
why.zh: 8 喷、每喷 20 mcg，一共 160 mcg。儿童减半：4 喷，80 mcg。

q.en: How does ipratropium open the airways?
q.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵是怎么打开气道的？

opts.en: It blocks acetylcholine in bronchial smooth muscle
opts.zh: 在支气管平滑肌上阻断乙酰胆碱

opts.en: It stimulates beta-2 receptors
opts.zh: 激动 β2 受体

opts.en: It reduces airway swelling like a steroid
opts.zh: 像激素一样减轻气道水肿

opts.en: It blocks histamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断组胺受体

why.en: It is an anticholinergic. With acetylcholine blocked, the airway muscle relaxes.
why.zh: 它是抗胆碱能药。乙酰胆碱被挡住，气道肌肉就放松。

cls.zh: 抗组胺药

hook.en: Takes histamine's seat on the cell so the reaction calms down.
hook.zh: 抢占组胺在细胞上的位置，让过敏反应平息下来。

how.en: Histamine drives much of an allergic reaction by attaching to receptor sites on cells. Diphenhydramine competes for the same sites, so less histamine gets through. It also has anticholinergic and sedative side effects.
how.zh: 组胺要结合到细胞的受体位点上，才能推动过敏反应。diphenhydramine 苯海拉明去抢同样的位点，组胺能起的作用就少了。它还有抗胆碱和镇静的副作用。

use.en: Adjunct treatment of allergic reactions
use.zh: 过敏反应的辅助治疗

use.en: Motion sickness
use.zh: 晕动病（晕车晕船）

use.en: Anaphylaxis, to mitigate medium-term effects and limit the histamine response (PCP, p.55, Anaphylaxis)
use.zh: 严重过敏反应，用来减轻中期影响、限制组胺反应（PCP，p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）

no.en: Known hypersensitivity or allergy to antihistamines
no.zh: 已知对抗组胺药过敏

no.en: Neonates
no.zh: 新生儿

noFake.zh: 已经给过 epinephrine 肾上腺素

care.en: Narrow angle glaucoma.
care.zh: 闭角型青光眼。

care.en: Stenosing peptic ulcer.
care.zh: 狭窄性消化性溃疡。

care.en: Expect sedation and anticholinergic side effects.
care.zh: 会有镇静和抗胆碱的副作用。

care.en: In anaphylaxis, epinephrine is the all-levels treatment and diphenhydramine is a PCP add-on (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
care.zh: 严重过敏反应时，epinephrine 肾上腺素是所有级别都要给的治疗，diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是 PCP 加用的药（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。

dose.en: 25 to 50 mg IV
dose.zh: 25–50 mg 静脉

dose.en: 25 to 50 mg PO
dose.zh: 25–50 mg 口服

dose.en: PCP: in anaphylaxis, give it in addition to epinephrine (p.55, Anaphylaxis)
dose.zh: PCP：严重过敏反应时，在 epinephrine 肾上腺素之外加用（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）

dose.en: Neonates: contraindicated. No pediatric dose is given in the exam monograph.
dose.zh: 新生儿：禁用。考试专论没有给出儿童剂量。

pk.en: IM onset is rapid. The monograph gives no other times.
pk.zh: 肌注起效快。专论没有给出其他时间。

pearl.en: It is an adjunct. In anaphylaxis epinephrine goes first and diphenhydramine is the add-on. Odd but true: its listed adverse effects are hypotension and urticaria, so keep watching the pressure.
pearl.zh: 它是辅助用药。严重过敏反应先给 epinephrine 肾上腺素，diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是后加的。有点怪但是真的：它列出的不良反应正是低血压和荨麻疹，所以血压要一直盯着。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): diphenhydramine is ACP and above, so BCEHS PCPs do not give it. This card is for the exam. BCEHS also warns that it must not be used in place of epinephrine in a reaction that is progressing to anaphylaxis.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是 ACP 及以上才能给，BCEHS 的 PCP 不给这个药。这张卡是为考试准备的。BCEHS 还警告：反应正在发展成严重过敏反应时，不能用它代替 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

stem.en: Chloe, 26, anaphylaxis after prawns at the Richmond Night Market. Epinephrine IM went in three minutes ago. Still covered in hives. IV running. No drug allergies.
stem.zh: Chloe，26 岁，在 Richmond 夜市吃虾后严重过敏。三分钟前已肌注 epinephrine 肾上腺素。全身还是荨麻疹。静脉通路在滴。没有药物过敏。

why.en: Epinephrine is already in. Diphenhydramine is the PCP add-on that limits the histamine response (p.55, Anaphylaxis). Give 25 to 50 mg.
why.zh: epinephrine 肾上腺素已经给了。diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是 PCP 加用的药，用来限制组胺反应（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。给 25–50 mg。

bad.en: The histamine response keeps going with nothing to limit it.
bad.zh: 组胺反应继续下去，没有东西去限制它。

stem.en: Baby Aiden, 12 days old, blotchy rash after his first dose of antibiotic drops. Breathing easily and feeding well.
stem.zh: Aiden，出生 12 天，第一次用抗生素滴剂后身上起了一片片红疹。呼吸平稳，吃奶正常。

why.en: Neonates are a contraindication.
why.zh: 新生儿是禁忌。

bad.en: A newborn gets a sedating drug that the monograph forbids at his age.
bad.zh: 一个新生儿被用上了专论在这个年龄禁用的镇静性药物。

stem.en: Marta, 52, itchy hives after a wasp sting in a Langley garden. Stable. She says Benadryl and Reactine both made her face swell.
stem.zh: Marta，52 岁，在 Langley 的花园里被黄蜂蜇后起了发痒的荨麻疹。情况稳定。她说 Benadryl 和 Reactine 都让她脸肿过。

why.en: Known hypersensitivity or allergy to antihistamines is a contraindication. Benadryl is diphenhydramine.
why.zh: 已知对抗组胺药过敏是禁忌。Benadryl 就是 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明。

bad.en: You add a second allergic reaction to the first one.
bad.zh: 你在第一场过敏反应上又加了第二场。

stem.en: Dev, 34, bee sting on a Squamish trail. Wheezing, hives spreading, BP 82/50. Nothing given yet.
stem.zh: Dev，34 岁，在 Squamish 的步道上被蜜蜂蜇了。喘鸣，荨麻疹在扩散，血压 82/50。还没给任何药。

ask.en: Which drug goes first?

opts.en: Epinephrine IM
opts.zh: 肌注 epinephrine 肾上腺素

opts.en: Diphenhydramine IV
opts.zh: 静脉给 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明

opts.en: Diphenhydramine PO
opts.zh: 口服 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明

why.en: Unstable anaphylaxis gets epinephrine at all licence levels. Diphenhydramine is the PCP add-on (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
why.zh: 不稳定的严重过敏反应，所有执照级别都先给 epinephrine 肾上腺素。diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是 PCP 加用的药（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。

bad.en: Minutes go to an antihistamine while his airway and blood pressure keep getting worse.
bad.zh: 时间花在抗组胺药上，他的气道和血压却在继续恶化。

s.en: The IV dose and the PO dose are the same: 25 to 50 mg.
s.zh: 静脉和口服的剂量一样：25–50 mg。

why.en: The route line gives 25 to 50 mg for both.
why.zh: 给药途径一栏两种都写 25–50 mg。

s.en: In anaphylaxis, give diphenhydramine before epinephrine.
s.zh: 严重过敏反应时，先给 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明，再给 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

why.en: Epinephrine is the all-levels step. Diphenhydramine is the PCP add-on (p.55, Anaphylaxis).
why.zh: epinephrine 肾上腺素是所有级别都做的一步。diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是 PCP 加用的药（p.55，Anaphylaxis 严重过敏反应）。

s.en: Neonates must not receive diphenhydramine.
s.zh: 新生儿不能用 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明。

why.en: Neonates are a listed contraindication.
why.zh: 新生儿列在禁忌症里。

s.en: Narrow angle glaucoma is a contraindication to diphenhydramine.
s.zh: 闭角型青光眼是 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明的禁忌。

why.en: It is a caution, together with stenosing peptic ulcer.
why.zh: 它是注意事项，和狭窄性消化性溃疡列在一起。

q.en: The dose of diphenhydramine is…
q.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明的剂量是…

opts.en: 25 to 50 mg IV or PO
opts.zh: 25–50 mg，静脉或口服

opts.en: 250 to 500 mg IV or PO
opts.zh: 250–500 mg，静脉或口服

opts.en: 2.5 to 5 mg IV or PO
opts.zh: 2.5–5 mg，静脉或口服

opts.en: 25 to 50 mg SL every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 25–50 mg 舌下，每 5 分钟一次

why.en: The monograph gives 25 to 50 mg by IV or PO.
why.zh: 专论写的是 25–50 mg，静脉或口服。

q.en: How does diphenhydramine work?
q.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: It competes with histamine for receptor sites on cells
opts.zh: 和组胺竞争细胞上的受体位点

opts.en: It stops the body from making histamine
opts.zh: 阻止身体制造组胺

opts.en: It constricts blood vessels to raise blood pressure
opts.zh: 收缩血管来升高血压

opts.en: It relaxes the muscle around the airways
opts.zh: 放松气道周围的肌肉

why.en: Antihistamines appear to compete with histamine for cell receptor sites on effector cells.
why.zh: 抗组胺药看来是和组胺竞争效应细胞上的受体位点。

q.en: Besides allergic reactions, what is diphenhydramine indicated for?
q.zh: 除了过敏反应，diphenhydramine 苯海拉明还有什么适应症？

opts.en: Motion sickness
opts.zh: 晕动病（晕车晕船）

opts.en: Opioid overdose
opts.zh: 阿片类过量

opts.en: Hypoglycemia
opts.zh: 低血糖

opts.en: Cardiac chest pain
opts.zh: 心源性胸痛

why.en: The two indications are adjunct treatment of allergic reactions and motion sickness.
why.zh: 两个适应症是过敏反应的辅助治疗和晕动病。

cls.zh: 非麻醉性镇痛药

hook.en: Pain relief that the patient breathes in and controls.
hook.zh: 病人自己吸、自己掌握的止痛气体。

how.en: It is a gas that the patient holds and breathes in without help. It is a potent painkiller and a weak anaesthetic. The onset is rapid.
how.zh: 这是一种由病人自己拿着、自己吸入的气体。它镇痛作用强，麻醉作用弱。起效很快。

use.en: Relief of pain
use.zh: 缓解疼痛

use.en: Cardiac chest pain where nitroglycerin will be of no value or is contraindicated
use.zh: 心源性胸痛，而 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油没有用或者有禁忌

use.en: Isolated extremity injuries
use.zh: 单纯的肢体损伤

use.en: Pain associated with burns
use.zh: 烧伤引起的疼痛

no.en: Inability to comply
no.zh: 病人无法配合

no.en: Inability to ventilate an enclosed treatment area
no.zh: 封闭的治疗空间无法通风

no.en: Decompression sickness
no.zh: 减压病

no.en: Altered level of consciousness
no.zh: 意识水平改变

no.en: Pneumothorax
no.zh: 气胸

no.en: Air embolism
no.zh: 空气栓塞

no.en: Inhalation injury
no.zh: 吸入性损伤

no.en: Nitroglycerin used in the last 5 minutes
no.zh: 过去 5 分钟内用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

noFake.zh: 10 分钟前用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

care.en: Shock.
care.zh: 休克。

care.en: Abdominal distention.
care.zh: 腹胀。

care.en: Patient has taken depressant drugs.
care.zh: 病人用过抑制中枢的药物。

care.en: COPD.
care.zh: 慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）。

care.en: Facial injuries.
care.zh: 面部损伤。

care.en: Chest pain: 30 minutes after the first dose of nitroglycerin, the protocol may be repeated after stopping Entonox for 5 minutes (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
care.zh: 胸痛：距第一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油满 30 分钟后，停用 Entonox 笑气 5 分钟，就可以重新走一遍胸痛流程（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

dose.en: Inhalation, self-administered
dose.zh: 吸入，病人自己给药

dose.en: Before use: primary survey, pain assessed with severity, baseline vitals with oxygen saturation, history and exam to rule out the contraindications
dose.zh: 使用前：完成初步评估，问清疼痛和严重程度，量基线生命体征（包括血氧饱和度），做足够的病史和体检来排除禁忌症

dose.en: Invert the cylinder 3 times
dose.zh: 把气瓶倒转 3 次

dose.en: In the ambulance: turn on the vehicle ventilation system, intake and output
dose.zh: 在救护车里：打开车辆通风系统，进风和排风都要开

dose.en: Chest pain: start 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin, when pain persists beyond 3 doses or SBP falls below 110 (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain)
dose.zh: 胸痛：3 次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油后疼痛还在，或收缩压掉到 110 以下时，在最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油 5 分钟后开始（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）

dose.en: If hospital arrival is not imminent 20 minutes after the last nitroglycerin: stop Entonox, resume high flow oxygen and give more nitroglycerin per protocol (p.73, Nitroglycerin monograph)
dose.zh: 最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油 20 分钟后还到不了医院：停 Entonox 笑气，恢复高流量氧气，按 protocol 再给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油（p.73，nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油专论）

pk.en: Onset is rapid.
pk.zh: 起效快。

pearl.en: The patient holds it. If they cannot follow instructions or are not fully alert, they cannot have it. With chest pain, wait 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin before the first breath.
pearl.zh: 气是病人自己拿着吸的。听不懂指令或者不完全清醒，就不能用。胸痛时，最后一次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油之后等 5 分钟，才能吸第一口。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): bullous emphysema and gross abdominal distension are contraindications. The exam does not mention bullous emphysema and lists abdominal distention only as a caution. BCEHS also forbids it aboard aircraft.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：大疱性肺气肿和明显腹胀是禁忌。考试没有提大疱性肺气肿，腹胀也只是注意事项。BCEHS 还规定飞机上不能用。

stem.en: Jake, 27, snowboarder at Cypress with a deformed wrist. Alert, pain 8 out of 10. Lungs clear, no other injuries. You are in an open first-aid hut.
stem.zh: Jake，27 岁，在 Cypress 滑单板摔伤，手腕变形。清醒，疼痛 8/10。双肺呼吸音清，没有其他伤。你们在一间敞开的急救小屋里。

why.en: An isolated extremity injury in an alert patient who can comply. No contraindications.
why.zh: 单纯的肢体损伤，病人清醒、能配合。没有禁忌症。

bad.en: He is splinted and carried down the hill with no pain relief at all.
bad.zh: 他被上夹板、抬下山，一点止痛都没有。

stem.en: Omar, 40, fell from a ladder in Abbotsford. Right rib pain 9 out of 10, short of breath, no breath sounds on the right. Alert.
stem.zh: Omar，40 岁，在 Abbotsford 从梯子上摔下来。右侧肋骨痛 9/10，气短，右侧听不到呼吸音。清醒。

why.en: The findings point to a pneumothorax, and pneumothorax is a contraindication.
why.zh: 这些表现提示气胸，而气胸是禁忌。

bad.en: The gas moves into the air trapped in his chest and the pneumothorax gets bigger.
bad.zh: 气体进入他胸腔里被困住的空气，气胸变得更大。

stem.en: Bev, 69, cardiac chest pain. Her third nitroglycerin spray went in two minutes ago. Pain still 6 out of 10. BP 124/78. Alert and cooperative.
stem.zh: Bev，69 岁，心源性胸痛。第三喷 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油是两分钟前给的。疼痛还有 6/10。血压 124/78。清醒，配合。

why.en: Nitroglycerin was used in the last 5 minutes. Entonox starts 5 minutes after the last dose (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
why.zh: 过去 5 分钟内用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。Entonox 笑气要在最后一次给药 5 分钟后才开始（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

bad.en: You add a second drug before you have seen what the nitroglycerin did to her pressure.
bad.zh: 还没看到 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油对她血压的影响，你就又加了一个药。

stem.en: Gary, 62, cardiac chest pain. Three nitroglycerin sprays, the last one 6 minutes ago. Pain 5 out of 10. BP 118/70. Alert.
stem.zh: Gary，62 岁，心源性胸痛。已喷三次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，最后一次是 6 分钟前。疼痛 5/10。血压 118/70。清醒。

ask.en: What is next for his pain?

opts.en: Entonox, self-administered
opts.zh: Entonox 笑气，病人自己吸

opts.en: A fourth nitroglycerin spray right now
opts.zh: 马上喷第四次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

opts.en: Nothing more until the hospital
opts.zh: 到医院之前什么都不再给

why.en: Pain persists beyond 3 doses of nitroglycerin, and 5 minutes have passed since the last one. The protocol moves to Entonox (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
why.zh: 3 次 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油后疼痛还在，离最后一次也过了 5 分钟。protocol 这时改用 Entonox 笑气（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

s.en: The patient must give Entonox to themselves.
s.zh: Entonox 笑气必须由病人自己吸。

why.en: It is self-administered, and inability to comply is a contraindication.
why.zh: 它是自己给药的，无法配合就是禁忌。

s.en: Entonox suits a burn patient who also has an inhalation injury.
s.zh: 烧伤病人同时有吸入性损伤，也适合用 Entonox 笑气。

why.en: Burn pain is an indication, but inhalation injury is a contraindication.
why.zh: 烧伤疼痛是适应症，但吸入性损伤是禁忌。

s.en: Invert the cylinder 3 times before use.
s.zh: 使用前把气瓶倒转 3 次。

why.en: It is on the before-use checklist.
why.zh: 这是使用前清单上的一步。

s.en: COPD is a contraindication to Entonox.
s.zh: COPD 是 Entonox 笑气的禁忌。

why.en: COPD is a caution, like shock, abdominal distention, depressant drugs and facial injuries.
why.zh: COPD 是注意事项，和休克、腹胀、抑制中枢的药物、面部损伤列在一起。

q.en: After nitroglycerin, how long before Entonox may start?
q.zh: 用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油之后，要等多久才能开始 Entonox 笑气？

opts.en: 5 minutes after the last dose
opts.zh: 最后一次给药后 5 分钟

opts.en: Right away, with no wait
opts.zh: 马上，不用等

opts.en: 30 minutes after the last dose
opts.zh: 最后一次给药后 30 分钟

opts.en: 24 hours after the last dose
opts.zh: 最后一次给药后 24 小时

why.en: Nitroglycerin in the last 5 minutes is a contraindication. The protocol starts Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose (p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain).
why.zh: 过去 5 分钟内用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油是禁忌。protocol 规定最后一次给药 5 分钟后才开始 Entonox 笑气（p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）。

q.en: Which of these is a contraindication to Entonox?
q.zh: 下面哪一项是 Entonox 笑气的禁忌？

opts.en: Decompression sickness
opts.zh: 减压病

opts.en: COPD
opts.zh: 慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）

opts.en: Facial injuries
opts.zh: 面部损伤

opts.en: Shock
opts.zh: 休克

why.en: Decompression sickness is a contraindication. The other three are cautions.
why.zh: 减压病是禁忌。另外三项是注意事项。

q.en: Entonox in the back of the ambulance. What must be on?
q.zh: 在救护车后舱用 Entonox 笑气，必须打开什么？

opts.en: The vehicle ventilation system, intake and output
opts.zh: 车辆通风系统，进风和排风

opts.en: The heater, with all the vents closed
opts.zh: 暖气，并关上所有通风口

opts.en: The suction unit, running continuously
opts.zh: 吸引器，持续运转

opts.en: A second oxygen mask on the patient
opts.zh: 给病人再戴一个氧气面罩

why.en: An enclosed area that cannot be ventilated is a contraindication. In the ambulance, turn on the ventilation system, intake and output.
why.zh: 封闭空间不能通风就是禁忌。在救护车里要打开通风系统，进风和排风都开。

cls.zh: 吸入性氟化烃类挥发性麻醉药

hook.en: Pain relief the patient breathes in from a hand-held inhaler.
hook.zh: 病人自己拿着吸入器，吸进去的止痛药。

how.en: It is a fast-acting anesthetic vapour that the patient breathes in. The exact way it works is not known, which is true of many anesthetics. The patient gives it to themselves, so they must be awake and able to follow instructions.
how.zh: 它是一种起效很快的麻醉性气体，由病人吸入。确切的作用机制还不清楚，很多麻醉药都是这样。药是病人自己给自己用的，所以病人必须清醒、能听懂并照做。

use.en: Self-administered pain relief in a conscious, hemodynamically stable patient
use.zh: 清醒、血流动力学稳定的病人，自己吸入止痛

no.en: Under 18 years of age
no.zh: 未满 18 岁

no.en: Pregnancy, intended pregnancy or current breastfeeding
