no.zh: 怀孕、备孕或正在哺乳

no.en: Inadequate patient understanding or lack of cooperation
no.zh: 病人理解不了或不配合

no.en: Decreased level of consciousness or head injury
no.zh: 意识水平下降或头部受伤

no.en: History of clinically significant renal impairment, for example reduced renal output
no.zh: 有临床意义的肾功能损害史，例如尿量减少

no.en: History of liver dysfunction after earlier exposure to halogenated anesthetics
no.zh: 以前用过卤代麻醉药后出现过肝功能异常

no.en: Current use of tetracycline antibiotics
no.zh: 正在用四环素类抗生素

no.en: Personal or genetic history of malignant hyperthermia
no.zh: 本人或家族遗传有恶性高热病史

no.en: Muscular dystrophy
no.zh: 肌营养不良

noFake.zh: 正在用青霉素类抗生素

care.en: CHECK, first C: cardiac instability or respiratory depression.
care.zh: CHECK 的第一个 C：心脏不稳定或呼吸抑制。

care.en: CHECK, H: hypersensitivity.
care.zh: CHECK 的 H：过敏。

care.en: CHECK, second C: consciousness, meaning an altered level of consciousness.
care.zh: CHECK 的第二个 C：意识，也就是意识水平改变。

care.en: CHECK, K: kidneys, meaning signs of kidney failure or renal impairment.
care.zh: CHECK 的 K：肾，也就是肾衰竭或肾功能损害的迹象。

care.en: The exam monograph prints no line for the E in CHECK.
care.zh: 考试专论里 CHECK 的 E 没有印出对应的内容。

dose.en: 3 mL, self-administered through the inhaler
dose.zh: 3 mL，病人自己用吸入器吸

dose.en: May repeat after 20 minutes
dose.zh: 20 分钟后可以重复

dose.en: Maximum total volume 6 mL
dose.zh: 总量最多 6 mL

dose.en: Contraindicated under 18 years of age
dose.zh: 未满 18 岁禁用

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: Works in 1 to 3 minutes, or 8 to 10 regular breaths. A 3 mL dose lasts about 25 minutes. The effect fades 3 to 5 minutes after stopping.
pk.zh: 1–3 分钟起效，也就是正常呼吸 8–10 次。一剂 3 mL 大约维持 25 分钟。停用后 3–5 分钟药效消退。

pearl.en: Four numbers: 3 mL, repeat after 20 minutes, 6 mL total, nobody under 18. Then say the contraindication list out loud. It is long, and the exam counts every miss.
pearl.zh: 四个数字：3 mL，20 分钟后可重复，总量 6 mL，未满 18 岁不给。然后把禁忌清单大声过一遍。清单很长，考试漏一条算一条。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the dose and the contraindication list are the same. BCEHS words the indication as moderate to severe pain, and its CHECK list keeps the E, an established diagnosis of malignant hyperthermia. BCEHS also lists adverse effects. The exam monograph lists none.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：剂量和禁忌清单都一样。BCEHS 把适应证写成中度到重度疼痛，它的 CHECK 里保留了 E，也就是已确诊的恶性高热。BCEHS 还列了不良反应，考试专论一条都没列。

stem.en: Jake, 27, snowboarder at Cypress with a deformed wrist. Pain 8 out of 10. Alert, follows instructions, BP 128/80, HR 96. Healthy, no medications.
stem.zh: Jake，27 岁，在 Cypress 滑单板，手腕变形。疼痛 8/10。清醒，能听指令，血压 128/80，心率 96。平时健康，不吃任何药。

why.en: Conscious, hemodynamically stable, cooperative, and nothing on the contraindication list. He gets 3 mL through the inhaler and gives it to himself.
why.zh: 清醒、血流动力学稳定、能配合，禁忌清单上一条都没有。给 3 mL，用吸入器，让他自己吸。

bad.en: He rides the rescue toboggan down the hill with a broken wrist and no pain relief.
bad.zh: 他带着骨折的手腕坐救援雪橇下山，一点止痛都没有。

stem.en: Sarah, 31, broke her ankle on a North Vancouver trail. Alert, vitals normal. Her partner holds their 4-month-old, whom she breastfeeds.
stem.zh: Sarah，31 岁，在 North Vancouver 的步道上摔断了脚踝。清醒，生命体征正常。她的伴侣抱着他们 4 个月大的宝宝，宝宝是她母乳喂养的。

why.en: Current breastfeeding is a contraindication, together with pregnancy and intended pregnancy.
why.zh: 正在哺乳是禁忌，和怀孕、备孕列在一起。

bad.en: The drug may pass to her baby in the milk.
bad.zh: 药可能通过母乳进到宝宝体内。

stem.en: Carlos, 44, fell off a ladder in Delta. Forearm clearly broken, pain 9 out of 10. He was knocked out briefly and has a bump on his forehead.
stem.zh: Carlos，44 岁，在 Delta 从梯子上摔下来。前臂明显骨折，疼痛 9/10。他短暂昏过去一下，额头上有个包。

why.en: Head injury is a contraindication. So is a decreased level of consciousness.
why.zh: 头部受伤是禁忌。意识水平下降也是。

bad.en: The drug makes him drowsy, and you can no longer tell whether his head injury is getting worse.
bad.zh: 药让他犯困，你就分不清是不是头部伤情在加重。

stem.en: Omar, 52, broken femur on a logging road, 90 minutes from hospital. He has finished two 3 mL doses. The pain is climbing again.
stem.zh: Omar，52 岁，在伐木道上股骨骨折，离医院 90 分钟。他已经吸完两剂 3 mL。疼痛又上来了。

ask.en: He asks for a third. What now?

opts.en: No more. 6 mL is the maximum total
opts.zh: 不能再给，总量最多 6 mL

opts.en: A third 3 mL, since 20 minutes have passed
opts.zh: 再给 3 mL，反正已经过了 20 分钟

opts.en: A half dose of 1.5 mL
opts.zh: 给半量 1.5 mL

why.en: Two doses of 3 mL reach the maximum total volume of 6 mL.
why.zh: 两剂 3 mL 就到了总量上限 6 mL。

bad.en: Going past the maximum puts his kidneys at risk.
bad.zh: 超过上限，他的肾就有危险。

s.en: A second 3 mL dose is allowed after 20 minutes.
s.zh: 20 分钟后可以再给第二剂 3 mL。

why.en: May repeat after 20 minutes, to a maximum total of 6 mL.
why.zh: 20 分钟后可重复，总量最多 6 mL。

s.en: A 17-year-old can use it if a parent consents.
s.zh: 只要家长同意，17 岁的病人也可以用。

why.en: Under 18 years of age is a contraindication. Consent does not change it.
why.zh: 未满 18 岁就是禁忌，家长同意也没用。

s.en: Current use of tetracycline antibiotics is a contraindication.
s.zh: 正在用四环素类抗生素是禁忌。

why.en: It is on the list, with malignant hyperthermia and muscular dystrophy.
why.zh: 它在清单上，和恶性高热、肌营养不良列在一起。

s.en: The paramedic holds the inhaler and decides when the patient breathes from it.
s.zh: 由急救员拿着吸入器，决定病人什么时候吸。

why.en: It is self-administered, so the patient must be conscious and cooperative.
why.zh: 这是病人自己用的药，所以病人必须清醒、能配合。

q.en: The dose of methoxyflurane is…
q.zh: methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷的剂量是…

opts.en: 3 mL by inhaler, may repeat after 20 minutes, maximum 6 mL
opts.zh: 3 mL 吸入，20 分钟后可重复，最多 6 mL

opts.en: 3 mL by inhaler, may repeat after 5 minutes, maximum 6 mL
opts.zh: 3 mL 吸入，5 分钟后可重复，最多 6 mL

opts.en: 6 mL by inhaler, may repeat after 20 minutes, maximum 12 mL
opts.zh: 6 mL 吸入，20 分钟后可重复，最多 12 mL

opts.en: 30 mL by inhaler, may repeat after 20 minutes, maximum 60 mL
opts.zh: 30 mL 吸入，20 分钟后可重复，最多 60 mL

why.en: 3 mL, one repeat after 20 minutes, 6 mL in total.
why.zh: 3 mL，20 分钟后可重复一次，总量 6 mL。

q.en: Which patient may have methoxyflurane?
q.zh: 下面哪个病人可以用 methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷？

opts.en: An alert, stable adult with a broken ankle
opts.zh: 清醒、稳定的成年人，脚踝骨折

opts.en: A breastfeeding mother with a broken wrist
opts.zh: 正在哺乳的妈妈，手腕骨折

opts.en: A man with a forearm fracture and a head injury
opts.zh: 前臂骨折同时头部受伤的男子

opts.en: A 17-year-old with a dislocated shoulder
opts.zh: 17 岁，肩关节脱位

why.en: It is for conscious, hemodynamically stable patients. Breastfeeding, head injury and age under 18 are contraindications.
why.zh: 它用于清醒、血流动力学稳定的病人。哺乳、头部受伤和未满 18 岁都是禁忌。

q.en: How fast does methoxyflurane start to work?
q.zh: methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷多快起效？

opts.en: In 1 to 3 minutes, about 8 to 10 breaths
opts.zh: 1–3 分钟，大约呼吸 8–10 次

opts.en: In 15 to 30 minutes
In 30 to 60 minutes
Only when the full 3 mL is finished
opts.zh: 要等 3 mL 全部吸完

why.en: Onset is 1 to 3 minutes, or 8 to 10 regular breaths.
why.zh: 1–3 分钟起效，也就是正常呼吸 8–10 次。

cls.zh: 镇痛药、退热药

hook.en: Turns down pain and fever from inside the brain.
hook.zh: 在大脑里把疼痛和发烧调低。

how.en: It blocks an enzyme called prostaglandin synthetase in the central nervous system. Fewer prostaglandins are made there. The result is less pain and a lower fever.
how.zh: 它在中枢神经系统里抑制一种叫前列腺素合成酶的酶。那里产生的前列腺素变少。结果是疼痛减轻、体温下降。

use.en: Mild to moderate pain (PO or IV)
use.zh: 轻到中度疼痛（PO 或 IV）

use.en: Pyrexia, which means fever (PO or IV)
use.zh: 发热（pyrexia）（PO 或 IV）

no.en: Hypersensitivity to acetaminophen or any component of the formulation
no.zh: 对 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚或制剂中任何成分过敏

no.en: Severe hepatic impairment or severe active liver disease
no.zh: 严重肝功能损害或严重活动性肝病

no.en: Acetaminophen given within the past 4 hours, from any source
no.zh: 过去 4 小时内用过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚（任何来源都算）

no.en: Total intake in the last 24 hours already exceeds the daily maximum
no.zh: 过去 24 小时的总量已经超过每日上限

no.en: Suspected overdose: nausea, vomiting or right upper quadrant pain
no.zh: 怀疑过量：恶心、呕吐或右上腹痛

noFake.zh: 一小时前吃过 ibuprofen 布洛芬

care.en: Use with caution in hepatic impairment, heavy alcohol use, chronic malnutrition and hypovolemia.
care.zh: 肝功能损害、大量饮酒、慢性营养不良、低血容量时要谨慎。

care.en: Liver dysfunction, heavy alcohol use or malnutrition lowers the 24-hour maximum to 2,000 mg.
care.zh: 肝功能不好、大量饮酒或营养不良时，24 小时上限降到 2,000 mg。

care.en: Count acetaminophen from all sources and all routes before you give any.
care.zh: 给药前，把所有来源、所有途径的 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚都算进去。

care.en: It may be used together with ibuprofen for analgesia.
care.zh: 止痛时可以和 ibuprofen 布洛芬一起用。

dose.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO. May repeat once after 4 hours.
dose.zh: 500–1,000 mg 口服。4 小时后可以重复一次。

dose.en: 24-hour maximum, from all sources and all routes: 4,000 mg
dose.zh: 24 小时上限（所有来源、所有途径合计）：4,000 mg

dose.en: Liver dysfunction, heavy alcohol use or malnutrition: 24-hour maximum 2,000 mg
dose.zh: 肝功能不好、大量饮酒或营养不良：24 小时上限 2,000 mg

dose.en: IV, patients 50 kg or more: 1,000 mg IV every 6 hours as required
dose.zh: IV（体重 50 kg 及以上）：1,000 mg 静脉，需要时每 6 小时一次

dose.en: IV: infuse the 1,000 mg/100 mL bag undiluted over 15 minutes with a 10 gtts/mL set (66 gtts/min)
dose.zh: IV：1,000 mg/100 mL 的袋子不稀释，用 10 gtts/mL 输液器 15 分钟输完（66 gtts/min）

dose.en: No separate pediatric dose is given in the exam monograph
dose.zh: 考试专论没有单独给出儿童剂量

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: PO: onset 30 minutes, peak 1 to 3 hours, lasts 4 hours. IV: onset 15 minutes, peak 1 hour, lasts 4 to 6 hours for pain and more than 6 hours for fever.
pk.zh: 口服：30 分钟起效，1–3 小时达峰，维持 4 小时。IV：15 分钟起效，1 小时达峰，镇痛维持 4–6 小时，退热超过 6 小时。

pearl.en: Two questions before every dose. When was the last acetaminophen, and how much in the last 24 hours, from all sources? Nausea, vomiting and right upper quadrant pain mean suspected overdose, so the answer is no.
pearl.zh: 每次给药前问两件事。上一次 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚是什么时候吃的？过去 24 小时所有来源加起来吃了多少？恶心、呕吐加右上腹痛就是怀疑过量，答案是不给。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): EMRs give it PO for pain only. Fever and the IV route are PCP. BCEHS also has a child dose, 15 mg/kg PO, and the exam monograph has none. Contraindications and adult doses are the same.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：EMR 只能口服给药止痛。退热和 IV 途径属于 PCP。BCEHS 还有儿童剂量 15 mg/kg 口服，考试专论没有。禁忌症和成人剂量相同。

stem.en: Maya, 34, rolled her ankle on the Grouse Grind. Pain 4 out of 10. No medicines today. No liver problems, rarely drinks.
stem.zh: Maya，34 岁，在 Grouse Grind 登山道扭了脚踝。疼痛 4/10。今天没吃过任何药。肝没问题，很少喝酒。

why.en: Mild to moderate pain. Nothing in the past 4 hours, no liver disease, no sign of overdose. Give 500 to 1,000 mg PO.
why.zh: 轻到中度疼痛。过去 4 小时没用过药，没有肝病，没有过量迹象。给 500–1,000 mg 口服。

bad.en: She rides to hospital in pain that a safe tablet would have eased.
bad.zh: 她一路痛到医院，而一片安全的药本来可以缓解。

stem.en: Ken, 52, headache and fever at his Richmond office. He took two extra-strength Tylenol at noon. It is now 2:30 pm.
stem.zh: Ken，52 岁，在 Richmond 的办公室头痛发烧。中午 12 点吃了两片强效 Tylenol。现在是下午 2:30。

why.en: Acetaminophen in the past 4 hours, from any source, is a contraindication. His own Tylenol counts.
why.zh: 过去 4 小时内用过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚（任何来源）就是禁忌。他自己吃的 Tylenol 也算。

bad.en: You stack a second dose on the first and push him toward the daily maximum.
bad.zh: 你在第一剂上又叠一剂，把他推向每日上限。

stem.en: Priya, 19, UBC dorm. Fever, nausea, vomited twice, pain under the right ribs. Her roommate says she took cold and flu pills all weekend.
stem.zh: Priya，19 岁，UBC 宿舍。发烧、恶心、吐了两次，右侧肋下痛。室友说她整个周末都在吃感冒药。

why.en: Nausea, vomiting and right upper quadrant pain point to an overdose. Do not give acetaminophen when overdose is suspected.
why.zh: 恶心、呕吐加右上腹痛，提示过量。怀疑过量时不能给 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。

bad.en: You add more acetaminophen to a liver that is already overloaded.
bad.zh: 你给一个已经超负荷的肝再加 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。

stem.en: Walter, 68, sore knee after a fall at the Legion hall. He drinks a mickey of rye every day. No acetaminophen this week.
stem.zh: Walter，68 岁，在 Legion 会所摔倒后膝盖痛。他每天喝一小瓶黑麦威士忌。这周没吃过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。

ask.en: What is his 24-hour maximum from all sources?
ask.zh: 他 24 小时内（所有来源）的上限是多少？

opts.en: 2,000 mg in 24 hours
4,000 mg in 24 hours
1,000 mg in 24 hours

why.en: Heavy alcohol use lowers the 24-hour maximum from 4,000 mg to 2,000 mg.
why.zh: 大量饮酒会把 24 小时上限从 4,000 mg 降到 2,000 mg。

bad.en: A full daily dose lands on a liver that alcohol has already worn down.
bad.zh: 足量的日剂量压在一个已经被酒精拖垮的肝上。

s.en: Acetaminophen and ibuprofen may be given together for pain.
s.zh: 止痛时 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚和 ibuprofen 布洛芬可以一起给。

why.en: The monograph allows concurrent use for analgesia.
why.zh: 专论允许两者同时用于镇痛。

s.en: The 4-hour rule only counts the doses that you gave.
s.zh: 4 小时规则只算你自己给的剂量。

why.en: It counts acetaminophen from all sources.
why.zh: 所有来源的 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚都算。

s.en: With heavy alcohol use, the 24-hour maximum is 2,000 mg.
s.zh: 大量饮酒的病人，24 小时上限是 2,000 mg。

why.en: Liver dysfunction, heavy alcohol use or malnutrition cuts it from 4,000 mg.
why.zh: 肝功能不好、大量饮酒或营养不良，上限从 4,000 mg 降下来。

s.en: The oral dose may be repeated every 4 hours as needed.
s.zh: 口服剂量可以按需每 4 小时重复。

why.en: The monograph says it may be repeated once after 4 hours.
why.zh: 专论写的是 4 小时后可重复一次。

q.en: The oral dose of acetaminophen is…
q.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚的口服剂量是…

opts.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO, may repeat once after 4 hours
opts.zh: 500–1,000 mg 口服，4 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO, may repeat once after 1 hour
opts.zh: 500–1,000 mg 口服，1 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 5,000 to 10,000 mg PO, may repeat once after 4 hours
opts.zh: 5,000–10,000 mg 口服，4 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 160 mg PO, chewed, one time only
opts.zh: 160 mg 口服嚼碎，只给一次

why.en: One dose is 500 to 1,000 mg, with one repeat after 4 hours and a 24-hour maximum of 4,000 mg.
why.zh: 一次 500–1,000 mg，4 小时后可重复一次，24 小时上限 4,000 mg。

q.en: How is the 1,000 mg IV bag of acetaminophen given?
q.zh: 1,000 mg 的 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚静脉袋怎么给？

opts.en: Undiluted, over 15 minutes
opts.zh: 不稀释，15 分钟输完

opts.en: Undiluted, as a push over 1 minute
opts.zh: 不稀释，1 分钟推完

opts.en: Diluted in 1 L of NS, over 6 hours
opts.zh: 加入 1 L NS，6 小时输完

opts.en: Diluted in 10 mL of NS, over 2 minutes
opts.zh: 用 10 mL NS 稀释，2 分钟推完

why.en: The 1,000 mg/100 mL bag runs undiluted over 15 minutes. With a 10 gtts/mL set that is 66 gtts/min.
why.zh: 1,000 mg/100 mL 的袋子不稀释，15 分钟输完。用 10 gtts/mL 输液器就是 66 gtts/min。

q.en: How does acetaminophen reduce pain and fever?
q.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚怎么减轻疼痛和发热？

opts.en: It inhibits prostaglandin synthetase in the central nervous system
opts.zh: 在中枢神经系统抑制前列腺素合成酶

opts.en: It blocks opioid receptors in the spinal cord
opts.zh: 在脊髓阻断阿片受体

opts.en: It stops platelets from clumping together
opts.zh: 阻止血小板聚集

opts.en: It widens the blood vessels in the skin
opts.zh: 扩张皮肤血管

why.en: Fewer prostaglandins in the central nervous system means less pain and less pyrexia.
why.zh: 中枢神经系统里前列腺素变少，疼痛和发热就减轻。

cls.zh: 镇痛药、退热药、非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）

hook.en: A pill that turns down pain, inflammation and fever.
hook.zh: 一片药，把疼痛、炎症和发热都压下去。

how.en: The body makes prostaglandins, chemical messengers that switch on pain, inflammation and fever. Ibuprofen blocks the body from making them. Fewer messengers, less of all three.
how.zh: 身体会合成前列腺素，它是引发疼痛、炎症和发热的化学信使。ibuprofen 布洛芬阻止身体合成它。信使少了，三样都减轻。

use.en: Mild to moderate pain
use.zh: 轻度到中度疼痛

use.en: Pyrexia (fever). The monograph marks the fever doses PCP
use.zh: 发热（pyrexia）。专论把退热剂量标为 PCP

no.en: Hypersensitivity to ibuprofen or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
no.zh: 对 ibuprofen 布洛芬或其他非甾体抗炎药过敏

no.en: Active GI hemorrhage or ulcers
no.zh: 活动性胃肠道出血或溃疡

no.en: Pregnancy: first, second or third trimester
no.zh: 怀孕：孕早期、孕中期、孕晚期都算

no.en: Anticoagulants (blood thinners)
no.zh: 正在用抗凝药（血液稀释药）

noFake.en: Being a child (there is a weight-based dose)
noFake.zh: 病人是儿童（有按体重算的剂量）
一小时前吃过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

care.en: History of gastrointestinal disease: consider another treatment.
care.zh: 有胃肠道疾病史：考虑换别的治疗。

care.en: History of renal (kidney) disease: consider another treatment.
care.zh: 有肾脏疾病史：考虑换别的治疗。

care.en: History of significant cardiovascular disease: consider another treatment.
care.zh: 有明显的心血管疾病史：考虑换别的治疗。

care.en: Ibuprofen and all NSAIDs can cause significant adverse reactions, and the risk rises with dose, duration of therapy and underlying risk factors.
care.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬和所有 NSAID 都可能引起严重不良反应，剂量越大、用得越久、基础风险越多，风险越高。

dose.en: Pain: 300 to 400 mg PO, may repeat every 4 to 6 hours, maximum 1,200 mg a day
dose.zh: 止痛：300–400 mg 口服，每 4–6 小时可重复，每天最多 1,200 mg

dose.en: PCP, pyrexia (fever): the same dose, repeat and daily maximum
dose.zh: PCP，退热：剂量、重复间隔和每日上限都一样

dose.en: Pain: 10 mg/kg PO, may repeat once after 6 hours, maximum 40 mg/kg a day
dose.zh: 止痛：10 mg/kg 口服，6 小时后可重复一次，每天最多 40 mg/kg

dose.en: PCP, fever below 39°C: 5 mg/kg, may repeat every 4 to 6 hours
dose.zh: PCP，体温低于 39°C 的发热：5 mg/kg，每 4–6 小时可重复

dose.en: PCP, fever of 39°C or higher: 10 mg/kg, may repeat every 4 to 6 hours
dose.zh: PCP，体温 39°C 或以上的发热：10 mg/kg，每 4–6 小时可重复

dose.en: PCP, fever: maximum 40 mg/kg a day
dose.zh: PCP，退热：每天最多 40 mg/kg

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: Pain relief starts in 30 to 60 minutes and lasts 4 to 6 hours. Fever relief starts in 30 minutes to 2.5 hours and lasts 6 to 8 hours.
pk.zh: 止痛 30–60 分钟起效，维持 4–6 小时。退热 30 分钟到 2.5 小时起效，维持 6–8 小时。

pearl.en: Two questions before the pill: could you be pregnant, and do you take a blood thinner. Either yes is a hard stop, in any trimester.
pearl.zh: 发药前问两句：有没有可能怀孕，有没有在吃抗凝药。只要有一个答“有”就不能给，孕期哪个阶段都一样。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): kidney dysfunction is a contraindication, not only a caution. So is concern for any severe active bleeding, such as trauma or intracranial hemorrhage. A child with fever gets a flat 10 mg/kg with one repeat after 6 hours. The exam splits the fever dose at 39°C.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：肾功能不全是禁忌，不只是慎用。担心有严重的活动性出血（比如创伤、颅内出血）也是禁忌。儿童退热一律 10 mg/kg，6 小时后可重复一次。考试则以 39°C 为界分两档。

stem.en: Maya, 34, rolled her ankle on the Grouse Grind. Pain 5 out of 10. Not pregnant, no blood thinners, no ulcers, no NSAID allergy.
stem.zh: Maya，34 岁，在 Grouse Grind 山道上扭了脚踝。疼痛 5/10。没怀孕，没吃抗凝药，没有溃疡，对 NSAID 不过敏。

why.en: Mild to moderate pain and none of the four contraindications. Give 300 to 400 mg PO.
why.zh: 轻到中度疼痛，四条禁忌一条都不沾。给 300–400 mg 口服。

bad.en: She limps down the trail with pain you could have eased.
bad.zh: 她只能一瘸一拐忍着痛下山，而这痛你本来可以帮她减轻。

stem.en: Walter, 72, sore shoulder after a fall at his Richmond care home. Pain 4 out of 10. His medication list includes warfarin.
stem.zh: Walter，72 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院摔了一跤，肩膀痛。疼痛 4/10。他的用药单上有 warfarin 华法林。

why.en: Warfarin is an anticoagulant, and anticoagulants are a contraindication.
why.zh: warfarin 华法林是抗凝药，用抗凝药就是禁忌。

bad.en: An NSAID on top of a blood thinner raises his risk of a serious bleed.
bad.zh: 抗凝药再加上 NSAID，他发生严重出血的风险更高。

stem.en: Priya, 29, tension headache on a Skytrain platform. Vitals normal. She mentions she is 10 weeks pregnant.
stem.zh: Priya，29 岁，在 Skytrain 站台上紧张性头痛。生命体征正常。她提到自己怀孕 10 周。

why.en: Pregnancy is a contraindication in the first, second and third trimesters. There is no safe window.
why.zh: 怀孕在孕早期、孕中期、孕晚期都是禁忌，没有安全窗口。

bad.en: Her baby is exposed to an NSAID for a headache that had other options.
bad.zh: 为了一个有别的办法可治的头痛，让胎儿接触了 NSAID。

stem.en: Dave, 45, back strain on a Steveston fishing boat. He took 400 mg of ibuprofen at 06:00, 10:00 and 14:00. It is 18:00 and he wants more.
stem.zh: Dave，45 岁，在 Steveston 的渔船上扭伤了腰。他在 06:00、10:00、14:00 各吃了 400 mg ibuprofen 布洛芬。现在 18:00，他还想再吃。

ask.en: What do you tell him?

opts.en: No more today. He has reached 1,200 mg
opts.zh: 今天不能再吃了，已经到 1,200 mg

opts.en: Give 400 mg, four hours have passed
opts.zh: 再给 400 mg，已经过了四小时

opts.en: Give 200 mg as a half dose
opts.zh: 给 200 mg，算半量

why.en: The maximum daily dose is 1,200 mg. Three doses of 400 mg already reach it.
why.zh: 每日最大剂量是 1,200 mg。三次 400 mg 已经到顶。

bad.en: A fourth dose puts him over the daily maximum, and the risk of adverse reactions rises with dose.
bad.zh: 第四次就超过每日上限，而不良反应的风险随剂量上升。

s.en: Ibuprofen is allowed in the third trimester if the pain is bad enough.
s.zh: 只要痛得厉害，孕晚期也可以用 ibuprofen 布洛芬。

why.en: Pregnancy is a contraindication in all three trimesters.
why.zh: 怀孕三个阶段全是禁忌。

s.en: A patient on an anticoagulant cannot have ibuprofen.
s.zh: 正在用抗凝药的病人不能给 ibuprofen 布洛芬。

why.en: Anticoagulants are on the contraindication list.
why.zh: 抗凝药在禁忌清单上。

s.en: For a child's fever, the PCP dose is 5 mg/kg below 39°C and 10 mg/kg at 39°C or higher.
s.zh: 儿童退热，PCP 的剂量是：低于 39°C 用 5 mg/kg，39°C 或以上用 10 mg/kg。

why.en: The exam monograph splits the fever dose at 39°C.
why.zh: 考试专论以 39°C 为界分两档。

s.en: On the exam, a history of kidney disease is a contraindication to ibuprofen.
s.zh: 考试里，有肾病史是 ibuprofen 布洛芬的禁忌。

why.en: It is a caution: consider another treatment.
why.zh: 它只是慎用：考虑换别的治疗。

q.en: The adult dose of ibuprofen for pain is…
q.zh: 成人止痛，ibuprofen 布洛芬的剂量是…

opts.en: 300 to 400 mg PO, repeat every 4 to 6 hours
opts.zh: 300–400 mg 口服，每 4–6 小时可重复

opts.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO, repeat once after 4 hours
opts.zh: 500–1,000 mg 口服，4 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 300 to 400 mg PO, repeat every hour
opts.zh: 300–400 mg 口服，每小时可重复

opts.en: 3,000 to 4,000 mg PO, repeat every 4 to 6 hours
opts.zh: 3,000–4,000 mg 口服，每 4–6 小时可重复

why.en: 300 to 400 mg by mouth every 4 to 6 hours, to a maximum of 1,200 mg a day.
why.zh: 300–400 mg 口服，每 4–6 小时一次，每天最多 1,200 mg。

q.en: A child's dose of ibuprofen for pain is…
q.zh: 儿童止痛，ibuprofen 布洛芬的剂量是…

opts.en: 10 mg/kg PO, may repeat once after 6 hours
opts.zh: 10 mg/kg 口服，6 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 10 mg/kg PO, may repeat every hour
opts.zh: 10 mg/kg 口服，每小时可重复

opts.en: 40 mg/kg PO, may repeat once after 6 hours
opts.zh: 40 mg/kg 口服，6 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 1 mg/kg PO, may repeat once after 6 hours
opts.zh: 1 mg/kg 口服，6 小时后可重复一次

why.en: 10 mg/kg, one repeat after 6 hours, and no more than 40 mg/kg in a day.
why.zh: 10 mg/kg，6 小时后可重复一次，一天不超过 40 mg/kg。

q.en: How does ibuprofen work?
q.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: It inhibits prostaglandin synthesis
opts.zh: 抑制前列腺素合成

opts.en: It blocks opioid receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 阻断大脑里的阿片受体

opts.en: It blocks histamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断组胺受体

opts.en: It relaxes smooth muscle in the blood vessels
opts.zh: 让血管平滑肌放松

why.en: Fewer prostaglandins means less pain, inflammation and fever.
why.zh: 前列腺素少了，疼痛、炎症和发热就都减轻。

cls.zh: 止吐药、抗组胺药、抗胆碱药、抗眩晕药

hook.en: Quiets the balance organ so the stomach settles.
hook.zh: 让内耳的平衡器官安静下来，胃也跟着消停。

how.en: The inner ear, called the labyrinth, tells the brain about motion. Dimenhydrinate turns that signal down. It also blocks the cholinergic messages that pass it on, so there is less nausea, vomiting and spinning.
how.zh: 内耳（迷路）负责把运动的信号告诉大脑。dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明把这个信号调小。它还阻断传递这个信号的胆碱能通路，所以恶心、呕吐和天旋地转都减轻。

use.en: Prevention or control of nausea and vomiting
use.zh: 预防或控制恶心、呕吐

use.en: Prevention or control of vertigo
use.zh: 预防或控制眩晕

use.en: Nausea in cardiac chest pain (PCP, p.47, Cardiac Chest Pain)
use.zh: 心源性胸痛伴恶心（PCP，p.47，Cardiac Chest Pain 心源性胸痛）

use.en: Nausea in Indigenous patients with a personal or family history of Long QT syndrome (p.75, Ondansetron monograph)
use.zh: 本人或家族有长 QT 综合征的原住民病人出现恶心（p.75，ondansetron 昂丹司琼专论）

no.en: Known hypersensitivity or allergy to dimenhydrinate
no.zh: 已知对 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明过敏

noFake.zh: 对 ondansetron 昂丹司琼过敏

care.en: Glaucoma (increased pressure inside the eye).
care.zh: 青光眼（眼内压升高）。

care.en: Asthma or COPD.
care.zh: 哮喘或 COPD。

care.en: Cardiovascular disease: hypertension, ischemic heart disease.
care.zh: 心血管疾病：高血压、缺血性心脏病。

care.en: Prostatic hyperplasia and urinary obstruction.
care.zh: 前列腺增生和尿路梗阻。

care.en: Elderly patients and pregnancy.
care.zh: 老年人和孕妇。

dose.en: 1 mg/kg IM or IV, to a maximum dose of 50 mg
dose.zh: 1 mg/kg，IM 或 IV，最大剂量 50 mg

dose.en: Contact the ER if the patient appears to be under 25 kg
dose.zh: 病人看起来不到 25 kg 时，联系 ER

dose.en: IM: give it undiluted
dose.zh: IM：不稀释直接给

dose.en: IV: dilute with NS and inject over 1 to 2 minutes
dose.zh: IV：用 NS 稀释，1–2 分钟推完

dose.en: IV, 50 mg: draw up 50 mg in a 10 mL syringe, add 9 mL of NS, mix, and give slowly over 2 minutes (25 mg/min)
dose.zh: IV 给 50 mg：用 10 mL 注射器抽 50 mg，再抽 9 mL NS，混匀，用 2 分钟慢慢推（25 mg/min）

fx.en: Dysuria (painful or difficult urination), blurred vision
fx.zh: 排尿疼痛或困难、视物模糊

pk.en: IM works in 20 to 30 minutes. IV is the most immediate.
pk.zh: 肌注 20–30 分钟起效。静脉最快。

pearl.en: It dries and it sedates, which explains the long caution list: glaucoma, asthma or COPD, heart disease, large prostate, the elderly, pregnancy. IV means diluted and slow, 25 mg/min.
pearl.zh: 它让人发干、犯困，所以注意事项一长串：青光眼、哮喘或 COPD、心脏病、前列腺肥大、老人、孕妇。静脉给药要稀释、要慢，25 mg/min。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): adults get a flat 25 to 50 mg IV or IM every 4 to 6 hours, and patients over 65 or frail get 12.5 mg. Children are ACP and above. The exam doses by weight, 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg, and says to contact the ER if the patient is under 25 kg. BCEHS also counts sensitivity to diphenhydramine or caffeine derivatives as a contraindication.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：成人固定 25–50 mg，IV 或 IM，每 4–6 小时一次。65 岁以上或体弱者 12.5 mg。儿童只有 ACP 及以上可以给。考试按体重算，1 mg/kg，上限 50 mg，体重不到 25 kg 要联系 ER。BCEHS 的禁忌还包括对 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明或咖啡因衍生物过敏。

stem.en: Emma, 31, 60 kg, on a BC Ferries crossing in rough water. Vomited three times and the room is spinning. No allergies, healthy, not pregnant.
stem.zh: Emma，31 岁，60 kg，在风浪里的 BC Ferries 渡轮上。吐了三次，天旋地转。没有过敏，平时健康，没有怀孕。

why.en: Nausea, vomiting and vertigo are the indications, and she has no contraindication. 1 mg/kg would be 60 mg, so give the maximum, 50 mg.
why.zh: 恶心、呕吐、眩晕都是适应症，她没有禁忌。1 mg/kg 算出来是 60 mg，所以给上限 50 mg。

bad.en: She keeps vomiting for the rest of the crossing and the drive.
bad.zh: 接下来的航程和车程，她会一直吐。

stem.en: Paul, 45, nauseated after a dizzy spell at a Burnaby mall. His MedicAlert bracelet reads: allergic to Gravol.
stem.zh: Paul，45 岁，在 Burnaby 的商场里一阵头晕后恶心。他的 MedicAlert 手环上写着：对 Gravol 过敏。

why.en: Known hypersensitivity or allergy to dimenhydrinate is the contraindication. Gravol is dimenhydrinate.
why.zh: 已知对 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明过敏就是禁忌。Gravol 就是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明。

bad.en: You trade his nausea for an allergic reaction.
bad.zh: 你把他的恶心换成了一场过敏反应。

stem.en: Joan, 58, 80 kg, vomiting in the ambulance outside Hope. Her IV is running. You have drawn up 50 mg in a 10 mL syringe.
stem.zh: Joan，58 岁，80 kg，在 Hope 附近的救护车上呕吐。静脉通路在滴。你已经用 10 mL 注射器抽了 50 mg。

ask.en: How do you give it IV?

opts.en: Add 9 mL of NS, then push slowly over 2 minutes
opts.zh: 再抽 9 mL NS，然后用 2 分钟慢慢推

opts.en: Push it undiluted over 10 seconds
opts.zh: 不稀释，10 秒推完

opts.en: Add it to a 1 L bag and run it over one hour
opts.zh: 加进 1 L 的袋子里，一小时滴完

why.en: IV doses are diluted with NS. 50 mg with 9 mL of NS goes in slowly over 2 minutes, which is 25 mg/min.
why.zh: 静脉给药要用 NS 稀释。50 mg 加 9 mL NS，用 2 分钟慢慢推，也就是 25 mg/min。

stem.en: Noah, 6, about 20 kg, carsick and vomiting on the Sea to Sky Highway. No allergies.
stem.zh: Noah，6 岁，大约 20 kg，在 Sea to Sky 公路上晕车呕吐。没有过敏。

ask.en: What comes before any dimenhydrinate?
ask.zh: 给 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明之前要先做什么？

opts.en: Contact the ER
opts.zh: 联系 ER

opts.en: Give 50 mg IM, the maximum dose
opts.zh: 肌注 50 mg，也就是最大剂量

opts.en: Give 20 mg IV, undiluted
opts.zh: 静脉推 20 mg，不稀释

why.en: If the patient appears to be under 25 kg, the monograph says to contact the ER.
why.zh: 病人看起来不到 25 kg 时，专论要求联系 ER。

s.en: IM dimenhydrinate is given undiluted.
s.zh: dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明肌注时不稀释。

why.en: Only the IV dose is diluted with NS.
why.zh: 只有静脉给药才用 NS 稀释。

s.en: The maximum dose is 100 mg.
s.zh: 最大剂量是 100 mg。

why.en: The dose is 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg.
why.zh: 剂量是 1 mg/kg，上限 50 mg。

s.en: Dimenhydrinate is the recommended antiemetic when Long QT syndrome runs in an Indigenous patient's family.
s.zh: 原住民病人家族里有长 QT 综合征时，推荐的止吐药是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明。

why.en: Congenital long QT is a contraindication to ondansetron (p.75, Ondansetron monograph).
why.zh: 先天性长 QT 是 ondansetron 昂丹司琼的禁忌（p.75，ondansetron 昂丹司琼专论）。

s.en: Asthma is a contraindication to dimenhydrinate.
s.zh: 哮喘是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的禁忌。

why.en: Asthma and COPD are cautions. The only contraindication is allergy to dimenhydrinate.
why.zh: 哮喘和 COPD 是注意事项。唯一的禁忌是对 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明过敏。

q.en: The dose of dimenhydrinate is…
q.zh: dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的剂量是…

opts.en: 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg
opts.zh: 1 mg/kg，上限 50 mg

opts.en: 10 mg/kg to a maximum of 500 mg
opts.zh: 10 mg/kg，上限 500 mg

opts.en: 0.1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg
opts.zh: 0.1 mg/kg，上限 50 mg

opts.en: 1 mg/kg with no maximum
opts.zh: 1 mg/kg，没有上限

why.en: It is weight-based, 1 mg/kg, and it stops at 50 mg.
why.zh: 按体重算，1 mg/kg，到 50 mg 封顶。

q.en: Which pair are adverse effects of dimenhydrinate?
q.zh: 哪一组是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的不良反应？

opts.en: Drowsiness and dry mouth
opts.zh: 嗜睡和口干

opts.en: Diarrhea and drooling
opts.zh: 腹泻和流口水

opts.en: Slow heart rate and low blood pressure
opts.zh: 心率慢和血压低

opts.en: Low blood sugar and sweating
opts.zh: 低血糖和出汗

why.en: It is anticholinergic. Drowsiness, dry mouth, tachycardia, dysuria and blurred vision are all on the list.
why.zh: 它是抗胆碱药。嗜睡、口干、心动过速、排尿困难、视物模糊都在列表里。

q.en: Which condition is a caution for dimenhydrinate?
q.zh: 哪一种情况是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的注意事项？

opts.en: Prostatic hyperplasia with urinary obstruction
opts.zh: 前列腺增生伴尿路梗阻

opts.en: Long QT syndrome
opts.zh: 长 QT 综合征

opts.en: Phenylketonuria (PKU)
opts.zh: 苯丙酮尿症（PKU）

opts.en: Peanut allergy
opts.zh: 花生过敏

why.en: Prostatic hyperplasia and urinary obstruction are cautions. Long QT and PKU belong to ondansetron.
why.zh: 前列腺增生和尿路梗阻是注意事项。长 QT 和 PKU 是 ondansetron 昂丹司琼的问题。

cls.zh: 止吐药

hook.en: Blocks the serotonin signal that makes you feel sick.
hook.zh: 挡住让人想吐的血清素信号。

how.en: Nausea travels partly on a chemical signal called serotonin. Ondansetron selectively blocks the type 3 serotonin receptors that pick the signal up. With the receptor blocked, the nausea is suppressed.
how.zh: 恶心有一部分是靠血清素这种化学信号传递的。ondansetron 昂丹司琼选择性地挡住接收这个信号的 3 型血清素受体。受体被挡住，恶心就被压下去。

use.en: Relief of moderate to severe nausea and vomiting
use.zh: 缓解中度到重度的恶心和呕吐

no.en: Known allergy or hypersensitivity to ondansetron
no.zh: 已知对 ondansetron 昂丹司琼过敏

no.en: Congenital long QT syndrome
no.zh: 先天性长 QT 综合征

no.en: Phenylketonuria (PKU): the ODT may contain aspartame. Injections are safe for these patients
no.zh: 苯丙酮尿症（PKU）：口崩片（ODT）可能含阿斯巴甜。注射剂对这类病人是安全的

no.en: First trimester of pregnancy (a relative contraindication)
no.zh: 孕早期（相对禁忌）

no.en: Indigenous patient with a personal or family diagnosis of Long QT Syndrome: dimenhydrinate is the recommended antiemetic
no.zh: 原住民病人本人或家人确诊过长 QT 综合征：推荐改用 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明止吐

noFake.en: Second or third trimester of pregnancy
A school-age child (there is a child dose)

care.en: Before giving it, assess the type and the intensity of the nausea.
care.zh: 给药前先评估恶心的类型和程度。

care.en: After giving it, check how well it worked.
care.zh: 给药后评估止吐效果。

care.en: Monitor closely for signs of respiratory depression or CNS effects.
care.zh: 密切观察有没有呼吸抑制或中枢神经系统反应的迹象。

care.en: Be extra careful with elderly patients and with hepatic or renal impairment.
care.zh: 老年病人、肝或肾功能受损的病人要格外小心。

care.en: A PCP step: stable patients may be treated on scene and unstable patients en route (p.48, Nausea and Vomiting).
care.zh: 属于 PCP 的处置：稳定的病人可以在现场给，不稳定的病人在去医院的路上给（p.48，Nausea and Vomiting）。

dose.en: 4 mg PO
dose.zh: 4 mg 口服

dose.en: 6 months to 4 years: 2 mg PO
dose.zh: 6 个月到 4 岁：2 mg 口服

dose.en: 4 years and older: 4 mg PO
dose.zh: 4 岁及以上：4 mg 口服

dose.en: Oral is the only route in the exam monograph
dose.zh: 考试专论只列了口服这一种途径

fx.en: None listed in the exam monograph
fx.zh: 考试专论没有列出不良反应

pk.en: Starts in 15 to 30 minutes, peaks at 1 hour and lasts more than 5 hours.
pk.zh: 15–30 分钟起效，1 小时达到高峰，维持 5 小时以上。

pearl.en: Three questions before the tablet: long QT in you or your family, PKU, and could you be in early pregnancy. With an Indigenous patient, always ask the long QT question.
pearl.zh: 给药前问三件事：本人或家人有没有长 QT，有没有 PKU，会不会正处在孕早期。病人是原住民时，长 QT 这一问每次都要问。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): a PCP gives the 4 mg by ODT, IV or IM, once only. The exam lists the oral route only. BCEHS counts acquired long QT as well as congenital. It does not list first trimester pregnancy or the question for Indigenous patients.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：PCP 可以用口崩片、IV 或 IM 给 4 mg，只给一次。考试只列了口服。BCEHS 把后天获得的长 QT 也算禁忌，不只是先天性的。它没有列孕早期，也没有针对原住民病人的那一问。

stem.en: Nora, 52, vomiting for six hours after oysters in Tofino. Alert, BP 118/72. No allergies, no heart history, no PKU, not pregnant. You are the PCP.
stem.zh: Nora，52 岁，在 Tofino 吃了生蚝后吐了六个小时。清醒，血压 118/72。没有过敏，没有心脏病史，没有 PKU，没有怀孕。你是 PCP。

why.en: Moderate to severe nausea and vomiting, and no contraindication. Give 4 mg PO.
why.zh: 中到重度的恶心呕吐，没有禁忌。给 4 mg 口服。

bad.en: She keeps vomiting through a long transport.
bad.zh: 漫长的转运路上她一直在吐。

stem.en: Ben, 19, vomiting after a rough ferry crossing to Nanaimo. He mentions he has PKU and follows a special diet. You carry ondansetron ODT.
stem.zh: Ben，19 岁，坐渡轮去 Nanaimo 遇上风浪，一直在吐。他提到自己有 PKU，要吃特殊饮食。你带的是 ondansetron 昂丹司琼口崩片（ODT）。

why.en: The ODT may contain aspartame, which patients with phenylketonuria should avoid.
why.zh: 口崩片可能含阿斯巴甜，苯丙酮尿症病人应当避开。

bad.en: The aspartame gives him the phenylalanine his diet exists to keep out.
bad.zh: 阿斯巴甜带来的苯丙氨酸，正是他的饮食要挡在外面的东西。

stem.en: Mary, 45, vomiting with a migraine at home in Hazelton. She is Indigenous. Her brother was diagnosed with Long QT Syndrome.
stem.zh: Mary，45 岁，在 Hazelton 的家里偏头痛发作、不停呕吐。她是原住民。她的哥哥确诊过长 QT 综合征。

why.en: An Indigenous patient with a family diagnosis of Long QT Syndrome: dimenhydrinate is the recommended antiemetic.
why.zh: 原住民病人，家人确诊过长 QT 综合征：推荐用 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明止吐。

bad.en: If she carries the same variation, ondansetron can lengthen her QT and set off a dangerous rhythm.
bad.zh: 如果她带着同样的基因变异，ondansetron 昂丹司琼会让 QT 更长，可能引发危险的心律失常。

stem.en: Lily, 2, has vomited five times since breakfast at her Langley daycare. Alert, no contraindications. You are the PCP.
stem.zh: Lily，2 岁，在 Langley 的托儿所里从早饭后已经吐了五次。清醒，没有禁忌。你是 PCP。

ask.en: What is her dose?

opts.en: 2 mg PO
opts.zh: 2 mg 口服

opts.en: 4 mg PO
opts.zh: 4 mg 口服

opts.en: 1 mg PO
opts.zh: 1 mg 口服

why.en: From 6 months to 4 years the dose is 2 mg PO. From 4 years and older it is 4 mg.
why.zh: 6 个月到 4 岁是 2 mg 口服。4 岁及以上是 4 mg。

s.en: PKU rules out every form of ondansetron.
s.zh: 有 PKU 就任何剂型的 ondansetron 昂丹司琼都不能用。

why.en: Only the ODT, which may contain aspartame. Injections are safe in PKU.
why.zh: 只是口崩片不行，因为可能含阿斯巴甜。注射剂对 PKU 病人是安全的。

s.en: First trimester pregnancy is a relative contraindication.
s.zh: 孕早期是相对禁忌。

why.en: Relative is the word the monograph uses.
why.zh: 专论用的就是“相对”这个词。

s.en: A 6-year-old gets the same 4 mg PO dose as an adult.
s.zh: 6 岁的孩子和成人一样，给 4 mg 口服。

why.en: The monograph gives 4 mg PO for 4 years and older, and 4 mg PO for adults.
why.zh: 专论写的是 4 岁及以上 4 mg 口服，成人也是 4 mg 口服。

s.en: On the exam, ondansetron can be given PO or IM.
s.zh: 考试里 ondansetron 昂丹司琼可以口服，也可以 IM。

why.en: The exam monograph lists oral administration only.
why.zh: 考试专论只列了口服。

q.en: The adult dose of ondansetron is…
q.zh: 成人的 ondansetron 昂丹司琼剂量是…

opts.en: 4 mg PO
opts.zh: 4 mg 口服

opts.en: 40 mg PO
opts.zh: 40 mg 口服

opts.en: 2 mg PO
opts.zh: 2 mg 口服

opts.en: 0.4 mg PO
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 口服

why.en: 4 mg by mouth. The 2 mg dose is for children from 6 months to 4 years.
why.zh: 4 mg 口服。2 mg 是 6 个月到 4 岁儿童的剂量。

q.en: Ondansetron works by…
q.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼的作用方式是…

opts.en: Blocking type 3 serotonin receptors
opts.zh: 阻断 3 型血清素受体

opts.en: Blocking histamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断组胺受体

opts.en: Blocking dopamine receptors in the gut
opts.zh: 阻断肠道里的多巴胺受体

opts.en: Lowering stomach acid
opts.zh: 减少胃酸

why.en: It selectively inhibits type 3 serotonergic receptors, which suppresses nausea.
why.zh: 它选择性抑制 3 型血清素受体，从而压住恶心。

q.en: Long QT Syndrome runs in an Indigenous patient's family. Which antiemetic does the monograph recommend?
q.zh: 原住民病人的家族里有长 QT 综合征。专论推荐用哪种止吐药？

opts.en: Dimenhydrinate
opts.zh: dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明

opts.en: Ondansetron at half the dose
opts.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼，剂量减半

opts.en: Ondansetron by injection
opts.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼，改用注射

opts.en: No antiemetic at all
opts.zh: 什么止吐药都不给

why.en: Ask the question. If the answer is yes, dimenhydrinate is the recommended antiemetic.
why.zh: 先问。回答是“有”，推荐的止吐药就是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明。

cls.zh: 抗炎药，全身性皮质类固醇

hook.en: A steroid that calms inflamed airways over minutes to hours.
hook.zh: 一种类固醇，用几分钟到几小时把发炎的气道压下去。

how.en: It stops neutrophils, a kind of white blood cell, from moving into the tissue. Fewer inflammatory chemicals are made. Leaky capillaries tighten up again, so the swelling goes down.
how.zh: 它不让中性粒细胞（一种白细胞）跑进组织里。炎症介质产生得少了。渗漏的毛细血管重新收紧，肿胀就消下去。

use.en: Adjunctive treatment for croup
use.zh: croup（哮吼）的辅助治疗

use.en: Adjunctive treatment for bronchospasm secondary to asthma
use.zh: 哮喘引起的支气管痉挛的辅助治疗

use.en: Adjunctive treatment for bronchospasm secondary to COPD
use.zh: COPD 引起的支气管痉挛的辅助治疗

no.en: Systemic fungal infections
no.zh: 全身性真菌感染

no.en: Hypersensitivity to dexamethasone or other corticosteroids
no.zh: 对 dexamethasone 地塞米松或其他皮质类固醇过敏

noFake.zh: 已经给过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

care.en: Not generally used for adrenal insufficiency, because it has no mineralocorticoid activity.
care.zh: 一般不用于肾上腺功能不全，因为它没有盐皮质激素活性。

care.en: Heart failure or hypertension: it is linked to fluid retention and electrolyte disturbance.
care.zh: 心力衰竭或高血压：它和液体潴留、电解质紊乱有关。

care.en: Acute myocardial infarction: corticosteroids are linked to myocardial rupture.
care.zh: 急性心肌梗死：皮质类固醇和心肌破裂有关。

care.en: Pregnancy: it crosses the placenta, and first-trimester steroid use is linked to oral clefts and lower birth weight.
care.zh: 怀孕：它能通过胎盘，孕早期用类固醇和唇腭裂、出生体重偏低有关。

dose.en: 8 mg IV, IO, IM or PO for all indications. PO preferred.
dose.zh: 所有适应症：8 mg，IV、IO、IM 或 PO 都可以。首选 PO。

dose.en: 0.5 mg/kg IV, IO, IM or PO for all indications, to a maximum of 16 mg. PO preferred.
dose.zh: 所有适应症：0.5 mg/kg，IV、IO、IM 或 PO，上限 16 mg。首选 PO。

dose.en: May be combined with juice to improve the taste
dose.zh: 可以混在果汁里改善口感

dose.en: PCP: consider it for shortness of breath with a history of asthma or COPD (p.49, SOB With History of Asthma/COPD)
dose.zh: PCP：有哮喘或 COPD 病史的呼吸困难，可以考虑使用（p.49，SOB With History of Asthma/COPD 哮喘/COPD 呼吸困难）

fx.en: Hypercortisolism, mostly in younger children or with long use at higher doses
fx.zh: 皮质醇增多症，多见于年幼儿童或长期大剂量使用

pk.en: Onset is minutes to hours, depending on the indication and route. Peak is 1 to 2 hours PO and 8 hours IM.
pk.zh: 起效需要几分钟到几小时，取决于适应症和给药途径。口服 1–2 小时达峰，肌注 8 小时达峰。

pearl.en: Two exam traps. PO is preferred, even with four routes allowed. And the child maximum, 16 mg, is higher than the adult dose, 8 mg.
pearl.zh: 两个考试陷阱。虽然有四种途径，首选是口服。儿童上限 16 mg，比成人剂量 8 mg 还高。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the child dose is 0.6 mg/kg, not 0.5 mg/kg, and the routes are IV or PO only. BCEHS requires a CliniCall consult before every dose and treats croup only in children over 6 months.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：儿童剂量是 0.6 mg/kg，不是 0.5 mg/kg，途径只有 IV 或 PO。BCEHS 每次给药前都必须咨询 CliniCall，croup（哮吼）只治 6 个月以上的儿童。

stem.en: Nadia, 44, known asthma, still wheezing after salbutamol and ipratropium on a Kamloops ranch. Speaks in short sentences. No allergies, otherwise healthy.
stem.zh: Nadia，44 岁，已知哮喘，在 Kamloops 的牧场上用了 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵后还在喘。只能说短句。没有过敏，平时健康。

why.en: Bronchospasm from asthma is an indication, as an adjunct. She has no contraindications. Give 8 mg, PO preferred.
why.zh: 哮喘引起的支气管痉挛是适应症，作为辅助用药。她没有禁忌症。给 8 mg，首选口服。

bad.en: She misses the one drug that works on the airway swelling over the next hours.
bad.zh: 她错过了接下来几小时里唯一能消气道肿胀的药。

stem.en: Harold, 71, COPD flare in a Nanaimo care home. His chart shows IV antifungals for a fungal infection in his blood.
stem.zh: Harold，71 岁，在 Nanaimo 的护理院里 COPD 发作。病历上写着他正在静脉用抗真菌药治疗血液里的真菌感染。

why.en: Systemic fungal infection is a contraindication.
why.zh: 全身性真菌感染是禁忌。

bad.en: A steroid holds back his defences while a fungus is in his bloodstream.
bad.zh: 真菌还在血液里，类固醇却把他的防御压了下去。

stem.en: Ines, 29, asthma attack at a Whistler hotel. She says prednisone gave her hives and a swollen face last year.
stem.zh: Ines，29 岁，在 Whistler 的酒店里哮喘发作。她说去年吃 prednisone 泼尼松后起了荨麻疹，脸也肿了。

why.en: Hypersensitivity to dexamethasone or other corticosteroids is a contraindication. Prednisone is a corticosteroid.
why.zh: 对 dexamethasone 地塞米松或其他皮质类固醇过敏是禁忌。prednisone 泼尼松就是一种皮质类固醇。

bad.en: You risk an allergic reaction on top of an asthma attack.
bad.zh: 哮喘发作之上，你又可能加一场过敏反应。

stem.en: Leo, 2, 12 kg, barking cough and stridor at night in Coquitlam. Diagnosed croup. He can swallow. No allergies.
stem.zh: Leo，2 岁，12 kg，夜里在 Coquitlam 家中犬吠样咳嗽、喘鸣。已诊断 croup（哮吼）。能吞咽。没有过敏。

ask.en: Which dose and route?

opts.en: 6 mg PO, mixed with juice
opts.zh: 6 mg 口服，混在果汁里

opts.en: 8 mg IM, the adult dose
opts.zh: 8 mg 肌注，成人剂量

opts.en: 60 mg PO, mixed with juice
opts.zh: 60 mg 口服，混在果汁里

why.en: The child dose is 0.5 mg/kg, to a maximum of 16 mg. PO is preferred, and juice improves the taste.
why.zh: 儿童剂量是 0.5 mg/kg，上限 16 mg。首选口服，混果汁口感更好。

s.en: PO is the preferred route for dexamethasone.
s.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松首选口服。

why.en: IV, IO, IM and PO are all allowed, but PO is preferred.
why.zh: IV、IO、IM、PO 都可以，但首选 PO。

s.en: The pediatric maximum is 8 mg, the same as the adult dose.
s.zh: 儿童上限是 8 mg，和成人剂量一样。

why.en: The pediatric maximum is 16 mg.
why.zh: 儿童上限是 16 mg。

s.en: Dexamethasone is an adjunct for croup, asthma and COPD.
s.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松是 croup（哮吼）、哮喘和 COPD 的辅助用药。

why.en: The indication is adjunctive treatment, so it is added to other care.
why.zh: 适应症写的是辅助治疗，所以是加在其他处理之上的。

s.en: Dexamethasone is a good choice for adrenal insufficiency.
s.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松很适合治疗肾上腺功能不全。

why.en: It has no mineralocorticoid activity, so it should not generally be used for that.
why.zh: 它没有盐皮质激素活性，一般不应该用于这种情况。

q.en: The adult dose of dexamethasone is…
q.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松的成人剂量是…

opts.en: 8 mg, PO preferred
opts.zh: 8 mg，首选口服

opts.en: 0.8 mg, PO preferred
opts.zh: 0.8 mg，首选口服

opts.en: 80 mg, IV only
opts.zh: 80 mg，只能静脉

opts.en: 16 mg, IM only
opts.zh: 16 mg，只能肌注

why.en: Adults get 8 mg for all indications by IV, IO, IM or PO, with PO preferred.
why.zh: 成人所有适应症都是 8 mg，IV、IO、IM 或 PO，首选 PO。

q.en: How does dexamethasone work?
q.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: It suppresses neutrophil migration and inflammatory mediators
opts.zh: 抑制中性粒细胞迁移和炎症介质

opts.en: It relaxes the airway muscle directly
opts.zh: 直接放松气道平滑肌

opts.en: It blocks histamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断组胺受体

opts.en: It dries up airway secretions
opts.zh: 让气道分泌物变干

why.en: It suppresses neutrophil migration, lowers inflammatory mediators and reverses increased capillary permeability.
why.zh: 它抑制中性粒细胞迁移，减少炎症介质，并逆转毛细血管通透性升高。

q.en: Which patient needs extra caution with dexamethasone?
q.zh: 哪个病人用 dexamethasone 地塞米松要格外小心？

opts.en: A patient with heart failure
opts.zh: 有心力衰竭的病人

opts.en: A patient with a broken wrist
opts.zh: 手腕骨折的病人

opts.en: A patient who uses a salbutamol inhaler
opts.zh: 平时用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇吸入器的病人

opts.en: A patient with seasonal allergies
opts.zh: 有季节性过敏的病人

why.en: It is linked to fluid retention and electrolyte disturbance, so heart failure and hypertension are cautions.
why.zh: 它和液体潴留、电解质紊乱有关，所以心力衰竭和高血压是注意事项。

cls.zh: 止血药，抗纤溶药

hook.en: Stops the body from dissolving the clots it has made.
hook.zh: 不让身体把刚形成的血凝块溶掉。

how.en: After an injury the body builds clots and also starts to break them down. TXA competes for the TPA receptor sites, so the clot is not broken down. It does not build new clots. It protects the ones already there.
how.zh: 受伤后，身体一边形成血凝块，一边又开始把它分解掉。TXA 氨甲环酸去抢 TPA 的受体位点，血凝块就不会被分解。它不会造出新的血凝块，只是保住已经形成的。

use.en: Major trauma, after the hypovolemia protocol has been started
use.zh: 重大创伤，在启动低血容量方案之后

use.en: Signs of shock, with a mechanism of injury or physical findings that suggest occult or ongoing bleeding
use.zh: 有休克表现，而且受伤机制或体检发现提示隐匿性或持续性出血

no.en: More than 3 hours since the injury
no.zh: 受伤已超过 3 小时

no.en: Patient under 12 years
no.zh: 病人未满 12 岁

no.en: Isolated TBI (traumatic brain injury)
no.zh: 单纯的创伤性脑损伤（isolated TBI）

no.en: Known hypersensitivity or allergy to TXA
no.zh: 已知对 TXA 氨甲环酸过敏

noFake.en: Low blood pressure from blood loss
Head injury together with other major injuries
noFake.zh: 头部受伤同时还有其他重伤

care.en: Given too quickly, it can cause further hypotension.
care.zh: 推得太快会让血压进一步下降。

care.en: It follows the start of the hypovolemia protocol and does not replace it.
care.zh: 它排在启动低血容量方案之后，不能代替方案里的其他处置。

care.en: A PCP step, en route or during a time delay (p.54, Hypovolemia).
care.zh: 属于 PCP 的处置，在途中或转运延误时给（p.54，Hypovolemia）。

care.en: The monograph lists epistaxis and postpartum hemorrhage as considerations, with no further detail.
care.zh: 专论把鼻出血和产后出血列为“考虑事项”，但没有进一步说明。

dose.en: Age 12 years and over: 2 g (2000 mg) IV push over 1 minute
dose.zh: 12 岁及以上：2 g（2000 mg），IV 推注，1 分钟推完

dose.en: Under 12 years: contraindicated
dose.zh: 未满 12 岁：禁用

dose.en: Only within 3 hours of the injury
dose.zh: 只能在受伤后 3 小时以内给

fx.en: Further hypotension if administered too quickly
fx.zh: 推得太快会让血压进一步下降

pk.en: Onset is immediate.
pk.zh: 立即起效。

pearl.en: Three hard stops: more than 3 hours since the injury, under 12 years, isolated TBI. Then push the 2 g over a full minute, by the clock.
pearl.zh: 三条硬杠：受伤超过 3 小时，未满 12 岁，单纯的创伤性脑损伤。过了这三关，再看着表用整整一分钟把 2 g 推完。

diff.en: On the road (BCEHS): the same 2 g IV push over 1 minute. BCEHS does not list isolated TBI as a contraindication, but it adds non-traumatic GI bleeding. A BCEHS PCP may also give TXA for shock with vaginal bleeding after 20 weeks or postpartum hemorrhage, after a CliniCall consult.
diff.zh: 路上（BCEHS）：同样是 2 g IV 推注，1 分钟推完。BCEHS 没有把单纯的创伤性脑损伤列为禁忌，但多了一条非创伤性消化道出血。BCEHS 的 PCP 在咨询 CliniCall 之后，还可以给孕 20 周后阴道出血或产后出血伴休克的病人用 TXA 氨甲环酸。

stem.en: Kyle, 31, motorcycle crash on the Sea to Sky 40 minutes ago. Pale, BP 82/50, HR 128, rigid abdomen. Hypovolemia protocol started, IV running. You are the PCP.
stem.zh: Kyle，31 岁，40 分钟前在 Sea to Sky 公路上骑摩托车出了车祸。面色苍白，血压 82/50，心率 128，腹部板样硬。低血容量方案已经启动，静脉通路已建好。你是 PCP。

why.en: Shock with findings that suggest occult bleeding. Under 3 hours from injury, older than 12, not an isolated TBI. Give 2 g IV push over 1 minute.
why.zh: 休克，体检发现提示隐匿性出血。受伤不到 3 小时，年龄超过 12 岁，不是单纯的脑损伤。给 2 g IV 推注，1 分钟推完。

bad.en: His clots keep dissolving while he bleeds into his abdomen.
bad.zh: 他的腹腔还在出血，血凝块却不断被溶掉。

stem.en: Hank, 54, logger near Port Renfrew, pelvis crushed by a log. His crew says it happened about four hours ago. BP 86/54, HR 122.
stem.zh: Hank，54 岁，Port Renfrew 附近的伐木工，骨盆被原木压伤。同事说大约是四个小时前的事。血压 86/54，心率 122。

why.en: More than 3 hours after the injury is a contraindication.
why.zh: 受伤超过 3 小时就是禁忌。

bad.en: This late the drug no longer helps him and may do harm.
bad.zh: 这么晚才给，药已经帮不上忙，反而可能有害。

stem.en: Olivia, 23, fell from a climbing wall in Squamish and landed on her head. GCS 9, scalp hematoma, BP 138/84, HR 72. No other injuries found.
stem.zh: Olivia，23 岁，在 Squamish 从攀岩墙上摔下来，头部着地。GCS 9，头皮血肿，血压 138/84，心率 72。没发现其他伤。

why.en: This is an isolated TBI, and TXA is contraindicated for isolated TBIs (p.27, Traumatic Brain Injuries).
why.zh: 这是单纯的创伤性脑损伤，TXA 氨甲环酸对单纯的脑损伤是禁忌（p.27，Traumatic Brain Injuries）。

bad.en: She has no hidden bleeding for TXA to help, so she gets only the risk.
bad.zh: 她没有需要 TXA 氨甲环酸帮忙的隐匿性出血，只白白担了风险。

stem.en: Amir, 40, stabbed in the flank outside a Surrey bar. BP 80/48. Your 2 g of TXA is drawn up. Your partner says to push it fast.
stem.zh: Amir，40 岁，在 Surrey 一家酒吧外被刺中侧腹。血压 80/48。你的 2 g TXA 氨甲环酸已经抽好。搭档让你快点推。

ask.en: How do you give it?

opts.en: IV push over 1 minute
opts.zh: IV 推注，1 分钟推完

opts.en: IV push as fast as it will go
opts.zh: IV 推注，能多快就多快

opts.en: IM in the thigh, it is quicker
opts.zh: 大腿 IM，更快

why.en: 2 g IV push over 1 minute. Given too quickly it can cause further hypotension.
why.zh: 2 g IV 推注，1 分钟推完。推得太快会让血压进一步下降。

bad.en: A faster push can drop a pressure that is already too low.
bad.zh: 推得更快，可能把本来就太低的血压再拉下去。

s.en: TXA can still be given four hours after the injury if the bleeding continues.
s.zh: 只要还在出血，受伤四小时后仍然可以给 TXA 氨甲环酸。

why.en: More than 3 hours after injury is a contraindication.
why.zh: 受伤超过 3 小时就是禁忌。

s.en: A child under 12 years cannot have TXA on the exam, even in shock.
s.zh: 考试里，未满 12 岁的孩子即使休克也不能给 TXA 氨甲环酸。

why.en: Patient under 12 years is a contraindication.
why.zh: 未满 12 岁是禁忌。

s.en: TXA is the first step, given before the hypovolemia protocol starts.
s.zh: TXA 氨甲环酸是第一步，在启动低血容量方案之前就给。

why.en: It comes after initiation of the hypovolemia protocol.
why.zh: 它排在启动低血容量方案之后。

s.en: TXA works by stopping clots from being broken down.
s.zh: TXA 氨甲环酸的作用是阻止血凝块被分解。

why.en: It competes for TPA receptor sites, which prevents clot degradation.
why.zh: 它竞争 TPA 的受体位点，从而阻止血凝块降解。

q.en: The dose of TXA is…
q.zh: TXA 氨甲环酸的剂量是…

opts.en: 2 g IV push over 1 minute
opts.zh: 2 g IV 推注，1 分钟推完

opts.en: 2 g IV push over 10 seconds
opts.zh: 2 g IV 推注，10 秒推完

opts.en: 200 mg IV push over 1 minute
opts.zh: 200 mg IV 推注，1 分钟推完

opts.en: 2 g IM, single injection
opts.zh: 2 g IM，打一针

why.en: 2 g, which is 2000 mg, by IV push over 1 minute.
why.zh: 2 g，也就是 2000 mg，IV 推注，1 分钟推完。

q.en: Which patient must NOT get TXA?
q.zh: 下面哪个病人不能给 TXA 氨甲环酸？

opts.en: A fall with an isolated traumatic brain injury
opts.zh: 摔伤，只有单纯的创伤性脑损伤

opts.en: A crash two hours ago with signs of shock
opts.zh: 两小时前车祸，有休克表现

opts.en: An adult in shock with a rigid abdomen
opts.zh: 成年人，休克，腹部板样硬

opts.en: A stabbing with ongoing bleeding and low pressure
opts.zh: 刺伤，持续出血，血压低

why.en: Isolated TBI is a contraindication. So are age under 12 and more than 3 hours since the injury.
why.zh: 单纯的创伤性脑损伤是禁忌。未满 12 岁、受伤超过 3 小时也是。

q.en: What can happen if TXA is pushed too fast?
q.zh: TXA 氨甲环酸推得太快会怎样？

opts.en: Further hypotension
opts.zh: 血压进一步下降

opts.en: A sudden rise in blood pressure
opts.zh: 血压突然升高

opts.en: Bronchospasm
opts.zh: 支气管痉挛

opts.en: Low blood sugar
opts.zh: 低血糖

why.en: The monograph warns of further hypotension if it is administered too quickly.
why.zh: 专论提醒：给得太快会让血压进一步下降。

bcehs.name: Naloxone (Narcan)

cls.zh: 阿片类（麻醉性镇痛药）拮抗剂

hook.en: Pushes opioids off their receptors so breathing comes back.
hook.zh: 把阿片类药从受体上挤下来，呼吸就回来了。

how.en: Opioids sit on receptors in the brain and slow the breathing. Naloxone competes for the same receptors and takes their place. It fits the lock but does not turn it.
how.zh: 阿片类药坐在大脑的受体上，让呼吸变慢。naloxone 纳洛酮去抢同一批受体，把位置占掉。它插得进锁孔，但不会去转动。

use.en: Reversal of respiratory depression caused by suspected narcotic intoxication
use.zh: 逆转怀疑由阿片类中毒引起的呼吸抑制

no.en: Neonates
no.zh: 新生儿

no.en: Allergy or known hypersensitivity to naloxone
no.zh: 对 naloxone 纳洛酮过敏或已知超敏

noFake.en: Not sure which drug was taken
noFake.zh: 不确定病人用的是什么药

care.en: Sudden reversal may make the patient combative.
care.zh: 突然逆转可能让病人变得有攻击性。

care.en: It may bring on withdrawal signs and symptoms.
care.zh: 可能诱发戒断的症状和体征。

care.en: Palliative patient: titrate small doses, so breathing returns without losing pain control.
care.zh: 姑息治疗的病人：小剂量慢慢滴定，让呼吸恢复，又不把止痛效果打掉。

care.en: Heat may weaken it: after 4 or more weeks stored above 40°C it may take higher doses.
care.zh: 受热可能让药效下降：在 40°C 以上存放 4 周或更久，可能要用更大的剂量。

dose.en: PCP: 0.4 mg, 0.4 mg, 0.8 mg, then 2 mg, IM or IV. IV is preferred for the fourth dose
dose.zh: PCP：0.4 mg、0.4 mg、0.8 mg、然后 2 mg，肌注或静注。第四剂首选静注

dose.en: Every 3 minutes as required. Maximum 4 doses, then CliniCall consultation before any more
dose.zh: 按需要每 3 分钟一次。最多 4 剂，之后要再给必须先咨询 CliniCall

dose.en: EMR: the same four doses, IM only. FR: 0.4 mg IM, or IN by metered device, maximum 3 doses
dose.zh: EMR：同样的四剂，只能肌注。FR：0.4 mg 肌注，或用定量装置鼻内给药，最多 3 剂

dose.en: Palliative patient: titrate 0.1 mg IM or IV per minute
dose.zh: 姑息治疗的病人：每分钟 0.1 mg 肌注或静注，慢慢滴定

dose.en: 0.1 mg/kg IM, maximum 2 mg per dose. Repeat every 3 minutes, maximum 4 doses
dose.zh: 0.1 mg/kg 肌注，每剂最多 2 mg。每 3 分钟重复，最多 4 剂

dose.en: Never in neonates. FR is not authorized to give it to children
dose.zh: 新生儿绝对不能用。FR 不得给儿童用

fx.zh: 突然逆转后出现攻击行为

pk.en: Works in 1 to 3 minutes IM or IV, peaks at 5 to 15 minutes and lasts 30 to 45 minutes.
pk.zh: 肌注或静注 1–3 分钟起效，5–15 分钟达峰，维持 30–45 分钟。

pearl.en: You are fixing the breathing, not waking the patient up. Count the doses out loud: 0.4, 0.4, 0.8, 2, three minutes apart. Then it is CliniCall.
pearl.zh: 你要救的是呼吸，不是把人叫醒。剂量大声数出来：0.4、0.4、0.8、2，每次隔三分钟。再往后就是 CliniCall 的事了。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the same 0.4, 0.4, 0.8 and 2 mg steps, but each repeat is tied to a target: give it if SpO2 of 94% or more and ventilations above 10 have not been reached. The exam also lists 4 mg IN, adds depressed mental status to the indication, has allergy as its only contraindication and gives no child dose.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：同样是 0.4、0.4、0.8、2 mg 这几步，但每次重复都挂着一个目标：SpO2 没到 94% 或以上、通气没超过 10 次，才给下一剂。考试还列了 4 mg 鼻内，适应证里多了「意识状态受抑制」，禁忌只有过敏，没有儿童剂量。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Naloxone drug monograph

stem.en: Dev, 27, found in a stairwell in the Downtown Eastside. Blue lips, pinpoint pupils, breathing 4 times a minute, SpO2 78%. A needle lies beside him.
stem.zh: Dev，27 岁，在 Downtown Eastside 的楼梯间里被发现。嘴唇发紫，瞳孔针尖样，每分钟呼吸 4 次，SpO2 78%。身边有一支针。

why.en: Respiratory depression with suspected narcotic intoxication. Give 0.4 mg IM or IV and look again in 3 minutes.
why.zh: 呼吸抑制，怀疑阿片类中毒。给 0.4 mg 肌注或静注，3 分钟后再评估。

bad.en: He keeps breathing 4 times a minute until his heart stops.
bad.zh: 他就这样每分钟呼吸 4 次，直到心脏停下来。

stem.en: Ruth, 58, cancer patient in Kerrisdale. Took her prescribed hydromorphone an hour ago. Sleepy, wakes to voice, breathing 16 a minute, SpO2 97%.
stem.zh: Ruth，58 岁，住在 Kerrisdale 的癌症病人。一小时前吃了医生开的 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮。犯困，一叫就醒，每分钟呼吸 16 次，SpO2 97%。

why.en: There is no respiratory depression to reverse. Sleepy on an opioid is not the indication.
why.zh: 没有呼吸抑制可以逆转。吃了阿片类药犯困，不是适应证。

bad.en: You throw her into withdrawal and bring her cancer pain back, and her breathing was never the problem.
bad.zh: 你把她推进戒断反应，癌痛也回来了，而她的呼吸从头到尾就没问题。

stem.en: Baby girl, born 10 minutes ago in a Surrey apartment. Limp, slow breathing. Her mother used fentanyl an hour before delivery.
stem.zh: 女婴，10 分钟前在 Surrey 的一间公寓里出生。全身软，呼吸慢。妈妈分娩前一小时用过 fentanyl 芬太尼。

why.en: Neonates are a contraindication. The monograph says never administer naloxone to neonates.
why.zh: 新生儿是禁忌。专论写明：绝对不要给新生儿用 naloxone 纳洛酮。

bad.en: You have given a banned drug to a newborn. What she needed was help with her breathing.
bad.zh: 你给新生儿用了禁用的药。她真正需要的是有人帮她呼吸。

stem.en: Kyle, 33, overdose in a tent in Chilliwack. You have given 0.4 mg IM twice, 3 minutes apart. Three minutes later he still breathes 6 times a minute.
stem.zh: Kyle，33 岁，在 Chilliwack 的帐篷里用药过量。你已经肌注了两次 0.4 mg，中间隔 3 分钟。又过了三分钟，他还是每分钟只呼吸 6 次。

ask.en: What is the third dose?

opts.en: 0.8 mg IM
opts.zh: 0.8 mg 肌注

opts.en: 0.4 mg IM
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 肌注

opts.en: 2 mg IM
opts.zh: 2 mg 肌注

why.en: The schedule is 0.4, 0.4, 0.8, then 2 mg, every 3 minutes as required.
why.zh: 顺序是 0.4、0.4、0.8、然后 2 mg，按需要每 3 分钟一次。

s.en: After the fourth dose you need a CliniCall consultation before giving more.
s.zh: 第四剂之后还要再给，必须先咨询 CliniCall。

why.en: CliniCall consultation is required before any further doses.
why.zh: 再往后给药之前必须咨询 CliniCall。

s.en: The goal of naloxone is a patient who is wide awake and talking.
s.zh: 用 naloxone 纳洛酮的目标，是让病人完全清醒、能说话。

why.en: The indication is reversal of respiratory depression. Breathing is the target.
why.zh: 适应证是逆转呼吸抑制。目标是呼吸。

s.en: A child gets a higher dose per kilogram, because children are unlikely to go into withdrawal.
s.zh: 儿童按公斤算的剂量更高，因为儿童不太会出现戒断。

why.en: The monograph says exactly that, and gives 0.1 mg/kg IM.
why.zh: 专论就是这么写的，剂量是 0.1 mg/kg 肌注。

s.en: Naloxone doses are spaced 10 minutes apart so each one can work.
s.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮每剂之间要隔 10 分钟，好让每一剂起效。

why.en: Doses are every 3 minutes as required.
why.zh: 按需要每 3 分钟一剂。

q.en: For an adult overdose, the PCP naloxone doses in order are…
q.zh: 成人用药过量，PCP 的 naloxone 纳洛酮剂量依次是…

opts.en: 0.4, 0.4, 0.8, then 2 mg, every 3 minutes
0.4, 0.4, 0.8, then 2 mg, every 10 minutes
4, 4, 8, then 20 mg, every 3 minutes
opts.zh: 4、4、8、然后 20 mg，每 3 分钟

opts.en: 2, 0.8, 0.4, then 0.4 mg, every 3 minutes

why.en: Start low and climb: 0.4, 0.4, 0.8, 2 mg, IM or IV, 3 minutes apart, maximum 4 doses.
why.zh: 从小剂量往上加：0.4、0.4、0.8、2 mg，肌注或静注，间隔 3 分钟，最多 4 剂。

q.en: How does naloxone work?
q.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: It competes with opioids for their receptors in the central nervous system
opts.zh: 在中枢神经系统里和阿片类药竞争受体

opts.en: It speeds up the breakdown of opioids in the liver
opts.zh: 加快肝脏对阿片类药的分解

opts.en: It directly stimulates the breathing centre in the brain
opts.zh: 直接兴奋大脑的呼吸中枢

opts.en: It binds to the opioid in the blood and traps it
opts.zh: 在血液里结合阿片类药，把它困住

why.en: It competitively antagonizes opioids bound to receptors in the central nervous system.
why.zh: 它竞争性拮抗结合在中枢神经系统受体上的阿片类药。

q.en: Naloxone has just worked. What should you be ready for?
q.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮刚刚起效。你要准备好应付什么？

opts.en: A combative patient with withdrawal signs and vomiting
opts.zh: 病人有攻击性，出现戒断表现并呕吐

opts.en: A sleepy patient with a slow heart rate
opts.zh: 病人犯困，心率变慢

opts.en: A sudden drop in blood sugar
opts.zh: 血糖突然下降

opts.en: Wheezing and a swollen tongue
opts.zh: 喘鸣和舌头肿胀

why.en: Sudden reversal may provoke combativeness and withdrawal, with nausea, vomiting, sweating and tachycardia.
why.zh: 突然逆转可能引发攻击行为和戒断，伴有恶心、呕吐、出汗和心动过速。

bcehs.name: Salbutamol (Ventolin)

cls.zh: 支气管扩张药，拟交感神经药

hook.en: Relaxes the airway muscles so air can move again.
hook.zh: 让气道的肌肉松开，气又能进出了。

how.en: It switches on beta-2 receptors in the muscle around the airways. The muscle relaxes and the airways open. At higher doses some beta-1 effect shows up, and the heart speeds up.
how.zh: 它激活气道周围肌肉上的 β2 受体。肌肉放松，气道张开。剂量大了会带出一些 β1 作用，心跳就变快。

use.en: EMR: bronchospasm
use.zh: EMR：支气管痉挛

use.en: PCP: bronchospasm in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
use.zh: PCP：哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）引起的支气管痉挛

no.en: Known hypersensitivity to salbutamol
no.zh: 已知对 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过敏

noFake.zh: 已经给过 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

noFake.en: Used their own inhaler an hour ago
noFake.zh: 一小时前用过自己的吸入器

care.en: Stop if signs of toxicity appear: heart rate above 150 (above 200 in children), severe tremors or ventricular arrhythmias.
care.zh: 出现中毒表现就停药：心率超过 150（儿童超过 200）、严重震颤或室性心律失常。

care.en: Signs of flu-like illness or another infectious respiratory condition: MDI and spacer are strongly recommended.
care.zh: 有流感样症状或其他呼吸道传染病表现：强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐。

care.en: No flu-like illness: nebules are preferred.
care.zh: 没有流感样症状：首选雾化。

care.en: Ipratropium may share the nebulizer (PCP and above only), and only the salbutamol is repeated.
care.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵可以放进同一个雾化器（仅限 PCP 及以上），之后只重复 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

care.en: An MDI is for one patient only, and it can be left with the patient at the hospital.
care.zh: MDI 只能给一个病人用，到医院交接时可以留给病人。

dose.en: 5 mg nebulized. Repeat back to back as necessary
dose.zh: 5 mg 雾化。需要的话一剂接一剂重复

dose.en: Or by MDI with spacer: 4 sprays of 100 mcg. Repeat as required
dose.zh: 或用 MDI 加储雾罐：100 mcg 喷 4 下。按需要重复

dose.en: Nebulizer: under 1 year 2.5 mg. Age 1 year and older 5 mg
dose.zh: 雾化：不满 1 岁 2.5 mg。1 岁及以上 5 mg

dose.en: MDI, 10 to 20 kg: 5 sprays of 100 mcg per course. May repeat up to 3 times
dose.zh: MDI，10–20 kg：每轮 100 mcg 喷 5 下。最多可重复 3 次

dose.en: MDI, over 20 kg: 10 sprays of 100 mcg per course. May repeat up to 3 times
dose.zh: MDI，超过 20 kg：每轮 100 mcg 喷 10 下。最多可重复 3 次

dose.en: MDI under 10 kg: not indicated
dose.zh: 不足 10 kg：不用 MDI

fx.zh: 心动过速或其他心律失常
烦躁不安、紧张、乏力、眩晕

fx.en: Cough, paradoxical worsening of respiratory distress, pulmonary edema
fx.zh: 咳嗽、呼吸窘迫反常加重、肺水肿

pk.en: Works in 5 to 15 minutes, peaks at 60 to 90 minutes and lasts 3 to 6 hours.
pk.zh: 5–15 分钟起效，60–90 分钟达峰，维持 3–6 小时。

pearl.en: Salbutamol is the one you can repeat. Watch the heart rate while you do. Above 150 in an adult or 200 in a child, you stop.
pearl.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇是可以重复给的那个药。一边给一边盯着心率。成人超过 150、儿童超过 200，就停。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the same doses, plus three cautions that BCEHS does not list: coronary disease, COPD with degenerative heart disease, and diabetes. The exam also names anaphylaxis as a cause of wheeze to treat, and it gives no heart rate numbers for stopping.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：剂量一样，但多了 BCEHS 没列的三条注意事项：冠心病、合并退行性心脏病的慢阻肺、糖尿病。考试还点名严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）引起的喘鸣也要治，而且没有给出停药的心率数字。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Salbutamol drug monograph

stem.en: Chloe, 24, asthmatic, wheezing after running for the bus in Kitsilano. Short phrases, SpO2 91%, HR 118. No allergies, no fever or cough before today.
stem.zh: Chloe，24 岁，有哮喘，在 Kitsilano 追公交后开始喘鸣。只能说短句，SpO2 91%，心率 118。没有过敏，今天之前没有发烧或咳嗽。

why.en: Bronchospasm in asthma and no hypersensitivity. Give 5 mg by nebulizer and repeat back to back as necessary. A heart rate of 118 does not stop you.
why.zh: 哮喘引起的支气管痉挛，没有过敏。雾化 5 mg，需要的话一剂接一剂重复。心率 118 不妨碍给药。

bad.en: Her airways keep tightening, and the next patient you meet is a much sicker Chloe.
bad.zh: 她的气道继续收紧，你接下来面对的就是一个重得多的 Chloe。

stem.en: Marcus, 31, asthma attack in Abbotsford. After three back-to-back nebulizers the wheeze is easing. HR is now 168, his hands shake violently, and he asks for another.
stem.zh: Marcus，31 岁，在 Abbotsford 哮喘发作。连着雾化三次后喘鸣在减轻。现在心率 168，双手抖得很厉害，他还想再来一次。

why.en: A heart rate above 150 and severe tremors are signs of toxicity. Discontinue.
why.zh: 心率超过 150 加上严重震颤，是中毒的表现。停药。

bad.en: You push him further into toxicity, and ventricular arrhythmias are next on that list.
bad.zh: 你把他往中毒里又推了一步，清单上的下一项就是室性心律失常。

stem.en: Lily, 9 months, 8 kg, wheezing and working hard to breathe at a Langley daycare. No fever. You carry nebules and an MDI with spacer.
stem.zh: Lily，9 个月，8 kg，在 Langley 的托儿所里喘鸣、呼吸费力。没有发烧。你带着雾化液，也带着 MDI 和储雾罐。

ask.en: How do you give her salbutamol?
ask.zh: 她的 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇怎么给？

opts.en: Nebulizer, 2.5 mg
opts.zh: 雾化，2.5 mg

opts.en: Nebulizer, 5 mg
opts.zh: 雾化，5 mg

opts.en: MDI with spacer, 5 sprays
opts.zh: MDI 加储雾罐，喷 5 下

why.en: Under 1 year the nebulized dose is 2.5 mg. The MDI is not indicated under 10 kg.
why.zh: 不满 1 岁，雾化剂量是 2.5 mg。体重不足 10 kg 不用 MDI。

stem.en: Frank, 70, COPD, wheezy and short of breath in Maple Ridge. Fever and cough for three days. His wife has influenza.
stem.zh: Frank，70 岁，慢阻肺，在 Maple Ridge 家里喘鸣、气短。发烧咳嗽三天了。他太太得了流感。

ask.en: How do you give his salbutamol?
ask.zh: 他的 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇怎么给？

opts.en: MDI with spacer, 4 sprays of 100 mcg
opts.zh: MDI 加储雾罐，100 mcg 喷 4 下

opts.en: Nebulizer, 5 mg, as usual
opts.zh: 照常雾化，5 mg

opts.en: Hold it until the fever is treated
opts.zh: 先不给，等退烧再说

why.en: With flu-like illness, MDI and spacer are strongly recommended. The adult MDI dose is 4 sprays of 100 mcg, repeated as required.
why.zh: 有流感样症状时，强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐。成人 MDI 剂量是 100 mcg 喷 4 下，按需要重复。

bad.en: A nebulizer puts whatever he is carrying into the air you are breathing.
bad.zh: 雾化会把他身上带的病原体喷进你正在呼吸的空气里。

s.en: An adult can get 5 mg nebulized doses back to back as necessary.
s.zh: 成人可以按需要一剂接一剂地雾化 5 mg。

why.en: The monograph says to repeat doses back to back as necessary.
why.zh: 专论写明：需要的话一剂接一剂重复。

s.en: An EMR may add ipratropium to the salbutamol nebulizer.
s.zh: EMR 可以把 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵加进 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的雾化器里。

why.en: Combining it with ipratropium is for PCP and above only.
why.zh: 和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵合用，仅限 PCP 及以上。

s.en: In a child, a heart rate above 200 is a sign of toxicity.
s.zh: 儿童心率超过 200 是中毒的表现。

why.en: Stop at a heart rate above 200 in pediatrics, or above 150 in adults.
why.zh: 儿童心率超过 200、成人超过 150 就停药。

s.en: Salbutamol acts only on the lungs and never on the heart.
s.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇只作用于肺，绝不影响心脏。

why.en: Some beta-1 effects can be seen, particularly at higher doses.
why.zh: 会出现一些 β1 作用，剂量大时更明显。

q.en: The adult nebulized dose of salbutamol is…
q.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的成人雾化剂量是…

opts.en: 5 mg, repeat back to back as necessary
opts.zh: 5 mg，需要的话一剂接一剂重复

opts.en: 0.5 mg, repeat back to back as necessary
opts.zh: 0.5 mg，需要的话一剂接一剂重复

opts.en: 5 mg, a single dose with no repeats
opts.zh: 5 mg，只给一次，不重复

opts.en: 2.5 mg, repeat once after 20 minutes
opts.zh: 2.5 mg，20 分钟后重复一次

why.en: 5 mg per nebulizer for an adult. 2.5 mg is the dose for a child under 1 year.
why.zh: 成人每次雾化 5 mg。2.5 mg 是不满 1 岁儿童的剂量。

q.en: A 25 kg child needs salbutamol by MDI. One course is…
q.zh: 一个 25 kg 的孩子要用 MDI 给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。一轮是…

opts.en: 10 sprays of 100 mcg, up to 3 times
opts.zh: 100 mcg 喷 10 下，最多 3 次

opts.en: 5 sprays of 100 mcg, up to 3 times
opts.zh: 100 mcg 喷 5 下，最多 3 次

opts.en: 4 sprays of 100 mcg, repeat as required
opts.zh: 100 mcg 喷 4 下，按需要重复

opts.en: Not indicated at this weight
opts.zh: 这个体重不用 MDI

why.en: Over 20 kg it is 10 sprays per course. From 10 to 20 kg it is 5 sprays.
why.zh: 超过 20 kg 每轮喷 10 下。10–20 kg 喷 5 下。

q.en: Salbutamol opens the airways by…
q.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇打开气道靠的是…

opts.en: Stimulating beta-2 receptors in the airway muscle
opts.zh: 兴奋气道肌肉上的 β2 受体

opts.en: Blocking acetylcholine in the airway muscle
opts.zh: 阻断气道肌肉上的乙酰胆碱

opts.en: Blocking beta-2 receptors in the airway muscle
opts.zh: 阻断气道肌肉上的 β2 受体

opts.en: Reducing airway swelling like a steroid
opts.zh: 像激素一样消除气道肿胀

why.en: It is a selective beta-2 agonist that produces bronchodilation.
why.zh: 它是选择性 β2 受体激动剂，能扩张支气管。

bcehs.name: Ipratropium (Atrovent)

cls.zh: 抗胆碱能支气管扩张药

hook.en: Stops the airway muscles from squeezing shut.
hook.zh: 不让气道的肌肉继续收紧。

how.en: Acetylcholine is the signal that tells airway muscle to tighten. Ipratropium blocks that signal, so the muscle relaxes and the airway opens. It works beside salbutamol, by a different road.
how.zh: 乙酰胆碱是叫气道肌肉收紧的信号。ipratropium 异丙托溴铵把这个信号挡住，肌肉放松，气道就张开。它和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇搭档，走的是另一条路。

use.en: Severe bronchospasm in asthma (adults and children)
use.zh: 哮喘引起的严重支气管痉挛（成人和儿童）

use.en: Severe bronchospasm in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, COPD (adults)
use.zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）引起的严重支气管痉挛（成人）

no.en: Known hypersensitivity to ipratropium or any component of the product
no.zh: 已知对 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵或制剂里任何成分过敏

no.en: Neonates under 30 days old
no.zh: 出生未满 30 天的新生儿

noFake.zh: 已经给过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇

care.en: Not for use alone in acute bronchospasm: it is meant to work together with salbutamol.
care.zh: 急性支气管痉挛时不能单独用：它是要和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇配合的。

care.en: Narrow-angle glaucoma: it may raise the pressure inside the eye.
care.zh: 闭角型青光眼：可能升高眼内压。

care.en: Enlarged prostate or bladder neck obstruction: it may cause urinary retention.
care.zh: 前列腺增生或膀胱颈梗阻：可能引起尿潴留。

dose.en: 500 mcg by nebulizer, or 160 mcg by MDI (8 sprays of 20 mcg)
dose.zh: 500 mcg 雾化，或 160 mcg 用 MDI（20 mcg 喷 8 下）

dose.en: Single dose. It may share the nebulizer with salbutamol, and only the salbutamol is repeated
dose.zh: 只给一次。可以和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇放进同一个雾化器，之后只重复 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇

dose.en: 250 mcg by nebulizer, or 80 mcg by MDI (4 sprays of 20 mcg)
dose.zh: 250 mcg 雾化，或 80 mcg 用 MDI（20 mcg 喷 4 下）

dose.en: CliniCall consultation is required for a PCP. Not for neonates under 30 days
dose.zh: PCP 必须先咨询 CliniCall。出生未满 30 天的新生儿不能用

dose.en: No flu-like illness: nebules are preferred
dose.zh: 没有流感样症状：首选雾化

dose.en: Signs of flu-like illness or another infectious respiratory condition: MDI and spacer are strongly recommended
dose.zh: 有流感样症状或其他呼吸道传染病表现：强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐

fx.en: Paradoxical bronchospasm (not common, typically on the first use)
fx.zh: 反常性支气管痉挛（不常见，一般出现在第一次用药时）

pk.en: Works in 3 to 15 minutes, peaks at 1.5 to 2 hours and lasts 6 hours.
pk.zh: 3–15 分钟起效，1.5–2 小时达峰，维持 6 小时。

pearl.en: Ipratropium never goes alone and never goes twice. It rides with salbutamol, once. After that, only the salbutamol is repeated.
pearl.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵从不单独上场，也从不上第二次。它跟着 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇一起给，只给一次。之后只重复 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the same doses, the same hypersensitivity contraindication, the same rule against use in neonates under 30 days and the same cautions. The exam monograph does not mention the CliniCall consultation that BCEHS requires before a PCP gives it to a child.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：剂量一样，过敏这条禁忌一样，出生未满 30 天的新生儿不能用这一条也一样，注意事项也一样。考试专论没有提 CliniCall 咨询，而 BCEHS 要求 PCP 给儿童用药前必须先咨询。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Ipratropium drug monograph

stem.en: Gord, 68, COPD, leaning forward at his kitchen table in Ladner. Single words only, loud wheeze, SpO2 86%. Salbutamol nebulizer is being set up. No allergies, no fever.
stem.zh: Gord，68 岁，慢阻肺，在 Ladner 家里的餐桌前身体前倾坐着。只能一个字一个字地说，喘鸣很响，SpO2 86%。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇雾化正在准备。没有过敏，没有发烧。

why.en: Severe bronchospasm in COPD. Add 500 mcg to the same nebulizer as the salbutamol, one time.
why.zh: 慢阻肺引起的严重支气管痉挛。把 500 mcg 加进 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的同一个雾化器里，只加这一次。

bad.en: He gets half of the treatment plan while he is working this hard to breathe.
bad.zh: 他喘得这么费力，却只拿到了一半的治疗。

stem.en: Farah, 35, severe asthma attack at a gym in Surrey. Her allergy card reads: Atrovent, facial swelling and hives.
stem.zh: Farah，35 岁，在 Surrey 的健身房里哮喘严重发作。她的过敏卡上写着：Atrovent，面部肿胀和荨麻疹。

why.en: Known hypersensitivity to ipratropium is the contraindication. Salbutamol carries on without it.
why.zh: 已知对 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵过敏就是禁忌。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇照常给，不加它。

bad.en: You add an allergic reaction to an airway that is already closing.
bad.zh: 气道本来就在关闭，你又给她加了一场过敏反应。

stem.en: Diego, 22, asthmatic, mild wheeze after soccer in the rain. Full sentences, SpO2 97%. He has had no salbutamol yet.
stem.zh: Diego，22 岁，有哮喘，雨里踢完足球后有轻微喘鸣。能说整句话，SpO2 97%。还没有用过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

why.en: Ipratropium is for severe bronchospasm, alongside salbutamol. This is mild, and salbutamol has not even been tried.
why.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵用于严重支气管痉挛，而且要配着 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。他这是轻度，连 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇都还没试。

bad.en: Nothing dramatic. He gets a drug he does not need and a fair chance of a coughing fit.
bad.zh: 不会出大事。他只是用了一个不需要的药，还很可能咳上一阵。

stem.en: Irene, 74, COPD. Ten minutes after a combined salbutamol and ipratropium nebulizer she is still tight and wheezy, SpO2 89%.
stem.zh: Irene，74 岁，慢阻肺。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇加 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵一起雾化后十分钟，她还是胸闷、喘鸣，SpO2 89%。

ask.en: What goes in the next nebulizer?

opts.en: Salbutamol only
opts.zh: 只放 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇

opts.en: Salbutamol and ipratropium again
opts.zh: 再放 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

opts.en: Ipratropium only
opts.zh: 只放 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

why.en: Ipratropium is a single dose. Salbutamol may be repeated.
why.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵只给一次。salbutamol 沙丁胺醇可以重复。

s.en: A PCP needs a CliniCall consultation before giving ipratropium to a child.
s.zh: PCP 给儿童用 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵之前，需要先咨询 CliniCall。

why.en: The pediatric section requires it for PCPs, to discuss care planning options.
why.zh: 儿科部分要求 PCP 必须咨询，讨论治疗方案。

s.en: If the wheeze continues, ipratropium is repeated with every salbutamol nebulizer.
s.zh: 喘鸣不缓解的话，每次雾化 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇都再加一次 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵。

why.en: Ipratropium is a single dose. Only the salbutamol is repeated.
why.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵只给一次。重复的只有 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

s.en: A wheezy patient with signs of influenza should get it by MDI and spacer.
s.zh: 有流感表现的喘鸣病人，应该用 MDI 加储雾罐给药。

why.en: MDI and spacer are strongly recommended in flu-like illness or other infectious respiratory conditions.
why.zh: 有流感样症状或其他呼吸道传染病时，强烈建议用 MDI 加储雾罐。

s.en: A two-week-old baby can have the pediatric dose.
s.zh: 两周大的婴儿可以按儿童剂量给。

why.en: It is not for use in neonates under 30 days.
why.zh: 出生未满 30 天的新生儿不能用。

q.en: The adult dose of ipratropium by nebulizer is…
q.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵的成人雾化剂量是…

opts.en: 500 mcg, single dose
opts.zh: 500 mcg，只给一次

opts.en: 500 mcg, repeated every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 500 mcg，每 5 分钟重复

opts.en: 5 mg, single dose
opts.zh: 5 mg，只给一次

opts.en: 250 mcg, single dose
opts.zh: 250 mcg，只给一次

why.en: 500 mcg once for an adult. The 250 mcg dose is for children.
why.zh: 成人 500 mcg，一次。250 mcg 是儿童剂量。

q.en: How does ipratropium open the airways?
q.zh: ipratropium 异丙托溴铵怎么打开气道？

opts.en: It blocks acetylcholine in bronchial smooth muscle
opts.zh: 阻断支气管平滑肌上的乙酰胆碱

opts.en: It stimulates beta-2 receptors in bronchial muscle
opts.zh: 兴奋支气管肌肉上的 β2 受体

opts.en: It reduces airway swelling like a steroid
opts.zh: 像激素一样消除气道肿胀

opts.en: It blocks histamine release in the lungs
opts.zh: 阻止肺里的组胺释放

why.en: It is an anticholinergic. Blocking acetylcholine relaxes the muscle and the airway widens.
why.zh: 它是抗胆碱能药。挡住乙酰胆碱，肌肉放松，气道就变宽。

q.en: Which patient needs extra caution with ipratropium?
q.zh: 哪位病人用 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵要格外小心？

opts.en: A man with an enlarged prostate
opts.zh: 前列腺增生的男性

opts.en: A woman with type 2 diabetes
opts.zh: 2 型糖尿病的女性

opts.en: A man with high cholesterol
opts.zh: 胆固醇高的男性

opts.en: A woman with an underactive thyroid
opts.zh: 甲状腺功能减退的女性

why.en: It may cause urinary retention in prostatic hyperplasia or bladder neck obstruction.
why.zh: 前列腺增生或膀胱颈梗阻的病人用了可能尿潴留。

bcehs.name: Dexamethasone

cls.zh: 糖皮质激素

hook.en: A strong steroid that slowly calms swollen, inflamed airways.
hook.zh: 强效激素，慢慢压下气道的肿胀和炎症。

how.en: It tells the immune system to stand down. Fewer inflammatory chemicals are made and leaky capillaries tighten up, so swollen airways settle. It is slow: the effect takes hours, not minutes.
how.zh: 它让免疫系统收手。炎症物质产生得少了，渗漏的毛细血管收紧，肿胀的气道就慢慢消下去。它很慢：起效要几个小时，不是几分钟。

use.en: Croup in children over 6 months of age
use.zh: 6 个月以上儿童的哮吼（croup）

use.en: Add-on treatment for a flare of known asthma or COPD (the patient names it, has an action plan, or uses inhalers regularly)
use.zh: 已确诊哮喘或 COPD 急性发作的辅助治疗（病人自己说得出诊断、有行动计划，或平时规律用吸入器）

use.en: Consider it when symptoms have not improved despite ipratropium and salbutamol
use.zh: 用了 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇症状仍没改善时考虑使用

no.en: Hypersensitivity to dexamethasone or other corticosteroids
no.zh: 对 dexamethasone 地塞米松或其他糖皮质激素过敏

no.en: Active systemic fungal infection
no.zh: 活动性全身真菌感染

noFake.en: A viral infection such as croup

noFake.zh: 已经给过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

care.en: Use with caution in decompensated heart failure or significantly uncontrolled hypertension.
care.zh: 失代偿性心力衰竭或明显控制不好的高血压要慎用。

care.en: First trimester of pregnancy: weigh the risks and benefits.
care.zh: 怀孕头三个月：权衡风险和获益。

care.en: Acute myocardial infarction: corticosteroids have been linked to myocardial rupture.
care.zh: 急性心肌梗死：糖皮质激素与心肌破裂有关联。

care.en: It is not effective for adrenal insufficiency, because it has no mineralocorticoid activity.
care.zh: 它对肾上腺皮质功能不全无效，因为它没有盐皮质激素活性。

care.en: Interactions: NSAIDs (gastrointestinal ulcer risk), warfarin (higher INR and bleeding risk), phenytoin (lower phenytoin levels).
care.zh: 相互作用：非甾体抗炎药 NSAIDs（胃肠溃疡风险）、warfarin 华法林（INR 升高、出血风险增加）、phenytoin 苯妥英（血药浓度下降）。

dose.en: 8 mg IV or PO. PO is preferred.
dose.zh: 8 mg IV 或 PO。首选 PO。

dose.en: 0.6 mg/kg IV or PO, to a maximum of 16 mg. PO is preferred.
dose.zh: 0.6 mg/kg IV 或 PO，最多 16 mg。首选 PO。

dose.en: With an actual weight, round to the nearest 0.5 mg. It may be mixed with juice and given right away.
dose.zh: 有实测体重时，剂量取整到最近的 0.5 mg。可以兑果汁，兑好马上喝。

dose.en: CliniCall consultation is required before giving it
dose.zh: 给药前必须先咨询 CliniCall

dose.en: IV: give over 3 to 5 minutes
dose.zh: IV：3–5 分钟推完

dose.en: Vial strengths vary. Check the concentration on the label every time.
dose.zh: 药瓶浓度不一。每次都要核对标签上的浓度。

fx.en: Nausea, stomach upset, reflux, increased appetite
fx.zh: 恶心、胃不舒服、反酸、食欲增加
情绪变化、失眠、头晕、头痛
心力衰竭加重、水肿、高血压

pk.en: Clinical effect starts within 2 hours IV and in 2 to 6 hours PO. It lasts 36 to 72 hours.
pk.zh: IV 在 2 小时内见效，PO 要 2–6 小时。作用维持 36–72 小时。

pearl.en: Dexamethasone does nothing for the next ten minutes. In asthma and COPD, salbutamol and ipratropium come first. This drug works on the hours after, and it needs a CliniCall consult every time.
pearl.zh: 接下来的十分钟里 dexamethasone 地塞米松什么都帮不上。哮喘和 COPD 时，salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵排在前面。这个药管的是之后的几个小时，而且每次都要先咨询 CliniCall。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the pediatric dose is 0.5 mg/kg, not 0.6 mg/kg, with the same 16 mg maximum and the same 8 mg adult dose. The exam also allows the IO and IM routes and has no CliniCall step. BCEHS gives it IV or PO only, and requires a CliniCall consult before every dose.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：儿童剂量是 0.5 mg/kg，不是 0.6 mg/kg，上限同样是 16 mg，成人同样是 8 mg。考试还允许 IO 和 IM 途径，没有 CliniCall 这一步。BCEHS 只走 IV 或 PO，而且每次给药前都要咨询 CliniCall。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Dexamethasone drug monograph

stem.en: Ivy, 3, 15 kg, barking cough and stridor since midnight in Prince George. Alert, drinking, no allergies. CliniCall agrees with your plan.
stem.zh: Ivy，3 岁，15 kg，在 Prince George，从半夜开始犬吠样咳嗽、喘鸣。清醒，能喝水，没有过敏。CliniCall 同意你的方案。

why.en: Croup in a child over 6 months, no corticosteroid allergy, no fungal infection, and the consult is done. Give 0.6 mg/kg, PO preferred.
why.zh: 6 个月以上孩子的哮吼，没有糖皮质激素过敏，没有真菌感染，也咨询过了。给 0.6 mg/kg，首选 PO。

bad.en: She misses the one drug that keeps working on her airway swelling long after you have left.
bad.zh: 她错过了那个在你离开很久之后还在给气道消肿的药。

stem.en: Harold, 70, COPD flare at home in Richmond, still wheezy after salbutamol and ipratropium. His home-care nurse says he is on IV treatment for a fungal blood infection.
stem.zh: Harold，70 岁，在 Richmond 家里 COPD 发作，用过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵后还在喘。家访护士说他正在 IV 治疗血液里的真菌感染。

why.en: Active systemic fungal infection is a contraindication.
why.zh: 活动性全身真菌感染是禁忌证。

bad.en: You turn down his immune response while a fungus is spreading through his blood.
bad.zh: 真菌正在他血液里扩散，你却把他的免疫反应压了下去。

stem.en: Nadia, 28, asthma flare at a Whistler lodge, still tight after salbutamol and ipratropium. She says prednisone gave her hives and a swollen throat last year.
stem.zh: Nadia，28 岁，在 Whistler 的旅馆里哮喘发作，用过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵后胸口还是紧。她说去年吃 prednisone 泼尼松后起了荨麻疹，喉咙也肿了。

why.en: Hypersensitivity to dexamethasone or other corticosteroids is a contraindication. Prednisone is a corticosteroid.
why.zh: 对 dexamethasone 地塞米松或其他糖皮质激素过敏是禁忌证。prednisone 泼尼松就是糖皮质激素。

bad.en: You add an allergic reaction to an asthma attack.
bad.zh: 你在哮喘发作上又加了一场过敏反应。

stem.en: Theo, 9, 30 kg, known asthma with an action plan, still wheezy after salbutamol and ipratropium at a Langley soccer field. CliniCall approves dexamethasone.
stem.zh: Theo，9 岁，30 kg，确诊哮喘并有行动计划，在 Langley 的足球场上用过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵后还在喘。CliniCall 同意给 dexamethasone 地塞米松。

ask.en: What dose?

opts.en: 16 mg PO
opts.zh: 16 mg 口服

opts.en: 18 mg PO
opts.zh: 18 mg 口服

opts.en: 8 mg PO
opts.zh: 8 mg 口服

why.en: 0.6 mg/kg times 30 kg is more than the 16 mg maximum, so he gets 16 mg. PO is preferred.
why.zh: 0.6 mg/kg 乘以 30 kg 超过了 16 mg 的上限，所以给 16 mg。首选 PO。

s.en: A CliniCall consult is required before dexamethasone, for adults and for children.
s.zh: 不管成人还是儿童，给 dexamethasone 地塞米松之前都必须咨询 CliniCall。

why.en: The monograph requires it before administration, for care planning.
why.zh: 专论要求给药前先咨询，以便安排处置。

s.en: Dexamethasone should ease breathing within five minutes.
s.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松五分钟内就能让呼吸轻松。

why.en: Clinical effect takes up to 2 hours IV and 2 to 6 hours PO.
why.zh: IV 最长要 2 小时见效，PO 要 2–6 小时。

s.en: The injectable form can be mixed with juice and given by mouth.
s.zh: 注射剂型可以兑果汁口服。

why.en: Juice improves the taste. Give it immediately after mixing.
why.zh: 果汁能改善口感。兑好马上给。

s.en: Dexamethasone is a good choice for adrenal insufficiency.
s.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松很适合治疗肾上腺皮质功能不全。

why.en: It has no mineralocorticoid activity, so it is not effective for that.
why.zh: 它没有盐皮质激素活性，所以对这个病无效。

q.en: The BCEHS pediatric dose of dexamethasone is…
q.zh: BCEHS 的 dexamethasone 地塞米松儿童剂量是…

opts.en: 0.6 mg/kg IV or PO, maximum 16 mg
opts.zh: 0.6 mg/kg IV 或 PO，最多 16 mg

opts.en: 6 mg/kg IV or PO, maximum 16 mg
opts.zh: 6 mg/kg IV 或 PO，最多 16 mg

opts.en: 0.06 mg/kg IV or PO, maximum 16 mg
opts.zh: 0.06 mg/kg IV 或 PO，最多 16 mg

opts.en: 0.6 mg/kg IM only, maximum 8 mg
opts.zh: 0.6 mg/kg 只能 IM，最多 8 mg

why.en: 0.6 mg/kg, capped at 16 mg, PO preferred. The adult dose is a flat 8 mg.
why.zh: 0.6 mg/kg，上限 16 mg，首选 PO。成人固定 8 mg。

q.en: Which patient fits the indications for dexamethasone?
q.zh: 哪位病人符合 dexamethasone 地塞米松的适应证？

opts.en: Known COPD, still short of breath after salbutamol and ipratropium
opts.zh: 确诊 COPD，用过 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵后仍气短

opts.en: First-ever wheeze in an adult with no diagnosis
opts.zh: 从没确诊过的成人第一次喘

opts.en: Croup in a 4-month-old infant
opts.zh: 4 个月大婴儿的哮吼

opts.en: Anaphylaxis with wheeze, before any epinephrine
opts.zh: 伴喘鸣的严重过敏反应，还没给 epinephrine 肾上腺素

why.en: It is an add-on for known asthma or COPD that has not improved with ipratropium and salbutamol, or for croup over 6 months of age.
why.zh: 它是辅助药：用于确诊哮喘或 COPD、用了 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇仍没改善的病人，或 6 个月以上的哮吼。

bcehs.name: Epinephrine

cls.zh: 拟交感神经药（高警示药品）
