hook.en: Squeezes the vessels, opens the airways, drives the heart. Fast.
hook.zh: 收紧血管，打开气道，催动心脏。而且快。

how.en: It switches on alpha and beta receptors, the body's own emergency buttons. Alpha tightens blood vessels and makes them less leaky. Beta relaxes the airway muscle and makes the heart beat faster and harder. It also slows the release of histamine.
how.zh: 它按下 α 和 β 受体，也就是身体自带的应急按钮。α 让血管收紧、不那么渗漏。β 让气道的肌肉放松，让心脏跳得更快、更有力。它还能减少组胺的释放。

use.en: Anaphylaxis (FR by autoinjector, EMR and PCP by IM injection)
use.zh: 严重过敏反应 anaphylaxis（FR 用自动注射笔，EMR 和 PCP 用 IM 注射）

use.en: Severe bronchospasm (PCP)
use.zh: 严重支气管痉挛（PCP）

use.en: Stridor from croup or another infectious cause, in children over 6 months of age (PCP)
use.zh: 6 个月以上儿童因哮吼或其他感染引起的喘鸣（PCP）

no.en: None listed. There are no absolute contraindications in life-threatening situations such as anaphylaxis
no.zh: 未列出。在严重过敏反应这类危及生命的情况下，没有绝对禁忌证

noFake.zh: 已经用过自己的自动注射笔

care.en: Cautions, not contraindications: cardiovascular disease, hypertension, diabetes, hyperthyroid, cerebrovascular disease.
care.zh: 这些是慎用，不是禁忌：心血管病、高血压、糖尿病、甲亢、脑血管病。

care.en: Patients with coronary artery disease may develop angina or myocardial ischemia.
care.zh: 有冠心病的病人可能出现心绞痛或心肌缺血。

care.en: Use caution with significant tachydysrhythmias and in hypothermia.
care.zh: 明显的快速性心律失常和低体温时要小心。

care.en: Beta-blockers can limit its effect on the airways and the heart, and antiarrhythmic drugs raise the risk of arrhythmias.
care.zh: β 受体阻滞剂会削弱它对气道和心脏的作用，抗心律失常药会增加心律失常的风险。

care.en: High alert drug: vials are stored in specially marked containers and never mixed with other medications.
care.zh: 高警示药品：药瓶要放在有专门标记的容器里，绝不和其他药混放。

dose.en: FR: 1 dose by autoinjector into the lateral thigh. No response after 5 minutes: repeat once with a new autoinjector.
dose.zh: FR：自动注射笔 1 剂，打在大腿外侧。5 分钟后没有反应：换一支新的注射笔再打一次。

dose.en: Anaphylaxis (EMR, PCP): 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes. May repeat up to 3 times.
dose.zh: 严重过敏反应（EMR、PCP）：0.5 mg IM，每 5 分钟一次。最多可重复 3 次。

dose.en: Anaphylaxis (EMR, PCP): 0.01 mg/kg IM, maximum 0.5 mg, every 5 minutes. Repeat up to 3 times as needed.
dose.zh: 严重过敏反应（EMR、PCP）：0.01 mg/kg IM，最多 0.5 mg，每 5 分钟一次。需要时最多重复 3 次。

dose.en: Severe asthma or bronchospasm, or impending respiratory arrest (PCP): 0.5 mg IM every 5 to 20 minutes. CliniCall consultation is recommended first.
dose.zh: 严重哮喘或支气管痉挛，或即将呼吸停止（PCP）：0.5 mg IM，每 5–20 分钟一次。建议先咨询 CliniCall。

dose.en: Severe asthma or bronchospasm with impending respiratory arrest (PCP): 0.01 mg/kg IM, maximum 0.5 mg. CliniCall consultation is recommended first.
dose.zh: 严重哮喘或支气管痉挛伴即将呼吸停止（PCP）：0.01 mg/kg IM，最多 0.5 mg。建议先咨询 CliniCall。

dose.en: Croup stridor, over 6 months old (PCP): 5 mg by nebulizer mask over 10 to 15 minutes. May repeat in 3 hours. CliniCall consultation is recommended. Requires additional training.
dose.zh: 哮吼喘鸣，6 个月以上（PCP）：5 mg 用雾化面罩吸入，10–15 分钟吸完。3 小时后可重复。建议咨询 CliniCall。需要额外培训。

fx.en: Faster heart rate, higher blood pressure and a risk of arrhythmias
fx.zh: 心率加快、血压升高，有心律失常的风险

fx.en: Accidental injection into a finger, hand or foot can cut off blood flow to that area
fx.zh: 误打进手指、手或脚，可能让那个部位失去血流

fx.en: Overdose: very high blood pressure and heart rate, which may cause cerebral hemorrhage
fx.zh: 过量：血压和心率明显升高，可能引起脑出血

pk.en: IM works in 30 to 90 seconds, peaks at 4 to 10 minutes and lasts 5 to 10 minutes.
pk.zh: IM 30–90 秒起效，4–10 分钟达峰，维持 5–10 分钟。

pearl.en: There are no absolute contraindications in anaphylaxis. Heart disease, hypertension and diabetes are cautions, not reasons to wait. Give 0.5 mg IM and watch the clock, because it lasts only 5 to 10 minutes.
pearl.zh: 严重过敏反应时没有绝对禁忌证。心脏病、高血压和糖尿病只是慎用，不是等一等的理由。给 0.5 mg IM，然后盯着表，因为它只能维持 5–10 分钟。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the IM doses are the same. The exam monograph has no nebulized epinephrine for croup, no autoinjector row and no CliniCall step. It gives the IM onset as 5 to 15 minutes, where BCEHS says 30 to 90 seconds. Its only caution is further hypotension if the drug is given too quickly.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：IM 剂量一样。考试专论没有哮吼的雾化 epinephrine 肾上腺素，没有自动注射笔那一行，也没有 CliniCall 这一步。它写的 IM 起效时间是 5–15 分钟，BCEHS 写的是 30–90 秒。它唯一的慎用是给药太快会让血压更低。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Epinephrine drug monograph

stem.en: Lorraine, 72, stung by a wasp in her Kelowna garden. Hives, wheeze, swollen tongue, BP 82/50. She has angina and high blood pressure.
stem.zh: Lorraine，72 岁，在 Kelowna 自家花园里被黄蜂蜇了。荨麻疹、喘鸣、舌头肿，血压 82/50。她有心绞痛和高血压。

why.en: This is anaphylaxis. Heart disease and hypertension are cautions, and there are no absolute contraindications in a life-threatening situation. Give 0.5 mg IM.
why.zh: 这是严重过敏反应。心脏病和高血压只是慎用，危及生命时没有绝对禁忌证。给 0.5 mg IM。

bad.en: Her airway closes and her pressure keeps falling while you worry about her angina.
bad.zh: 你还在担心她的心绞痛，她的气道已经在关闭，血压一路往下掉。

stem.en: Noah, 19, asthma flare at a Coquitlam gym. Wheezy but speaking full sentences, SpO2 95% after his first salbutamol. He says he already feels better.
stem.zh: Noah，19 岁，在 Coquitlam 的健身房哮喘发作。有喘鸣，但能说完整的句子，第一次 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇后 SpO2 95%。他说已经好多了。

why.en: IM epinephrine is for severe bronchospasm or impending respiratory arrest. He is improving on salbutamol.
why.zh: IM 的 epinephrine 肾上腺素是给严重支气管痉挛或即将呼吸停止的病人的。他用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇后正在好转。

bad.en: You give a racing heart, tremor and anxiety to a patient who only needed more salbutamol.
bad.zh: 这个病人只需要再来点 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇，你却给了他心跳狂飙、手抖和焦虑。

stem.en: Jas, 30, anaphylaxis to peanuts at a Surrey wedding. You gave 0.5 mg IM five minutes ago. Still wheezing, lips still swollen, BP 86/54.
stem.zh: Jas，30 岁，在 Surrey 的婚礼上吃到花生后出现严重过敏反应。五分钟前你给过 0.5 mg IM。还在喘，嘴唇还肿，血压 86/54。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: A second 0.5 mg IM now
opts.zh: 现在再给一次 0.5 mg IM

opts.en: Wait until 20 minutes have passed
opts.zh: 等满 20 分钟再说

opts.en: Give 0.25 mg IM, a half dose
opts.zh: 给 0.25 mg IM，也就是半量

why.en: In anaphylaxis the dose is 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, and it may be repeated up to 3 times.
why.zh: 严重过敏反应时剂量是 0.5 mg IM，每 5 分钟一次，最多可重复 3 次。

bad.en: He spends fifteen more minutes with a low pressure and a swelling airway.
bad.zh: 他又多熬了十五分钟的低血压和越来越肿的气道。

stem.en: Mila, 2, barking cough and stridor at rest, working hard to breathe in a Burnaby apartment at 3 a.m. You have the additional training.
stem.zh: Mila，2 岁，凌晨 3 点在 Burnaby 的公寓里，犬吠样咳嗽，安静时也有喘鸣，呼吸很费力。你受过额外培训。

ask.en: What does the monograph give a PCP here?
ask.zh: 专论让 PCP 在这里给什么？

opts.en: 5 mg epinephrine by nebulizer mask over 10 to 15 minutes
opts.zh: 5 mg epinephrine 肾上腺素，雾化面罩，10–15 分钟吸完

opts.en: 0.5 mg epinephrine IM, repeated every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 0.5 mg epinephrine 肾上腺素 IM，每 5 分钟重复

opts.en: 0.01 mg/kg epinephrine by nebulizer mask, once only
opts.zh: 0.01 mg/kg epinephrine 肾上腺素，雾化面罩，只给一次

why.en: Croup stridor in a child over 6 months: 5 mg by nebulizer mask over 10 to 15 minutes. CliniCall consultation is recommended, and it may be repeated in 3 hours.
why.zh: 6 个月以上孩子的哮吼喘鸣：5 mg 雾化面罩吸入，10–15 分钟吸完。建议咨询 CliniCall，3 小时后可重复。

s.en: Epinephrine has no absolute contraindications in anaphylaxis.
s.zh: 严重过敏反应时 epinephrine 肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌证。

why.en: The monograph says so. Heart disease and hypertension are cautions.
why.zh: 专论就是这么写的。心脏病和高血压只是慎用。

s.en: A patient on a beta-blocker must not get epinephrine.
s.zh: 正在吃 β 受体阻滞剂的病人不能给 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

why.en: Beta-blockers can limit its effect. That is an interaction, not a contraindication.
why.zh: β 受体阻滞剂会削弱它的作用。这是药物相互作用，不是禁忌证。

s.en: An FR can repeat the autoinjector once if there is no response after 5 minutes.
s.zh: 5 分钟后没有反应，FR 可以再用一次自动注射笔。

why.en: One repeat, using a new autoinjector.
why.zh: 可以重复一次，要换一支新的注射笔。

s.en: For anaphylaxis the IM dose is repeated every 20 minutes.
s.zh: 严重过敏反应时 IM 剂量每 20 分钟重复一次。

why.en: Anaphylaxis is every 5 minutes. The 5 to 20 minute interval belongs to severe bronchospasm.
why.zh: 严重过敏反应是每 5 分钟。5–20 分钟的间隔是严重支气管痉挛用的。

q.en: The adult IM dose of epinephrine for anaphylaxis is…
q.zh: 成人严重过敏反应的 epinephrine 肾上腺素 IM 剂量是…

opts.en: 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes, up to 3 repeats
opts.zh: 0.5 mg IM，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次

opts.en: 5 mg IM every 5 minutes, up to 3 repeats
opts.zh: 5 mg IM，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次

opts.en: 0.5 mg IV every 5 minutes, up to 3 repeats
opts.zh: 0.5 mg IV，每 5 分钟一次，最多重复 3 次

opts.en: 0.5 mg IM every 20 minutes, once only
opts.zh: 0.5 mg IM，每 20 分钟一次，只给一次

why.en: 0.5 mg into the muscle every 5 minutes. The 5 mg figure is the nebulized croup dose.
why.zh: 0.5 mg 打进肌肉，每 5 分钟一次。5 mg 是哮吼的雾化剂量。

q.en: A 1-year-old in anaphylaxis weighs 10 kg. What is the IM dose?
q.zh: 一个 1 岁孩子出现严重过敏反应，体重 10 kg。IM 剂量是多少？

opts.en: 0.1 mg IM
opts.zh: 0.1 mg 肌注

opts.en: 1 mg IM
opts.zh: 1 mg 肌注

opts.en: 0.5 mg IM
opts.zh: 0.5 mg 肌注

opts.en: 0.01 mg IM
opts.zh: 0.01 mg 肌注

why.en: 0.01 mg/kg times 10 kg is 0.1 mg. The 0.5 mg figure is the maximum, not the dose for every child.
why.zh: 0.01 mg/kg 乘以 10 kg 是 0.1 mg。0.5 mg 是上限，不是每个孩子的剂量。

q.en: What does the beta-adrenergic activity of epinephrine do?
q.zh: epinephrine 肾上腺素的 β 肾上腺素能作用是什么？

opts.en: Relaxes airway muscle and makes the heart beat faster and harder
opts.zh: 放松气道肌肉，让心脏跳得更快、更有力

opts.en: Tightens blood vessels and makes them less leaky
opts.zh: 收紧血管，让血管不那么渗漏

opts.en: Slows the heart and lowers the blood pressure
opts.zh: 减慢心率，降低血压

opts.en: Blocks histamine receptors in the skin
opts.zh: 阻断皮肤里的组胺受体

why.en: Beta activity relaxes bronchial smooth muscle and raises heart rate and contractility. Vasoconstriction is the alpha effect.
why.zh: β 作用让支气管平滑肌放松，心率和心肌收缩力增加。血管收缩是 α 的作用。

bcehs.name: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)

cls.zh: 抗组胺药

hook.en: Blocks histamine. A helper in allergic reactions, never the main drug.
hook.zh: 挡住组胺。过敏反应里的帮手，永远不是主角。

how.en: In an allergic reaction the body releases histamine. Diphenhydramine competes with histamine for its receptors, so less histamine gets through. It also has anticholinergic and sedating effects, which is why patients get dry and sleepy.
how.zh: 过敏反应时身体会放出组胺。diphenhydramine 苯海拉明和组胺抢受体，能起作用的组胺就少了。它还有抗胆碱和镇静作用，所以病人会口干、犯困。

use.en: Add-on treatment of a hypersensitivity reaction (BCEHS: ACP and above)
use.zh: 过敏反应的辅助治疗（BCEHS：ACP 及以上）

no.en: Hypersensitivity to antihistamines
no.zh: 对抗组胺药过敏

no.en: Neonates
no.zh: 新生儿

no.en: Premature infants
no.zh: 早产儿

noFake.zh: 已经给过 epinephrine 肾上腺素

care.en: It will not stop a reaction that is progressing to anaphylaxis, so never use it in place of epinephrine.
care.zh: 它挡不住正在发展成严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）的过敏，所以绝不能用它代替 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

care.en: Use with caution in narrow-angle glaucoma, stenosing peptic ulcer, pyloroduodenal obstruction, symptomatic prostatic hypertrophy or bladder neck obstruction.
care.zh: 闭角型青光眼、狭窄性消化性溃疡、幽门十二指肠梗阻、有症状的前列腺肥大或膀胱颈梗阻时慎用。

care.en: It strengthens the effect of alcohol, benzodiazepines and other CNS depressants.
care.zh: 它会加强酒精、苯二氮䓬类药物和其他中枢抑制药的作用。

care.en: Other anticholinergic drugs add to it: tricyclic antidepressants, MAO inhibitors, other antihistamines.
care.zh: 其他有抗胆碱作用的药会和它叠加：三环类抗抑郁药、单胺氧化酶抑制剂、其他抗组胺药。

care.en: Heat may weaken it: 4 or more weeks of storage above 40°C can reduce its potency.
care.zh: 高温可能让它失效：在 40°C 以上存放 4 周或更久，药效可能下降。

dose.en: ACP: 50 mg IM or IV, or 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg
dose.zh: ACP：50 mg IM 或 IV，或 1 mg/kg，最多 50 mg

dose.en: ACP: 1 mg/kg IM or IV, to a maximum of 50 mg
dose.zh: ACP：1 mg/kg IM 或 IV，最多 50 mg

dose.en: Never for neonates or premature infants
dose.zh: 新生儿和早产儿绝对不能用

dose.en: BCEHS PCPs do not give this drug. On the road it is ACP and above.
dose.zh: BCEHS 的 PCP 不给这个药。在路上它属于 ACP 及以上。

fx.zh: 剂量越大，这些反应越明显

fx.en: Overdose looks like atropine poisoning: flushing, dilated pupils, hallucinations, confusion, ataxia, seizures
fx.zh: 过量时像 atropine 阿托品中毒：面部潮红、瞳孔散大、幻觉、意识混乱、共济失调、抽搐

pk.en: IM works in 30 to 60 minutes and IV in 5 to 10 minutes. It lasts 4 to 6 hours.
pk.zh: IM 30–60 分钟起效，IV 5–10 分钟起效。维持 4–6 小时。

pearl.en: Diphenhydramine will not stop a reaction that is turning into anaphylaxis. Epinephrine does that. In BCEHS this drug is ACP and above, so on the road your job is to know it, not to give it. The licensing exam does include it.
pearl.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明挡不住正在变成严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）的过敏。那是 epinephrine 肾上腺素的活。在 BCEHS 这个药属于 ACP 及以上，所以在路上你的任务是懂它，不是给它。执照考试是会考它的。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): this drug is on the licensing exam at 25 to 50 mg, IV or PO, and motion sickness is a second indication. BCEHS gives 50 mg, or 1 mg/kg up to 50 mg, IM or IV, for hypersensitivity reactions only and only at ACP and above. BCEHS also adds premature infants to the contraindications.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：执照考试会考这个药，剂量 25–50 mg，IV 或 PO，晕动病是第二个适应证。BCEHS 给 50 mg，或 1 mg/kg 最多 50 mg，IM 或 IV，只用于过敏反应，而且只有 ACP 及以上能给。BCEHS 的禁忌证还多了早产儿。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: DiphenhydrAMINE drug monograph

stem.en: Your ACP partner is treating Elena, 33, hives and itching after a new antibiotic. Breathing easily, BP 124/78. She has taken antihistamines before with no trouble.
stem.zh: 你的 ACP 搭档正在处理 Elena，33 岁，吃了一种新抗生素后起荨麻疹、发痒。呼吸轻松，血压 124/78。她以前吃过抗组胺药，没出过问题。

why.en: A hypersensitivity reaction, no anaphylaxis, no antihistamine allergy. In BCEHS it is an ACP drug, so your partner gives it.
why.zh: 这是过敏反应，还没到严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）的程度，她对抗组胺药也不过敏。在 BCEHS 它是 ACP 的药，所以由你的搭档来给。

bad.en: She itches for the whole transport while an indicated drug stays in the kit.
bad.zh: 她一路痒到医院，而该用的药一直躺在药箱里。

stem.en: A 10-day-old baby in Surrey, blotchy rash after her first bottle of formula. Pink, feeding well, breathing normally. Your ACP partner looks at you.
stem.zh: Surrey，一个出生 10 天的女婴，第一次喝配方奶后起了成片的红疹。肤色红润，吃奶好，呼吸正常。你的 ACP 搭档看向你。

why.en: Neonates are a contraindication, at any dose.
why.zh: 新生儿是禁忌证，多小的剂量都不行。

bad.en: A newborn gets a sedating drug that the monograph forbids at her age.
bad.zh: 一个新生儿被用上了专论在这个年龄明令禁止的镇静性药物。

stem.en: Greg, 50, hives after shellfish at a Steveston restaurant. Breathing fine, BP 130/84. He says Benadryl and Gravol both made his face swell.
stem.zh: Greg，50 岁，在 Steveston 的餐馆吃了贝类后起荨麻疹。呼吸正常，血压 130/84。他说 Benadryl 和 Gravol 都让他脸肿过。

why.en: Hypersensitivity to antihistamines is a contraindication.
why.zh: 对抗组胺药过敏是禁忌证。

bad.en: You treat an allergic reaction with a drug he is allergic to.
bad.zh: 你用一个他过敏的药去治他的过敏反应。

stem.en: Tariq, 22, stung by a bee in a Kelowna orchard. Hives, wheeze, swollen lips, BP 84/50. Your ACP partner opens the drug kit.
stem.zh: Tariq，22 岁，在 Kelowna 的果园里被蜜蜂蜇了。荨麻疹、喘鸣、嘴唇肿，血压 84/50。你的 ACP 搭档打开了药箱。

ask.en: What goes in first?

opts.en: Epinephrine. Diphenhydramine is only an add-on.
opts.zh: epinephrine 肾上腺素。diphenhydramine 苯海拉明只是辅助。

opts.en: Diphenhydramine IV, then reassess in 10 minutes
opts.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明 IV，10 分钟后再评估

opts.en: Diphenhydramine IM, and epinephrine only if he gets worse
opts.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明 IM，恶化了再给 epinephrine 肾上腺素

why.en: Diphenhydramine will not stop a reaction that is progressing to anaphylaxis. It must not be used in place of epinephrine.
why.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明挡不住正在发展成严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）的过敏。绝不能用它代替 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

bad.en: His airway keeps swelling while everyone waits for an antihistamine to work.
bad.zh: 大家都在等抗组胺药起效，他的气道却越肿越厉害。

s.en: In BCEHS, diphenhydramine is given by ACPs and above, not by PCPs.
s.zh: 在 BCEHS，diphenhydramine 苯海拉明由 ACP 及以上给，PCP 不给。

why.en: The monograph gives its indication and its doses to ACP only.
why.zh: 专论里它的适应证和剂量都只写给 ACP。

s.en: Diphenhydramine can replace epinephrine in early anaphylaxis.
s.zh: 严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）早期可以用 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明代替 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

why.en: It will not abort a reaction that is progressing to anaphylaxis.
why.zh: 它终止不了正在发展成严重过敏反应的过敏。

s.en: The maximum single dose is 50 mg, for adults and for children.
s.zh: 不管成人还是儿童，单次最大剂量都是 50 mg。

why.en: 1 mg/kg IM or IV, to a maximum of 50 mg.
why.zh: 1 mg/kg IM 或 IV，最多 50 mg。

s.en: IM diphenhydramine starts working within five minutes.
s.zh: IM 的 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明五分钟内就起效。

why.en: IM onset is 30 to 60 minutes. IV onset is 5 to 10 minutes.
why.zh: IM 要 30–60 分钟起效。IV 是 5–10 分钟。

q.en: The BCEHS (ACP) dose of diphenhydramine for a child is…
q.zh: BCEHS（ACP）给儿童的 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明剂量是…

opts.en: 1 mg/kg IM or IV, maximum 50 mg
opts.zh: 1 mg/kg IM 或 IV，最多 50 mg

opts.en: 10 mg/kg IM or IV, maximum 50 mg
opts.zh: 10 mg/kg IM 或 IV，最多 50 mg

opts.en: 1 mg/kg PO only, maximum 25 mg
opts.zh: 1 mg/kg 只能 PO，最多 25 mg

opts.en: 0.01 mg/kg IM, maximum 0.5 mg
opts.zh: 0.01 mg/kg IM，最多 0.5 mg

why.en: 1 mg/kg up to 50 mg, IM or IV. The adult dose is 50 mg.
why.zh: 1 mg/kg，最多 50 mg，IM 或 IV。成人剂量是 50 mg。

q.en: How does diphenhydramine work?
q.zh: diphenhydramine 苯海拉明是怎样起作用的？

opts.en: It competes with histamine for its receptors
opts.zh: 和组胺竞争受体

opts.en: It tightens blood vessels and opens the airways
opts.zh: 收缩血管并打开气道

opts.en: It stops the body from making histamine
opts.zh: 让身体不再制造组胺

opts.en: It suppresses the immune system like a steroid
opts.zh: 像激素一样抑制免疫系统

why.en: It appears to compete with histamine for receptors on effector cells. Dryness and sedation are side effects.
why.zh: 它似乎是在效应细胞上和组胺竞争受体。口干和镇静属于副作用。

bcehs.name: Tranexamic acid (TXA)

cls.zh: 止血药、抗纤溶药

hook.en: Keeps the clots the body has already made from dissolving.
hook.zh: 护住身体已经结好的血块，不让它化掉。

how.en: The body builds a clot, then sends TPA to take it apart. TXA competes for the TPA receptor sites, like parking in the spot TPA wanted. The clot stays. TXA makes no new clots.
how.zh: 身体结好血块后，会派 TPA 去把它拆掉。TXA 氨甲环酸去抢 TPA 的受体位点，等于占了 TPA 要停的车位。血块就留住了。它不造新血块。

use.en: Signs of shock or hypoperfusion with an injury that suggests hidden or ongoing bleeding
use.zh: 有休克或低灌注表现，且伤情提示有隐匿性或持续性出血

use.en: Signs of shock or hypoperfusion with maternal vaginal bleeding after 20 weeks, or with postpartum hemorrhage
use.zh: 有休克或低灌注表现的孕 20 周后阴道出血，或产后出血

no.en: More than 3 hours from the injury to administration
no.zh: 从受伤到给药超过 3 小时

no.en: Age under 12 years (PCP)
no.zh: 年龄小于 12 岁（PCP）

no.en: Non-traumatic gastrointestinal hemorrhage, for example a bleeding ulcer or a variceal bleed
no.zh: 非创伤性消化道出血，例如溃疡出血或静脉曲张破裂出血

no.en: Hypersensitivity to tranexamic acid
no.zh: 对 tranexamic acid 氨甲环酸过敏

care.en: For intravenous use only: never give it IM or subcutaneously.
care.zh: 只能静脉给药，不能肌注，也不能皮下注射。

care.en: Pushing it too quickly may make hypotension worse.
care.zh: 推得太快可能让低血压更重。

care.en: Vaginal bleeding or postpartum hemorrhage needs a CliniCall consultation before the dose.
care.zh: 阴道出血或产后出血，给药前必须先咨询 CliniCall。

care.en: Vials are 100 mg/mL, as 500 mg in 5 mL or 1,000 mg in 10 mL.
care.zh: 药瓶浓度是 100 mg/mL，规格有 500 mg/5 mL 和 1,000 mg/10 mL 两种。

dose.en: Injury with signs of shock or hypoperfusion: 2 g IV push over 1 minute
dose.zh: 外伤伴休克或低灌注表现：2 g 静推，推 1 分钟

dose.en: Vaginal bleeding after 20 weeks or postpartum hemorrhage, with signs of shock or hypoperfusion: 2 g IV push over 1 minute
dose.zh: 孕 20 周后阴道出血或产后出血，伴休克或低灌注表现：2 g 静推，推 1 分钟

dose.en: Vaginal bleeding or postpartum hemorrhage: CliniCall consultation is required before you give it
dose.zh: 阴道出血或产后出血：给药前必须先咨询 CliniCall

dose.en: Under 12 years: contraindicated for PCPs. Weight-based dosing for children is BCEHS: ACP and above.
dose.zh: 12 岁以下：PCP 禁用。儿童按体重给药属于 BCEHS：ACP 及以上。

fx.en: Hypotension may get worse if it is given too quickly
fx.zh: 给得太快可能加重低血压

pk.en: Onset is immediate. Peak is at 3 hours and it lasts 3 hours.
pk.zh: 立即起效。3 小时达峰，作用维持 3 小时。

pearl.en: The 3-hour clock starts at the injury, not when you arrive. Ask what time it happened before you draw up the drug.
pearl.zh: 3 小时是从受伤那一刻算起，不是从你到场算起。抽药之前先问清楚几点受的伤。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): isolated TBI is a contraindication there, and non-traumatic GI bleeding is not listed. Postpartum hemorrhage and epistaxis appear only as considerations, with no CliniCall step. The exam also names major trauma after starting the hypovolemia protocol as an indication. Same dose: 2 g IV push over 1 minute.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：单纯颅脑损伤（isolated TBI）在那边是禁忌，非创伤性消化道出血却没有列出。产后出血和鼻出血只列在「注意事项」里，没有 CliniCall 这一步。考试还把「启动低血容量方案后的重大创伤」列为适应证。剂量相同：2 g 静推，推 1 分钟。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Tranexamic acid drug monograph

stem.en: Marco, 34, truck rollover near Squamish 40 minutes ago. Pale, cold skin, HR 128, BP 84/50. His pelvis moves when you check it.
stem.zh: Marco，34 岁，40 分钟前在 Squamish 附近翻了卡车。面色苍白、皮肤发凉，心率 128，血压 84/50。检查时骨盆不稳。

why.en: Signs of shock, an injury that suggests hidden bleeding, and well inside 3 hours. Give 2 g IV push over 1 minute.
why.zh: 有休克表现，伤情提示隐匿出血，离受伤远不到 3 小时。给 2 g 静推，推 1 分钟。

bad.en: He keeps bleeding into his pelvis while his body takes its own clots apart.
bad.zh: 他继续往骨盆里出血，身体还在拆自己的血块。

stem.en: Walter, 67, vomiting dark blood at home in Burnaby. Known liver disease. Pale and sweaty, HR 122, BP 82/48. No fall, no injury.
stem.zh: Walter，67 岁，在 Burnaby 家中呕出暗红色的血。有肝病史。面色苍白出汗，心率 122，血压 82/48。没有摔倒，没有外伤。

why.en: This is non-traumatic gastrointestinal hemorrhage. That is a contraindication, even with clear signs of shock.
why.zh: 这是非创伤性消化道出血，属于禁忌。休克表现再明显也不给。

bad.en: You push a contraindicated drug into a man in shock and spend minutes he needed for transport.
bad.zh: 你给一个休克病人推了禁忌药，还花掉了他转运要用的时间。

stem.en: Dev, 29, crushed between two boats in Steveston at 06:00. It is now 09:40. Pale, HR 118, BP 88/54, rigid belly.
stem.zh: Dev，29 岁，06:00 在 Steveston 被夹在两条船中间。现在是 09:40。面色苍白，心率 118，血压 88/54，腹部板状硬。

why.en: More than 3 hours have passed since the injury. The limit runs from the injury to administration, not from your arrival.
why.zh: 离受伤已经超过 3 小时。这个时限是从受伤算到给药，不是从你到场算起。

bad.en: He gets a drug that is contraindicated this late, and the push delays the surgery he needs.
bad.zh: 这么晚了给的是禁忌药，推药还耽误了他需要的手术。

stem.en: Amara, 31, gave birth at home in Surrey 25 minutes ago. Bleeding is heavy and not slowing. Pale, HR 126, BP 86/52. IV is in.
stem.zh: Amara，31 岁，25 分钟前在 Surrey 家中分娩。出血很多，没有减少。面色苍白，心率 126，血压 86/52。静脉通路已建立。

ask.en: What comes before the TXA?
ask.zh: 给 TXA 氨甲环酸之前要做什么？

opts.en: Consult CliniCall
opts.zh: 先咨询 CliniCall

opts.en: Nothing, the shock signs are enough
opts.zh: 不用做什么，有休克表现就够了

opts.en: Wait until 3 hours after the birth
opts.zh: 等到产后 3 小时再给

why.en: For vaginal bleeding or postpartum hemorrhage, CliniCall consultation is required before TXA. After that it is 2 g IV push over 1 minute.
why.zh: 阴道出血或产后出血，给 TXA 氨甲环酸之前必须先咨询 CliniCall。之后是 2 g 静推，推 1 分钟。

s.en: The 3-hour limit is counted from the injury, not from your arrival.
s.zh: 3 小时的时限从受伤算起，不是从你到场算起。

why.en: The contraindication is more than 3 hours from injury to administration.
why.zh: 禁忌写的是从受伤到给药超过 3 小时。

s.en: A PCP may give TXA to a 10-year-old in shock after a crash.
s.zh: 车祸后休克的 10 岁孩子，PCP 可以给 TXA 氨甲环酸。

why.en: Under 12 years is a contraindication for PCPs.
why.zh: 12 岁以下对 PCP 来说是禁忌。

s.en: With no IV access, TXA can go IM.
s.zh: 建不了静脉通路时，TXA 氨甲环酸可以肌注。

why.en: It is for intravenous use only, never IM or subcutaneous.
why.zh: 只能静脉给药，不能肌注或皮下注射。

s.en: Pushing TXA too quickly can make hypotension worse.
s.zh: TXA 氨甲环酸推得太快会加重低血压。

why.en: That is why the push takes a full 1 minute.
why.zh: 所以要推满 1 分钟。

q.en: The PCP dose of TXA for an injury with signs of shock is…
q.zh: 外伤伴休克表现时，PCP 给 TXA 氨甲环酸的剂量是…

opts.en: 2 g IV push over 1 minute
opts.zh: 2 g 静推，推 1 分钟

opts.en: 200 mg IV push over 1 minute
opts.zh: 200 mg 静推，推 1 分钟

opts.en: 2 g IM in the thigh
opts.zh: 2 g 大腿肌注

opts.en: 15 mg/kg IV push over 1 minute
opts.zh: 15 mg/kg 静推，推 1 分钟

why.en: 2 g IV push over 1 minute. It is IV only, and 15 mg/kg is the ACP dose for children under 12.
why.zh: 2 g 静推，推 1 分钟。只能静脉给，15 mg/kg 是 ACP 给 12 岁以下儿童的剂量。

q.en: How does TXA help a bleeding patient?
q.zh: TXA 氨甲环酸怎么帮到出血的病人？

opts.en: It stops clots from being broken down
opts.zh: 阻止血块被分解

opts.en: It tightens the blood vessels
opts.zh: 让血管收缩

opts.en: It adds clotting factors to the blood
opts.zh: 给血液补充凝血因子

opts.en: It raises blood pressure directly
opts.zh: 直接升高血压

why.en: It prevents clot degradation by competing for TPA receptor sites.
why.zh: 它竞争 TPA 的受体位点，防止血块被降解。

q.en: Which patient must NOT get TXA?
q.zh: 下面哪个病人不能给 TXA 氨甲环酸？

opts.en: Bleeding stomach ulcer, in shock
opts.zh: 胃溃疡出血，休克

opts.en: Pelvic fracture, in shock
opts.zh: 骨盆骨折，休克

opts.en: Stab wound to the belly, in shock
opts.zh: 腹部刀刺伤，休克

opts.en: Fall from a roof, in shock
opts.zh: 从屋顶坠落，休克

why.en: Non-traumatic gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a contraindication. The other three are injuries with shock, which is the indication.
why.zh: 非创伤性消化道出血是禁忌。另外三个都是外伤伴休克，正是适应证。

bcehs.name: ASA (Aspirin)

cls.zh: 抗血小板药、抗血栓药

hook.en: Stops platelets from sticking together, so the clot stops growing.
hook.zh: 不让血小板粘在一起，血栓就不再长大。

how.en: Platelets need a signal called thromboxane A2 before they clump together. ASA blocks the making of that signal. The block is permanent, so it lasts for the life of the platelet, 7 to 10 days.
how.zh: 血小板要先收到一种叫血栓素 A2 的信号才会聚在一起。ASA 阿司匹林挡住这个信号的生成。这种阻断不可逆，所以会一直持续到这颗血小板寿命结束，也就是 7–10 天。

use.en: Chest pain, or signs and symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia
use.zh: 胸痛，或符合心肌缺血的症状和体征

no.en: Hypersensitivity to ASA or its components
no.zh: 对 ASA 阿司匹林或其成分过敏

no.en: Past bronchospasm or other breathing reaction triggered by ASA or NSAIDs
no.zh: 以前用 ASA 阿司匹林或非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）后出现过支气管痉挛或其他呼吸道反应

no.en: Active or recent bleeding of any kind, including head injury or peptic ulcer disease
no.zh: 任何正在发生或近期的出血，包括头部外伤或消化性溃疡

no.en: Children with signs and symptoms of a viral illness (risk of Reye's syndrome)
no.zh: 有病毒感染症状和体征的儿童（有 Reye 综合征风险）

noFake.en: Asthma that has never reacted to ASA or NSAIDs
noFake.zh: 有哮喘，但从没对 ASA 阿司匹林或 NSAIDs 起过反应

care.en: On an anticoagulant: bleeding risk is higher, so weigh it against the benefit, and CliniCall consultation is recommended.
care.zh: 正在用抗凝药：出血风险更高，要和获益一起权衡，建议咨询 CliniCall。

care.en: Alcohol use raises the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding.
care.zh: 饮酒会增加消化道出血的风险。

care.en: Do not use in children, teenagers or young adults with chickenpox, influenza or a flu-like illness (Reye syndrome).
care.zh: 儿童、青少年或年轻成人有水痘、流感或流感样疾病时不要用（Reye 综合征）。

care.en: Chest pain in children is unlikely to be ischemia, so ASA is not indicated without a rare, specific history.
care.zh: 儿童胸痛不太可能是缺血，所以除非有罕见的特定病史，否则不用 ASA 阿司匹林。

care.en: Overdose: toxic above 150 mg/kg, with early nausea, vomiting, sweating and ringing in the ears.
care.zh: 过量：超过 150 mg/kg 可中毒，早期表现为恶心、呕吐、出汗和耳鸣。

dose.en: 162 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
dose.zh: 162 mg PO，嚼碎后吞下

dose.en: That is two 81 mg chewable tablets
dose.zh: 也就是两片 81 mg 的咀嚼片

dose.en: One dose. The monograph gives no repeat.
dose.zh: 只给一次。专论没有重复给药。

dose.en: CliniCall consultation is required before any pediatric dose
dose.zh: 给儿童用药前必须先咨询 CliniCall

fx.en: Irritation of the gastrointestinal tract (the most common)

pk.en: Works in 5 to 30 minutes, peaks at 1 to 2 hours and lasts 4 to 6 hours.
pk.zh: 5–30 分钟起效，1–2 小时达峰，维持 4–6 小时。

pearl.en: The monograph gives ASA no blood pressure limit and no heart rate limit. Students copy the nitroglycerin rules onto it and hold it. Ask three things: allergy, breathing reaction to ASA or NSAIDs, bleeding. Then give it.
pearl.zh: 专论没有给 ASA 阿司匹林设血压或心率限制。学生常把 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的规则套到它头上，结果该给不给。问三件事：过敏、对 ASA 阿司匹林或 NSAIDs 的呼吸道反应、出血。然后就给。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the dose is 160 mg PO, not 162 mg. The exam adds two contraindications that BCEHS does not list: the patient cannot swallow, or has already taken the recommended ASA dose before you arrive. BCEHS is stricter on bleeding: any active or recent bleeding, head injury included. The exam lists only active peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, with recent internal bleeding as a caution.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：剂量是 160 mg PO，不是 162 mg。考试多了两条 BCEHS 没列的禁忌证：病人不能吞咽，或者在你到达前已经吃过推荐剂量的 ASA 阿司匹林。BCEHS 对出血更严：任何正在发生或近期的出血都不行，头部外伤也算。考试只列活动性消化性溃疡或消化道出血，近期内出血只算慎用。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Acetylsalicylic Acid drug monograph

stem.en: Dmitri, 59, crushing chest pain on a Skytrain platform. Sweaty, BP 96/60, HR 104. No allergies, tolerates ibuprofen, no ulcers, no recent bleeding.
stem.zh: Dmitri，59 岁，在 Skytrain 站台上胸口压榨样疼痛。出汗，血压 96/60，心率 104。没有过敏，吃 ibuprofen 布洛芬没问题，没有溃疡，近期没有出血。

why.en: Cardiac chest pain, no allergy, no bleeding. A low blood pressure stops nitroglycerin, not ASA. Give 162 mg, chewed.
why.zh: 心源性胸痛，没有过敏，没有出血。血压低挡住的是 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，不是 ASA 阿司匹林。给 162 mg，嚼碎。

bad.en: The clot in his coronary artery keeps growing while you wait for a better blood pressure.
bad.zh: 你在等血压好转，他冠状动脉里的血栓却一直在长大。

stem.en: Priya, 47, chest tightness at her desk in Burnaby. BP 134/80, HR 88. She says ibuprofen once made her wheeze so badly she went to hospital.
stem.zh: Priya，47 岁，在 Burnaby 的办公桌前胸口发紧。血压 134/80，心率 88。她说有一次吃 ibuprofen 布洛芬后喘得厉害，进了医院。

why.en: A past breathing reaction to ASA or an NSAID is a contraindication. Ibuprofen is an NSAID.
why.zh: 以前对 ASA 阿司匹林或 NSAIDs 有过呼吸道反应，就是禁忌证。ibuprofen 布洛芬属于 NSAIDs。

bad.en: Minutes later she has chest pain and bronchospasm, and you caused the second one.
bad.zh: 几分钟后她既胸痛又支气管痉挛，后一个是你造成的。

stem.en: Frank, 68, chest pressure for 30 minutes at a care home in Richmond. BP 150/90. Staff mention black, tarry stools since yesterday.
stem.zh: Frank，68 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院，胸口压迫感 30 分钟。血压 150/90。护工提到他从昨天起拉黑色柏油样便。

why.en: Black, tarry stools mean he is bleeding now. Active or recent bleeding of any kind is a contraindication.
why.zh: 黑色柏油样便说明他正在出血。任何正在发生或近期的出血都是禁忌证。

bad.en: ASA switches off his platelets for a week while his gut is still bleeding.
bad.zh: 他的肠胃还在出血，ASA 阿司匹林却让他的血小板停工一个星期。

stem.en: Anita, 62, jaw and left arm pain, pale and nauseated on the ferry to Nanaimo. No allergies, no bleeding. Your bottle holds 81 mg chewable tablets.
stem.zh: Anita，62 岁，在去 Nanaimo 的渡轮上，下颌和左臂疼，面色苍白、恶心。没有过敏，没有出血。你的药瓶里是 81 mg 的咀嚼片。

ask.en: What do you give?

opts.en: Two tablets, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 两片，嚼碎后吞下

opts.en: One tablet, swallowed whole with water
opts.zh: 一片，用水整片吞下

opts.en: Four tablets, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 四片，嚼碎后吞下

why.en: The dose is 162 mg, which is two 81 mg tablets, chewed and then swallowed.
why.zh: 剂量是 162 mg，也就是两片 81 mg，嚼碎后吞下。

s.en: The monograph gives ASA no blood pressure or heart rate limit.
s.zh: 专论没有给 ASA 阿司匹林设血压或心率限制。

why.en: No vital sign appears anywhere in its contraindications.
why.zh: 它的禁忌证里没有任何生命体征。

s.en: A patient on warfarin with cardiac chest pain must never get ASA.
s.zh: 正在吃 warfarin 华法林的心源性胸痛病人绝对不能给 ASA 阿司匹林。

why.en: It is a bleeding risk to weigh against the benefit. CliniCall consultation is recommended.
why.zh: 这是需要和获益一起权衡的出血风险。建议咨询 CliniCall。

s.en: One dose of ASA affects platelets for about a week.
s.zh: 一剂 ASA 阿司匹林对血小板的影响大约持续一周。

why.en: The effect is irreversible and lasts the life of the platelet, 7 to 10 days.
why.zh: 作用不可逆，持续到血小板寿命结束，7–10 天。

s.en: A feverish 8-year-old with the flu can have ASA for comfort.
s.zh: 发烧的 8 岁流感患儿可以吃 ASA 阿司匹林来舒服一点。

why.en: ASA in a child with a viral illness risks Reye syndrome.
why.zh: 病毒感染的孩子用 ASA 阿司匹林有 Reye 综合征的风险。

q.en: The BCEHS dose of ASA for cardiac chest pain is…
q.zh: BCEHS 治疗心源性胸痛的 ASA 阿司匹林剂量是…

opts.en: 162 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 162 mg PO，嚼碎后吞下

opts.en: 81 mg PO, swallowed whole
opts.zh: 81 mg PO，整片吞下

opts.en: 1,620 mg PO, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 1,620 mg PO，嚼碎后吞下

opts.en: 162 mg SL, left under the tongue
opts.zh: 162 mg SL，含在舌下

why.en: Two 81 mg chewable tablets make 162 mg. Chewed, then swallowed.
why.zh: 两片 81 mg 咀嚼片就是 162 mg。先嚼碎，再吞下。

q.en: How does ASA help in cardiac ischemia?
q.zh: ASA 阿司匹林在心肌缺血时怎样起作用？

opts.en: It stops platelets from clumping by blocking thromboxane A2
opts.zh: 阻断血栓素 A2，不让血小板聚集

opts.en: It dissolves the clot that has already formed
opts.zh: 把已经形成的血栓溶掉

opts.en: It widens the coronary arteries
opts.zh: 扩张冠状动脉

opts.en: It thins the blood by blocking vitamin K
opts.zh: 阻断维生素 K 让血变稀

why.en: It blocks the formation of thromboxane A2, a potent platelet aggregator and vasoconstrictor.
why.zh: 它阻断血栓素 A2 的生成，而血栓素 A2 是很强的血小板聚集剂和血管收缩剂。

q.en: A 10-year-old has chest pain after a soccer game. Before any ASA you must…
q.zh: 一个 10 岁孩子踢完足球后胸痛。给 ASA 阿司匹林之前你必须…

opts.en: Consult CliniCall, because ischemia is unlikely in children
opts.zh: 咨询 CliniCall，因为儿童不太可能是缺血

opts.en: Give half the adult dose, chewed and swallowed
opts.zh: 给成人剂量的一半，嚼碎后吞下

opts.en: Check the blood pressure, then give one tablet
opts.zh: 量血压，然后给一片

opts.en: Ask a parent to sign a consent form first
opts.zh: 先让家长签同意书

why.en: CliniCall consultation is required before pediatric administration. Chest pain in children is rarely ischemia.
why.zh: 给儿童用药前必须咨询 CliniCall。儿童胸痛很少是缺血。

bcehs.name: Nitroglycerin

cls.zh: 抗心绞痛药（血管扩张药）

hook.en: Opens the blood vessels so the heart has less work to do.
hook.zh: 把血管松开，让心脏少干点活。

how.en: It relaxes the muscle in the vessel walls, mostly the veins. Less blood returns to the heart, so the heart needs less oxygen. The coronary arteries open a little too.
how.zh: 它让血管壁的肌肉放松，主要是静脉。回到心脏的血变少，心脏需要的氧就少了。冠状动脉也会稍微张开。

use.en: Chest pain suggestive of acute coronary syndrome
use.zh: 提示急性冠脉综合征的胸痛

no.en: Systolic BP below 110 mmHg
no.zh: 收缩压低于 110 mmHg

no.en: Heart rate below 50 or above 150
no.zh: 心率低于 50 或高于 150

no.en: Viagra (sildenafil) or Levitra (vardenafil) in the last 24 hours
no.zh: 过去 24 小时内用过 Viagra（sildenafil 西地那非）或 Levitra（vardenafil 伐地那非）

no.en: Cialis (tadalafil) in the last 48 hours
no.zh: 过去 48 小时内用过 Cialis（tadalafil 他达拉非）

no.en: Documented right-sided myocardial infarction
no.zh: 已确诊的右心室心肌梗死

no.en: Hypotension or uncorrected hypovolemia
no.zh: 低血压或未纠正的低血容量

no.en: Severe anemia
no.zh: 严重贫血

no.en: Constrictive pericarditis or pericardial tamponade
no.zh: 缩窄性心包炎或心包填塞

no.en: Known allergy to nitroglycerin
no.zh: 已知对 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油过敏

noFake.zh: 今天已经吃过 ASA 阿司匹林

care.en: Inferior ischemia on the 12-lead: rule out right-sided involvement first.
care.zh: 12 导联提示下壁缺血：先排除右心室受累。

care.en: Clinically significant aortic stenosis.
care.zh: 有临床意义的主动脉瓣狭窄。

care.en: Liver or kidney insufficiency.
care.zh: 肝或肾功能不全。

care.en: Blood pressure pills add to its effect.
care.zh: 降压药会和它的作用叠加。

dose.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes
dose.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟一次

dose.en: Before every dose: SBP must be 110 or higher and HR between 50 and 150
dose.zh: 每次给药前：收缩压必须 ≥ 110，心率在 50–150 之间

dose.en: Call CliniCall first if the patient has no nitroglycerin prescription, or if more than 3 doses are needed
dose.zh: 病人没有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油处方，或需要超过 3 次时，先打 CliniCall

dose.en: Not authorized in pediatrics
dose.zh: 儿童不得使用

pk.en: Works in 30 seconds to 2 minutes, lasts 15 to 30 minutes.
pk.zh: 30 秒到 2 分钟起效，维持 15–30 分钟。

pearl.en: Three questions before every spray: pressure, pulse, pills. Miss the ED-pill question and the pressure can fall off a cliff.
pearl.zh: 每喷一次前问三件事：血压、脉搏、药片。漏问壮阳药，血压可能直接掉下悬崖。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the monograph lists only SBP below 110, HR below 50 or above 150, nitrate allergy and the ED pills, with a maximum of 3 doses in any 30 minutes and no CliniCall step. BCEHS adds right-sided MI, severe anemia, tamponade and uncorrected hypovolemia.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：专论只列收缩压低于 110、心率低于 50 或高于 150、硝酸酯过敏和壮阳药，任意 30 分钟内最多 3 次，没有 CliniCall 这一步。BCEHS 多了右心室心梗、严重贫血、心包填塞和未纠正的低血容量。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Nitroglycerin drug monograph

stem.en: Raj, 58, heavy chest pressure for 20 minutes. BP 142/88, HR 92. He has his own nitro spray. No ED pills, ever.
stem.zh: Raj，58 岁，胸口压榨感 20 分钟。血压 142/88，心率 92。他自己有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油喷雾，从没用过壮阳药。

why.en: Pressure 110 or higher, pulse between 50 and 150, no ED pills, his own prescription. Give 0.4 mg SL and recheck before the next one.
why.zh: 收缩压 ≥ 110、心率在 50–150、没用壮阳药、自己有处方。给 0.4 mg 舌下，下一次之前再查一遍。

bad.en: He stays in pain while his heart muscle keeps starving for oxygen.
bad.zh: 他继续痛着，心肌继续缺氧。

stem.en: Helen, 71, chest pain, pale and sweaty. BP 104/62, HR 84.
stem.zh: Helen，71 岁，胸痛，面色苍白出汗。血压 104/62，心率 84。

why.en: Systolic is below 110. Nitroglycerin would drop it further.
why.zh: 收缩压低于 110。nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油会让它更低。

bad.en: Her pressure falls to 76/40 and she slumps in the chair.
bad.zh: 她的血压掉到 76/40，人瘫在椅子上。

stem.en: Tom, 63, chest pain after dinner. BP 150/90, HR 88. His wife says he took Cialis last night, about 20 hours ago.
stem.zh: Tom，63 岁，晚饭后胸痛。血压 150/90，心率 88。太太说他昨晚吃了 Cialis，大约 20 小时前。

why.en: Cialis needs 48 hours. Twenty hours is not enough, even with a great blood pressure.
why.zh: Cialis 要等 48 小时。20 小时不够，血压再好看也不行。

bad.en: Two minutes later his pressure is 70/38 and it will not come back up easily.
bad.zh: 两分钟后血压 70/38，而且很难拉回来。

stem.en: Mrs. Lee, 66, first-ever chest pain. BP 138/84, HR 76. She has never been prescribed nitroglycerin.
stem.zh: 李太太，66 岁，第一次胸痛。血压 138/84，心率 76。她从没开过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

ask.en: What comes before the first spray?
ask.zh: 喷第一下之前要做什么？

opts.en: Consult CliniCall
opts.zh: 先咨询 CliniCall

opts.en: Nothing, vitals are fine
opts.zh: 不用做什么，生命体征没问题

opts.en: Wait for a second set of vitals in 10 minutes
opts.zh: 等 10 分钟再量一次生命体征

why.en: No prior prescription means a CliniCall consult before giving it.
why.zh: 没有处方，就要先咨询 CliniCall 再给。

s.en: You must recheck blood pressure before every dose.
s.zh: 每次给药前都必须重新量血压。

why.en: SBP has to be 110 or higher each time.
why.zh: 每一次收缩压都要 ≥ 110。

s.en: A child with chest pain can have a half dose.
s.zh: 胸痛的儿童可以给半量。

why.en: It is not authorized in pediatrics at all.
why.zh: 儿童完全不允许使用。

s.en: Cialis blocks nitroglycerin for twice as long as Viagra does.
s.zh: Cialis 挡住 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的时间是 Viagra 的两倍。

why.en: Cialis is 48 hours. Viagra and Levitra are 24.
why.zh: Cialis 是 48 小时，Viagra 和 Levitra 是 24 小时。

s.en: Levitra yesterday morning, 30 hours ago, still blocks nitroglycerin.
s.zh: 昨天早上（30 小时前）吃的 Levitra 仍然不能给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

why.en: Levitra and Viagra are 24 hours. Only Cialis is 48.
why.zh: Levitra 和 Viagra 是 24 小时，只有 Cialis 是 48 小时。

q.en: The dose of nitroglycerin is…
q.zh: nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的剂量是…

opts.en: 0.4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟

opts.en: 0.4 mg SL every 10 minutes
opts.zh: 0.4 mg 舌下，每 10 分钟

opts.en: 4 mg SL every 3 to 5 minutes
opts.zh: 4 mg 舌下，每 3–5 分钟

opts.en: 0.8 mg SL once only
opts.zh: 0.8 mg 舌下，只给一次

why.en: One spray is 0.4 mg, repeated every 3 to 5 minutes while vitals allow.
why.zh: 一喷 0.4 mg，生命体征允许时每 3–5 分钟重复。

q.en: Why does nitroglycerin ease cardiac chest pain?
q.zh: nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油为什么能缓解心源性胸痛？

opts.en: It dilates vessels, so the heart needs less oxygen
opts.zh: 扩张血管，心脏需氧量下降

opts.en: It thins the blood
opts.zh: 让血变稀

opts.en: It blocks pain signals in the brain
opts.zh: 在大脑里阻断痛觉信号

opts.en: It slows the heart rate
opts.zh: 减慢心率

why.en: Mostly venodilation: less preload, less work, less oxygen demand.
why.zh: 主要是扩张静脉：前负荷下降，心脏做功少，需氧量降低。

bcehs.name: Ketamine

cls.en: General anesthetic (high alert medication, controlled and targeted substance)
cls.zh: 全身麻醉药（高警示药品，受管制药物）

hook.en: At a low dose it dulls pain. For PCPs: analgesia only.
hook.zh: 小剂量能止痛。PCP 只能用来镇痛。

how.en: Ketamine acts on several receptors, including NMDA and opioid receptors. A low dose gives analgesia. Higher doses lead to dissociation, where the patient seems cut off from the body and the room. PCPs use the low dose, as a nasal spray.
how.zh: ketamine 氯胺酮作用于好几种受体，包括 NMDA 受体和阿片受体。小剂量带来镇痛。剂量再大就会出现分离状态，病人像是和自己的身体、周围的环境断开了。PCP 用的是小剂量，从鼻子喷进去。

use.en: Analgesia. This is the only PCP indication, and the PCP route is intranasal.
use.zh: 镇痛。这是 PCP 唯一的适应证，PCP 的给药途径是鼻内。

no.en: Conditions where hypertension may be harmful, such as cerebral vascular accident or severe cardiac disease
no.zh: 血压升高可能造成伤害的情况，例如脑血管意外或严重心脏病

no.en: Age under 5 years (PCP)
no.zh: 年龄小于 5 岁（PCP）

no.en: Hypersensitivity to ketamine
no.zh: 对 ketamine 氯胺酮过敏

care.en: Use with caution in severe hypertension, meaning systolic BP above 180 mmHg.
care.zh: 严重高血压（收缩压高于 180 mmHg）时慎用。

care.en: Use with caution in subarachnoid hemorrhage or epidural hematoma with severe hypertension.
care.zh: 蛛网膜下腔出血或硬膜外血肿合并严重高血压时慎用。

care.en: Use with caution in myocardial ischemia or cardiac arrhythmias.
care.zh: 心肌缺血或心律失常时慎用。

care.en: Allow for the 0.1 mL dead space in the MAD, so the dose you give and document is accurate.
care.zh: 要把 MAD（鼻黏膜雾化器）里 0.1 mL 的死腔算进去，这样实际给的和记录的剂量才准确。

dose.en: PCP: analgesia only, intranasal only. Requires BCEHS-specific education (Flight Training Program, including the IN ketamine endorsement).
dose.zh: PCP：只用于镇痛，只走鼻内途径。必须受过 BCEHS 专门培训（Flight Training Program，含鼻内 ketamine 氯胺酮认证）。

dose.en: Mandatory consult before administration with 1) CCP-A 2) EPOS 3) CliniCall
dose.zh: 给药前必须咨询：1) CCP-A 2) EPOS 3) CliniCall

dose.en: First dose 0.75 mg/kg IN, maximum 100 mg. The usual dose is 50 to 100 mg.
dose.zh: 首剂 0.75 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 100 mg。通常剂量是 50–100 mg。

dose.en: May repeat 0.5 mg/kg after 20 minutes. Consult again for further dosing. There is no maximum cumulative dose.
dose.zh: 20 分钟后可重复 0.5 mg/kg。还要再给，就再咨询一次。没有累计最大剂量。

dose.en: Ages 5 to 11 years: 1 mg/kg IN, maximum 100 mg. May repeat 1 mg/kg after 20 minutes as needed. Same education and mandatory consult.
dose.zh: 5–11 岁：1 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 100 mg。需要时 20 分钟后可重复 1 mg/kg。培训要求和必须咨询的规定相同。

dose.en: Under 5 years: contraindicated for PCPs
dose.zh: 5 岁以下：PCP 禁用

fx.en: Blood pressure and heart rate may rise or fall for a short time
fx.zh: 血压和心率可能短暂升高或下降

fx.en: Emergence reaction during recovery: vivid dreams, confusion, excitement, hallucinations
fx.zh: 恢复期的苏醒反应：梦境逼真、意识混乱、兴奋、幻觉

fx.en: Muscle rigidity and spontaneous involuntary movements
fx.zh: 肌肉僵硬和自发的不自主运动

fx.en: Laryngospasm, which is rare and usually transient
fx.zh: 喉痉挛，少见，通常是一过性的

fx.en: Apnea and respiratory depression with rapid administration
fx.zh: 给药过快时出现呼吸暂停和呼吸抑制

pk.en: Intranasal analgesia starts in 5 to 10 minutes, peaks at 20 minutes and lasts 45 minutes.
pk.zh: 鼻内给药 5–10 分钟开始镇痛，20 分钟达峰，维持 45 分钟。

pearl.en: Wait the full 20 minutes before a repeat. Intranasal ketamine peaks at 20 minutes, so a second dose at 10 is stacking, not treating.
pearl.zh: 重复给药之前要等满 20 分钟。鼻内 ketamine 氯胺酮 20 分钟才达峰，10 分钟就补第二剂是在叠加剂量，不是在治疗。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Ketamine drug monograph

stem.en: Kyle, 27, snowboarder at Cypress, deformed lower leg, pain 9/10. Alert, BP 128/78, HR 104, healthy. You hold the IN ketamine endorsement and CliniCall has approved it.
stem.zh: Kyle，27 岁，在 Cypress 滑单板摔伤，小腿变形，疼痛 9/10。清醒，血压 128/78，心率 104，平时健康。你有鼻内 ketamine 氯胺酮认证，CliniCall 也已同意。

why.en: Analgesia, no contraindication, endorsement held, mandatory consult done. The first dose is 0.75 mg/kg IN, to a maximum of 100 mg.
why.zh: 用途是镇痛，没有禁忌，有认证，也做了必须的咨询。首剂 0.75 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 100 mg。

bad.en: He is carried off the mountain in severe pain that you were cleared to treat.
bad.zh: 他带着剧痛被抬下山，而你明明获准给他止痛。

stem.en: Mei, 4, fell from the monkey bars in Richmond. Forearm clearly broken, screaming. 17 kg, vitals normal for her age. You hold the endorsement.
stem.zh: Mei，4 岁，在 Richmond 从攀爬架上摔下来。前臂明显骨折，大声哭叫。体重 17 kg，生命体征符合年龄。你有认证。

why.en: Age under 5 years is a contraindication for PCPs. The endorsement does not change that.
why.zh: 5 岁以下对 PCP 是禁忌。有认证也不改变这一点。

bad.en: If she has a reaction such as laryngospasm, you caused it with a drug you were not allowed to give.
bad.zh: 万一她出现喉痉挛之类的反应，那就是你用一个不该给的药造成的。

stem.en: Gordon, 68, slipped on ice in Kamloops, hip pain 8/10. His speech turned slurred and his right arm weak an hour ago. BP 190/104.
stem.zh: Gordon，68 岁，在 Kamloops 冰上滑倒，髋部疼痛 8/10。一小时前开始口齿不清、右臂无力。血压 190/104。

why.en: A cerebral vascular accident is a condition where hypertension may be harmful. That is a contraindication, endorsement or not.
why.zh: 脑血管意外属于血压升高可能造成伤害的情况。这是禁忌，有没有认证都一样。

bad.en: Ketamine can push his blood pressure up for a while, in a brain that cannot afford it.
bad.zh: ketamine 氯胺酮可能让他的血压再升一阵，而他的脑子承受不起。

stem.en: Tessa, 33, hand crushed at a Delta warehouse. Her first IN ketamine dose was 12 minutes ago, after consult. Pain still 7/10. Vitals steady.
stem.zh: Tessa，33 岁，在 Delta 的仓库里手被压伤。咨询后给的第一剂鼻内 ketamine 氯胺酮是 12 分钟前。疼痛还是 7/10。生命体征平稳。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Wait until 20 minutes, then 0.5 mg/kg IN
opts.zh: 等到 20 分钟，再给 0.5 mg/kg 鼻内

opts.en: Repeat 0.75 mg/kg IN right now
opts.zh: 现在就重复 0.75 mg/kg 鼻内

opts.en: Repeat 0.5 mg/kg IN right now
opts.zh: 现在就重复 0.5 mg/kg 鼻内

why.en: A repeat is 0.5 mg/kg after 20 minutes. The intranasal peak is at 20 minutes, so the first dose is still building.
why.zh: 重复剂量是 20 分钟后给 0.5 mg/kg。鼻内给药 20 分钟才达峰，第一剂的药效还在往上走。

bad.en: The doses stack, and she drifts toward dissociation instead of analgesia.
bad.zh: 剂量叠加起来，她得到的不是镇痛，而是慢慢滑向分离状态。

s.en: A PCP gives ketamine by the intranasal route only.
s.zh: PCP 给 ketamine 氯胺酮只能走鼻内途径。

why.en: The PCP dosing is intranasal. IV, IO and IM ketamine are BCEHS: ACP and above.
why.zh: PCP 的剂量只有鼻内。静脉、骨内和肌注的 ketamine 氯胺酮属于 BCEHS：ACP 及以上。

s.en: With the endorsement, a PCP needs no consult before IN ketamine.
s.zh: 有了认证，PCP 给鼻内 ketamine 氯胺酮之前就不用咨询了。

why.en: A consult before administration is mandatory, with CCP-A, EPOS or CliniCall.
why.zh: 给药前必须咨询 CCP-A、EPOS 或 CliniCall。

s.en: Systolic BP above 180 mmHg is a caution for ketamine.
s.zh: 收缩压高于 180 mmHg 是 ketamine 氯胺酮的慎用情况。

why.en: Severe hypertension, systolic above 180 mmHg, is a listed caution.
why.zh: 严重高血压（收缩压高于 180 mmHg）列在慎用里。

s.en: A PCP can use ketamine to sedate a severely agitated patient.
s.zh: PCP 可以用 ketamine 氯胺酮给严重躁动的病人镇静。

why.en: For PCPs it is analgesia only. Severe agitation is BCEHS: ACP and above.
why.zh: PCP 只能用它镇痛。严重躁动属于 BCEHS：ACP 及以上。

q.en: The first adult dose of intranasal ketamine for a PCP is…
q.zh: PCP 给成人鼻内 ketamine 氯胺酮的首剂是…

opts.en: 0.75 mg/kg IN, maximum 100 mg
opts.zh: 0.75 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 100 mg

opts.en: 7.5 mg/kg IN, maximum 1,000 mg
opts.zh: 7.5 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 1,000 mg

opts.en: 0.75 mg/kg IV slow push, maximum 100 mg
opts.zh: 0.75 mg/kg 静脉慢推，最多 100 mg

opts.en: 0.25 mg/kg IN, maximum 35 mg
opts.zh: 0.25 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 35 mg

why.en: 0.75 mg/kg IN with a maximum of 100 mg. The usual dose is 50 to 100 mg.
why.zh: 0.75 mg/kg 鼻内，最多 100 mg。通常剂量是 50–100 mg。

q.en: What does ketamine do at a low dose?
q.zh: 小剂量的 ketamine 氯胺酮起什么作用？

opts.en: Analgesia, with dissociation only at higher doses
opts.zh: 镇痛，剂量更大才出现分离状态

opts.en: Dissociation, with analgesia only at higher doses
opts.zh: 分离状态，剂量更大才镇痛

opts.en: Muscle paralysis, with analgesia only at higher doses
opts.zh: 肌肉麻痹，剂量更大才镇痛

opts.en: Sleep, with no effect on pain at any dose
opts.zh: 让人入睡，多大剂量都不止痛

why.en: At low doses it causes analgesia, and higher doses lead to dissociation.
why.zh: 小剂量带来镇痛，剂量更大则导致分离状态。

q.en: Which reaction is listed for ketamine during recovery?
q.zh: ketamine 氯胺酮在恢复期列明的反应是哪一个？

opts.en: Vivid dreams, confusion, excitement or hallucinations
opts.zh: 梦境逼真、意识混乱、兴奋或幻觉

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils, constipation and slow breathing
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔、便秘和呼吸变慢

opts.en: Low blood sugar, sweating and shaking
opts.zh: 低血糖、出汗和发抖

opts.en: Itchy rash, wheeze and swollen lips
opts.zh: 皮疹发痒、喘鸣和嘴唇肿胀

why.en: This is the emergence reaction. It may occur during recovery.
why.zh: 这就是苏醒反应，可能在恢复期出现。

bcehs.name: Entonox (Nitrous oxide)

cls.zh: 吸入性麻醉药

hook.en: Laughing gas: pain relief the patient breathes in on their own.
hook.zh: Entonox 笑气：病人自己拿着吸的止痛气体。

how.en: Entonox is half nitrous oxide and half oxygen. Nobody is sure exactly how it works, but it probably makes the body release endorphins, its own painkillers. The gas also moves into any air pocket in the body and makes it bigger, which explains most of its contraindications.
how.zh: Entonox 笑气是一半 nitrous oxide 氧化亚氮、一半氧气。它到底怎么起作用还不完全清楚，很可能是让身体放出内啡肽，也就是自带的止痛物质。这种气体还会钻进体内任何一个气腔并把它撑大，它的大部分禁忌证都是这么来的。

use.en: Self-administered relief of moderate to severe pain
use.zh: 病人自行吸入，缓解中到重度疼痛

use.en: Pain from extremity injuries, burns, or other injuries and conditions, but not inhalation injuries
use.zh: 四肢损伤、烧伤或其他损伤和疾病引起的疼痛，但不包括吸入性损伤

no.en: Pneumothorax, traumatic or spontaneous
no.zh: 气胸，不管是外伤性还是自发性

no.en: Air embolism, or decompression sickness after a recent SCUBA dive
no.zh: 空气栓塞，或近期潜水（SCUBA）后的减压病

no.en: Altered mental status, or unable to follow instructions
no.zh: 意识状态改变，或不能听从指令

no.en: Inhalation injury (smoke or chemicals)
no.zh: 吸入性损伤（烟雾或化学品）

no.en: Nitroglycerin in the five minutes before Entonox
no.zh: 用 Entonox 笑气前五分钟内用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

no.en: Bullous emphysema
no.zh: 大疱性肺气肿

no.en: Gross abdominal distension
no.zh: 明显的腹部膨隆

noFake.zh: 20 分钟前用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

noFake.en: Child aged 8 who can follow instructions
noFake.zh: 能听从指令的 8 岁孩子

noFake.en: Burn to the arm with no smoke inhalation
noFake.zh: 手臂烧伤，没有吸入烟雾

care.en: Use with caution in patients who are hypotensive or in shock.
care.zh: 低血压或休克的病人慎用。

care.en: Depressant drugs add to its effect: alcohol, sedatives, antihistamines, psychotropic medications.
care.zh: 抑制性药物会和它叠加：酒精、镇静药、抗组胺药、精神科药物。

care.en: Use with caution in COPD and in facial injuries.
care.zh: COPD 和面部外伤时慎用。

care.en: The gas is breathed out unchanged, so in the ambulance run the exhaust fans or open the windows.
care.zh: 这种气体会原样呼出来，所以在救护车里要开排风扇或开窗。

care.en: Do not use it aboard an aircraft, because the flight crew would be exposed.
care.zh: 不要在飞机上用，因为机组人员会吸到。

dose.en: Self-administered by inhalation, to effect
dose.zh: 病人自行吸入，吸到有效为止

dose.en: The same as an adult: self-administered, to effect
dose.zh: 和成人一样：自行吸入，吸到有效为止

dose.en: Pain relief starts in less than one minute, after 4 to 5 deep breaths
dose.zh: 深吸 4–5 口后，不到一分钟就开始止痛

dose.en: It only works while the patient keeps breathing it
dose.zh: 只有一直吸着才有效

dose.en: Not within five minutes after nitroglycerin
dose.zh: 用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油后五分钟内不能用

pk.en: Works in less than one minute, after 4 to 5 deep breaths. It needs continuous use to keep working.
pk.zh: 深吸 4–5 口后不到一分钟起效。要持续吸才能维持效果。

pearl.en: Nitrous oxide moves into every trapped pocket of gas and makes it bigger: a collapsed lung, a diver's bubbles, a distended belly. Learn that one idea and most of CDCPAIN explains itself.
pearl.zh: nitrous oxide 氧化亚氮会钻进体内每一个封闭的气腔并把它撑大：塌掉的肺、潜水员体内的气泡、鼓胀的肚子。记住这一个道理，CDCPAIN 的大部分内容就不用死背了。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): abdominal distension is only a caution, bullous emphysema is not listed, and an enclosed area you cannot ventilate is a contraindication. The exam also lists cardiac chest pain when nitroglycerin is contraindicated or will not help, and wants the cylinder inverted 3 times before use.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：腹部膨隆只算慎用，没有列大疱性肺气肿，而无法通风的封闭空间是禁忌证。考试还把 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油有禁忌或无效时的心源性胸痛列为适应证，并要求使用前把气瓶倒置 3 次。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Nitrous Oxide drug monograph

stem.en: Jordan, 24, dislocated shoulder on a Whistler ski run. Alert, follows instructions, BP 128/80. No chest injury, no diving, no nitroglycerin.
stem.zh: Jordan，24 岁，在 Whistler 的雪道上肩关节脱位。清醒，能听从指令，血压 128/80。没有胸部外伤，没潜过水，没用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

why.en: Moderate to severe pain from an extremity injury. He is alert, can follow instructions, and has none of the CDCPAIN contraindications.
why.zh: 四肢损伤引起的中到重度疼痛。他清醒，能听从指令，CDCPAIN 里的禁忌证一条都没有。

bad.en: He rides the toboggan down in full pain when relief was a few breaths away.
bad.zh: 他一路忍着剧痛被雪橇拖下山，其实吸几口就能缓解。

stem.en: Ben, 38, fell from a ladder in Abbotsford. Broken wrist. Also sharp right-sided chest pain, short of breath, quiet breath sounds on the right.
stem.zh: Ben，38 岁，在 Abbotsford 从梯子上摔下来。手腕骨折。另外右侧胸部锐痛、气短，右侧呼吸音减弱。

why.en: This looks like a traumatic pneumothorax. Nitrous oxide expands into trapped gas and makes it bigger.
why.zh: 这看起来像外伤性气胸。nitrous oxide 氧化亚氮会钻进封闭的气体里把它撑大。

bad.en: The pocket of air in his chest grows, and breathing gets harder with every breath of gas.
bad.zh: 他胸腔里的那团气越来越大，每吸一口 Entonox 笑气，呼吸就更费力。

stem.en: Aiko, 31, deep joint pain and tingling one hour after a SCUBA dive at Whytecliff Park. Alert, cooperative, asking for pain relief.
stem.zh: Aiko，31 岁，在 Whytecliff Park 潜水（SCUBA）后一小时，关节深处疼痛、发麻。清醒，配合，想要止痛。

why.en: Decompression sickness after a recent SCUBA dive is a contraindication. The gas would move into the bubbles already in her body.
why.zh: 近期潜水后的减压病是禁忌证。这种气体会钻进她体内已有的气泡里。

bad.en: Her bubbles grow, and her symptoms get worse instead of better.
bad.zh: 她体内的气泡变大，症状不但没好，反而更重。

stem.en: Carlos, 60, felt chest pressure on his stairs in Victoria, stumbled and broke his ankle. No chest injury. Nitroglycerin spray given two minutes ago. He wants something for the ankle.
stem.zh: Carlos，60 岁，在 Victoria 家里的楼梯上胸口发闷，脚下一绊摔断了脚踝。胸部没有受伤。两分钟前给过一喷 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。他想要点东西止脚踝的痛。

ask.en: When can he start Entonox?
ask.zh: 他什么时候可以开始用 Entonox 笑气？

opts.en: Once five minutes have passed since the nitroglycerin
opts.zh: 用完 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油满五分钟之后

opts.en: Right now, because the two do not interact
opts.zh: 现在就可以，因为两者互不影响

opts.en: Not today, because any nitroglycerin rules it out
opts.zh: 今天都不行，因为只要用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油就不能用

why.en: Nitroglycerin within five minutes before Entonox is a contraindication. Outside that window it is not.
why.zh: 用 Entonox 笑气前五分钟内用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油是禁忌证。过了这个时间窗就不是。

s.en: Entonox is half nitrous oxide and half oxygen.
s.zh: Entonox 笑气是一半 nitrous oxide 氧化亚氮、一半氧气。

why.en: BCEHS supplies it as a 50/50 mixture with oxygen.
why.zh: BCEHS 用的是和氧气 50/50 的混合气。

s.en: You hold the mask on the patient's face so they get a full dose.
s.zh: 你要把面罩按在病人脸上，保证吸够量。

why.en: It is self-administered. A patient who cannot comply does not get it.
why.zh: 它是病人自行吸入的。不能配合的病人就不给。

s.en: Entonox must not be used aboard an aircraft.
s.zh: 飞机上不能用 Entonox 笑气。

why.en: The flight crew would be exposed to the gas.
why.zh: 机组人员会吸到这种气体。

s.en: Pain relief carries on for an hour after the patient stops breathing it.
s.zh: 病人停止吸入后，止痛效果还能维持一小时。

why.en: It requires continuous use to keep working.
why.zh: 要持续吸才有效。

q.en: How is Entonox dosed?
q.zh: Entonox 笑气怎么给？

opts.en: Self-administered by inhalation, to effect
opts.zh: 病人自行吸入，吸到有效为止

opts.en: 10 L/min by non-rebreather mask for 5 minutes
opts.zh: 用非重复呼吸面罩 10 L/min 吸 5 分钟

opts.en: One deep breath every 5 minutes
opts.zh: 每 5 分钟深吸一口

opts.en: The paramedic holds the mask on for 2 minutes
opts.zh: 由急救员把面罩按住 2 分钟

why.en: The patient breathes it to effect. Relief starts in less than one minute, after 4 to 5 deep breaths.
why.zh: 由病人自己吸到有效为止。深吸 4–5 口后不到一分钟开始止痛。

q.en: Why is Entonox contraindicated in pneumothorax and decompression sickness?
q.zh: 为什么气胸和减压病不能用 Entonox 笑气？

opts.en: The gas expands into trapped gas spaces in the body
opts.zh: 这种气体会钻进体内封闭的气腔并使其膨胀

opts.en: It lowers the blood pressure too far
opts.zh: 它会把血压降得太低

opts.en: It takes away the drive to breathe
opts.zh: 它会抑制呼吸驱动

opts.en: It reacts with nitrogen to form a toxin
opts.zh: 它会和氮气反应生成毒素

why.en: Nitrous oxide moves into internal gas spaces and enlarges them. That accounts for most of its contraindications.
why.zh: nitrous oxide 氧化亚氮会进入体内的气腔并把它撑大。它的大部分禁忌证都是这个原因。

q.en: In BCEHS, which of these is a caution for Entonox, not a contraindication?
q.zh: 在 BCEHS，下面哪一项对 Entonox 笑气只是慎用，不是禁忌证？

opts.en: Facial injuries
opts.zh: 面部外伤

opts.en: Inhalation injury
opts.zh: 吸入性损伤

opts.en: Bullous emphysema
opts.zh: 大疱性肺气肿

opts.en: Gross abdominal distension
opts.zh: 明显的腹部膨隆

why.en: Facial injuries, COPD, shock and depressant drugs call for caution. The other three are contraindications.
why.zh: 面部外伤、COPD、休克和抑制性药物属于慎用。另外三项是禁忌证。

bcehs.name: Methoxyflurane (Penthrox)

cls.zh: 吸入性氟代烃类挥发性麻醉药

hook.en: A pain inhaler the patient holds and breathes from.
hook.zh: 病人自己拿着吸的止痛吸入器。

how.en: It is a fast-acting anesthetic vapour that the patient breathes in. The exact way it works is not known. That is the honest answer, and it is the one in the monograph.
how.zh: 它是一种起效很快的麻醉蒸气，由病人自己吸入。确切的作用机制还不清楚。这是老实话，专论里也是这么写的。

use.en: Self-administered relief of moderate to severe pain in a conscious, hemodynamically stable patient
use.zh: 清醒、血流动力学稳定的病人，自己吸入来缓解中到重度疼痛

no.en: Under 18 years of age
no.zh: 未满 18 岁

no.en: Decreased level of consciousness or head injury
no.zh: 意识水平下降或头部外伤

no.en: Pregnancy, intended pregnancy or current breast-feeding
no.zh: 怀孕、备孕或正在哺乳

no.en: Kidney impairment: a history of clinically significant renal impairment (for example reduced renal output) or signs of kidney failure
no.zh: 肾功能受损：有临床意义的肾功能损害病史（比如肾排出量减少），或有肾衰竭的表现

no.en: Cardiac instability or respiratory depression
no.zh: 心脏情况不稳定或呼吸抑制

no.en: Inadequate patient understanding or lack of cooperation
no.zh: 病人理解不了或不配合

no.en: History of liver dysfunction after earlier exposure to halogenated anesthetics
no.zh: 以前用卤代麻醉药后出现过肝功能异常

no.en: Current use of tetracycline antibiotics
no.zh: 正在用 tetracycline 四环素类抗生素

no.en: Personal or genetic history of malignant hyperthermia
no.zh: 本人或家族遗传有恶性高热病史

no.en: Muscular dystrophy
no.zh: 肌营养不良

no.en: Hypersensitivity to methoxyflurane
no.zh: 对 methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷过敏

noFake.zh: 正在吃 amoxicillin 阿莫西林

care.en: More than the recommended dose can cause serious, irreversible kidney damage.
care.zh: 超过推荐剂量会造成严重的、不可逆的肾损伤。

care.en: The activated carbon chamber must always be attached during use.
care.zh: 使用时活性炭腔必须一直装在吸入器上。

care.en: Fill the inhaler outside the vehicle when possible and start in a well-ventilated space.
care.zh: 尽量在车外装药，并在通风良好的地方开始吸。

care.en: In the vehicle: cab fan on high, partition window closed, patient compartment exhaust on high.
care.zh: 在车里：驾驶室风扇开到最大，隔窗关上，病人舱排风开到最大。

care.en: Crew exposure limit: 3 doses (9 mL) in total in any 24 hours.
care.zh: 急救人员自己的暴露上限：任意 24 小时内一共 3 剂（9 mL）。

dose.en: 3 mL in the inhaler, self-administered
dose.zh: 3 mL 装入吸入器，病人自己吸

dose.en: May repeat after 20 minutes. Maximum total 6 mL
dose.zh: 20 分钟后可重复。总量最多 6 mL

dose.en: The patient gives it to themselves as needed, under direct EMR or paramedic supervision
dose.zh: 病人按需要自己吸，EMR 或 paramedic 必须在旁边直接监督

dose.en: No more than 6 mL in any 24 hours, and no more than 15 mL in 1 week
dose.zh: 任意 24 小时内不超过 6 mL，1 周内不超过 15 mL

dose.en: Not approved under 18 years
dose.zh: 未满 18 岁未获批准使用

fx.en: Drowsiness and altered level of consciousness

fx.zh: 咳嗽（咳个不停就先停用）

fx.en: Pungent smell and taste (coach slow first breaths)
fx.zh: 气味和味道刺鼻（指导病人头几口慢慢吸）
低血压和心动过缓（少见）
容易受暗示，自控力下降

pk.en: Works in 1 to 3 minutes or 8 to 10 regular breaths, a 3 mL dose lasts about 25 minutes, and it wears off 3 to 5 minutes after stopping.
pk.zh: 1–3 分钟（正常呼吸 8–10 口）起效，一剂 3 mL 大约维持 25 分钟，停用后 3–5 分钟消退。

pearl.en: The patient holds the inhaler, never you. And 6 mL is the ceiling, because an overdose can ruin the kidneys for good.
pearl.zh: 吸入器由病人自己拿，绝不是你替他拿。6 mL 是上限，因为过量会把肾永久毁掉。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): same dose and the same nine listed contraindications, but the indication says pain, not moderate to severe pain. The exam files the CHECK mnemonic under cautions, and it does not mention the 24-hour and weekly limits or the crew exposure limit.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：剂量一样，列出的九条禁忌也一样，但适应证只写「疼痛」，没有「中到重度」这个限定。考试把 CHECK 口诀放在注意事项里，没有提 24 小时和每周的用量上限，也没有提急救人员的暴露上限。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Methoxyflurane (Penthrox) drug monograph

stem.en: Marco, 41, snowboarder at Cypress Mountain with a deformed forearm. Pain 8 out of 10. Alert, BP 128/80, HR 96. No kidney or liver problems, no medicines.
stem.zh: Marco，41 岁，在 Cypress Mountain 滑单板，前臂变形。疼痛 8 分（满分 10）。清醒，血压 128/80，心率 96。没有肝肾问题，不吃药。

why.en: Moderate to severe pain in a conscious, stable adult with no contraindication. He breathes the 3 mL himself while you supervise.
why.zh: 清醒、稳定的成人，中到重度疼痛，没有禁忌。3 mL 由他自己吸，你在旁边监督。

bad.en: He goes down the mountain on a sled with severe pain and nothing for it.
bad.zh: 他带着剧痛被雪橇拖下山，什么止痛都没有。

stem.en: Tyler, 16, dirt bike crash near Squamish. Obvious ankle fracture, pain 9 out of 10. Alert, vitals stable, begging for something.
stem.zh: Tyler，16 岁，在 Squamish 附近骑越野摩托摔了。脚踝明显骨折，疼痛 9 分（满分 10）。清醒，生命体征稳定，求你给点什么。

why.en: He is under 18. Methoxyflurane is not approved by Health Canada below that age.
why.zh: 他未满 18 岁。Health Canada 没有批准 methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷用于这个年龄以下的病人。

bad.en: A minor has breathed an anesthetic that is not approved for his age. That is yours to explain.
bad.zh: 一个未成年人吸了没有获批用于他这个年龄的麻醉药。这得由你来解释。

stem.en: Sandra, 45, fell from a ladder in her Kitsilano garage. Painful, swollen wrist. She also hit her head and keeps asking what happened.
stem.zh: Sandra，45 岁，在 Kitsilano 自家车库里从梯子上摔下来。手腕又痛又肿。她还撞到了头，一直反复问发生了什么。

why.en: Head injury and a decreased level of consciousness are both contraindications. Asking the same question again and again is not a clear head.
why.zh: 头部外伤和意识水平下降都是禁忌。翻来覆去问同一个问题，说明脑子并不清楚。

bad.en: She gets drowsier, and now nobody can tell the drug from a bleed in her head.
bad.zh: 她越来越嗜睡，而这时已经没人分得清是药的作用还是颅内出血。

stem.en: Ivan, 52, dislocated shoulder on a trail in Whistler. He finished his first 3 mL 20 minutes ago. Pain is climbing again. Alert, BP 134/82.
stem.zh: Ivan，52 岁，在 Whistler 的山道上肩关节脱位。20 分钟前吸完了第一剂 3 mL。疼痛又上来了。清醒，血压 134/82。

ask.en: What can you offer now?

opts.en: A second 3 mL, and that is the last
opts.zh: 再给 3 mL，这是最后一剂

opts.en: Nothing more, one dose is the limit
opts.zh: 不能再给，一剂就是上限

opts.en: 3 mL more every 20 minutes as needed
opts.zh: 按需要每 20 分钟再给 3 mL

why.en: It may be repeated after 20 minutes, to a maximum total of 6 mL.
why.zh: 20 分钟后可以重复，总量最多 6 mL。

s.en: The patient must give it to themselves, with you supervising directly.
s.zh: 必须由病人自己吸，你在旁边直接监督。

why.en: It is self-administered as needed, under direct EMR or paramedic supervision.
why.zh: 按需要自己吸入，EMR 或 paramedic 直接监督。

s.en: A breastfeeding mother with a broken wrist can use it.
s.zh: 正在哺乳的妈妈手腕骨折，可以用它。

why.en: Current breast-feeding is a contraindication, along with pregnancy and intended pregnancy.
why.zh: 正在哺乳是禁忌，怀孕和备孕也是。

s.en: Too much methoxyflurane can damage the kidneys permanently.
s.zh: methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷用多了会永久损伤肾脏。

why.en: Doses above the therapeutic range have caused serious, irreversible nephrotoxicity.
why.zh: 超过治疗量的剂量造成过严重的、不可逆的肾毒性。

s.en: The carbon chamber can come off if the patient finds the inhaler awkward.
s.zh: 病人觉得吸入器不好拿的话，可以把活性炭腔拆掉。

why.en: The activated carbon chamber must always be attached during administration.
why.zh: 给药过程中活性炭腔必须一直装着。

q.en: The dose of methoxyflurane is…
q.zh: methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷的剂量是…

opts.en: 3 mL inhaled, may repeat after 20 minutes, maximum 6 mL
opts.zh: 3 mL 吸入，20 分钟后可重复，最多 6 mL

opts.en: 3 mL inhaled, may repeat after 5 minutes, maximum 6 mL
opts.zh: 3 mL 吸入，5 分钟后可重复，最多 6 mL

opts.en: 3 mL inhaled, may repeat after 20 minutes, maximum 9 mL
opts.zh: 3 mL 吸入，20 分钟后可重复，最多 9 mL

opts.en: 6 mL inhaled, may repeat after 20 minutes, maximum 15 mL
opts.zh: 6 mL 吸入，20 分钟后可重复，最多 15 mL

why.en: One 3 mL dose, one repeat after 20 minutes, 6 mL in total. The 9 mL figure is the crew exposure limit.
why.zh: 一剂 3 mL，20 分钟后可重复一次，总共 6 mL。9 mL 那个数字是急救人员自己的暴露上限。

q.en: Your patient on methoxyflurane keeps coughing and cannot stop. What do you do?
q.zh: 病人吸着 methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷，一直咳个不停。你怎么办？

opts.en: Pause the inhaler
opts.zh: 先停一下吸入器

opts.en: Coach faster, deeper breaths
opts.zh: 指导他吸得更快更深

opts.en: Add the second 3 mL dose
opts.zh: 加上第二剂 3 mL

opts.en: Take off the carbon chamber
opts.zh: 把活性炭腔拆掉

why.en: The monograph says to pause use for persistent coughing.
why.zh: 专论写明：持续咳嗽就暂停使用。

q.en: How much methoxyflurane exposure may one crew member have in 24 hours?
q.zh: 一名急救人员 24 小时内最多可以暴露于多少 methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷？

opts.en: 3 doses, 9 mL in total
opts.zh: 3 剂，一共 9 mL

opts.en: 1 dose, 3 mL in total
opts.zh: 1 剂，一共 3 mL

opts.en: 2 doses, 6 mL in total
opts.zh: 2 剂，一共 6 mL

opts.en: 5 doses, 15 mL in total
opts.zh: 5 剂，一共 15 mL

why.en: EMRs and paramedics must limit their own exposure to 3 doses, 9 mL, in any 24 hours.
why.zh: EMR 和 paramedic 必须把自己的暴露限制在任意 24 小时内 3 剂、9 mL。

bcehs.name: Acetaminophen

cls.zh: 镇痛药、退热药

hook.en: Turns down pain and fever. Too much wrecks the liver.
hook.zh: 把疼痛和发烧调低。吃多了伤肝。

how.en: It blocks an enzyme in the brain and spinal cord that makes prostaglandins. Prostaglandins are the chemicals that turn up pain and fever. Fewer of them means less pain and a lower temperature.
how.zh: 它在脑和脊髓里挡住一种制造前列腺素的酶。前列腺素就是把疼痛和发烧“调大”的化学物质。前列腺素少了，疼痛减轻，体温下降。

use.en: Mild to moderate pain (EMR: by mouth only)
use.zh: 轻到中度疼痛（EMR 只能口服给药）

use.en: Severe pain, as one part of a multimodal approach (PCP)
use.zh: 重度疼痛，作为多模式镇痛的一部分（PCP）

use.en: Symptomatic fever above 38°C, with muscle aches, chills or rigors (PCP, PO or IV)
use.zh: 有症状的发热，高于 38°C，伴肌肉酸痛、发冷或寒战（PCP，PO 或 IV）

no.en: Acetaminophen from any source in the past 4 hours
no.zh: 过去 4 小时内用过任何来源的 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

no.en: Total intake in the last 24 hours is already over the daily maximum
no.zh: 过去 24 小时的总量已经超过每日上限

no.en: Suspected overdose: nausea, vomiting or right upper quadrant pain
no.zh: 怀疑过量：恶心、呕吐或右上腹痛

no.en: Severe liver impairment or severe active liver disease
no.zh: 严重肝功能损害或严重的活动性肝病

no.en: Hypersensitivity to acetaminophen or any component of the formulation
no.zh: 对 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚或制剂中任何成分过敏

noFake.zh: 一小时前吃过 ibuprofen 布洛芬

care.en: Liver problems, heavy alcohol use or malnutrition: the 24-hour maximum drops to 2,000 mg.
care.zh: 肝有问题、大量饮酒或营养不良：24 小时上限降到 2,000 mg。

care.en: Use with caution in hypovolemia.
care.zh: 低血容量时慎用。

care.en: It hides in many over-the-counter products, so take a complete medication history first.
care.zh: 很多非处方药里都藏着它，所以给药前要问清全部用药史。

care.en: IV: hypotension has been reported, so check BP before the infusion and then every 15 minutes, three times.
care.zh: IV：有低血压的报告，所以输注前先量血压，之后每 15 分钟量一次，共三次。

care.en: Alcohol adds to its liver toxicity, and chronic use can change the INR of patients on warfarin.
care.zh: 酒精会加重它的肝毒性，长期服用还可能改变 warfarin 华法林病人的 INR。

dose.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO. May repeat once after 4 hours.
dose.zh: 500–1,000 mg PO。4 小时后可重复一次。

dose.en: 24-hour maximum, all sources and all routes: 4,000 mg. With liver dysfunction, heavy alcohol use or malnutrition: 2,000 mg.
dose.zh: 24 小时上限（所有来源、所有途径合计）：4,000 mg。肝功能不好、大量饮酒或营养不良：2,000 mg。

dose.en: PCP, 50 kg or more: 1,000 mg IV every 6 hours as needed, infused over 15 minutes. Under 50 kg: IV is BCEHS ACP and above.
dose.zh: PCP，体重 50 kg 及以上：1,000 mg IV，需要时每 6 小时一次，15 分钟输完。不到 50 kg：IV 属于 BCEHS 的 ACP 及以上。

dose.en: 15 mg/kg PO. May repeat once after 4 hours. 24-hour maximum: 75 mg/kg or 4,000 mg.
dose.zh: 15 mg/kg PO。4 小时后可重复一次。24 小时上限：75 mg/kg 或 4,000 mg。

dose.en: PCP IV: only age 12 to 17 and over 50 kg, 1,000 mg every 6 hours as needed. Age 2 to 11 and under 50 kg: BCEHS ACP and above.
dose.zh: PCP 的 IV：只限 12–17 岁且超过 50 kg，1,000 mg，需要时每 6 小时一次。2–11 岁且不到 50 kg：BCEHS 规定 ACP 及以上才能给。

dose.en: PO is the preferred route. IV and PO doses are equal, mg for mg.
dose.zh: 首选 PO。IV 和 PO 剂量按 mg 一比一等效。

fx.en: Adverse reactions are uncommon with short-term use
fx.zh: 短期使用很少有不良反应

fx.en: Nausea and vomiting with the IV form
fx.zh: IV 剂型可引起恶心、呕吐

fx.en: Hypotension with IV infusion, mostly in critically ill patients
fx.zh: IV 输注时低血压，多见于危重病人

pk.en: By mouth it works in 30 minutes and lasts 4 hours. IV works in 15 minutes and pain relief lasts 4 to 6 hours.
pk.zh: 口服 30 分钟起效，维持 4 小时。IV 15 分钟起效，镇痛维持 4–6 小时。

pearl.en: Before you give it, ask what they already took today, from every bottle in the house. Acetaminophen hides in many over-the-counter products, and it is the leading cause of serious liver injury in Canada.
pearl.zh: 给药前先问今天已经吃过什么，家里每一个药瓶都算。很多非处方药里都藏着 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，它是加拿大严重肝损伤的头号原因。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the adult doses, daily limits and contraindications are the same. The exam monograph gives no pediatric dose and does not list severe pain as an indication. BCEHS adds 15 mg/kg PO for children, and limits EMRs to oral dosing for pain only.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：成人剂量、每日上限和禁忌证都一样。考试专论没有儿童剂量，也没把重度疼痛列为适应证。BCEHS 多了儿童 15 mg/kg PO，并且 EMR 只能口服、只用于止痛。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Acetaminophen drug monograph

stem.en: Maya, 34, rolled her ankle on the Grouse Grind. Pain 5 out of 10. No medications today. No liver problems, rarely drinks.
stem.zh: Maya，34 岁，在 Grouse Grind 步道上扭了脚踝。疼痛 5/10。今天没吃过任何药。没有肝病，很少喝酒。

why.en: Mild to moderate pain, nothing taken in the past 4 hours, no liver disease, no sign of overdose. Give 500 to 1,000 mg PO.
why.zh: 轻到中度疼痛，过去 4 小时内没吃过药，没有肝病，没有过量迹象。给 500–1,000 mg PO。

bad.en: She limps down the mountain in pain that two tablets would have eased.
bad.zh: 她一瘸一拐地下山，其实两片药就能让她好受不少。

stem.en: Gord, 52, strained his back unloading a truck in Surrey. Pain 6 out of 10. He took two extra-strength Tylenol three hours ago.
stem.zh: Gord，52 岁，在 Surrey 卸货时扭伤了腰。疼痛 6/10。三小时前他吃了两片强效 Tylenol。

why.en: Acetaminophen from any source in the past 4 hours means no dose now. Tylenol is acetaminophen.
why.zh: 过去 4 小时内用过任何来源的 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，现在就不能给。Tylenol 就是 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。

bad.en: His daily total climbs toward the limit, and nobody on scene has counted it.
bad.zh: 他的全天总量一路往上限走，现场却没人算过。

stem.en: Jia, 19, on her dorm floor at UBC. Nauseated, vomiting, pain under her right ribs. An empty Tylenol bottle sits on the desk. She asks for a painkiller.
stem.zh: Jia，19 岁，坐在 UBC 宿舍地板上。恶心、呕吐，右侧肋下疼。桌上有一个空的 Tylenol 药瓶。她想要点止痛药。

why.en: Nausea, vomiting and right upper quadrant pain point to acetaminophen overdose. Suspected overdose is a contraindication.
why.zh: 恶心、呕吐加右上腹痛，指向 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚过量。怀疑过量就是禁忌证。

bad.en: You add more of the same drug that is already injuring her liver.
bad.zh: 她的肝已经在被这个药伤害，你又添了一份。

stem.en: Walter, 61, drinks heavily every day. Rib pain after a fall at home in Nanaimo. His only acetaminophen in the past 24 hours was 1,000 mg, eight hours ago.
stem.zh: Walter，61 岁，每天大量喝酒。在 Nanaimo 家里摔倒后肋骨疼。过去 24 小时里他只在八小时前吃过一次 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，1,000 mg。

ask.en: What is the most you can give him now?

opts.en: 1,000 mg PO, because his 24-hour limit is 2,000 mg
opts.zh: 1,000 mg PO，因为他的 24 小时上限是 2,000 mg

opts.en: Nothing, because heavy drinking is a contraindication
opts.zh: 不能给，因为大量饮酒是禁忌证

opts.en: 1,000 mg PO now and again in 4 hours
opts.zh: 现在 1,000 mg PO，4 小时后再给一次

why.en: Heavy alcohol use lowers the 24-hour maximum to 2,000 mg. He has had 1,000 mg, so 1,000 mg is all that is left.
why.zh: 大量饮酒把 24 小时上限降到 2,000 mg。他已经吃了 1,000 mg，只剩 1,000 mg 的额度。

bad.en: A repeat dose puts him over his limit for the day, in a liver that alcohol has already worn down.
bad.zh: 再重复一次就超过他当天的上限，而他的肝早被酒精磨损了。

s.en: Acetaminophen and ibuprofen can be given together for pain.
s.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚和 ibuprofen 布洛芬可以一起用来止痛。

why.en: The monograph allows them at the same time for analgesia.
why.zh: 专论允许两者同时用于镇痛。

s.en: An EMR can give acetaminophen to bring down a fever.
s.zh: EMR 可以给 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚退烧。

why.en: For EMRs it is pain only, by mouth. Fever is a PCP indication.
why.zh: EMR 只能口服、只用于止痛。退热是 PCP 的适应证。

s.en: The 4,000 mg daily limit counts every source and every route.
s.zh: 每日 4,000 mg 的上限要把所有来源、所有途径都算进去。

why.en: Tablets, over-the-counter products and the IV bag all add to one total.
why.zh: 药片、非处方药和 IV 袋都算在同一个总量里。

s.en: IV acetaminophen is stronger than the same dose by mouth.
s.zh: IV 的 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚比同样剂量口服更强。

why.en: IV and oral doses are equivalent, mg for mg. Oral is the preferred route.
why.zh: IV 和口服按 mg 一比一等效。首选口服。

q.en: The adult oral dose of acetaminophen is…
q.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚的成人口服剂量是…

opts.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO, may repeat once after 4 hours
opts.zh: 500–1,000 mg PO，4 小时后可重复一次

opts.en: 500 to 1,000 mg PO every 2 hours as needed
opts.zh: 500–1,000 mg PO，需要时每 2 小时一次

opts.en: 5,000 mg PO, once only
opts.zh: 5,000 mg PO，只给一次

opts.en: 15 mg/kg PO every 4 hours, with no daily limit
opts.zh: 15 mg/kg PO，每 4 小时一次，没有每日上限

why.en: 500 to 1,000 mg, one repeat after 4 hours, and never more than 4,000 mg in 24 hours from all sources.
why.zh: 500–1,000 mg，4 小时后可重复一次，所有来源合计 24 小时不超过 4,000 mg。

q.en: A 10-year-old weighs 30 kg and has a broken wrist. What is the oral dose?
q.zh: 一个 10 岁孩子体重 30 kg，手腕骨折。口服剂量是多少？

opts.en: 450 mg PO
opts.zh: 450 mg 口服

opts.en: 45 mg PO
opts.zh: 45 mg 口服

opts.en: 2,250 mg PO
opts.zh: 2,250 mg 口服

opts.en: 1,000 mg PO
opts.zh: 1,000 mg 口服

why.en: 15 mg/kg times 30 kg is 450 mg. The 75 mg/kg figure is the 24-hour maximum, not a single dose.
why.zh: 15 mg/kg 乘以 30 kg 是 450 mg。75 mg/kg 是 24 小时上限，不是单次剂量。

q.en: How does acetaminophen reduce pain and fever?
q.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚怎样减轻疼痛和发烧？

opts.en: It blocks prostaglandin production in the central nervous system
opts.zh: 在中枢神经系统里阻断前列腺素的生成

opts.en: It binds to opioid receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 与大脑里的阿片受体结合

opts.en: It stops platelets from clumping together
opts.zh: 阻止血小板聚集

opts.en: It reduces swelling at the site of injury
opts.zh: 减轻受伤部位的肿胀

why.en: It inhibits prostaglandin synthetase in the central nervous system. That lowers both pain and fever.
why.zh: 它抑制中枢神经系统里的前列腺素合成酶，所以疼痛和发烧都降下来。

bcehs.name: Ibuprofen

cls.zh: 镇痛药、退热药、非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）

hook.en: Turns down pain, swelling and fever.
hook.zh: 把疼痛、肿胀和发烧压下去。

how.en: Injured or inflamed tissue makes chemicals called prostaglandins. They cause pain, swelling and fever. Ibuprofen stops the body from making them.
how.zh: 受伤或发炎的组织会产生一种叫前列腺素的化学物质，它们引起疼痛、肿胀和发烧。ibuprofen 布洛芬让身体造不出前列腺素。

use.en: Mild to moderate pain (EMR and PCP)
use.zh: 轻到中度疼痛（EMR 和 PCP）

use.en: PCP: symptomatic fever above 38°C (muscle aches, chills, rigors)
use.zh: PCP：有症状的发热，体温高于 38°C（肌肉酸痛、发冷、寒战）

use.en: PCP: severe pain, as part of a multimodal approach
use.zh: PCP：重度疼痛，作为多模式镇痛的一部分

no.en: Taking an anticoagulant (apixaban, rivaroxaban, warfarin, edoxaban, dabigatran)
no.zh: 正在用抗凝药（apixaban 阿哌沙班、rivaroxaban 利伐沙班、warfarin 华法林、edoxaban 艾多沙班、dabigatran 达比加群）

no.en: Known or suspected kidney dysfunction (GFR or creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min, or the patient says their kidneys are bad)
no.zh: 已知或怀疑肾功能不全（GFR 或肌酐清除率低于 30 mL/min，或病人自己说肾不好）

no.en: Pregnancy
no.zh: 怀孕

no.en: Concern for severe active bleeding (trauma, intracranial hemorrhage, GI bleeding)
no.zh: 担心有严重的活动性出血（创伤、颅内出血、消化道出血）

no.en: Known hypersensitivity to ibuprofen or other anti-inflammatories, including aspirin
no.zh: 已知对 ibuprofen 布洛芬或其他抗炎药过敏，包括 aspirin 阿司匹林

noFake.zh: 一小时前吃过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚
对 penicillin 青霉素过敏

care.en: Severe volume depletion or dehydration.
care.zh: 严重的容量不足或脱水。

care.en: Active cardiac emergency, such as a myocardial infarction.
care.zh: 正在发生的心脏急症，比如心肌梗死。

care.en: Another anti-inflammatory in the last 6 to 12 hours (ibuprofen, celecoxib, naproxen).
care.zh: 过去 6–12 小时内吃过别的抗炎药（ibuprofen 布洛芬、celecoxib 塞来昔布、naproxen 萘普生）。

care.en: History of gastrointestinal, kidney or significant cardiovascular disease: consider another option.
care.zh: 有胃肠道、肾脏或明显心血管疾病史：考虑换别的办法。

care.en: NSAIDs may raise blood pressure and make blood pressure pills work less well.
care.zh: NSAID 可能升高血压，让降压药的效果打折扣。

dose.en: 300 to 400 mg PO
May repeat every 4 to 6 hours. Maximum 1,200 mg per day
dose.zh: 每 4–6 小时可重复。每天最多 1,200 mg

dose.en: 10 mg/kg PO, by weight
dose.zh: 10 mg/kg 口服，按体重算

dose.en: May repeat once after 6 hours. Maximum 40 mg/kg per day
dose.zh: 6 小时后可重复一次。每天最多 40 mg/kg

dose.en: EMR gives it for pain only. PCP also for symptomatic fever above 38°C
dose.zh: EMR 只用于止痛。PCP 还可用于体温高于 38°C 的有症状发热

dose.en: Supplied as 300 mg tablets and 100 mg per 5 mL liquid
dose.zh: 剂型：300 mg 片剂，以及 100 mg/5 mL 口服液

fx.en: Stomach upset and abdominal discomfort (the most common)
fx.zh: 胃部不适、腹部不舒服（最常见）

fx.en: Gastric ulceration, bleeding and perforation (unlikely after a single dose)
fx.zh: 胃溃疡、出血和穿孔（只给一次的话不太会发生）

fx.en: In overdose: gastrointestinal irritation and CNS depression
fx.zh: 过量时：胃肠道刺激和中枢神经抑制

pk.en: Pain relief starts in 30 to 60 minutes and lasts 4 to 6 hours, and the fever effect lasts 6 to 8 hours.
pk.zh: 止痛 30–60 分钟起效，维持 4–6 小时。退热效果维持 6–8 小时。

pearl.en: Before the tablets, ask about blood thinners, kidneys and pregnancy. Then ask when the last anti-inflammatory was taken. Six to twelve hours ago still counts.
pearl.zh: 给药片之前先问三样：抗凝药、肾、怀孕。再问上一次吃抗炎药是什么时候，6 到 12 小时前吃的也要算进去。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): for a child with fever the dose depends on temperature: 5 mg/kg below 39°C and 10 mg/kg at 39°C or above, every 4 to 6 hours. Its contraindications name active GI hemorrhage or ulcers, and leave out kidney dysfunction and bleeding from trauma.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：儿童退热的剂量看体温：低于 39°C 给 5 mg/kg，39°C 或以上给 10 mg/kg，每 4–6 小时一次。禁忌里写的是活动性消化道出血或溃疡，没有肾功能不全，也没有创伤出血。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Ibuprofen drug monograph

stem.en: Priya, 29, rolled her ankle on the Grouse Grind. Pain 5 out of 10. Healthy, no medicines, no allergies, not pregnant.
stem.zh: Priya，29 岁，在 Grouse Grind 山道上崴了脚。疼痛 5 分（满分 10）。平时健康，不吃药，没有过敏，没有怀孕。

why.en: Mild to moderate pain and none of the contraindications. Give 300 to 400 mg PO.
why.zh: 轻到中度疼痛，一条禁忌都不沾。给 300–400 mg 口服。

bad.en: She limps down the mountain in pain that one dose would have eased.
bad.zh: 她一瘸一拐地疼着下山，其实一剂药就能缓解。

stem.en: Walter, 77, sore knee after a fall in his Richmond care home. Vitals normal. His pill list includes apixaban.
stem.zh: Walter，77 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院摔了一跤，膝盖疼。生命体征正常。他的用药单上有 apixaban 阿哌沙班。

why.en: He takes an anticoagulant. That is a contraindication, however small the injury looks.
why.zh: 他在用抗凝药。这是禁忌，伤看起来再小也一样。

bad.en: An NSAID on top of an anticoagulant raises his bleeding risk, and he has just fallen.
bad.zh: 抗凝药上再加一个 NSAID，出血风险更高，而他刚刚才摔过。

stem.en: Jenna, 31, 20 weeks pregnant, strained her lower back lifting boxes. Vitals normal, no bleeding, baby moving.
stem.zh: Jenna，31 岁，怀孕 20 周，搬箱子时扭了腰。生命体征正常，没有出血，胎动正常。

why.en: Pregnancy is a contraindication. The monograph makes no exception for any stage.
why.zh: 怀孕是禁忌。专论没有给任何孕期开例外。

bad.en: You exposed her baby to a contraindicated drug in order to treat a sore back.
bad.zh: 为了治一个腰痛，你让她的宝宝接触了一个禁用的药。

stem.en: Noah, 9, weighs 30 kg, fell off his bike in Stanley Park. Sore, swollen wrist. No other injuries, no medicines, no allergies.
stem.zh: Noah，9 岁，体重 30 kg，在 Stanley Park 骑车摔倒。手腕又痛又肿。没有别的伤，不吃药，没有过敏。

ask.en: How much ibuprofen?

opts.en: 300 mg PO
opts.zh: 300 mg 口服

opts.en: 30 mg PO
opts.zh: 30 mg 口服

opts.en: 1,200 mg PO
opts.zh: 1,200 mg 口服

why.en: Children get 10 mg/kg PO. At 30 kg that is 300 mg.
why.zh: 儿童按 10 mg/kg 口服。30 kg 就是 300 mg。

s.en: A patient who is allergic to aspirin should not get ibuprofen.
s.zh: 对 aspirin 阿司匹林过敏的病人不应该给 ibuprofen 布洛芬。

why.en: Hypersensitivity to other anti-inflammatories, including aspirin, is a contraindication.
why.zh: 对其他抗炎药过敏（包括 aspirin 阿司匹林）就是禁忌。

s.en: An adult in pain can have 400 mg every 2 hours.
s.zh: 疼痛的成人可以每 2 小时吃 400 mg。

why.en: The repeat is every 4 to 6 hours, with a maximum of 1,200 mg per day.
why.zh: 要隔 4–6 小时才能重复，每天最多 1,200 mg。

s.en: An EMR gives ibuprofen for pain only. A PCP may also give it for fever.
s.zh: EMR 只能用 ibuprofen 布洛芬止痛。PCP 还可以用它退热。

why.en: The EMR line is mild to moderate pain. Antipyresis is on the PCP line.
why.zh: EMR 那一行只写轻到中度疼痛。退热写在 PCP 那一行。

s.en: A patient who says her kidneys are bad can still have a single dose.
s.zh: 病人说自己肾不好，给一次还是可以的。

why.en: The patient saying they have kidney dysfunction is enough to make it contraindicated.
why.zh: 病人自述肾功能有问题，就足以构成禁忌。

q.en: The adult dose of ibuprofen is…
q.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬的成人剂量是…

opts.en: 300 to 400 mg PO every 4 to 6 hours, maximum 1,200 mg per day
opts.zh: 300–400 mg 口服，每 4–6 小时，每天最多 1,200 mg

opts.en: 300 to 400 mg PO every 1 to 2 hours, maximum 1,200 mg per day
opts.zh: 300–400 mg 口服，每 1–2 小时，每天最多 1,200 mg

opts.en: 30 to 40 mg PO every 4 to 6 hours, maximum 120 mg per day
opts.zh: 30–40 mg 口服，每 4–6 小时，每天最多 120 mg

opts.en: 300 to 400 mg IM every 4 to 6 hours, maximum 1,200 mg per day
opts.zh: 300–400 mg 肌注，每 4–6 小时，每天最多 1,200 mg

why.en: It is given by mouth, 300 to 400 mg. Repeat every 4 to 6 hours, never more than 1,200 mg in a day.
why.zh: 口服，300–400 mg。每 4–6 小时可重复，一天不超过 1,200 mg。

q.en: Ibuprofen works by…
q.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬的作用方式是…

opts.en: Blocking the making of prostaglandins
opts.zh: 抑制前列腺素的合成

opts.en: Blocking opioid receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 阻断大脑里的阿片受体

opts.en: Blocking histamine release from mast cells
opts.zh: 阻止肥大细胞释放组胺

opts.en: Relaxing smooth muscle in the blood vessels
opts.zh: 放松血管的平滑肌

why.en: Fewer prostaglandins means less pain, less inflammation and less fever.
why.zh: 前列腺素少了，疼痛、炎症和发烧就都轻了。

q.en: Which home medicine means no ibuprofen?
q.zh: 病人在家吃哪种药，就不能给 ibuprofen 布洛芬？

opts.en: Rivaroxaban, an anticoagulant
opts.zh: rivaroxaban 利伐沙班（抗凝药）

opts.en: Metformin, for diabetes
opts.zh: metformin 二甲双胍（降糖药）

opts.en: Levothyroxine, for the thyroid
opts.zh: levothyroxine 左甲状腺素（甲状腺药）

opts.en: Atorvastatin, for cholesterol
opts.zh: atorvastatin 阿托伐他汀（降脂药）

why.en: Use of an anticoagulant is a contraindication. The monograph names apixaban, rivaroxaban, warfarin, edoxaban and dabigatran.
