why.zh: 在用抗凝药就是禁忌。专论点名了 apixaban 阿哌沙班、rivaroxaban 利伐沙班、warfarin 华法林、edoxaban 艾多沙班和 dabigatran 达比加群。

bcehs.name: Ketorolac (Toradol)

cls.zh: 非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）

hook.en: A non-opioid painkiller you give by needle.
hook.zh: 打针用的止痛药，不是阿片类。

how.en: Injured tissue makes prostaglandins, the chemicals behind pain, inflammation and fever. Ketorolac blocks COX 1 and COX 2, the enzymes that make them. It is in the same family as ibuprofen, but injected.
how.zh: 受伤的组织会产生前列腺素，疼痛、炎症和发热都是它在推动。ketorolac 酮咯酸阻断制造前列腺素的两种酶：COX 1 和 COX 2。它和 ibuprofen 布洛芬是一家的，只不过是注射用。

use.en: Mild to moderate pain
use.zh: 轻到中度疼痛

use.en: Severe pain, as part of a multimodal approach
use.zh: 重度疼痛，作为多模式镇痛的一部分

no.en: Use of an anticoagulant, for example apixaban, rivaroxaban, warfarin, edoxaban or dabigatran
no.zh: 正在用抗凝药，例如 apixaban 阿哌沙班、rivaroxaban 利伐沙班、warfarin 华法林、edoxaban 艾多沙班或 dabigatran 达比加群

no.en: Known or suspected renal dysfunction: GFR or creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min, or the patient says they have kidney dysfunction
no.zh: 已知或怀疑肾功能不全：GFR 或肌酐清除率低于 30 mL/min，或病人自己说肾功能不好

no.en: Concern for severe active bleeding: trauma, intracranial hemorrhage, GI bleeding
no.zh: 担心有严重的活动性出血：创伤、颅内出血、消化道出血

no.en: Pregnancy
no.zh: 怀孕

no.en: Known hypersensitivity to ketorolac or other anti-inflammatories, including aspirin
no.zh: 已知对 ketorolac 酮咯酸或其他抗炎药过敏，包括 ASA 阿司匹林

noFake.zh: 正在吃 ASA 阿司匹林或 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷
一小时前吃过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

care.en: Use caution in severe volume depletion or dehydration.
care.zh: 严重容量不足或脱水时慎用。

care.en: Use caution in an active cardiac emergency, such as myocardial infarction.
care.zh: 正在发生的心脏急症（例如心肌梗死）时慎用。

care.en: Use caution if an anti-inflammatory was taken in the last 6 to 12 hours, for example ibuprofen, celecoxib or naproxen.
care.zh: 过去 6–12 小时内用过抗炎药时慎用，例如 ibuprofen 布洛芬、celecoxib 塞来昔布或 naproxen 萘普生。

care.en: Antiplatelets such as ASA or clopidogrel are not a caution or a contraindication on their own.
care.zh: 抗血小板药（例如 ASA 阿司匹林或 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷）本身既不算慎用，也不算禁忌。

dose.en: 10 mg IV or IM. The ampule is 10 mg/mL.
dose.zh: 10 mg 静脉或肌注。安瓿浓度是 10 mg/mL。

dose.en: May repeat after 6 hours if required
dose.zh: 需要时 6 小时后可重复

dose.en: IM as a direct injection. IV undiluted over 15 seconds.
dose.zh: 肌注直接注射。静脉不稀释，推 15 秒。

dose.en: Age 2 to 11 years: 0.5 mg/kg IM, maximum single dose 10 mg
dose.zh: 2–11 岁：0.5 mg/kg 肌注，单次最多 10 mg

dose.en: May repeat after 6 to 8 hours if required. PCPs give children IM only. IV in children is BCEHS: ACP and above.
dose.zh: 需要时 6–8 小时后可重复。PCP 给儿童只能肌注。儿童静脉给药属于 BCEHS：ACP 及以上。

dose.en: For when to use it, see BCEHS E08 (Pain Management)
dose.zh: 什么时候用，见 BCEHS E08（Pain Management 疼痛管理）

fx.en: GI ulcer, low risk with a single dose
fx.zh: 消化道溃疡，单次给药风险低

pk.en: IV works in 10 minutes and IM in 20 minutes, and both last 6 hours.
pk.zh: 静脉 10 分钟起效，肌注 20 分钟起效，两种都维持 6 小时。

pearl.en: Anticoagulants stop ketorolac. Antiplatelets do not. When a patient says blood thinner, get the name of the pill before you draw anything up.
pearl.zh: 抗凝药挡住 ketorolac 酮咯酸，抗血小板药不挡。病人说自己在吃 blood thinner（稀释血液的药）时，抽药之前先问清楚药名。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Ketorolac drug monograph and Ketorolac FAQ

stem.en: Liam, 24, rolled his ankle at a Burnaby soccer field, pain 6/10. No medicines, no allergies, no kidney problems, no bleeding. BP 124/76.
stem.zh: Liam，24 岁，在 Burnaby 的足球场上崴了脚，疼痛 6/10。不吃任何药，无过敏史，肾没问题，没有出血。血压 124/76。

why.en: Moderate pain, and no contraindication or caution. Give 10 mg IV or IM.
why.zh: 中度疼痛，没有禁忌，也没有慎用情况。给 10 mg 静脉或肌注。

bad.en: He rides to hospital in pain that a simple, safe dose would have eased.
bad.zh: 他一路痛到医院，其实一针简单安全的药就能缓解。

stem.en: Doris, 78, sore shoulder after a fall in her Richmond care home, pain 5/10. Alert, no head strike. Her medication list includes apixaban.
stem.zh: Doris，78 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院摔倒后肩膀痛，疼痛 5/10。清醒，没有撞到头。她的用药单上有 apixaban 阿哌沙班。

why.en: Use of an anticoagulant is a contraindication, and apixaban is one of the examples named.
why.zh: 正在用抗凝药是禁忌，apixaban 阿哌沙班就是专论点名的例子之一。

bad.en: An NSAID adds its own bleeding risk to an anticoagulated woman who has just fallen.
bad.zh: 一位吃着抗凝药、刚摔过跤的老人，又被 NSAID 添了一份出血风险。

stem.en: Jas, 52, right flank pain 8/10, pacing his kitchen in Surrey. BP 148/90. He says he has bad kidneys and sees a kidney doctor.
stem.zh: Jas，52 岁，右侧腰腹痛 8/10，在 Surrey 家里的厨房走来走去。血压 148/90。他说自己肾不好，一直在看肾科医生。

why.en: A patient who identifies as having kidney dysfunction has a contraindication. You do not need a lab number.
why.zh: 病人自己说肾功能不好，就已经是禁忌。不需要化验数字。

bad.en: Renal dysfunction is a listed adverse effect, and his kidneys are already damaged.
bad.zh: 肾功能损害本来就是列明的不良反应，而他的肾已经受损了。

stem.en: Ava, 7, weighs 24 kg. Broken wrist at a Kelowna playground, pain 6/10. No medicines, no allergies, healthy.
stem.zh: Ava，7 岁，体重 24 kg。在 Kelowna 的游乐场摔断了手腕，疼痛 6/10。不吃任何药，无过敏史，平时健康。

ask.en: How does a PCP give her ketorolac?
ask.zh: PCP 怎么给她用 ketorolac 酮咯酸？

opts.en: 10 mg IM
opts.zh: 10 mg 肌注

opts.en: 12 mg IM
opts.zh: 12 mg 肌注

opts.en: 10 mg IV over 15 seconds
opts.zh: 10 mg 静脉，推 15 秒

why.en: 0.5 mg/kg would be 12 mg, but the maximum single dose is 10 mg. PCPs give children IM only.
why.zh: 按 0.5 mg/kg 算是 12 mg，但单次最多 10 mg。PCP 给儿童只能肌注。

s.en: ASA or clopidogrel alone is not a contraindication to ketorolac.
s.zh: 只吃 ASA 阿司匹林或 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷，不算 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌。

why.en: Antiplatelets are not a caution or a contraindication. Active bleeding is.
why.zh: 抗血小板药既不算慎用也不算禁忌。活动性出血才是。

s.en: Ibuprofen taken 4 hours ago is a contraindication to ketorolac.
s.zh: 4 小时前吃过 ibuprofen 布洛芬，是 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌。

why.en: An anti-inflammatory in the last 6 to 12 hours is a caution, not a contraindication.
why.zh: 过去 6–12 小时内用过抗炎药是慎用，不是禁忌。

s.en: Pregnancy is a contraindication to ketorolac.
s.zh: 怀孕是 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌。

why.en: The list says pregnancy, with no trimester attached.
why.zh: 禁忌里写的就是怀孕，没有分孕期。

s.en: Ketorolac can be repeated after 1 hour if the pain comes back.
s.zh: 疼痛又回来的话，1 小时后可以再给一次 ketorolac 酮咯酸。

why.en: The adult repeat is after 6 hours, if required.
why.zh: 成人要过 6 小时，需要时才重复。

q.en: The adult PCP dose of ketorolac is…
q.zh: PCP 给成人 ketorolac 酮咯酸的剂量是…

opts.en: 10 mg IV or IM, repeat after 6 hours if required
opts.zh: 10 mg 静脉或肌注，需要时 6 小时后重复

opts.en: 30 mg IV or IM, repeat after 6 hours if required
opts.zh: 30 mg 静脉或肌注，需要时 6 小时后重复

opts.en: 100 mg IV or IM, repeat after 6 hours if required
opts.zh: 100 mg 静脉或肌注，需要时 6 小时后重复

opts.en: 10 mg IV or IM, repeat after 1 hour if required
opts.zh: 10 mg 静脉或肌注，需要时 1 小时后重复

why.en: 10 mg IV or IM, repeated after 6 hours if required. BCEHS doses NSAIDs at the low end of the range.
why.zh: 10 mg 静脉或肌注，需要时 6 小时后重复。BCEHS 的 NSAID 剂量取的是范围的低端。

q.en: How does ketorolac reduce pain?
q.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸是怎么止痛的？

opts.en: It blocks COX 1 and 2, so fewer prostaglandins are made
opts.zh: 阻断 COX 1 和 2，前列腺素生成减少

opts.en: It binds opioid receptors in the brain and spinal cord
opts.zh: 和脑、脊髓里的阿片受体结合

opts.en: It blocks sodium channels, so the nerve cannot fire
opts.zh: 阻断钠通道，神经发不出信号

opts.en: It blocks NMDA receptors and causes dissociation
opts.zh: 阻断 NMDA 受体，引起分离状态

why.en: Non-selective COX 1 and 2 inhibition leads to prostaglandin inhibition, which reduces pain, inflammation and fever.
why.zh: 非选择性抑制 COX 1 和 2，前列腺素被抑制，疼痛、炎症和发热随之减轻。

q.en: Which home medicine is a contraindication to ketorolac?
q.zh: 下面哪种家里常吃的药是 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌？

opts.en: Warfarin
opts.zh: warfarin 华法林

opts.en: Clopidogrel
opts.zh: clopidogrel 氯吡格雷

opts.en: Low-dose ASA
opts.zh: 小剂量 ASA 阿司匹林

opts.en: Acetaminophen
opts.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

why.en: Warfarin is an anticoagulant. Antiplatelets such as ASA and clopidogrel are not a caution or a contraindication.
why.zh: warfarin 华法林是抗凝药。ASA 阿司匹林、clopidogrel 氯吡格雷这类抗血小板药既不算慎用也不算禁忌。

bcehs.name: Dimenhydrinate (Gravol)

cls.zh: 止吐药

hook.en: Quiets the motion signals from the inner ear that cause nausea.
hook.zh: 让内耳发出的“晃动信号”安静下来，就不那么想吐。

how.en: The balance organ in the inner ear tells the brain that the body is moving. Dimenhydrinate blocks the cholinergic signals that carry that message. Less signal means less nausea. It also causes drowsiness and a dry mouth.
how.zh: 内耳的平衡器官会告诉大脑“身体在动”。dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明挡住传递这个消息的胆碱能信号。信号少了，恶心就轻了。它也会让人犯困、口干。

use.en: First line for nausea and vomiting from motion sickness, vertigo or pregnancy
use.zh: 晕动病、眩晕或怀孕引起的恶心呕吐：一线用药

use.en: First line when ondansetron is contraindicated
use.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼有禁忌时：一线用药

use.en: Second line for moderate to severe nausea on a long transport, if ondansetron has not worked after 15 to 30 minutes
use.zh: 长途转运中的中到重度恶心，ondansetron 昂丹司琼用了 15–30 分钟仍无效时：二线用药

no.en: Known sensitivity to dimenhydrinate, diphenhydramine or caffeine derivatives
no.zh: 已知对 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明、diphenhydramine 苯海拉明或咖啡因衍生物敏感

noFake.zh: 已经给过 ondansetron 昂丹司琼
对 ondansetron 昂丹司琼过敏

care.en: Older adults are more sensitive to its side effects, and higher doses risk delirium.
care.zh: 老年人对它的副作用更敏感，剂量大了有谵妄风险。

care.en: Use with caution in elevated eye pressure and enlarged prostate.
care.zh: 眼压升高和前列腺肥大时慎用。

care.en: It strengthens the effect of alcohol, benzodiazepines and other CNS depressants.
care.zh: 它会加强酒精、苯二氮䓬类药物和其他中枢抑制药的作用。

care.en: Other anticholinergic drugs add to it: tricyclic antidepressants, MAO inhibitors, other antihistamines.
care.zh: 其他有抗胆碱作用的药会和它叠加：三环类抗抑郁药、单胺氧化酶抑制剂、其他抗组胺药。

care.en: Overdose looks like atropine poisoning: flushing, dilated pupils, hallucinations, confusion, ataxia, seizures.
care.zh: 过量时像 atropine 阿托品中毒：面部潮红、瞳孔散大、幻觉、意识混乱、共济失调、抽搐。

dose.en: 25 to 50 mg IV or IM every 4 to 6 hours as needed
dose.zh: 25–50 mg IV 或 IM，需要时每 4–6 小时一次

dose.en: Over 65 years old or frail: 12.5 mg IV or IM every 4 to 6 hours as needed
dose.zh: 65 岁以上或体弱者：12.5 mg IV 或 IM，需要时每 4–6 小时一次

dose.en: IV: dilute in 9 mL of NS and give at 25 mg per minute
dose.zh: IV：用 9 mL 生理盐水（NS）稀释，按每分钟 25 mg 的速度给

dose.en: IM: give as a direct injection
dose.zh: IM：直接注射

dose.en: BCEHS: ACP and above
dose.zh: BCEHS：ACP 及以上才能给

dose.en: Supplied as 50 mg in a 1 mL ampoule
dose.zh: 包装是 1 mL 安瓿，含 50 mg

pk.en: IM works in 20 to 30 minutes and IV almost immediately. It lasts 3 to 6 hours.
pk.zh: IM 20–30 分钟起效，IV 几乎立刻起效。维持 3–6 小时。

pearl.en: Over 65 or frail gets 12.5 mg, a quarter of the ampoule. Give the full 50 mg and the nausea may settle, but you may hand over a delirious patient.
pearl.zh: 65 岁以上或体弱的病人只给 12.5 mg，也就是四分之一支。整支 50 mg 推下去，恶心也许好了，但你交给医院的可能是个谵妄的病人。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the dose is 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg, with no separate 12.5 mg dose for patients over 65. The only contraindication is allergy to dimenhydrinate itself. On the exam, pregnancy, asthma or COPD and cardiovascular disease are cautions, and you contact the ER if the patient appears to be under 25 kg. BCEHS lists pregnancy nausea as a first-line indication and keeps pediatric dosing for ACPs.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：剂量是 1 mg/kg，最多 50 mg，没有给 65 岁以上单列 12.5 mg。禁忌证只有对 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明本身过敏。考试里怀孕、哮喘或 COPD、心血管病都是慎用，病人看起来不到 25 kg 时要联系急诊。BCEHS 把孕吐列为一线适应证，儿童剂量只给 ACP。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: DimenhyDRINATE drug monograph

stem.en: Chloe, 26, ten weeks pregnant, vomiting all morning on the ferry from Tsawwassen. BP 112/70. No allergies, no other medications.
stem.zh: Chloe，26 岁，怀孕十周，在从 Tsawwassen 出发的渡轮上吐了一上午。血压 112/70。没有过敏，没用其他药。

why.en: Nausea and vomiting from pregnancy or motion sickness is a first-line indication, and she has no sensitivity to it.
why.zh: 怀孕或晕动病引起的恶心呕吐是一线适应证，她对这个药也不敏感。

bad.en: She vomits for the whole crossing and arrives dry, dizzy and exhausted.
bad.zh: 她一路吐到靠岸，下船时脱水、头晕、筋疲力尽。

stem.en: Marcus, 41, badly seasick on a whale-watching boat off Tofino. He says Benadryl once gave him hives and a swollen face.
stem.zh: Marcus，41 岁，在 Tofino 外海的观鲸船上晕船晕得厉害。他说有一次吃 Benadryl 后起了荨麻疹，脸也肿了。

why.en: Known sensitivity to diphenhydramine is a contraindication to dimenhydrinate too. Benadryl is diphenhydramine.
why.zh: 已知对 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明敏感，同样是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的禁忌证。Benadryl 就是 diphenhydramine 苯海拉明。

bad.en: You trade seasickness for an allergic reaction, a long way from the dock.
bad.zh: 你把晕船换成了过敏反应，而码头还远着呢。

stem.en: Mrs. Wong, 82, frail, spinning vertigo and vomiting at a care home in Richmond. No allergies. Your IV is in place.
stem.zh: 王太太，82 岁，体弱，在 Richmond 的护理院，天旋地转还呕吐。没有过敏。你的 IV 已经打好。

ask.en: What dose?

opts.en: 12.5 mg IV
opts.zh: 12.5 mg 静脉

opts.en: 25 mg IV
opts.zh: 25 mg 静脉

opts.en: 50 mg IV
opts.zh: 50 mg 静脉

why.en: Over 65 or frail gets 12.5 mg. Higher doses carry a risk of delirium.
why.zh: 65 岁以上或体弱者给 12.5 mg。剂量再大有谵妄风险。

bad.en: The vomiting stops and the confusion starts, and she pulls out her IV.
bad.zh: 吐是止住了，人却开始糊涂，还把 IV 拔了。

stem.en: Dev, 35, vomiting from food poisoning, 90 minutes from hospital on a logging road near Port Alberni. You gave ondansetron 20 minutes ago. Still retching hard.
stem.zh: Dev，35 岁，食物中毒呕吐，在 Port Alberni 附近的伐木路上，离医院 90 分钟。你 20 分钟前给过 ondansetron 昂丹司琼。他还在剧烈干呕。

ask.en: Can dimenhydrinate be added?
ask.zh: 可以加用 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明吗？

opts.en: Yes, it is second line once ondansetron has had 15 to 30 minutes
opts.zh: 可以，ondansetron 昂丹司琼用了 15–30 分钟无效后，它是二线药

opts.en: No, the two antiemetics must never be combined
opts.zh: 不行，两种止吐药绝对不能合用

opts.en: Yes, but only after a full hour has passed
opts.zh: 可以，但要等满一小时

why.en: It is second line for moderate to severe nausea on a long transport when ondansetron has not worked after 15 to 30 minutes.
why.zh: 长途转运中的中到重度恶心，ondansetron 昂丹司琼用了 15–30 分钟仍无效时，它是二线药。

s.en: Nausea of pregnancy is a first-line indication for dimenhydrinate.
s.zh: 孕吐是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的一线适应证。

why.en: Motion sickness, vertigo and pregnancy are its first-line uses.
why.zh: 晕动病、眩晕和怀孕都是它的一线用途。

s.en: A healthy 70-year-old gets the standard 25 to 50 mg.
s.zh: 身体健康的 70 岁老人照样给标准的 25–50 mg。

why.en: Over 65 gets 12.5 mg, because higher doses risk delirium.
why.zh: 65 岁以上给 12.5 mg，因为剂量大了有谵妄风险。

s.en: IV dimenhydrinate must be diluted before it is given.
s.zh: IV 给 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明之前必须先稀释。

why.en: Dilute in 9 mL of NS and give at 25 mg per minute.
why.zh: 用 9 mL 生理盐水稀释，按每分钟 25 mg 的速度给。

s.en: A caffeine sensitivity has nothing to do with dimenhydrinate.
s.zh: 对咖啡因敏感和 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明没有关系。

why.en: Known sensitivity to caffeine derivatives is part of the contraindication.
why.zh: 已知对咖啡因衍生物敏感就写在禁忌证里。

q.en: The dose of dimenhydrinate for an adult under 65 is…
q.zh: 65 岁以下成人的 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明剂量是…

opts.en: 25 to 50 mg IV or IM every 4 to 6 hours
opts.zh: 25–50 mg IV 或 IM，每 4–6 小时一次

opts.en: 250 to 500 mg IV or IM every 4 to 6 hours
opts.zh: 250–500 mg IV 或 IM，每 4–6 小时一次

opts.en: 25 to 50 mg IV or IM every 30 minutes
opts.zh: 25–50 mg IV 或 IM，每 30 分钟一次

opts.en: 12.5 mg PO, once only
opts.zh: 12.5 mg PO，只给一次

why.en: 25 to 50 mg, IV or IM, every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Over 65 or frail drops to 12.5 mg.
why.zh: 25–50 mg，IV 或 IM，需要时每 4–6 小时一次。65 岁以上或体弱者降到 12.5 mg。

q.en: How do you give 50 mg of dimenhydrinate by IV?
q.zh: 50 mg dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明怎样 IV 给？

opts.en: Dilute in 9 mL of NS and give at 25 mg per minute
opts.zh: 用 9 mL 生理盐水稀释，按每分钟 25 mg 给

opts.en: Push the 1 mL ampoule undiluted in 5 seconds
opts.zh: 1 mL 安瓿不稀释，5 秒内推完

opts.en: Add it to a 250 mL bag and run it over an hour
opts.zh: 加进 250 mL 输液袋，滴一小时

opts.en: Dilute in 9 mL of NS and push it all in 10 seconds
opts.zh: 用 9 mL 生理盐水稀释，10 秒内全部推完

why.en: Dilute in 9 mL of NS and give at 25 mg per minute, so 50 mg takes two minutes.
why.zh: 用 9 mL 生理盐水稀释，按每分钟 25 mg 给，所以 50 mg 要推两分钟。

q.en: Which set of side effects belongs to dimenhydrinate?
q.zh: 哪一组是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明的副作用？

opts.en: Drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, urinary retention
opts.zh: 嗜睡、头晕、口干、尿潴留

opts.en: Diarrhea, drooling, small pupils, slow pulse
opts.zh: 腹泻、流口水、瞳孔缩小、脉搏慢

opts.en: Headache, flushing, low blood pressure
opts.zh: 头痛、面部潮红、低血压

opts.en: Tremor, fast pulse, shaky hands
opts.zh: 震颤、脉搏快、手抖

why.en: The monograph lists drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth and urinary retention.
why.zh: 专论列的是嗜睡、头晕、口干和尿潴留。

bcehs.name: Ondansetron (Zofran)

cls.zh: 止吐药

hook.en: Blocks the signal that makes you feel sick.
hook.zh: 把让人想吐的信号挡住。

how.en: Nausea signals pass through type 3 serotonin receptors. Ondansetron blocks those receptors, so the signal does not get through and the nausea settles.
how.zh: 恶心的信号要经过 3 型血清素受体。ondansetron 昂丹司琼把这些受体挡住，信号传不过去，恶心就压下来了。

use.en: First line for undifferentiated moderate to severe nausea and vomiting
use.zh: 原因未明的中到重度恶心呕吐，一线用药

use.en: Second line for severe vomiting in pregnancy, when dimenhydrinate has not worked after 15 to 30 minutes
use.zh: 孕期严重呕吐的二线用药：dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明用了 15–30 分钟无效时才用

no.en: Congenital or acquired long QT syndrome
no.zh: 先天性或获得性长 QT 综合征

no.en: Phenylketonuria (PKU): the ODT tablet may contain aspartame. The injection is safe for these patients
no.zh: 苯丙酮尿症（PKU）：ODT 口崩片可能含阿斯巴甜。这类病人用注射剂是安全的

no.en: Known allergy or hypersensitivity to ondansetron
no.zh: 已知对 ondansetron 昂丹司琼过敏

noFake.zh: 之前给过 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明

care.en: IV: give it undiluted over 2 to 5 minutes, to lower the risk of QT prolongation.
care.zh: 静注：不稀释，用 2–5 分钟推完，降低 QT 延长的风险。

care.en: PKU: be careful with the ODT tablet because of aspartame.
care.zh: PKU：ODT 口崩片含阿斯巴甜，要当心。

care.en: One dose only: do not repeat it.
care.zh: 只给一次：不要重复。

care.en: The oral route is preferred.
care.zh: 首选口服途径。

dose.en: 4 mg ODT, IV or IM, once
dose.zh: 4 mg，ODT 口崩片、静注或肌注，只给一次

dose.en: Oral route preferred. Do not repeat the dose
dose.zh: 首选口服。不要重复给药

dose.en: IV: undiluted, over 2 to 5 minutes. IM: undiluted
dose.zh: 静注：不稀释，2–5 分钟推完。肌注：不稀释

dose.en: 6 months to 3 years: 2 mg PO or ODT, once
dose.zh: 6 个月到 3 岁：2 mg 口服或 ODT，只给一次

dose.en: 4 to 12 years: 4 mg PO or ODT, once
dose.zh: 4 到 12 岁：4 mg 口服或 ODT，只给一次

dose.en: For the 2 mg dose, give the IV product by mouth, mixed with juice if available. Do not repeat
dose.zh: 2 mg 这个剂量：把注射液拿来口服，有果汁就兑果汁。不要重复

fx.en: QT prolongation, rarely Torsades de Pointes
fx.zh: QT 延长，罕见尖端扭转型室速（Torsades de Pointes）

pk.en: The ODT tablet works in 1 hour, an injection in 15 to 30 minutes, and both last 6 to 8 hours.
pk.zh: ODT 口崩片 1 小时起效，注射 15–30 分钟起效，两种都维持 6–8 小时。

pearl.en: One dose, one time. The tablet needs about an hour, so a second tablet at ten minutes is a mistake, not a treatment.
pearl.zh: 一剂，只给一次。口崩片要大约一小时才起效，所以十分钟后再给一片是犯错，不是治疗。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): 4 mg PO only, with no IV or IM route. It adds first trimester pregnancy as a relative contraindication and says to ask Indigenous patients about long QT syndrome in the family.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：只有 4 mg 口服，没有静注或肌注。它多了一条相对禁忌：孕早期。还要求询问原住民病人家族里有没有长 QT 综合征。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Ondansetron drug monograph

stem.en: Olivia, 36, on the ferry to Nanaimo. Vomited six times since last night and is still retching. No heart problems, no medicines, not pregnant. Vitals stable.
stem.zh: Olivia，36 岁，在去 Nanaimo 的渡轮上。从昨晚到现在吐了六次，还在干呕。没有心脏病，不吃药，没有怀孕。生命体征稳定。

why.en: Undifferentiated moderate to severe nausea and vomiting, and no contraindication. Give 4 mg ODT, once.
why.zh: 原因未明的中到重度恶心呕吐，没有禁忌。给 4 mg ODT 口崩片，一次。

bad.en: She keeps vomiting for the rest of the crossing and gets more dehydrated.
bad.zh: 剩下的航程她一路吐下去，脱水越来越重。

stem.en: Grace, 44, strong nausea after chemotherapy in Burnaby. She tells you she has long QT syndrome and carries a list of medicines to avoid.
stem.zh: Grace，44 岁，在 Burnaby 做完化疗后恶心得厉害。她告诉你她有长 QT 综合征，随身带着一张要避开的药物清单。

why.en: Congenital or acquired long QT syndrome is a contraindication.
why.zh: 先天性或获得性长 QT 综合征是禁忌。

bad.en: Her QT stretches further, and the rare end of that road is Torsades de Pointes.
bad.zh: 她的 QT 被拉得更长，这条路走到头，少数情况下就是 Torsades de Pointes。

stem.en: Amira, 30, 9 weeks pregnant, vomiting all morning in her Coquitlam condo. Cannot keep water down. No antiemetic given yet. Vitals stable.
stem.zh: Amira，30 岁，怀孕 9 周，在 Coquitlam 的公寓里吐了一上午。连水都留不住。还没用过任何止吐药。生命体征稳定。

why.en: In pregnancy ondansetron is second line. Dimenhydrinate goes first, and you judge it after 15 to 30 minutes.
why.zh: 孕期 ondansetron 昂丹司琼是二线。先给 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明，15–30 分钟后再看效果。

bad.en: She gets the second-line drug first, against the monograph, for no reason you can write down.
bad.zh: 她先拿到的是二线药，和专论相反，而你写不出任何理由。

stem.en: Ben, 22, vomiting after bad oysters in Tofino. He says he has PKU. You are holding an ODT tablet.
stem.zh: Ben，22 岁，在 Tofino 吃了不新鲜的生蚝后呕吐。他说自己有 PKU。你手里拿着一片 ODT 口崩片。

ask.en: How do you give his ondansetron?
ask.zh: 他的 ondansetron 昂丹司琼怎么给？

opts.en: 4 mg by injection, not the ODT
opts.zh: 4 mg 注射，不用 ODT

opts.en: The ODT, one tablet is harmless
opts.zh: 就给 ODT，一片没关系

opts.en: No ondansetron at all for him
opts.zh: 他完全不能用 ondansetron 昂丹司琼

why.en: The ODT may contain aspartame, which PKU patients should avoid. The injection is safe for them.
why.zh: ODT 口崩片可能含阿斯巴甜，PKU 病人要避开。注射剂对他们是安全的。

s.en: If the first dose does not settle the vomiting, you do not give a second.
s.zh: 第一剂没止住呕吐，也不给第二剂。

why.en: It is given once. Do not repeat the dose.
why.zh: 只给一次。不要重复给药。

s.en: IV ondansetron is pushed fast so that it works sooner.
s.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼静注要推得快，这样起效早。

why.en: Give it undiluted over 2 to 5 minutes, to reduce the risk of QT prolongation.
why.zh: 不稀释，用 2–5 分钟推完，降低 QT 延长的风险。

s.en: A patient with PKU can safely get ondansetron by injection.
s.zh: PKU 病人可以安全地用注射的 ondansetron 昂丹司琼。

why.en: Only the ODT may contain aspartame.
why.zh: 只有 ODT 口崩片可能含阿斯巴甜。

s.en: The ODT tablet works within five minutes.
s.zh: ODT 口崩片五分钟内就起效。

why.en: ODT onset is 1 hour. An injection takes 15 to 30 minutes.
why.zh: ODT 要 1 小时起效。注射要 15–30 分钟。

q.en: The adult PCP dose of ondansetron is…
q.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼的成人 PCP 剂量是…

opts.en: 4 mg ODT, IV or IM, once only
opts.zh: 4 mg，ODT、静注或肌注，只给一次

opts.en: 4 mg ODT, IV or IM, repeat after 30 minutes
opts.zh: 4 mg，ODT、静注或肌注，30 分钟后重复

opts.en: 40 mg ODT, IV or IM, once only
opts.zh: 40 mg，ODT、静注或肌注，只给一次

opts.en: 2 mg ODT, IV or IM, once only
opts.zh: 2 mg，ODT、静注或肌注，只给一次

why.en: 4 mg, one time, oral route preferred. The 2 mg dose is for children from 6 months to 3 years.
why.zh: 4 mg，一次，首选口服。2 mg 是 6 个月到 3 岁儿童的剂量。

q.en: Ondansetron stops nausea by…
q.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼止吐靠的是…

opts.en: Blocking type 3 serotonin receptors
opts.zh: 阻断 3 型血清素受体

opts.en: Blocking histamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断组胺受体

opts.en: Blocking acetylcholine in the inner ear
opts.zh: 阻断内耳的乙酰胆碱

opts.en: Slowing the emptying of the stomach
opts.zh: 减慢胃排空

why.en: It selectively inhibits type 3 serotonergic receptors.
why.zh: 它选择性抑制 3 型血清素受体。

q.en: Why is IV ondansetron given slowly, over 2 to 5 minutes?
q.zh: 为什么 ondansetron 昂丹司琼静注要慢慢推 2–5 分钟？

opts.en: To lower the risk of QT prolongation
opts.zh: 降低 QT 延长的风险

opts.en: To prevent a fall in blood sugar
opts.zh: 防止血糖下降

opts.en: To prevent bronchospasm
opts.zh: 防止支气管痉挛

opts.en: To stop the vein from collapsing
opts.zh: 防止血管塌陷

why.en: QT prolongation, and rarely Torsades de Pointes, are the adverse effects to respect.
why.zh: QT 延长，以及罕见的 Torsades de Pointes，是要认真对待的不良反应。

bcehs.name: Hydrocortisone

cls.zh: 全身用糖皮质激素

hook.en: Replaces the stress hormone the adrenal glands failed to make.
hook.zh: 把肾上腺没造出来的应激激素补回去。

how.en: Hydrocortisone is the drug form of cortisol, the stress hormone made by the adrenal glands. In adrenal crisis the body has run out, so you put it back. Like other steroids it also calms inflammation and makes leaky capillaries less leaky.
how.zh: hydrocortisone 氢化可的松就是药物形式的皮质醇，也就是肾上腺分泌的应激激素。肾上腺危象时身体里的不够用了，你把它补回去。和其他激素类药一样，它还能压住炎症，让渗漏的毛细血管不那么漏。

use.en: Acute adrenal crisis, under BCEHS E02 (Adrenal Crisis)
use.zh: 急性肾上腺危象，按 BCEHS E02（Adrenal Crisis 肾上腺危象）处理

no.en: Hypersensitivity to hydrocortisone or other corticosteroids
no.zh: 对 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松或其他糖皮质激素过敏

no.en: Systemic fungal infections
no.zh: 全身性真菌感染

noFake.en: Already takes a daily steroid pill
noFake.zh: 平时每天都在吃激素药片

care.en: Use with caution in heart failure or hypertension, because corticosteroids are linked to fluid retention and electrolyte disturbance.
care.zh: 心力衰竭或高血压病人慎用，因为糖皮质激素会引起液体潴留和电解质紊乱。

care.en: Corticosteroids have been associated with myocardial rupture when used in acute myocardial infarction.
care.zh: 急性心肌梗死时使用糖皮质激素，有过心肌破裂的报道。

care.en: It may add to the ulcer and bleeding risk of NSAIDs and salicylates, strengthen warfarin and lower phenytoin levels.
care.zh: 它可能加重非甾体抗炎药和水杨酸类药的溃疡、出血风险，增强 warfarin 华法林的抗凝作用，并降低 phenytoin 苯妥英的血药浓度。

care.en: It may cause hypercortisolism, mostly in younger children or with long use at higher doses.
care.zh: 可能引起皮质醇过多，多见于年幼儿童，或长期、较大剂量使用时。

dose.en: Acute adrenal crisis: CliniCall consultation is required before administration
dose.zh: 急性肾上腺危象：给药前必须先咨询 CliniCall

dose.en: 100 mg direct over 1 minute
dose.zh: 100 mg 直接推注，推 1 分钟

dose.en: IV is preferred. IM is acceptable if IV access cannot be obtained or is delayed.
dose.zh: 首选静脉。静脉通路建不上或被耽搁时，可以肌注。

dose.en: For IM, a large muscle such as vastus lateralis is preferred. The deltoid may cause subcutaneous atrophy.
dose.zh: 肌注首选大块肌肉，例如股外侧肌。打三角肌可能造成皮下萎缩。

dose.en: Maximum administration rate is 200 mg per minute. One vial holds 100 mg.
dose.zh: 最快给药速度是每分钟 200 mg。一瓶是 100 mg。

dose.en: CliniCall consultation is required before administration, because data are limited. The monograph prints child doses for CCP only.
dose.zh: 给药前必须先咨询 CliniCall，因为儿童资料有限。专论里的儿童剂量只写给 CCP。

fx.en: Burning or tingling of the skin, especially in the perineal area after IV injection
fx.zh: 皮肤烧灼感或刺痛，静脉注射后会阴部尤其明显
过敏反应，包括严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）

pk.en: Given IV, onset is 1 hour. Peak and duration are variable.
pk.zh: 静脉给药 1 小时起效。达峰时间和维持时间不固定。

pearl.en: A missed vein is not a reason to wait. IM in the thigh is acceptable when the IV is delayed, and CliniCall comes before either route.
pearl.zh: 扎不上静脉不是等下去的理由。静脉通路被耽搁时可以打大腿肌注，而不管走哪条路，都要先打 CliniCall。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Hydrocortisone drug monograph

stem.en: Priya, 42, known adrenal insufficiency. Two days of vomiting, could not keep her steroid pills down. Drowsy, BP 78/44, HR 118. CliniCall agrees this is adrenal crisis. No allergies.
stem.zh: Priya，42 岁，已知肾上腺功能不全。呕吐两天，激素药片吃了就吐。嗜睡，血压 78/44，心率 118。CliniCall 同意这是肾上腺危象。无过敏史。

why.en: Acute adrenal crisis, the consultation is done, and there is no contraindication. Give 100 mg direct over 1 minute, IV preferred.
why.zh: 急性肾上腺危象，已经咨询过，也没有禁忌。给 100 mg 直接推注，推 1 分钟，首选静脉。

bad.en: Her pressure keeps falling, because the hormone she lacks does not come back by itself.
bad.zh: 她的血压继续往下掉，因为缺的那种激素不会自己回来。

stem.en: Grace, 63, adrenal insufficiency, weak and vomiting, BP 88/52. Her husband says she is in the middle of IV treatment for a fungal infection in her blood.
stem.zh: Grace，63 岁，肾上腺功能不全，乏力、呕吐，血压 88/52。丈夫说她血液里有真菌感染，正在做静脉抗真菌治疗。

why.en: A systemic fungal infection is a listed contraindication. You do not give it on your own reading. Report it to CliniCall in the consult.
why.zh: 全身性真菌感染是列明的禁忌。不能凭自己的判断就给。咨询时把这一点告诉 CliniCall。

bad.en: Corticosteroids increase susceptibility to infection, so the fungus gets an easier fight.
bad.zh: 糖皮质激素让人更容易感染，真菌就更好对付她了。

stem.en: Hugo, 48, adrenal insufficiency, two days of vomiting, BP 86/50. His wallet card reads: anaphylaxis to hydrocortisone injection last year.
stem.zh: Hugo，48 岁，肾上腺功能不全，呕吐两天，血压 86/50。钱包里的卡片写着：去年注射 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松后发生过严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）。

why.en: Hypersensitivity to hydrocortisone is a contraindication. Tell CliniCall, because he needs a different plan.
why.zh: 对 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松过敏是禁忌。告诉 CliniCall，他需要别的方案。

bad.en: Anaphylaxis lands on top of adrenal crisis in a man who is already hypotensive.
bad.zh: 一个本来就低血压的人，肾上腺危象之上再加一次严重过敏反应。

stem.en: Nadia, 35, adrenal crisis. CliniCall has approved hydrocortisone. Two IV attempts have failed and she is getting drowsier. BP 80/46.
stem.zh: Nadia，35 岁，肾上腺危象。CliniCall 已同意给 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松。两次静脉穿刺都失败了，她越来越嗜睡。血压 80/46。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Give 100 mg IM in the vastus lateralis
opts.zh: 100 mg 股外侧肌肌注

opts.en: Give 100 mg IM in the deltoid
opts.zh: 100 mg 三角肌肌注

opts.en: Keep trying for an IV until one works
opts.zh: 继续扎静脉，直到扎上为止

why.en: IM is acceptable when IV access cannot be obtained or is delayed. A large muscle is preferred, because the deltoid may cause subcutaneous atrophy.
why.zh: 静脉通路建不上或被耽搁时可以肌注。首选大块肌肉，因为打三角肌可能造成皮下萎缩。

bad.en: Every failed poke is more time in crisis without the one drug she needs.
bad.zh: 每多扎空一次，她就多在危象里熬一会儿，而她只缺这一个药。

s.en: CliniCall must be consulted before a PCP gives hydrocortisone.
s.zh: PCP 给 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松之前必须先咨询 CliniCall。

why.en: The monograph requires the consultation before administration.
why.zh: 专论要求给药前先咨询。

s.en: The deltoid is the preferred site for IM hydrocortisone.
s.zh: 肌注 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松首选三角肌。

why.en: A large muscle such as vastus lateralis is preferred. The deltoid may cause subcutaneous atrophy.
why.zh: 首选股外侧肌这样的大块肌肉。打三角肌可能造成皮下萎缩。

s.en: Heart failure is a contraindication to hydrocortisone.
s.zh: 心力衰竭是 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松的禁忌。

why.en: It is a caution, not a contraindication. The concern is fluid retention.
why.zh: 那是慎用，不是禁忌。担心的是液体潴留。

s.en: After IV hydrocortisone you should not expect an effect within minutes.
s.zh: 静脉给了 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松，别指望几分钟内就见效。

why.en: The listed IV onset is 1 hour.
why.zh: 专论写的静脉起效时间是 1 小时。

q.en: The PCP dose of hydrocortisone in acute adrenal crisis is…
q.zh: 急性肾上腺危象时，PCP 给 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松的剂量是…

opts.en: 100 mg direct over 1 minute
opts.zh: 100 mg 直接推注，推 1 分钟

opts.en: 1,000 mg direct over 1 minute
opts.zh: 1,000 mg 直接推注，推 1 分钟

opts.en: 100 mg infused over 1 hour
opts.zh: 100 mg 滴注 1 小时

opts.en: 25 mg IV bolus
opts.zh: 25 mg 静脉推注

why.en: 100 mg direct over 1 minute, which is one vial. IV is preferred and IM is acceptable.
why.zh: 100 mg 直接推注，推 1 分钟，正好一瓶。首选静脉，也可以肌注。

q.en: For a PCP, hydrocortisone is indicated in…
q.zh: 对 PCP 来说，hydrocortisone 氢化可的松的适应证是…

opts.en: Acute adrenal crisis
opts.zh: 急性肾上腺危象

opts.en: Severe septic shock
opts.zh: 严重感染性休克

opts.en: Status asthmaticus
opts.zh: 哮喘持续状态

opts.en: Anaphylaxis
opts.zh: 严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）

why.en: Acute adrenal crisis is the only PCP indication. Septic shock and status asthmaticus are listed for CCP.
why.zh: 急性肾上腺危象是 PCP 唯一的适应证。感染性休克和哮喘持续状态是写给 CCP 的。

q.en: Which is a listed adverse effect of hydrocortisone?
q.zh: 下面哪一项是 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松列明的不良反应？

opts.en: Hyperglycemia
opts.zh: 高血糖

opts.en: Hypoglycemia
opts.zh: 低血糖

opts.en: Respiratory depression
opts.zh: 呼吸抑制

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔

why.en: Hyperglycemia is listed, and it can raise the need for insulin in diabetes.
why.zh: 专论列了高血糖，糖尿病病人的胰岛素需要量可能因此增加。

bcehs.name: Oral glucose

cls.zh: 葡萄糖凝胶

hook.en: Sugar by mouth for a low patient who can swallow.
hook.zh: 给还能吞咽的低血糖病人，从嘴里补糖。

how.en: It is plain glucose. Given by mouth, it is absorbed through the lining of the mouth, and the blood glucose rises.
how.zh: 它就是葡萄糖。经口给药后，通过口腔黏膜吸收，血糖就升上来。

use.en: Known or suspected hypoglycemia in a conscious patient with no risk of aspiration or choking
use.zh: 清醒、没有误吸或呛噎风险的病人，已知或怀疑低血糖

no.en: None listed. Altered consciousness is a warning for choking or aspiration, not a formal contraindication
no.zh: 专论写的是“无”。意识改变是呛噎和误吸的警示，不算正式禁忌

noFake.en: One tube already given 5 minutes ago

care.en: Altered consciousness brings a risk of choking or aspiration.
care.zh: 意识改变时有呛噎或误吸的风险。

care.en: In that situation, soak a gauze swab with gel and place it between the lip and gum.
care.zh: 这种情况下，用纱布蘸满凝胶，放在嘴唇和牙龈之间。

dose.en: 15 g glucose PO: one tube of about 31 g, or one 32 mL pouch
dose.zh: 15 g 葡萄糖口服：一管（约 31 g）或一袋 32 mL

dose.en: Or glucose tablets: 4 tablets contain 16 g of glucose
dose.zh: 或葡萄糖片：4 片含 16 g 葡萄糖

dose.en: Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary. No limit
dose.zh: 需要的话 5 分钟后重复。没有上限

dose.en: Same dose as an adult
dose.zh: 剂量和成人一样

dose.en: Neonate: draw up 0.6 g (1.5 mL) of gel and apply it inside the cheek
dose.zh: 新生儿：抽取 0.6 g（1.5 mL）凝胶，涂在颊黏膜上

fx.zh: 专论没有列出不良反应

pearl.en: The only real question is whether this patient can swallow safely. If yes, give 15 g and repeat at 5 minutes as needed. There is no maximum.
pearl.zh: 真正要问的只有一句：这个病人能不能安全吞咽。能，就给 15 g，需要的话 5 分钟后再给。没有上限。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the same 15 g PO, repeated at 5 minutes with no limit. The exam makes mentation a contraindication (only for patients who can maintain their own airway), while BCEHS lists none and describes the gauze swab between lip and gum.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：同样是 15 g 口服，5 分钟后可重复，没有上限。考试把神志列为禁忌（只给能自己维持气道的病人），BCEHS 则写“无”禁忌，还介绍了把纱布放在唇和牙龈之间的办法。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Glucose (Oral) drug monograph

stem.en: Harjit, 62, diabetic, sweaty and shaky at a bus stop in Surrey. Talking, a little slow, follows commands, swallows without trouble. Glucose 2.9.
stem.zh: Harjit，62 岁，糖尿病，在 Surrey 的公交站出汗、发抖。能说话，反应稍慢，能听指令，吞咽没问题。血糖 2.9。

why.en: Known hypoglycemia in a conscious patient with no risk of aspiration or choking. Give 15 g PO.
why.zh: 已知低血糖，病人清醒，没有误吸或呛噎风险。给 15 g 口服。

bad.en: His sugar keeps falling while you wait, and soon he cannot swallow at all.
bad.zh: 你等着的时候他的血糖继续掉，很快他就完全咽不了了。

stem.en: Kevin, 19, type 1 diabetic, found at a campsite near Hope. Drowsy, breathing deep and fast, very thirsty. Glucose 24.
stem.zh: Kevin，19 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Hope 附近的露营地被发现。嗜睡，呼吸又深又快，非常口渴。血糖 24。

why.en: A glucose of 24 is not hypoglycemia, known or suspected. Oral glucose has no job here.
why.zh: 血糖 24 不是低血糖，既不是已知也谈不上怀疑。oral glucose 口服葡萄糖在这里没有用武之地。

bad.en: The gel does little harm, but you treated the wrong problem and lost time.
bad.zh: 这管凝胶伤害不大，但你治错了问题，还耽误了时间。

stem.en: Edna, 81, in a Richmond care home. Glucose 2.1. Drowsy, mumbling, and she coughs when the aide offers juice.
stem.zh: Edna，81 岁，住在 Richmond 的护理院。血糖 2.1。嗜睡，说话含糊，护工喂果汁时她会呛咳。

ask.en: How does the monograph say to give the gel?
ask.zh: 专论说这种情况下凝胶怎么给？

opts.en: On a gauze swab between her lip and gum
opts.zh: 蘸在纱布上，放在她的嘴唇和牙龈之间

opts.en: Squeezed onto the back of her tongue
opts.zh: 挤到她的舌根上

opts.en: Mixed into juice and poured in slowly
opts.zh: 兑进果汁里慢慢倒进去

why.en: Altered consciousness means a risk of choking or aspiration. The gel can go on a soaked gauze swab placed between lip and gum.
why.zh: 意识改变就有呛噎或误吸的风险。可以用纱布蘸满凝胶，放在嘴唇和牙龈之间。

bad.en: A mouthful of gel in a drowsy patient can end up in her lungs.
bad.zh: 给嗜睡的病人挤一嘴凝胶，最后可能进了她的肺。

stem.en: Tessa, 26, type 1 diabetic, shaky after a run on the Seawall. She took one tube 5 minutes ago. Still shaky, glucose 3.1, wide awake.
stem.zh: Tessa，26 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Seawall 跑完步后发抖。5 分钟前吃了一管。现在还在抖，血糖 3.1，人很清醒。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Give another 15 g now
opts.zh: 现在再给 15 g

opts.en: Wait 15 minutes, then recheck
opts.zh: 等 15 分钟再复查

opts.en: Stop, one tube is the maximum
opts.zh: 停下，一管就是上限

why.en: Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary. There is no limit.
why.zh: 需要的话 5 分钟后重复。没有上限。

s.en: There is no maximum number of doses of oral glucose.
s.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖没有最多几剂的限制。

why.en: Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary, with no limit.
why.zh: 需要的话 5 分钟后重复，没有上限。

s.en: You need a glucometer reading before you give oral glucose.
s.zh: 给 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖之前必须先有血糖仪读数。

why.en: The indication is known or suspected hypoglycemia. Suspected is enough.
why.zh: 适应证是已知或怀疑低血糖。怀疑就够了。

s.en: Four glucose tablets give about the same sugar as one tube of gel.
s.zh: 四片葡萄糖片的糖量和一管凝胶差不多。

why.en: 4 tablets contain 16 g. One tube gives 15 g.
why.zh: 4 片含 16 g。一管是 15 g。

s.en: You must wait 15 minutes before repeating a dose.
s.zh: 必须等 15 分钟才能重复给药。

why.en: The repeat is at 5 minutes as necessary.
why.zh: 需要的话 5 分钟后就可以重复。

q.en: The dose of oral glucose is…
q.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖的剂量是…

opts.en: 15 g PO, repeat at 5 minutes as needed, no limit
opts.zh: 15 g 口服，需要时 5 分钟后重复，没有上限

opts.en: 15 g PO, repeat at 15 minutes, maximum 2 doses
opts.zh: 15 g 口服，15 分钟后重复，最多 2 剂

opts.en: 1.5 g PO, repeat at 5 minutes as needed, no limit
opts.zh: 1.5 g 口服，需要时 5 分钟后重复，没有上限

opts.en: 50 g PO, repeat at 5 minutes as needed, no limit
opts.zh: 50 g 口服，需要时 5 分钟后重复，没有上限

why.en: 15 g is one tube or one pouch. Repeat at 5 minutes as necessary.
why.zh: 15 g 就是一管或一袋。需要的话 5 分钟后重复。

q.en: Who is oral glucose for?
q.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖是给谁用的？

opts.en: A conscious patient with known or suspected low blood sugar and no choking risk
opts.zh: 清醒、已知或怀疑低血糖、没有呛噎风险的病人

opts.en: Any diabetic patient who feels unwell
opts.zh: 任何觉得不舒服的糖尿病病人

opts.en: Only a patient with a low reading confirmed on the glucometer
opts.zh: 只给血糖仪确认读数偏低的病人

opts.en: A diabetic patient with a very high glucose reading
opts.zh: 血糖读数很高的糖尿病病人

why.en: Known or suspected hypoglycemia, conscious, no risk of aspiration or choking.
why.zh: 已知或怀疑低血糖，清醒，没有误吸或呛噎风险。

q.en: For a neonate, the monograph says to…
q.zh: 对新生儿，专论的做法是…

opts.en: Draw up 0.6 g (1.5 mL) of gel and apply it buccally
opts.zh: 抽取 0.6 g（1.5 mL）凝胶，涂在颊黏膜上

opts.en: Give half a tube, 7.5 g, by mouth
opts.zh: 口服半管，7.5 g

opts.en: Give one full tube slowly by mouth
opts.zh: 慢慢口服一整管

opts.en: Give 4 glucose tablets, crushed
opts.zh: 给 4 片葡萄糖片，压碎

why.en: Neonates get 0.6 g, which is 1.5 mL of gel, applied inside the cheek.
why.zh: 新生儿给 0.6 g，也就是 1.5 mL 凝胶，涂在颊黏膜上。

bcehs.name: Glucagon

cls.zh: 胰腺激素，胰岛素拮抗剂

hook.en: Tells the liver to release its stored sugar.
hook.zh: 叫肝脏把存着的糖放出来。

how.en: Glucagon is a hormone from the pancreas. It makes the liver turn stored glycogen into glucose, so the blood sugar rises. If the liver has no glycogen left, it does nothing.
how.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素是胰腺分泌的一种激素。它让肝脏把储存的糖原变成葡萄糖，血糖就升上来。肝里没有糖原了，它就不起作用。

use.en: FR and EMR: confirmed hypoglycemia, patient not alert enough to take oral glucose safely, age 4 years or older
use.zh: FR 和 EMR：已确认低血糖，病人神志不够清楚、不能安全地吃 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖，年龄 4 岁或以上

use.en: PCP: confirmed hypoglycemia, patient not alert enough to take oral glucose safely, and IV access is unavailable
use.zh: PCP：已确认低血糖，病人神志不够清楚、不能安全地吃 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖，而且建立不了静脉通路

no.en: Under 4 years of age (intranasal glucagon)
no.zh: 未满 4 岁（鼻内 glucagon 胰高血糖素）

no.en: Pheochromocytoma (a tumour that releases catecholamines)
no.zh: 嗜铬细胞瘤（会释放儿茶酚胺的肿瘤）

no.en: Insulinoma (a tumour that makes insulin)
no.zh: 胰岛素瘤（分泌 insulin 胰岛素的肿瘤）

no.en: Hypersensitivity to glucagon
no.zh: 对 glucagon 胰高血糖素过敏

noFake.zh: 今天早上打过 insulin 胰岛素

care.en: In pheochromocytoma it can release catecholamines, causing significant hypertension and tachycardia, and may provoke a bleed in the brain.
care.zh: 嗜铬细胞瘤病人用了会释放儿茶酚胺，引起明显的高血压和心动过速，还可能诱发脑出血。

care.en: Low blood sugar caused by heavy drinking is unlikely to respond to it.
care.zh: 大量饮酒引起的低血糖，用它多半拉不回来。

care.en: It only works if the liver has glycogen available.
care.zh: 肝里有糖原可用，它才有效。

dose.en: 3 mg IN, one sealed kit. Adults and children 4 years and older
dose.zh: 3 mg 鼻内，一个密封药盒。成人和 4 岁及以上儿童

dose.en: No clinical response within 15 minutes: consider a second 3 mg dose. Maximum 6 mg
dose.zh: 15 分钟内没有临床反应：可考虑再给 3 mg。最多 6 mg

dose.en: CliniCall consultation is required before the second dose
dose.zh: 给第二剂之前必须先咨询 CliniCall

dose.en: Under 4 years: contraindicated
dose.zh: 未满 4 岁：禁用

pk.en: Starts to work in 15 minutes, peaks at 15 minutes and lasts 90 minutes.
pk.zh: 15 分钟起效，15 分钟达峰，维持 90 分钟。

pearl.en: Glucagon is slow. Give it, then wait the full 15 minutes before you judge it. A second dose needs CliniCall first.
pearl.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素起效慢。给完以后等满 15 分钟再判断有没有效。要给第二剂，先打 CliniCall。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): adds an IM dose of 0.5 to 1 mg beside the 3 mg IN, and lists allergy as the only contraindication. It has no age limit of 4 years, no pheochromocytoma or insulinoma, no CliniCall step and no 6 mg maximum.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：除了 3 mg 鼻内，还多一个 0.5–1 mg 肌注的剂量，禁忌只列过敏。没有 4 岁的年龄限制，没有嗜铬细胞瘤和胰岛素瘤，没有 CliniCall 这一步，也没有 6 mg 的上限。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Glucagon drug monograph

stem.en: Mei, 34, type 1 diabetic, found slumped on a fishing boat in Steveston. Groans to pain only. Glucose 1.9. Two IV attempts have failed.
stem.zh: Mei，34 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Steveston 的渔船上被发现瘫坐着。只对疼痛有呻吟。血糖 1.9。两次静脉穿刺都失败了。

why.en: Confirmed hypoglycemia, she cannot take oral glucose safely, and there is no IV access. Give 3 mg IN.
why.zh: 已确认低血糖，她不能安全地吃 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖，又没有静脉通路。给 3 mg 鼻内。

bad.en: Her brain stays without sugar while you keep hunting for a vein.
bad.zh: 你继续找血管的时候，她的大脑一直没有糖用。

stem.en: Leo, 3, type 1 diabetic, floppy and drowsy at his daycare in Burnaby. Glucose 2.2. He will not swallow anything.
stem.zh: Leo，3 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Burnaby 的托儿所里软绵绵、昏昏欲睡。血糖 2.2。什么都不肯咽。

why.en: Intranasal glucagon is contraindicated under 4 years of age. He needs his sugar by another route.
why.zh: 未满 4 岁禁用鼻内 glucagon 胰高血糖素。他得靠别的途径补糖。

bad.en: You gave a drug that is contraindicated at his age. If he reacts badly, no protocol stands behind you.
bad.zh: 你给了一个在他这个年龄禁用的药。万一出现不良反应，没有任何规程替你撑腰。

stem.en: Anita, 47, on insulin, sweaty and shaky on a Skytrain platform. Glucose 2.8. She talks, follows commands and sips from her water bottle.
stem.zh: Anita，47 岁，在用 insulin 胰岛素，在 Skytrain 站台上出汗、发抖。血糖 2.8。她能说话，能听指令，还在喝自己水瓶里的水。

why.en: She is alert enough to swallow safely, so she gets oral glucose. Glucagon is for the patient who cannot take sugar by mouth.
why.zh: 她足够清醒，能安全吞咽，所以给 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖。glucagon 胰高血糖素是留给没法经口吃糖的病人的。

bad.en: She waits 15 minutes for a slow drug and may vomit, when a tube of gel was the answer.
bad.zh: 她要等 15 分钟让一个慢药起效，还可能呕吐，其实一管葡萄糖凝胶就解决了。

stem.en: Owen, 58, unresponsive, glucose 1.7, no IV access. You gave 3 mg IN glucagon 15 minutes ago. Nothing has changed.
stem.zh: Owen，58 岁，没有反应，血糖 1.7，没有静脉通路。15 分钟前你给了 3 mg 鼻内 glucagon 胰高血糖素。到现在毫无变化。

ask.en: What comes before a second dose?
ask.zh: 给第二剂之前要做什么？

opts.en: Consult CliniCall
opts.zh: 先咨询 CliniCall

opts.en: Nothing, just give it
opts.zh: 不用做什么，直接给

opts.en: Wait another 15 minutes
opts.zh: 再等 15 分钟

why.en: A second 3 mg dose can be considered after 15 minutes with no clinical response, but CliniCall consultation is required first.
why.zh: 15 分钟没有临床反应可以考虑再给 3 mg，但必须先咨询 CliniCall。

s.en: Glucagon only works if the liver still has glycogen stored.
s.zh: 肝里还存着糖原，glucagon 胰高血糖素才有效。

why.en: Its whole job is to turn liver glycogen into glucose.
why.zh: 它的全部作用就是把肝糖原变成葡萄糖。

s.en: If the first dose fails, give the second one right away without calling anyone.
s.zh: 第一剂没效，可以不用联系任何人，马上给第二剂。

why.en: Wait 15 minutes, and CliniCall consultation is required before the second dose.
why.zh: 要等 15 分钟，而且给第二剂之前必须咨询 CliniCall。

s.en: Low blood sugar from heavy drinking often does not respond to glucagon.
s.zh: 大量饮酒引起的低血糖，用 glucagon 胰高血糖素常常没反应。

why.en: The monograph says alcohol-related hypoglycemia is unlikely to be reversible with it.
why.zh: 专论写明：酒精引起的低血糖不太可能被它逆转。

s.en: A PCP with a working IV line should still choose glucagon first.
s.zh: PCP 手上有通畅的静脉通路时，还是应该先选 glucagon 胰高血糖素。

why.en: The PCP indication is hypoglycemia where IV access is unavailable.
why.zh: PCP 的适应证是建立不了静脉通路的低血糖。

q.en: The BCEHS dose of glucagon is…
q.zh: BCEHS 的 glucagon 胰高血糖素剂量是…

opts.en: 3 mg IN, repeat after 15 minutes if needed, maximum 6 mg
opts.zh: 3 mg 鼻内，需要时 15 分钟后重复，最多 6 mg

opts.en: 3 mg IN, repeat after 5 minutes if needed, maximum 6 mg
opts.zh: 3 mg 鼻内，需要时 5 分钟后重复，最多 6 mg

opts.en: 30 mg IN, repeat after 15 minutes if needed, maximum 60 mg
opts.zh: 30 mg 鼻内，需要时 15 分钟后重复，最多 60 mg

opts.en: 3 mg SL, repeat after 15 minutes if needed, maximum 6 mg
opts.zh: 3 mg 舌下，需要时 15 分钟后重复，最多 6 mg

why.en: One 3 mg kit in the nose. A second after 15 minutes needs CliniCall, and 6 mg is the maximum.
why.zh: 一个 3 mg 药盒喷鼻。15 分钟后要给第二个得先咨询 CliniCall，上限 6 mg。

q.en: How does glucagon raise blood sugar?
q.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素怎么让血糖升高？

opts.en: It makes the liver turn glycogen into glucose
opts.zh: 让肝脏把糖原变成葡萄糖

opts.en: It is a sugar absorbed through the nose
opts.zh: 它本身是糖，经鼻腔吸收

opts.en: It stops the pancreas from releasing insulin
opts.zh: 阻止胰腺释放 insulin 胰岛素

opts.en: It pulls glucose out of the muscles
opts.zh: 把葡萄糖从肌肉里抽出来

why.en: It speeds up the conversion of glycogen to glucose in the liver.
why.zh: 它加快肝脏里糖原向葡萄糖的转化。

q.en: Why is pheochromocytoma a contraindication?
q.zh: 为什么嗜铬细胞瘤是禁忌？

opts.en: Glucagon can release catecholamines and cause significant hypertension
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素会促使儿茶酚胺释放，引起明显的高血压

opts.en: Glucagon makes the tumour release a flood of insulin
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素会让肿瘤大量释放 insulin 胰岛素

opts.en: Glucagon is destroyed by the tumour and cannot work
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素会被肿瘤破坏，起不了作用

opts.en: Glucagon causes a dangerous fall in heart rate
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素会让心率危险地下降

why.en: The catecholamine release leads to significant hypertension and tachycardia, and may provoke an intracerebral hemorrhage.
why.zh: 儿茶酚胺释放会导致明显的高血压和心动过速，还可能诱发脑出血。

bcehs.name: D10W (Dextrose 10%)

cls.zh: 碳水化合物底物（给细胞的糖类燃料）

hook.en: Sugar straight into the vein for a brain running on empty.
hook.zh: 大脑没油了，把糖直接送进静脉。

how.en: It delivers glucose and water straight to cells that have run out of fuel. Nothing to swallow and nothing to digest. For a short time it also makes the kidneys pass more water, which is called osmotic diuresis.
how.zh: 它把葡萄糖和水直接送给断了燃料的细胞。不用吞咽，也不用消化。它还会让肾脏在短时间内多排水，这叫渗透性利尿。

use.en: Suspected or known hypoglycemia
use.zh: 怀疑或已确认的低血糖

no.en: None listed in the monograph
no.zh: 专论没有列出任何禁忌证

noFake.en: Suspected hypoglycemia with no meter reading yet
noFake.zh: 怀疑低血糖，但还没测到血糖值
已经给过 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖

care.en: Extravasation of glucose solution can cause tissue necrosis.
care.zh: 葡萄糖溶液外渗可导致组织坏死。

care.en: Suspected intracerebral hemorrhage: CliniCall consultation is recommended to discuss care planning.
care.zh: 怀疑脑出血：建议咨询 CliniCall 讨论处置方案。

dose.en: 10 to 25 g IV, which is 100 to 250 mL of D10W
dose.zh: 10–25 g IV，也就是 100–250 mL 的 D10W 10% 葡萄糖

dose.en: Over 12 years old (PCP): 5 mL/kg IV, up to a maximum of 10 to 25 g, which is 100 to 250 mL
dose.zh: 12 岁以上（PCP）：5 mL/kg IV，最多 10–25 g，也就是 100–250 mL

dose.en: Give over 5 to 15 minutes. May repeat once.
dose.zh: 5–15 分钟内输完。可重复一次。

dose.en: Age 12 and under: BCEHS ACP and above
dose.zh: 12 岁及以下：BCEHS 规定 ACP 及以上才能给

dose.en: Supplied as a 250 mL bag of 10% solution, so a full bag is 25 g
dose.zh: 包装是 250 mL 一袋的 10% 溶液，所以一整袋是 25 g

fx.en: Tissue necrosis if the solution leaks out of the vein (extravasation)
fx.zh: 溶液漏到血管外（外渗）会造成组织坏死

pk.en: Onset is immediate. How long it lasts depends on how severe the hypoglycemia is.
pk.zh: 立即起效。能维持多久取决于低血糖有多严重。

pearl.en: Think in grams, pour in mL: 100 mL is 10 g and the full 250 mL bag is 25 g. Keep your eyes on the IV site, because sugar outside the vein kills tissue.
pearl.zh: 脑子里算克，手上放毫升：100 mL 是 10 g，一整袋 250 mL 是 25 g。眼睛盯住 IV 穿刺点，因为糖漏到血管外会让组织坏死。

diff.en: Exam (EMALB): the dose is the same, 10 to 25 g IV, and there are no contraindications. The exam also lists altered level of responsiveness and coma or seizure not yet diagnosed as indications. It gives no pediatric dose and no CliniCall note for suspected intracerebral hemorrhage.
diff.zh: 考试（EMALB）：剂量一样，10–25 g IV，也没有禁忌证。考试还把反应水平改变、原因未明的昏迷或抽搐列为适应证。考试没有儿童剂量，也没有怀疑脑出血时咨询 CliniCall 这一条。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Dextrose drug monograph

stem.en: Marcel, 54, type 1 diabetic, slumped and unresponsive in his truck at a Kamloops rest stop. Glucose 1.9 mmol/L. Your IV is in and running well.
stem.zh: Marcel，54 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Kamloops 休息站的卡车里瘫着，叫不醒。血糖 1.9 mmol/L。你的 IV 已经打好，滴得很顺。

why.en: Known hypoglycemia and a working IV. That is the indication, and the monograph lists no contraindications.
why.zh: 已确认低血糖，IV 通畅。这就是适应证，专论也没有列任何禁忌证。

bad.en: His brain stays without fuel, and a seizure may be the next thing you treat.
bad.zh: 他的大脑继续断油，接下来你要处理的可能就是抽搐。

stem.en: Ruth, 80, confused since this morning at a care home in Richmond. She takes insulin. Glucose 6.8 mmol/L. Staff ask if she needs sugar.
stem.zh: Ruth，80 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院，从早上起就糊涂。她在用 insulin 胰岛素。血糖 6.8 mmol/L。护工问要不要给她补糖。

why.en: The indication is suspected or known hypoglycemia. Her glucose is normal, so the confusion has another cause.
why.zh: 适应证是怀疑或已确认的低血糖。她的血糖正常，所以糊涂另有原因。

bad.en: You push up a normal blood sugar and stop looking for the real reason she is confused.
bad.zh: 你把正常的血糖推高了，还不再去找她糊涂的真正原因。

stem.en: Sam, 13, 50 kg, type 1 diabetic, unresponsive at hockey practice in Kelowna. Glucose 2.0 mmol/L. IV running well.
stem.zh: Sam，13 岁，50 kg，1 型糖尿病，在 Kelowna 冰球训练时叫不醒。血糖 2.0 mmol/L。IV 通畅。

ask.en: How much D10W?
ask.zh: 给多少 D10W 10% 葡萄糖？

opts.en: 250 mL IV over 5 to 15 minutes
opts.zh: 250 mL IV，5–15 分钟输完

opts.en: 25 mL IV over 5 to 15 minutes
opts.zh: 25 mL IV，5–15 分钟输完

opts.en: 500 mL IV, as fast as it will run
opts.zh: 500 mL IV，能滴多快就多快

why.en: 5 mL/kg times 50 kg is 250 mL, which is 25 g, the top of the range. Give it over 5 to 15 minutes.
why.zh: 5 mL/kg 乘以 50 kg 是 250 mL，也就是 25 g，正好是范围的上限。5–15 分钟输完。

stem.en: Kofi, 23, diabetic, drowsy at a Vancouver bus stop. Glucose 2.1 mmol/L. Your IV in his hand has gone puffy and cool, and the drip has stopped.
stem.zh: Kofi，23 岁，糖尿病，在温哥华的公交站昏昏沉沉。血糖 2.1 mmol/L。你打在他手背上的 IV 鼓起来了，摸着发凉，也不滴了。

ask.en: What now?

opts.en: Stop and start a new IV before giving D10W
opts.zh: 停下，重新打一条 IV 再给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖

opts.en: Run the D10W slowly through this line
opts.zh: 用这条线慢慢滴 D10W 10% 葡萄糖

opts.en: Squeeze the bag to push past the blockage
opts.zh: 挤压输液袋把堵的地方冲开

why.en: The line is no longer in the vein. Extravasation of glucose solution can cause tissue necrosis.
why.zh: 这条线已经不在血管里了。葡萄糖溶液外渗可导致组织坏死。

bad.en: The sugar solution pools under his skin and the tissue there starts to die.
bad.zh: 糖水积在皮下，那里的组织开始坏死。

s.en: The BCEHS monograph lists no contraindications for D10W.
s.zh: BCEHS 专论没有给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖列任何禁忌证。

why.en: It says none noted.
why.zh: 专论写的是“未列出”。

s.en: Suspected bleeding in the brain is a contraindication to D10W.
s.zh: 怀疑脑出血是 D10W 10% 葡萄糖的禁忌证。

why.en: It is not. CliniCall consultation is recommended to plan care.
why.zh: 不是。只是建议咨询 CliniCall 来安排处置。

s.en: A full 250 mL bag of D10W holds 25 g of dextrose.
s.zh: 一整袋 250 mL 的 D10W 10% 葡萄糖含 25 g 葡萄糖。

why.en: A 10% solution has 10 g in every 100 mL.
why.zh: 10% 溶液就是每 100 mL 含 10 g。

s.en: A PCP can give D10W to a hypoglycemic 6-year-old.
s.zh: PCP 可以给低血糖的 6 岁孩子用 D10W 10% 葡萄糖。

why.en: PCP pediatric dosing is for patients over 12 years old.
why.zh: PCP 的儿童剂量只适用于 12 岁以上。

q.en: The adult dose of D10W for hypoglycemia is…
q.zh: D10W 10% 葡萄糖治疗低血糖的成人剂量是…

opts.en: 10 to 25 g IV, which is 100 to 250 mL
10 to 25 mL IV, which is 1 to 2.5 g
opts.zh: 10–25 mL IV，也就是 1–2.5 g

opts.en: 100 to 250 g IV, which is 1 to 2.5 L
10 to 25 g IM, into the thigh
opts.zh: 10–25 g IM，打在大腿

why.en: D10W holds 10 g in every 100 mL, so 10 to 25 g is 100 to 250 mL, by IV.
why.zh: D10W 10% 葡萄糖每 100 mL 含 10 g，所以 10–25 g 就是 100–250 mL，走 IV。

q.en: What does D10W do in the body?
q.zh: D10W 10% 葡萄糖在体内做什么？

opts.en: Gives cells an immediate source of glucose and water
opts.zh: 立刻给细胞提供葡萄糖和水

opts.en: Makes the liver release its stored sugar
opts.zh: 让肝脏放出储存的糖

opts.en: Blocks the action of insulin on the cells
opts.zh: 阻断 insulin 胰岛素对细胞的作用

opts.en: Slows the absorption of sugar from the gut
opts.zh: 减慢肠道对糖的吸收

why.en: It is an immediate source of glucose and water for nutrient-deficient cells. It also causes a transient osmotic diuresis.
why.zh: 它立刻给缺乏营养的细胞提供葡萄糖和水。它还会引起一过性的渗透性利尿。

bcehs.name: Morphine

cls.en: Opioid analgesic (high alert medication, controlled and targeted substance)
cls.zh: 阿片类镇痛药（高警示药品，受管制药物）

hook.en: Turns the volume of pain down. For PCPs: palliative or end-of-life only.
hook.zh: 把疼痛的音量调低。PCP 只能用于姑息或临终病人。

how.en: Morphine binds to opioid receptors in the brain and spinal cord, mainly the mu receptors. Pain signals travelling up are blocked, and the pain that arrives matters less to the patient. It also slows the whole central nervous system, breathing included.
how.zh: morphine 吗啡和脑、脊髓里的阿片受体结合，主要是 mu 受体。往上传的痛觉信号被挡住，传到的那部分痛病人也不那么在意了。它同时压低整个中枢神经系统，呼吸也在内。

use.en: Pain management in palliative or end-of-life emergencies
use.zh: 姑息或临终急症中的疼痛处理

no.en: Hypotension: adult SBP below 90 mmHg (children under 12: SBP below 70 mmHg)
no.zh: 低血压：成人收缩压低于 90 mmHg（12 岁以下儿童低于 70 mmHg）

no.en: Respiratory depression: adults below 10 breaths per minute (children under 12: below 20)
no.zh: 呼吸抑制：成人每分钟少于 10 次（12 岁以下儿童少于 20 次）

no.en: Head injury with altered LOC (GCS below 9)
no.zh: 头部外伤伴意识水平改变（GCS 低于 9）

no.en: Known hypersensitivity to morphine or other opioid analgesics
no.zh: 已知对 morphine 吗啡或其他阿片类镇痛药过敏

no.en: Taking a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), or stopped one within the last 14 days
no.zh: 正在用单胺氧化酶抑制剂（MAOI），或停药还不到 14 天

noFake.zh: 有「不施行心肺复苏」的医嘱

care.en: Use caution in respiratory insufficiency, including asthma, COPD and upper airway obstruction.
care.zh: 呼吸功能不全时慎用，包括哮喘、COPD 和上气道梗阻。

care.en: Use caution in hypovolemia, cardiac arrhythmias, convulsive disorders and cranial injuries.
care.zh: 低血容量、心律失常、惊厥性疾病和颅脑损伤时慎用。

care.en: Other opioids, benzodiazepines, phenothiazines, anesthetics and alcohol may deepen respiratory and circulatory depression.
care.zh: 其他阿片类药、苯二氮䓬类、吩噻嗪类、麻醉药和酒精可能加重呼吸和循环抑制。

care.en: In overdose, manage the airway and ventilation, and use naloxone carefully in long-term opioid patients to avoid acute withdrawal.
care.zh: 过量时先管气道、辅助通气。长期用阿片类药的病人用 naloxone 纳洛酮要谨慎，以免诱发急性戒断。

dose.en: PCP: only for pain management in palliative emergencies or end-of-life patients
dose.zh: PCP：只用于姑息急症或临终病人的疼痛处理

dose.en: Mandatory CliniCall or palliative team consultation to discuss dosing strategies
dose.zh: 必须先咨询 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队，商量给药方案

dose.en: 2.5 to 5 mg subcut every 10 to 30 minutes as needed
dose.zh: 2.5–5 mg 皮下注射，需要时每 10–30 分钟一次

dose.en: Dosing is based on blood pressure, SBP above 100 mmHg, or follows the CliniCall or palliative team care plan
dose.zh: 给药要看血压（收缩压高于 100 mmHg），或者按 CliniCall、姑息治疗团队的照护方案执行

dose.en: Maximum 20 mg per hour. The ampoule is 10 mg in 1 mL.
dose.zh: 每小时最多 20 mg。安瓿是 10 mg/1 mL。

dose.en: Children: BCEHS: ACP and above
dose.zh: 儿童：BCEHS：ACP 及以上

fx.zh: 嗜睡、头晕、镇静、躁动、欣快
恶心、呕吐、便秘、针尖样瞳孔

fx.en: Itch or rash from histamine release, a pseudoallergic reaction (anaphylaxis is rare)
fx.zh: 组胺释放引起的瘙痒或皮疹，属于假性过敏反应（真正的严重过敏反应少见）

fx.en: Local tissue irritation with repeated subcutaneous doses
fx.zh: 反复皮下注射引起局部组织刺激

pk.en: Subcutaneous morphine works in 10 minutes, peaks at 20 to 60 minutes and lasts 2 to 4 hours.
pk.zh: 皮下注射 10 分钟起效，20–60 分钟达峰，维持 2–4 小时。

pearl.en: Count the breathing and take the pressure before every dose. Fewer than 10 breaths a minute or systolic below 90 is a contraindication, and the dosing itself is based on systolic above 100.
pearl.zh: 每次给药前都要数呼吸、量血压。每分钟少于 10 次，或收缩压低于 90，就是禁忌。给药本身则是按血压（收缩压高于 100）来定的。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Morphine drug monograph

stem.en: Mr. Thompson, 84, home hospice in Victoria, bone cancer, crying with pain. RR 18, BP 122/70, GCS 15. The palliative team, by phone, plans morphine 2.5 mg subcut.
stem.zh: Thompson 先生，84 岁，在 Victoria 家中接受临终关怀，骨癌，痛得直哭。呼吸 18，血压 122/70，GCS 15。姑息治疗团队在电话里定了 morphine 吗啡 2.5 mg 皮下注射。

why.en: End-of-life pain, the mandatory consultation is done, and no contraindication. Give 2.5 mg subcut, then recheck breathing and pressure.
why.zh: 临终病人的疼痛，必须的咨询已经做了，也没有禁忌。给 2.5 mg 皮下注射，然后再查呼吸和血压。

bad.en: He stays in severe pain at the end of his life, with the drug sitting in your kit.
bad.zh: 他在生命的最后还在剧痛里，而药就躺在你的药包里。

stem.en: Mrs. Wong, 79, palliative, lung cancer, moaning. She took her own long-acting opioid an hour ago. Hard to wake, RR 8, BP 110/64.
stem.zh: 黄太太，79 岁，姑息病人，肺癌，一直在呻吟。一小时前吃了自己的长效阿片类药。很难叫醒，呼吸 8，血压 110/64。

why.en: Fewer than 10 breaths per minute in an adult is respiratory depression. That is a contraindication, however bad the pain looks.
why.zh: 成人每分钟少于 10 次就是呼吸抑制。这是禁忌，看起来再痛也不给。

bad.en: Her breathing slows further and may stop.
bad.zh: 她的呼吸会更慢，甚至可能停掉。

stem.en: Joe, 70, end-stage liver cancer at home in Prince George, pain 8/10. Awake and asking for something. RR 16, BP 84/50.
stem.zh: Joe，70 岁，肝癌晚期，在 Prince George 家中，疼痛 8/10。清醒，一直要止痛药。呼吸 16，血压 84/50。

why.en: Adult SBP below 90 mmHg is a contraindication. Tell CliniCall or the palliative team and ask for another plan.
why.zh: 成人收缩压低于 90 mmHg 是禁忌。告诉 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队，请他们换一个方案。

bad.en: Morphine can cause profound hypotension, and his pressure has no room left to fall.
bad.zh: morphine 吗啡可能引起严重低血压，而他的血压已经没有再掉的余地了。

stem.en: Ellen, 88, palliative. Under the team plan she has had morphine 5 mg subcut four times in the last hour. Pain is back. RR 14, BP 112/68.
stem.zh: Ellen，88 岁，姑息病人。按团队方案，过去一小时里已经打了四次 morphine 吗啡 5 mg 皮下注射。疼痛又回来了。呼吸 14，血压 112/68。

ask.en: Give another 5 mg now?

opts.en: No. She has reached 20 mg this hour
opts.zh: 不给。这一小时已经到 20 mg 了

opts.en: Yes. Her vital signs allow it
opts.zh: 给。她的生命体征允许

opts.en: Yes, and make it 10 mg this time
opts.zh: 给，而且这次给 10 mg

why.en: The maximum is 20 mg per hour. Four doses of 5 mg is already 20 mg, so call the team before giving more.
why.zh: 每小时最多 20 mg。四次 5 mg 已经是 20 mg 了，再给之前先打电话给团队。

s.en: Itching after morphine means anaphylaxis is starting.
s.zh: 打了 morphine 吗啡后发痒，说明严重过敏反应要来了。

why.en: Itch and rash are usually pseudoallergic, from histamine release. Anaphylaxis is rare.
why.zh: 瘙痒和皮疹多半是组胺释放引起的假性过敏。真正的严重过敏反应少见。

s.en: Asthma and COPD are cautions for morphine, not contraindications.
s.zh: 哮喘和 COPD 对 morphine 吗啡来说是慎用，不是禁忌。

why.en: Respiratory insufficiency, including asthma and COPD, is listed under cautions.
why.zh: 呼吸功能不全（包括哮喘和 COPD）列在慎用里。

s.en: For palliative pain, the PCP route for morphine is subcutaneous.
s.zh: 处理姑息病人的疼痛时，PCP 给 morphine 吗啡走的是皮下途径。

why.en: The PCP palliative dose is 2.5 to 5 mg subcut.
why.zh: PCP 的姑息剂量是 2.5–5 mg 皮下注射。

s.en: A patient who stopped an MAOI last week can have morphine.
s.zh: 上周刚停掉 MAOI 的病人可以用 morphine 吗啡。

why.en: Do not use morphine within 14 days of stopping an MAOI.
why.zh: 停用 MAOI 不到 14 天，不能用 morphine 吗啡。

q.en: The PCP dose of morphine for a palliative patient in pain is…
q.zh: PCP 给疼痛的姑息病人用 morphine 吗啡的剂量是…

opts.en: 2.5 to 5 mg subcut every 10 to 30 minutes as needed
opts.zh: 2.5–5 mg 皮下，需要时每 10–30 分钟

opts.en: 25 to 50 mg subcut every 10 to 30 minutes as needed
opts.zh: 25–50 mg 皮下，需要时每 10–30 分钟

opts.en: 2.5 to 5 mg subcut every 1 to 3 minutes as needed
opts.zh: 2.5–5 mg 皮下，需要时每 1–3 分钟

opts.en: 0.05 to 0.1 mg/kg IV every 2 hours as needed
opts.zh: 0.05–0.1 mg/kg 静脉，需要时每 2 小时

why.en: 2.5 to 5 mg subcut every 10 to 30 minutes as needed, to a maximum of 20 mg per hour, after the mandatory consultation.
why.zh: 2.5–5 mg 皮下，需要时每 10–30 分钟一次，每小时最多 20 mg，而且必须先咨询。

q.en: Morphine relieves pain mainly by…
q.zh: morphine 吗啡止痛主要靠…

opts.en: Binding mu opioid receptors in the CNS
opts.zh: 和中枢神经系统的 mu 阿片受体结合

opts.en: Blocking COX enzymes at the injury
opts.zh: 在受伤部位阻断 COX 酶

opts.en: Blocking sodium channels in the nerve
opts.zh: 阻断神经的钠通道

opts.en: Blocking NMDA receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 阻断脑里的 NMDA 受体

why.en: It binds opioid receptors in the CNS, primarily mu receptors, and inhibits the ascending pain pathways.
why.zh: 它和中枢神经系统的阿片受体结合，主要是 mu 受体，抑制上行的痛觉通路。

q.en: Which of these is a contraindication to morphine, not just a caution?
q.zh: 下面哪一项是 morphine 吗啡的禁忌，而不只是慎用？

opts.en: Head injury with GCS below 9
opts.zh: 头部外伤，GCS 低于 9

opts.en: Asthma or COPD
opts.zh: 哮喘或 COPD

opts.en: A convulsive disorder
opts.zh: 惊厥性疾病

opts.en: Reduced blood volume
opts.zh: 血容量减少

why.en: Head injury with altered LOC, GCS below 9, is a contraindication. The other three are cautions.
why.zh: 头部外伤伴意识水平改变（GCS 低于 9）是禁忌。另外三项是慎用。

bcehs.name: Hydromorphone (Dilaudid)

cls.en: Opioid analgesic (high alert medication, controlled and targeted substance)
cls.zh: 阿片类镇痛药（高警示药品，受管制药物）

hook.en: A strong opioid for pain. For PCPs: palliative or end-of-life patients only.
hook.zh: 强效阿片类止痛药。PCP 只能用于姑息或临终病人。

how.en: It binds to opiate receptors in the brain and spinal cord. Pain signals travelling up are blocked, and the pain that still arrives bothers the patient less. It also slows the whole central nervous system, and that includes breathing.
how.zh: 它和脑、脊髓里的阿片受体结合。往上传的痛觉信号被挡住，传到的那部分痛也不那么让人难受了。它同时压低整个中枢神经系统，呼吸也在内。

use.en: Analgesia in palliative care settings: pain management in palliative or end-of-life patients
use.zh: 姑息治疗中的镇痛：姑息或临终病人的疼痛处理

no.en: Allergy or known hypersensitivity to hydromorphone
no.zh: 对 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮过敏或已知超敏

noFake.zh: 有「不施行心肺复苏」的医嘱

care.en: It causes respiratory depression and can cause or worsen hypotension.
care.zh: 它会抑制呼吸，也可能引起或加重低血压。

care.en: Alcohol, sedatives, antihistamines, neuroleptics and psychotropic drugs add to its depressant effects.
care.zh: 酒精、镇静药、抗组胺药、抗精神病药和其他精神类药物会加重它的抑制作用。

care.en: Liver disease needs an adjusted dose, and sensitivity to other opioids needs caution.
care.zh: 肝病病人要调整剂量，对其他阿片类药敏感的病人要慎用。

care.en: In overdose, manage the airway and ventilation, and use naloxone carefully in long-term opioid patients, as in BCEHS J12 (Opioids).
care.zh: 过量时先管气道、辅助通气。长期用阿片类药的病人用 naloxone 纳洛酮要谨慎，见 BCEHS J12（Opioids 阿片类药物）。

dose.en: PCP: pain in palliative or end-of-life patients only. CliniCall or the palliative care team must be consulted before you select a dosing strategy.
dose.zh: PCP：只用于姑息或临终病人的疼痛。选定给药方案之前，必须先咨询 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队。

dose.en: PO: 2 to 4 mg every 4 to 6 hours
dose.zh: 口服：2–4 mg，每 4–6 小时一次

dose.en: May repeat every 10 to 30 minutes as required, based on blood pressure above 100 mmHg, or as per the CliniCall or palliative care team plan
dose.zh: 需要时可每 10–30 分钟重复一次，条件是血压高于 100 mmHg，或者按 CliniCall、姑息治疗团队的方案执行

dose.en: IV: 0.2 to 1.0 mg every 2 to 3 hours
dose.zh: 静脉：0.2–1.0 mg，每 2–3 小时一次

dose.en: SC: 1 mg every 4 hours
dose.zh: 皮下：1 mg，每 4 小时一次

dose.en: Children: BCEHS: ACP and above, with specific training and licence endorsement
dose.zh: 儿童：BCEHS：ACP 及以上，并且要有专门培训和执照认证

fx.zh: 镇静、嗜睡、头晕、头重脚轻
躁动、恐惧、谵妄、幻觉、定向障碍

fx.en: Reflex tachycardia, bradycardia, palpitations, chest wall rigidity
fx.zh: 反射性心动过速、心动过缓、心悸、胸壁僵硬

pk.en: IV works in 5 minutes and oral in 15 to 30 minutes, and both last 3 to 4 hours.
pk.zh: 静脉 5 分钟起效，口服 15–30 分钟起效，两种都维持 3–4 小时。

pearl.en: You do not choose this dose alone. CliniCall or the palliative care team selects the strategy first. Your job after that is to watch the breathing and the pressure.
pearl.zh: 这个剂量不是你一个人定的。先由 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队选定方案。之后你的任务是盯住呼吸和血压。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Hydromorphone drug monograph

stem.en: Mrs. Chan, 81, home hospice in Richmond, pancreatic cancer, pain 9/10. RR 16, BP 118/70. The palliative team, by phone, plans hydromorphone 1 mg SC. No allergies.
stem.zh: 陈太太，81 岁，在 Richmond 家中接受临终关怀，胰腺癌，疼痛 9/10。呼吸 16，血压 118/70。姑息治疗团队在电话里定了 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮 1 mg 皮下注射。无过敏史。

why.en: A palliative patient in pain, the consultation is done, and no hydromorphone allergy. Give 1 mg SC as planned, then watch breathing and pressure.
why.zh: 姑息病人在痛，已经咨询过，对 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮也不过敏。按方案给 1 mg 皮下，然后盯住呼吸和血压。

bad.en: She spends her last days in pain that you had the plan and the drug to treat.
bad.zh: 她在疼痛里度过最后的日子，而方案和药你手上都有。

stem.en: Frank, 77, end-stage lung cancer at home in Nanaimo, pain 8/10. RR 18, BP 124/72. His chart lists hydromorphone: hives and throat swelling last year.
stem.zh: Frank，77 岁，肺癌晚期，在 Nanaimo 家中，疼痛 8/10。呼吸 18，血压 124/72。病历上写着 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮：去年用后起荨麻疹、喉头肿胀。

why.en: Allergy or known hypersensitivity to hydromorphone is the one listed contraindication. Tell CliniCall or the palliative care team and get another plan.
why.zh: 对 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮过敏或已知超敏，是唯一列明的禁忌。告诉 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队，换一个方案。

bad.en: His throat swells again, at home, in a man whose lungs are already failing.
bad.zh: 他的喉头又肿起来，人在家里，肺本来就不行了。

stem.en: Jason, 36, crashed his mountain bike in Whistler. Deformed forearm, pain 8/10, BP 132/80, RR 18. Your partner reaches for the hydromorphone.
stem.zh: Jason，36 岁，在 Whistler 骑山地车摔了。前臂变形，疼痛 8/10，血压 132/80，呼吸 18。你的搭档伸手去拿 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮。

why.en: For PCPs hydromorphone is only for pain in palliative or end-of-life patients. A broken arm is not that, so pick another analgesic.
why.zh: 对 PCP 来说，hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮只用于姑息或临终病人的疼痛。骨折的胳膊不算，换别的镇痛药。

bad.en: You give a high alert opioid outside the PCP indication, with no consult behind you if his breathing slows.
bad.zh: 你在 PCP 适应证之外给了高警示阿片类药，万一他呼吸变慢，背后连一次咨询都没有。

stem.en: Mr. Singh, 79, palliative. Hydromorphone was given 20 minutes ago under the team plan. Pain still 8/10. He is drowsy, BP 92/56.
stem.zh: Singh 先生，79 岁，姑息病人。20 分钟前按团队方案给过 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮。疼痛还是 8/10。人有点嗜睡，血压 92/56。

ask.en: Repeat the dose now?

opts.en: No. Hold it and call the palliative team
opts.zh: 不给。先停，打电话给姑息治疗团队

opts.en: Yes. More than 10 minutes have passed
opts.zh: 给。已经过了 10 分钟以上

opts.en: Yes. Give a double dose for the pain
opts.zh: 给。痛得厉害，剂量加倍

why.en: Repeats are based on blood pressure above 100 mmHg, or on the plan from CliniCall or the palliative care team. At 92 he does not qualify, so call.
why.zh: 重复给药的条件是血压高于 100 mmHg，或者按 CliniCall、姑息治疗团队的方案。他只有 92，不够条件，所以打电话。

bad.en: The next dose can cause or worsen hypotension, and his pressure is already low.
bad.zh: 再给一次可能引起或加重低血压，而他的血压已经偏低了。

s.en: The oral dose and the IV dose of hydromorphone are the same number of milligrams.
s.zh: hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮口服和静脉的毫克数是一样的。

why.en: Oral is 2 to 4 mg. IV is 0.2 to 1.0 mg.
why.zh: 口服是 2–4 mg，静脉是 0.2–1.0 mg。

s.en: A PCP must consult CliniCall or the palliative care team before selecting a hydromorphone dose.
s.zh: PCP 选定 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮的剂量之前，必须先咨询 CliniCall 或姑息治疗团队。

why.en: The consultation is required before a dosing strategy is selected.
why.zh: 选定给药方案之前必须先咨询。

s.en: Antihistamines and alcohol make the depressant effects of hydromorphone stronger.
s.zh: 抗组胺药和酒精会加重 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮的抑制作用。

why.en: Other CNS depressants potentiate its depressant effects.
why.zh: 其他中枢抑制药会加强它的抑制作用。

s.en: A sleepy palliative patient on long-term opioids should get naloxone freely.
s.zh: 长期用阿片类药的姑息病人一犯困，就可以放手给 naloxone 纳洛酮。

why.en: Naloxone is used judiciously in long-term opioid patients, to avoid acute withdrawal.
why.zh: 长期用阿片类药的病人用 naloxone 纳洛酮要谨慎，以免诱发急性戒断。

q.en: The PCP dose of IV hydromorphone for a palliative patient is…
q.zh: PCP 给姑息病人静脉用 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮的剂量是…

opts.en: 0.2 to 1.0 mg IV every 2 to 3 hours
2 to 4 mg IV every 4 to 6 hours
opts.zh: 2–4 mg 静脉，每 4–6 小时

opts.en: 2 to 10 mg IV every 2 to 3 hours
opts.zh: 2–10 mg 静脉，每 2–3 小时

opts.en: 0.2 to 1.0 mg/kg IV every 2 to 3 hours
opts.zh: 0.2–1.0 mg/kg 静脉，每 2–3 小时

why.en: IV is 0.2 to 1.0 mg every 2 to 3 hours, after the consultation. The 2 to 4 mg range is the oral dose.
why.zh: 静脉是 0.2–1.0 mg，每 2–3 小时一次，而且要先咨询。2–4 mg 是口服剂量。

q.en: How does hydromorphone reduce pain?
q.zh: hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮是怎么止痛的？

opts.en: It binds opiate receptors in the CNS and blocks rising pain signals
opts.zh: 和中枢神经系统的阿片受体结合，挡住上传的痛觉信号

opts.en: It blocks prostaglandin production at the site of injury
opts.zh: 在受伤部位阻断前列腺素的生成

opts.en: It blocks sodium channels in the nerves near the injury
opts.zh: 阻断受伤部位附近神经的钠通道

opts.en: It relaxes the blood vessels so less blood reaches the injury
opts.zh: 让血管放松，流到伤处的血变少

why.en: It binds to opiate receptors in the CNS and inhibits the ascending pain pathways.
why.zh: 它和中枢神经系统的阿片受体结合，抑制上行的痛觉通路。

q.en: After hydromorphone a palliative patient is hard to rouse and breathing very slowly. What comes first?
q.zh: 给了 hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮之后，姑息病人很难叫醒，呼吸非常慢。第一步做什么？

opts.en: Manage the airway and support ventilation
opts.zh: 管好气道，辅助通气

opts.en: Give a large dose of naloxone at once
opts.zh: 马上给大剂量 naloxone 纳洛酮

opts.en: Give oral glucose and recheck later
opts.zh: 给 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖，过一会儿再查

opts.en: Lay the patient flat and wait for it to pass
opts.zh: 让病人平躺，等它自己过去

why.en: Airway management and ventilatory support come first. Naloxone is considered next, and used judiciously in long-term opioid patients.
why.zh: 先管气道、辅助通气。然后再考虑 naloxone 纳洛酮，长期用阿片类药的病人要谨慎使用。

bcehs.name: Lidocaine

cls.en: Class IB antiarrhythmic and local anesthetic
cls.zh: IB 类抗心律失常药、局部麻醉药

hook.en: Numbs the bone marrow so an IO infusion does not hurt.
hook.zh: 把骨髓腔麻住，骨内输液就不痛了。

how.en: Lidocaine blocks sodium channels. Nerves need those channels to send a signal, so the pain message from the marrow never leaves. The same action on heart cells is why it is also an antiarrhythmic.
how.zh: lidocaine 利多卡因阻断钠通道。神经要靠钠通道才能发出信号，所以骨髓腔里的痛觉信号根本传不出去。它对心肌细胞也有同样的作用，所以它也是抗心律失常药。

use.en: Local anesthetic during adult intraosseous cannulation (12 years old and greater), in conscious patients. PCP: ONLY under the direction of an on-scene ACP or higher.
use.zh: 成人（12 岁及以上）清醒病人骨内通路的局部麻醉。PCP：只能在现场 ACP 或更高级别人员的指示下使用。

no.en: Allergy or hypersensitivity to lidocaine
no.zh: 对 lidocaine 利多卡因过敏或超敏

no.en: Third-degree AV block
no.zh: 三度房室传导阻滞

no.en: Ventricular escape rhythms
no.zh: 室性逸搏心律

no.en: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome
no.zh: Wolff-Parkinson-White 综合征（预激综合征）

care.en: In congestive heart failure, consider alternative agents, and a CliniCall consultation is recommended.
care.zh: 充血性心力衰竭的病人要考虑换别的药，并建议咨询 CliniCall。

care.en: The risk of lidocaine toxicity is higher in patients taking cimetidine, ranitidine or beta blockers.
care.zh: 正在用 cimetidine 西咪替丁、ranitidine 雷尼替丁或 β 受体阻滞剂的病人，lidocaine 利多卡因中毒的风险更高。

care.en: In patients taking disopyramide it may cause bradycardia that can progress to cardiac arrest.
care.zh: 正在用 disopyramide 丙吡胺的病人，可能出现心动过缓，并发展成心脏骤停。

care.en: Care for an overdose is mainly supportive.
care.zh: 过量时以支持治疗为主。

dose.en: PCP: ONLY under the direction of an on-scene ACP or higher
dose.zh: PCP：只能在现场 ACP 或更高级别人员的指示下给

dose.en: IO local anesthesia in a conscious patient, 12 years old and greater: 40 mg
dose.zh: 清醒病人（12 岁及以上）骨内通路局部麻醉：40 mg

dose.en: Instill it slowly over 120 seconds through the extension, then let it dwell in the bone marrow cavity for 60 seconds
dose.zh: 经延长管缓慢注入，用 120 秒，然后让药在骨髓腔里停留 60 秒

dose.en: Then flush the IO slowly with 5 to 10 mL of normal saline
dose.zh: 之后用 5–10 mL 生理盐水缓慢冲洗骨内通路

dose.en: The prefilled syringe is 2%, which is 20 mg/mL, so 40 mg is 2 mL
dose.zh: 预充注射器是 2%，也就是 20 mg/mL，所以 40 mg 是 2 mL

dose.en: Under 12 years: BCEHS: ACP and above
dose.zh: 12 岁以下：BCEHS：ACP 及以上

fx.zh: 头晕、头重脚轻、嗜睡、口齿不清

fx.en: Paresthesia, particularly in the fingers or lips
fx.zh: 感觉异常，手指或嘴唇尤其明显

pk.en: By the IO route it works in 1 to 4 minutes, peaks at 5 to 10 minutes and lasts 20 minutes.
pk.zh: 骨内给药 1–4 分钟起效，5–10 分钟达峰，维持 20 分钟。

pearl.en: Slow is the whole technique: 120 seconds in, 60 seconds of dwell, then a slow flush. And a PCP gives it only when an ACP or higher on scene directs it.
pearl.zh: 整个技术就是一个「慢」字：120 秒注入，停留 60 秒，再慢慢冲管。而且只有现场的 ACP 或更高级别人员下了指示，PCP 才能给。

bcehs.src: BCEHS Clinical Practice Guidelines: Lidocaine drug monograph

stem.en: Brenda, 58, awake, septic, no veins. The on-scene ACP has a tibial IO in and tells you to give lidocaine before the flush. Sinus tachycardia, no allergies.
stem.zh: Brenda，58 岁，清醒，脓毒症，找不到静脉。现场的 ACP 已在胫骨建好骨内通路，让你在冲管前先给 lidocaine 利多卡因。窦性心动过速，无过敏史。

why.en: A conscious adult with an IO, an on-scene ACP directing you, and no contraindication. Give 40 mg slowly, over 120 seconds.
why.zh: 清醒的成人，有骨内通路，现场的 ACP 在指示你，又没有禁忌。缓慢给 40 mg，用 120 秒。

bad.en: The flush goes into the marrow of an awake patient with no anesthetic, and she feels all of it.
bad.zh: 没打麻药就往清醒病人的骨髓腔里冲液体，她会一点不落地全感觉到。

stem.en: Colin, 61, has a tibial IO placed at a rural clinic and groans with every flush. Your crew is two PCPs. An ACP is on the phone, 30 minutes out.
stem.zh: Colin，61 岁，在乡村诊所建了胫骨骨内通路，每次冲管都痛得直哼。你们车组是两名 PCP。一位 ACP 在电话上，还要 30 分钟才到。

why.en: A PCP gives lidocaine only under the direction of an on-scene ACP or higher. An ACP on the phone is not on scene.
why.zh: PCP 只能在现场 ACP 或更高级别人员的指示下给 lidocaine 利多卡因。电话里的 ACP 不算在现场。

bad.en: You give a cardiac drug outside your authorization, with nobody on scene who can manage a toxic reaction.
bad.zh: 你越权给了一个作用于心脏的药，现场又没有人能处理中毒反应。

stem.en: Irene, 74, awake, HR 34. The monitor shows third-degree AV block. The on-scene ACP has an IO in and, busy with pacing pads, asks you for the lidocaine.
stem.zh: Irene，74 岁，清醒，心率 34。监护仪显示三度房室传导阻滞。现场的 ACP 已建好骨内通路，正忙着贴起搏电极片，叫你拿 lidocaine 利多卡因。

why.en: Third-degree AV block is a contraindication to IO lidocaine. Say so out loud to the ACP before anything is drawn up.
why.zh: 三度房室传导阻滞是骨内给 lidocaine 利多卡因的禁忌。抽药之前，先大声告诉 ACP。

bad.en: Lidocaine can cause cardiac arrhythmias, and her slow rhythm is the only one she has.
bad.zh: lidocaine 利多卡因可能引起心律失常，而她只剩这一个慢心律在撑着。

stem.en: Omar, 45, awake, humeral IO in place. The on-scene ACP directs lidocaine. You have just finished instilling 40 mg over 120 seconds.
stem.zh: Omar，45 岁，清醒，肱骨骨内通路已建好。现场的 ACP 指示给 lidocaine 利多卡因。你刚用 120 秒注完 40 mg。

ask.en: What next?

opts.en: Let it dwell 60 seconds, then flush slowly with 5 to 10 mL saline
opts.zh: 停留 60 秒，再用 5–10 mL 生理盐水缓慢冲管

opts.en: Flush fast right away with 10 mL saline
opts.zh: 马上用 10 mL 生理盐水快速冲管

opts.en: Give a second 40 mg, then flush at once
opts.zh: 再给 40 mg，然后立刻冲管

why.en: After the slow dose, it dwells in the bone marrow cavity for 60 seconds. Then the IO is flushed slowly with 5 to 10 mL of normal saline.
why.zh: 慢慢注完之后，让药在骨髓腔里停留 60 秒。然后用 5–10 mL 生理盐水缓慢冲洗骨内通路。

s.en: The 40 mg dose is pushed quickly so it numbs faster.
s.zh: 40 mg 要推得快，这样麻得快。

why.en: It is instilled slowly, over 120 seconds.
why.zh: 要缓慢注入，用 120 秒。

s.en: A PCP may give IO lidocaine only when an ACP or higher on scene directs it.
s.zh: 只有现场的 ACP 或更高级别人员下了指示，PCP 才能经骨内通路给 lidocaine 利多卡因。

why.en: The monograph says ONLY under the direction of an on-scene ACP or higher.
why.zh: 专论写的是：只能在现场 ACP 或更高级别人员的指示下。

s.en: A PCP can give lidocaine for ventricular tachycardia.
s.zh: PCP 可以用 lidocaine 利多卡因治疗室性心动过速。

why.en: Control of ventricular arrhythmias is BCEHS: ACP and above.
why.zh: 控制室性心律失常属于 BCEHS：ACP 及以上。

s.en: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome is a contraindication to IO lidocaine.
s.zh: Wolff-Parkinson-White 综合征是骨内给 lidocaine 利多卡因的禁忌。

why.en: It is listed for systemic use, and IO anesthesia counts as systemic.
why.zh: 它列在全身给药的禁忌里，骨内麻醉也算全身给药。

q.en: The dose of lidocaine for IO anesthesia in a conscious adult is…
q.zh: 清醒成人骨内通路麻醉时，lidocaine 利多卡因的剂量是…

opts.en: 40 mg, instilled slowly over 120 seconds
opts.zh: 40 mg，用 120 秒缓慢注入

opts.en: 400 mg, instilled slowly over 120 seconds
opts.zh: 400 mg，用 120 秒缓慢注入

opts.en: 40 mg, pushed fast over 5 seconds
opts.zh: 40 mg，5 秒内快速推完

opts.en: 1 to 1.5 mg/kg as a rapid IV bolus
opts.zh: 1–1.5 mg/kg 静脉快速推注

why.en: 40 mg, instilled slowly over 120 seconds, followed by a dwell of 60 seconds.
why.zh: 40 mg，用 120 秒缓慢注入，之后停留 60 秒。

q.en: How does lidocaine stop the pain of an IO infusion?
q.zh: lidocaine 利多卡因怎么止住骨内输液的痛？

opts.en: It blocks sodium channels, so the nerve cannot fire
opts.zh: 阻断钠通道，神经发不出信号

opts.en: It binds opioid receptors in the bone marrow
opts.zh: 和骨髓里的阿片受体结合

opts.en: It tightens the blood vessels inside the bone
opts.zh: 让骨头里的血管收缩

opts.en: It blocks prostaglandin production in the bone
opts.zh: 阻断骨头里前列腺素的生成

why.en: Lidocaine is a sodium channel blocker.
why.zh: lidocaine 利多卡因是钠通道阻滞剂。

q.en: Which is a listed adverse effect of lidocaine?
q.zh: 下面哪一项是 lidocaine 利多卡因列明的不良反应？

opts.en: Paresthesia in the fingers or lips
opts.zh: 手指或嘴唇感觉异常

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔

opts.en: High blood sugar
opts.zh: 高血糖

opts.en: Hypersalivation
opts.zh: 唾液分泌过多

why.en: Paresthesia, particularly in the fingers or lips, is listed. So are tinnitus and muscle twitching.
why.zh: 专论列了感觉异常，手指或嘴唇尤其明显。耳鸣和肌肉抽动也在列。

home.name: Beta-blockers

cls.zh: β 肾上腺素受体阻滞剂

hook.en: A speed limit for the heart.
hook.zh: 给心脏装了个限速器。

how.en: It blocks the beta receptors that adrenaline uses. The heart beats slower and softer, so it needs less oxygen and blood pressure comes down.
how.zh: 它挡住肾上腺素要用的 β 受体。心跳变慢、变轻，需氧量下降，血压也跟着降。

tells.en: Angina or a previous heart attack

use.en: Lower blood pressure
use.zh: 降血压

use.en: Prevent angina and protect the heart after a heart attack
use.zh: 预防心绞痛，心梗后保护心脏

use.en: Slow a fast, irregular heart (atrial fibrillation)
use.zh: 让又快又乱的心跳慢下来（房颤）

use.en: Long-term treatment of heart failure
use.zh: 心力衰竭的长期治疗

no.en: Very slow heart rate or heart block
no.zh: 心率过慢或房室传导阻滞

no.en: Cardiogenic shock or acutely worsening heart failure
no.zh: 心源性休克或急性加重的心衰

no.en: Severe asthma (especially the non-selective ones like propranolol)
no.zh: 重度哮喘（尤其是 propranolol 普萘洛尔这类非选择性的）

care.en: Diabetes: it hides the shaking and fast pulse that warn of low blood sugar.
care.zh: 糖尿病：它会盖住低血糖的预警信号（发抖、心跳快）。

care.en: Never stop it suddenly: the heart rate and pressure can rebound.
care.zh: 不能突然停药：心率和血压会反弹。

care.en: Asthma and COPD: it can tighten the airways.
care.zh: 哮喘和 COPD：可能让气道收紧。

medic.en: Shock without a fast pulse. A bleeding patient on a beta-blocker can sit at HR 70. Trust the pressure, the skin and the mentation, not the pulse.
medic.zh: 休克了心率也不快。吃 β 阻滞剂的出血病人心率可以一直是 70。看血压、皮肤和意识，别信脉搏。

medic.en: Silent low sugar. Check a glucose on any confused diabetic who takes one.
medic.zh: 低血糖没有预警。吃这类药的糖尿病人只要意识不对，就测血糖。

medic.en: Overdose looks slow and low: bradycardia, hypotension, sometimes low sugar and wheeze.
medic.zh: 过量的样子是又慢又低：心动过缓、低血压，有时还有低血糖和喘鸣。

medic.en: Salbutamol and epinephrine may work less well than you expect.
medic.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 epinephrine 肾上腺素的效果可能不如预期。

pearl.en: If the pulse looks too calm for how sick the patient looks, read the pill bottles.
pearl.zh: 病人看着很重、脉搏却很平静，就去看药瓶。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihypertensive Medications and ch.30 Medications Commonly Prescribed; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Frank, 74, fell off a ladder. Pale, sweaty, belly tender. BP 92/60, HR 68. His bag has metoprolol and ramipril.
stem.zh: Frank，74 岁，从梯子上摔下来。面色苍白、出汗、腹部压痛。血压 92/60，心率 68。药袋里有 metoprolol 美托洛尔和 ramipril 雷米普利。

ask.en: What does a heart rate of 68 tell you?

opts.en: Nothing reassuring: the beta-blocker is hiding the tachycardia of shock
opts.zh: 不能放心：β 阻滞剂把休克该有的心动过速盖住了

opts.en: He is compensating well, so he is stable
opts.zh: 他代偿得很好，所以是稳定的

opts.en: It rules out internal bleeding
opts.zh: 可以排除内出血

why.en: Metoprolol caps the heart rate. Low pressure, pale skin and a tender belly say shock.
why.zh: metoprolol 美托洛尔把心率封顶了。低血压、苍白皮肤、腹部压痛都在说休克。

bad.en: You treat him as stable and he crashes in the ambulance.
bad.zh: 你按稳定病人处理，他在救护车上垮掉。

stem.en: Mei, 67, type 2 diabetic on insulin and bisoprolol. Her son says she is 'just a bit confused'. No shaking, HR 64.
stem.zh: Mei，67 岁，2 型糖尿病，用 insulin 胰岛素和 bisoprolol 比索洛尔。儿子说她「就是有点糊涂」。没发抖，心率 64。

ask.en: Your next move?

opts.en: Check her blood glucose now
opts.zh: 马上测血糖

opts.en: Low sugar is unlikely without shaking or a fast pulse
opts.zh: 没发抖、心跳也不快，不太可能是低血糖

opts.en: Start with a stroke assessment and skip the glucose
opts.zh: 先做卒中评估，不测血糖

why.en: A beta-blocker can hide the shaking and fast pulse that warn of low blood sugar. Confusion may be the only clue.
why.zh: β 阻滞剂可能盖住低血糖的预警信号（发抖、心跳快）。糊涂可能是唯一的线索。

stem.en: You find an empty bottle of propranolol beside a drowsy 19-year-old.
stem.zh: 一个嗜睡的 19 岁病人身边有个空的 propranolol 普萘洛尔药瓶。

ask.en: Which picture do you expect?

opts.en: Slow pulse and low blood pressure
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、血压低

opts.en: Fast pulse and high blood pressure
opts.zh: 脉搏快、血压高

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils and slow breathing only
opts.zh: 只有针尖样瞳孔和呼吸慢

why.en: Beta-blocker overdose is slow and low. Watch the sugar and the airway too.
why.zh: β 阻滞剂过量就是又慢又低。还要留意血糖和气道。

s.en: Drug names ending in -lol are beta-blockers.
s.zh: 药名以 -lol 结尾的是 β 阻滞剂。

why.en: Metoprolol, bisoprolol, atenolol, carvedilol, propranolol.
why.zh: metoprolol 美托洛尔、bisoprolol 比索洛尔、atenolol 阿替洛尔、carvedilol 卡维地洛、propranolol 普萘洛尔都是。

s.en: A normal heart rate rules out shock in a patient on bisoprolol.
s.zh: 吃 bisoprolol 比索洛尔的病人，心率正常就可以排除休克。

why.en: The drug blocks the tachycardia. Look at pressure, skin and mentation.
why.zh: 药把心动过速挡住了。要看血压、皮肤和意识。

s.en: A patient should stop the beta-blocker at once if they feel tired.
s.zh: 病人觉得累就应该马上停掉 β 阻滞剂。

why.en: Stopping suddenly can cause rebound fast heart rate and high pressure.
why.zh: 突然停药会引起心率和血压反弹。

s.en: Beta-blockers can make asthma worse.
s.zh: β 阻滞剂可能让哮喘加重。

why.en: Blocking beta-2 receptors can tighten the airways.
why.zh: 阻断 β2 受体会让气道收紧。

q.en: How does a beta-blocker lower the heart's workload?
q.zh: β 阻滞剂怎样减轻心脏负担？

opts.en: It blocks adrenaline at the beta receptors, slowing and softening the beat
opts.zh: 在 β 受体上挡住肾上腺素，让心跳变慢变轻

opts.en: It removes extra fluid through the kidneys
opts.zh: 通过肾脏排掉多余的水

opts.en: It stops platelets from sticking together
opts.zh: 让血小板不再聚集

opts.en: It widens the airways
