opts.zh: 扩张气道

why.en: Less adrenaline effect means a slower, gentler heartbeat and lower pressure.
why.zh: 肾上腺素的作用小了，心跳更慢更轻，血压下降。

home.name: ACE inhibitors

cls.zh: 血管紧张素转换酶（ACE）抑制剂

hook.en: Cuts the supply of the hormone that squeezes the arteries.
hook.zh: 切断那个让动脉收紧的激素的来源。

how.en: The body turns angiotensin I into angiotensin II, a hormone that tightens the arteries and makes the body hold salt and water. This drug blocks the enzyme that does the converting. The arteries relax, the pressure falls and the heart pushes against less resistance.
how.zh: 身体会把血管紧张素 I 变成血管紧张素 II。后者让动脉收紧，还让身体留住盐和水。这类药挡住负责转换的那个酶。动脉放松，血压下降，心脏泵血的阻力也变小。

use.en: Lower blood pressure
use.zh: 降血压

use.en: Long-term treatment of heart failure
use.zh: 心力衰竭的长期治疗

use.en: Protect the heart after a heart attack
use.zh: 心梗后保护心脏

use.en: Slow kidney damage in diabetes
use.zh: 延缓糖尿病对肾脏的损害

no.en: Angioedema with an ACE inhibitor in the past
no.zh: 以前吃 ACE 抑制剂出现过血管性水肿

no.en: Pregnancy
no.zh: 怀孕

no.en: Narrowing of the arteries to both kidneys
no.zh: 双侧肾动脉狭窄

care.en: Potassium can climb, more so with kidney disease, spironolactone or potassium pills.
care.zh: 血钾可能升高，有肾病、同时吃 spironolactone 螺内酯或补钾药时更明显。

care.en: Vomiting, diarrhea or poor drinking: the pressure can drop and the kidneys can suffer.
care.zh: 呕吐、腹泻或喝水少的时候：血压可能掉下来，肾脏也可能受损。

care.en: The first doses can drop the pressure, especially in a patient already on a water pill.
care.zh: 刚开始吃的几次可能让血压掉得多，已经在吃利尿药的病人更要小心。

fx.en: Angioedema: swelling of the lips, tongue or throat
fx.zh: 血管性水肿：嘴唇、舌头或喉咙肿胀

medic.en: Swollen lips, tongue or throat with no hives and no itch: think ACE inhibitor angioedema. It can start after years on the same pill. The airway is the worry.
medic.zh: 嘴唇、舌头或喉咙肿，却没有荨麻疹也不痒：想到 ACE 抑制剂引起的血管性水肿。同一种药吃了好几年也可能突然出现。要担心的是气道。

medic.en: It adds to nitroglycerin. Both lower the pressure, so check the systolic before every dose.
medic.zh: 它会和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油叠加。两个都降血压，所以每一次给药前都要量收缩压。

medic.en: Dizzy on standing? Check the pressure lying and then sitting. A drop is common on blood pressure pills.
medic.zh: 一站起来就头晕？先躺着量血压，再坐起来量。吃降压药的人血压往下掉很常见。

medic.en: Ask about the kidneys. Kidney trouble plus this pill can mean high potassium. Kidney dysfunction is also a BCEHS contraindication to ibuprofen and ketorolac.
medic.zh: 问一下肾功能。肾不好再加上这类药，可能出现高血钾。另外，肾功能不全是 BCEHS 规定的 ibuprofen 布洛芬和 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌证。

pearl.en: A swollen tongue with no hives in a patient on a '-pril' is the pill until proven otherwise. Years of taking it safely prove nothing.
pearl.zh: 吃「普利」的病人舌头肿了又没有荨麻疹，先当成是药的问题。吃了很多年都没事，并不能排除。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihypertensive Medications and ch.30 Antihypertensive Medications (Table 30-26); standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS and EMALB monographs (nitroglycerin, ibuprofen, ketorolac)

stem.en: Harjit, 61, woke with a swollen tongue and lower lip. No hives, no itch, no new foods. His speech is getting thick. He has taken ramipril for six years.
stem.zh: Harjit，61 岁，醒来发现舌头和下唇肿了。没有荨麻疹，不痒，也没吃新东西。说话越来越含糊。他吃 ramipril 雷米普利已经六年。

ask.en: What is the most likely cause?

opts.en: Angioedema from the ramipril, even after six years
opts.zh: ramipril 雷米普利引起的血管性水肿，哪怕已经吃了六年

opts.en: A food allergy, since drug reactions come in the first week
opts.zh: 食物过敏，因为药物反应只会在第一周出现

opts.en: A dental infection, since the ramipril has been safe for years
opts.zh: 牙齿感染，因为 ramipril 雷米普利这么多年都没事

why.en: ACE inhibitor angioedema can appear after years of use. Swelling of the lips and tongue with no hives and no itch is the typical picture. Watch the airway and go.
why.zh: ACE 抑制剂引起的血管性水肿可以在用药多年后才出现。嘴唇和舌头肿、没有荨麻疹也不痒，就是典型表现。盯住气道，尽快走。

bad.en: You treat it as minor and the tongue keeps swelling while you wait on scene.
bad.zh: 你当成小问题，在现场磨蹭的时候舌头继续肿。

stem.en: Dolores, 78, has crushing chest pain. BP 114/70, HR 84. Her pill organizer holds perindopril and furosemide. Your partner has the nitroglycerin ready.
stem.zh: Dolores，78 岁，胸口压榨样疼痛。血压 114/70，心率 84。药盒里有 perindopril 培哚普利和 furosemide 呋塞米。搭档已经把 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油准备好了。

ask.en: What do her home pills change?
ask.zh: 她在家吃的药会改变什么？

opts.en: Expect a bigger pressure drop, and check the systolic before every dose
opts.zh: 血压可能掉得更多，每次给药前都要量收缩压

opts.en: Nothing, because home pills do not interact with nitroglycerin
opts.zh: 什么都不变，因为家里的药和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油没有相互作用

opts.en: Everything, because nitroglycerin is contraindicated with an ACE inhibitor
opts.zh: 完全不能给，因为吃 ACE 抑制剂的人禁用 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

why.en: Blood pressure pills add to the effect of nitroglycerin. That is a reason to watch, not a contraindication. The systolic is checked before each dose.
why.zh: 降压药会和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的作用叠加。这是要多留意的理由，不是禁忌证。每次给药前都要量收缩压。

bad.en: You stop watching the pressure and she slumps after the second dose.
bad.zh: 你没再盯血压，第二次给药后她瘫软下去。

stem.en: Walter, 82, has had diarrhea for three days. He still takes ramipril and a water pill. Lying: BP 118/70. Sitting up: BP 92/58, grey and dizzy.
stem.zh: Walter，82 岁，腹泻三天。ramipril 雷米普利和利尿药一直照吃。躺着：血压 118/70。坐起来：血压 92/58，脸色发灰、头晕。

ask.en: How do you read this?

opts.en: He is volume depleted and his pills make the drop worse
opts.zh: 他体液不足，吃的药让血压掉得更厉害

opts.en: This is normal at his age, so he can walk out
opts.zh: 这个年纪这样很正常，可以让他自己走出去

opts.en: The ramipril has stopped working and the dose is too low
opts.zh: ramipril 雷米普利失效了，剂量太低

why.en: Fluid loss plus blood pressure pills gives a big drop on sitting up. Keep him flat and move him on the stretcher.
why.zh: 体液丢失再加上降压药，一坐起来血压就大幅下降。让他平躺，用担架搬运。

bad.en: You walk him to the door and he faints in the hallway.
bad.zh: 你扶他走到门口，他在走廊里晕倒。

s.en: A dry cough that will not go away is a classic ACE inhibitor side effect.
s.zh: 一直好不了的干咳是 ACE 抑制剂的典型副作用。

why.en: It is common and harmless. Many patients are switched to an ARB because of it.
why.zh: 很常见，也没有危险。很多病人因为它被换成 ARB。

s.en: ACE inhibitor angioedema only happens in the first week of treatment.
s.zh: ACE 抑制剂引起的血管性水肿只会发生在用药的第一周。

why.en: It can appear months or years after the first dose.
why.zh: 它可以在开始用药几个月甚至几年后才出现。

s.en: Drug names ending in -pril are ACE inhibitors.
s.zh: 药名以 -pril 结尾的是 ACE 抑制剂。

why.en: Ramipril, perindopril, enalapril, lisinopril.
why.zh: ramipril 雷米普利、perindopril 培哚普利、enalapril 依那普利、lisinopril 赖诺普利都是。

s.en: ACE inhibitors lower the potassium level.
s.zh: ACE 抑制剂会让血钾降低。

why.en: They raise it, more so with kidney disease or spironolactone.
why.zh: 它们让血钾升高，有肾病或同时吃 spironolactone 螺内酯时更明显。

q.en: How does an ACE inhibitor lower blood pressure?
q.zh: ACE 抑制剂怎样降血压？

opts.en: It stops angiotensin I becoming angiotensin II, so the arteries relax
opts.zh: 不让血管紧张素 I 变成血管紧张素 II，动脉就放松

opts.en: It blocks beta receptors, so the heart beats slower and softer
opts.zh: 阻断 β 受体，让心跳变慢变轻

opts.en: It blocks calcium channels in the muscle of the artery wall
opts.zh: 阻断动脉壁肌肉上的钙通道

opts.en: It stops platelets from sticking together in the arteries
opts.zh: 让血小板不在动脉里聚集

why.en: Less angiotensin II means relaxed arteries and less salt and water held back.
why.zh: 血管紧张素 II 少了，动脉放松，身体留住的盐和水也少了。

q.en: Which pair of side effects points to an ACE inhibitor?
q.zh: 哪一组副作用指向 ACE 抑制剂？

opts.en: Dry cough and swelling of the lips or tongue
opts.zh: 干咳，嘴唇或舌头肿胀

opts.en: Slow pulse and wheeze
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、喘鸣

opts.en: Swollen ankles and flushing
opts.zh: 脚踝肿、面部潮红

opts.en: Muscle pain and dark urine
opts.zh: 肌肉痛、尿色深

why.en: Cough is the common one. Angioedema is the dangerous one.
why.zh: 干咳是常见的那个。血管性水肿是危险的那个。

home.name: DOACs (direct oral anticoagulants)

cls.zh: 直接口服抗凝药（DOAC）

hook.en: The newer blood thinners. No INR tests needed.
hook.zh: 新一代抗凝药。不用查 INR。

how.en: Each one blocks a single clotting factor directly. Apixaban, rivaroxaban and edoxaban block factor Xa, and the name tells you: 'xa-ban'. Dabigatran blocks thrombin. They start working within hours, wear off much faster than warfarin and need no routine blood tests.
how.zh: 每一种都直接阻断一个凝血因子。apixaban 阿哌沙班、rivaroxaban 利伐沙班和 edoxaban 艾多沙班阻断 Xa 因子，名字里就写着「xa-ban」。dabigatran 达比加群阻断凝血酶。它们几小时内起效，消退比 warfarin 华法林快得多，也不需要常规抽血监测。

tells.en: A clot in a leg vein or in the lung (DVT, PE)
tells.zh: 腿部静脉血栓或肺栓塞（DVT、PE）

tells.en: A recent hip or knee replacement
tells.zh: 最近做过髋关节或膝关节置换

use.en: Prevent stroke in atrial fibrillation
use.zh: 预防房颤引起的卒中

use.en: Treat and prevent clots in the leg veins and lungs
use.zh: 治疗和预防腿部静脉血栓和肺栓塞

use.en: Prevent clots after hip or knee replacement
use.zh: 髋、膝关节置换术后预防血栓

no.en: Active serious bleeding
no.zh: 活动性严重出血

no.en: A mechanical heart valve
no.zh: 机械心脏瓣膜

no.en: Severe kidney failure
no.zh: 严重肾衰竭

noFake.en: A previous clot in the leg

care.en: Kidney disease: the drug leaves the body more slowly and the bleeding risk rises.
care.zh: 肾病：药排出得更慢，出血风险升高。

care.en: The effect fades fast, so missed doses leave the patient unprotected.
care.zh: 药效消退得快，所以漏服就等于没有保护。

care.en: ASA, clopidogrel and NSAIDs add to the bleeding risk.
care.zh: ASA 阿司匹林、clopidogrel 氯吡格雷和 NSAID 会让出血风险叠加。

care.en: Dabigatran has a specific reversal drug, idarucizumab, which is given in hospital.
care.zh: dabigatran 达比加群有专门的逆转药 idarucizumab 依达赛珠单抗，要在医院里给。

fx.en: Blood in the urine or black stools

fx.zh: dabigatran 达比加群：烧心、胃部不适

medic.en: No routine blood test shows how anticoagulated the patient is. Ask when the last dose was taken and tell the hospital.
medic.zh: 没有哪项常规验血能告诉你病人抗凝到什么程度。问清楚最后一次是什么时候吃的，告诉医院。

medic.en: A head injury on a DOAC needs a hospital assessment, however well the patient looks. Bleeding inside the skull can be slow.
medic.zh: 吃 DOAC 的人头部受伤，不管看着多好都需要去医院评估。颅内出血可能很慢。

medic.en: Ketorolac and ibuprofen: BCEHS names apixaban, rivaroxaban, edoxaban and dabigatran as contraindications. The exam monograph lists anticoagulants as a contraindication to ibuprofen.
medic.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸和 ibuprofen 布洛芬：BCEHS 点名把 apixaban 阿哌沙班、rivaroxaban 利伐沙班、edoxaban 艾多沙班和 dabigatran 达比加群列为禁忌证。考试专论也把抗凝药列为 ibuprofen 布洛芬的禁忌证。

medic.en: ASA for chest pain: an anticoagulant is a caution on the exam, not a contraindication. BCEHS recommends a CliniCall consult.
medic.zh: 胸痛给 ASA 阿司匹林：考试里抗凝药属于慎用，不是禁忌证。BCEHS 建议咨询 CliniCall。

pearl.en: A name ending in '-xaban' means anticoagulated. On the road that means no ketorolac, no ibuprofen, and a firm push to hospital after any head injury.
pearl.zh: 名字以「-xaban」结尾，就是在抗凝。出车时这意味着：不给 ketorolac 酮咯酸，不给 ibuprofen 布洛芬，头部受伤一定要力劝去医院。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Anticoagulants, Fibrinolytics, and Blood Components (direct oral anticoagulants) and ch.30 Anticoagulant Medications; standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS and EMALB monographs (ketorolac, ibuprofen, ASA)

stem.en: Anita, 68, fell hiking near Squamish. Obvious wrist fracture, pain 8/10, no head strike. She takes Eliquis for atrial fibrillation. Your partner draws up ketorolac.
stem.zh: Anita，68 岁，在 Squamish 附近徒步时摔倒。手腕明显骨折，疼痛 8/10，没有撞到头。她因为房颤在吃 Eliquis（apixaban 阿哌沙班）。搭档正在抽 ketorolac 酮咯酸。

ask.en: What do you say?

opts.en: Stop: apixaban is an anticoagulant, a BCEHS contraindication to ketorolac
opts.zh: 停：apixaban 阿哌沙班是抗凝药，是 BCEHS 规定的 ketorolac 酮咯酸禁忌证

opts.en: Go ahead: apixaban is an antiplatelet, and those are allowed
opts.zh: 给吧：apixaban 阿哌沙班是抗血小板药，那一类是允许的

opts.en: Go ahead: the anticoagulant rule only applies to warfarin
opts.zh: 给吧：抗凝药那条规定只针对 warfarin 华法林

why.en: The BCEHS ketorolac monograph names apixaban among the anticoagulants that are a contraindication. Choose another analgesic.
why.zh: BCEHS 的 ketorolac 酮咯酸专论点名把 apixaban 阿哌沙班列在属于禁忌证的抗凝药里。换一种止痛药。

bad.en: You add an NSAID to an anticoagulant and raise her risk of bleeding.
bad.zh: 你在抗凝药上又加了 NSAID，让她的出血风险更高。

stem.en: Dennis, 74, feels light-headed at a community centre in Langley. He says his heartbeat is irregular. His only pill is rivaroxaban.
stem.zh: Dennis，74 岁，在 Langley 的社区中心感到头重脚轻。他说自己心跳不规则。他唯一在吃的药是 rivaroxaban 利伐沙班。

ask.en: Why is he most likely taking it?
ask.zh: 他吃这个药最可能的原因是什么？

opts.en: To prevent a stroke caused by atrial fibrillation
opts.zh: 预防房颤引起的卒中

opts.en: To slow his heart rate in atrial fibrillation
opts.zh: 房颤时减慢心率

opts.en: To bring his heart back to a regular rhythm
opts.zh: 让心脏恢复规则的节律

why.en: A DOAC does nothing to the rate or the rhythm. It stops clots from forming in a fibrillating atrium and travelling to the brain.
why.zh: DOAC 对心率和节律都没有作用。它是防止颤动的心房里长出血栓、再跑到脑子里去。

stem.en: Bernard, 79, fell on the Skytrain platform at Metrotown. His forehead cut is soaking through the gauze. GCS 15. He takes dabigatran.
stem.zh: Bernard，79 岁，在 Metrotown 的 Skytrain 站台上跌倒。额头的伤口把纱布都渗透了。GCS 15。他在吃 dabigatran 达比加群。

ask.en: What extra information does the hospital need from you?
ask.zh: 医院还需要你提供什么信息？

opts.en: The name of the drug and the time of his last dose
opts.zh: 药名，以及他最后一次吃药的时间

opts.en: The result of his most recent INR test
opts.zh: 他最近一次 INR 的结果

opts.en: How many leafy vegetables he ate this week
opts.zh: 他这周吃了多少绿叶蔬菜

why.en: DOACs are not followed with the INR. The time of the last dose tells the hospital how much effect is left. Dabigatran also has a reversal drug.
why.zh: DOAC 不靠 INR 监测。最后一次吃药的时间能让医院知道还剩多少药效。dabigatran 达比加群还有逆转药。

s.en: Apixaban and rivaroxaban block clotting factor Xa.
s.zh: apixaban 阿哌沙班和 rivaroxaban 利伐沙班阻断凝血因子 Xa。

why.en: The '-xaban' ending says so.
why.zh: 「-xaban」这个词尾就是这个意思。

s.en: Patients on a DOAC need regular INR tests.
s.zh: 吃 DOAC 的病人需要定期查 INR。

why.en: That is warfarin. A DOAC needs no routine INR checks.
why.zh: 那是 warfarin 华法林。DOAC 不需要常规查 INR。

s.en: Dabigatran has a specific reversal drug that hospitals can give.
s.zh: dabigatran 达比加群有专门的逆转药，医院可以给。

why.en: It is called idarucizumab.
why.zh: 它叫 idarucizumab 依达赛珠单抗。

s.en: A DOAC is the standard anticoagulant for a mechanical heart valve.
s.zh: DOAC 是机械心脏瓣膜的标准抗凝药。

why.en: Mechanical valves need warfarin.
why.zh: 机械瓣膜要用 warfarin 华法林。

q.en: What makes a DOAC 'direct'?
q.zh: DOAC 的「直接」是什么意思？

opts.en: It blocks one clotting factor itself, factor Xa or thrombin
opts.zh: 它自己直接阻断一个凝血因子：Xa 因子或凝血酶

opts.en: It blocks vitamin K in the liver
opts.zh: 它在肝脏里挡住维生素 K

opts.en: It stops platelets from sticking together
opts.zh: 它不让血小板互相黏住

opts.en: It dissolves clots as soon as it touches them
opts.zh: 它一碰到血栓就把血栓溶解

why.en: Warfarin works indirectly through vitamin K. A DOAC acts on the clotting factor itself.
why.zh: warfarin 华法林是通过维生素 K 间接起作用。DOAC 直接作用在凝血因子上。

home.name: Insulin

cls.zh: 胰腺激素（注射用降糖药）

hook.en: The key that lets sugar into the cells.
hook.zh: 让糖进入细胞的那把钥匙。

how.en: Insulin moves sugar out of the blood and into the cells. People with type 1 diabetes make none, so they inject it to stay alive. Too much insulin for the food eaten drops the blood sugar.
how.zh: 胰岛素把糖从血里送进细胞。1 型糖尿病人自己一点都造不出来，要靠注射活命。胰岛素比吃进去的食物多，血糖就掉下去。

tells.en: Type 2 diabetes that pills no longer control
tells.zh: 口服药已经控制不住的 2 型糖尿病

use.en: Replace the insulin the body cannot make (type 1 diabetes)
use.zh: 替代身体造不出来的胰岛素（1 型糖尿病）

use.en: Lower blood sugar when pills are not enough (type 2 diabetes)
use.zh: 口服药不够时降血糖（2 型糖尿病）

use.en: Control blood sugar during pregnancy
use.zh: 控制孕期血糖

use.en: Treat diabetic ketoacidosis in hospital
use.zh: 在医院里治疗糖尿病酮症酸中毒

no.en: Low blood sugar at the time of the dose
no.zh: 打针时血糖已经偏低

no.en: Allergy to that insulin product
no.zh: 对该胰岛素制剂过敏

noFake.zh: 同时在吃 metformin 二甲双胍

care.en: Insulin without food is the usual cause of a low: a missed meal, vomiting, or extra exercise.
care.zh: 打了胰岛素却没吃够，是低血糖最常见的原因：没吃饭、呕吐、或运动量加大。

care.en: Alcohol makes lows more likely and harder to notice.
care.zh: 喝酒让低血糖更容易发生，也更难察觉。

care.en: Sick days: a type 1 diabetic who stops insulin because they are not eating can slide into ketoacidosis.
care.zh: 生病的日子：1 型糖尿病人因为吃不下就停胰岛素，可能滑进酮症酸中毒。

care.en: A beta-blocker can hide the warning signs of a low.
care.zh: β 阻滞剂会盖住低血糖的预警信号。

fx.en: Hypoglycemia: sweating, shaking, confusion, seizure, coma
fx.zh: 低血糖：出汗、发抖、糊涂、抽搐、昏迷

fx.en: Lumps under the skin where it is injected

medic.en: Most diabetic lows you meet are insulin lows. Any diabetic who is confused, combative, seizing or unresponsive gets a glucose check first.
medic.zh: 你遇到的糖尿病低血糖，大多是胰岛素引起的。糖尿病人只要糊涂、躁动、抽搐或叫不醒，先测血糖。

medic.en: Treat by the airway. Awake and swallowing safely gets oral glucose. Not safe to swallow gets D10W by IV. No IV gets glucagon.
medic.zh: 按气道来选。清醒、能安全吞咽，用 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖。不能安全吞咽，IV 给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖。打不上 IV，用 glucagon 胰高血糖素。

medic.en: Overdose, by mistake or on purpose, causes deep lows that keep returning for hours, longest with long-acting insulin. Recheck the glucose often.
medic.zh: 不管是打错还是故意过量，都会出现很深、几小时内反复出现的低血糖，长效胰岛素拖得最久。要经常复测血糖。

medic.en: The opposite problem: no insulin for days, vomiting, deep fast breathing and a high glucose is diabetic ketoacidosis. Paramedics do not give insulin.
medic.zh: 相反的问题：几天没打胰岛素、呕吐、呼吸又深又快、血糖很高，是糖尿病酮症酸中毒。急救员不给胰岛素。

pearl.en: Insulin plus no breakfast is the most common diabetic emergency you will see. Check the glucose before you build a theory.
pearl.zh: 打了胰岛素又没吃早饭，是你最常见到的糖尿病急症。先测血糖，再去想别的解释。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Medications Affecting the Pancreas and the household medications list (Insulins); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Tyler, 24, type 1 diabetic, had a seizure in a Whistler lift line. Now unresponsive. Glucose 1.6 mmol/L. Two IV attempts have failed in the cold.
stem.zh: Tyler，24 岁，1 型糖尿病，在 Whistler 排队上缆车时抽搐。现在叫不醒。血糖 1.6 mmol/L。天冷，两次 IV 都没打上。

ask.en: Which drug comes next?

opts.en: Glucagon: he is hypoglycemic, has no IV and cannot swallow
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素：他低血糖、没有 IV、不能吞咽

opts.en: Oral glucose gel poured into his mouth
opts.zh: 把 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖凝胶倒进他嘴里

opts.en: His own insulin pen, to steady the sugar
opts.zh: 用他自己的胰岛素笔，把血糖稳住

why.en: Glucagon is for hypoglycemia when IV access has failed and the patient cannot safely take oral glucose.
why.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素用于低血糖、IV 打不上、病人又不能安全使用 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖的时候。

bad.en: Gel in an unresponsive mouth is aspirated. Insulin would push the sugar lower.
bad.zh: 凝胶进了叫不醒的病人嘴里会被误吸。胰岛素会把血糖压得更低。

stem.en: Amy, 19, type 1 diabetic, flu for two days. She stopped her insulin because she is not eating. Vomiting, RR 32 and deep, HR 124, glucose 28 mmol/L.
stem.zh: Amy，19 岁，1 型糖尿病，流感两天。因为吃不下东西，她把胰岛素停了。呕吐，呼吸 32 次/分而且很深，心率 124，血糖 28 mmol/L。

ask.en: What is happening?

opts.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis from stopping her insulin
opts.zh: 停了胰岛素引起的糖尿病酮症酸中毒

opts.en: Hypoglycemia from two days without food
opts.zh: 两天没吃东西引起的低血糖

opts.en: A simple stomach flu that needs only rest
opts.zh: 普通肠胃炎，休息就行

why.en: A type 1 diabetic needs insulin even when not eating. Without it the body burns fat and makes acid. She needs hospital.
why.zh: 1 型糖尿病人不吃饭也需要胰岛素。没有胰岛素，身体就烧脂肪、产酸。她需要去医院。

stem.en: Stan, 52, on insulin, drinks heavily and has not eaten for two days. Glucose 2.0 mmol/L, drowsy. No IV possible. Glucagon was given. No change so far.
stem.zh: Stan，52 岁，打胰岛素，酗酒，两天没吃东西。血糖 2.0 mmol/L，嗜睡。IV 打不上。已经给了 glucagon 胰高血糖素。到现在没有变化。

ask.en: Why might glucagon fail in him?
ask.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素为什么可能对他无效？

opts.en: His liver has little stored sugar left to release
opts.zh: 他的肝脏里没多少储存的糖可以放出来

opts.en: Glucagon only works in type 2 diabetes
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素只对 2 型糖尿病有效

opts.en: Glucagon only works when it is given through an IV
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素只有从 IV 给才有效

why.en: Glucagon works by releasing sugar stored in the liver. The BCEHS monograph says an alcohol-related low is unlikely to respond.
why.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素靠放出肝脏里储存的糖起效。BCEHS 药物专论说，饮酒引起的低血糖对它多半没反应。

s.en: A patient on insulin who skips a meal is at risk of hypoglycemia.
s.zh: 打胰岛素的病人少吃一顿饭，就有低血糖的风险。

why.en: The insulin keeps working whether or not food arrives.
why.zh: 不管有没有吃东西，胰岛素都照样起效。

s.en: A type 1 diabetic who is too sick to eat should stop all insulin.
s.zh: 1 型糖尿病人病得吃不下饭时，应该把胰岛素全停掉。

why.en: With no insulin at all, ketoacidosis follows.
why.zh: 一点胰岛素都没有，接下来就是酮症酸中毒。

s.en: Paramedics treat a high blood sugar with the patient's own insulin.
s.zh: 急救员用病人自己的胰岛素来处理高血糖。

why.en: Insulin is not a paramedic drug. A sick patient with a high sugar needs hospital.
why.zh: 胰岛素不是急救员用的药。血糖高又病重的病人需要去医院。

s.en: Lantus (insulin glargine) is a long-acting insulin.
s.zh: Lantus（insulin glargine 甘精胰岛素）是长效胰岛素。

why.en: It is a background insulin, usually injected once a day.
why.zh: 它是基础胰岛素，通常一天打一次。

q.en: What does insulin do?
q.zh: 胰岛素是干什么的？

opts.en: It moves sugar from the blood into the cells
opts.zh: 把糖从血里送进细胞

opts.en: It makes the liver release its stored sugar
opts.zh: 让肝脏把储存的糖放出来

opts.en: It makes the kidneys pass sugar into the urine
opts.zh: 让肾脏把糖排进尿里

opts.en: It slows the absorption of food from the gut
opts.zh: 让肠道吸收食物变慢

why.en: Insulin lowers blood sugar by moving it into cells. Releasing liver sugar is the job of glucagon.
why.zh: 胰岛素把糖送进细胞，所以血糖下降。让肝脏放糖是 glucagon 胰高血糖素的工作。

q.en: Which is the most common dangerous effect of insulin?
q.zh: 胰岛素最常见的危险反应是什么？

opts.en: Hypoglycemia
opts.zh: 低血糖

opts.en: High potassium
opts.zh: 高钾

opts.en: Slow heart rate
opts.zh: 心率慢

opts.en: Bleeding
opts.zh: 出血

why.en: Too much insulin for the food eaten drops the sugar. The brain is the first organ to complain.
why.zh: 胰岛素比吃进去的食物多，血糖就掉。最先出问题的是大脑。

home.name: Reliever inhalers (SABA)
home.zh: 急救吸入剂（短效 β2 激动剂）

cls.zh: 短效 β2 受体激动剂（支气管扩张剂，拟交感药）

hook.en: The blue rescue puffer. Opens tight airways in minutes.
hook.zh: 蓝色的急救喷雾。几分钟内打开收紧的气道。

how.en: It stimulates beta-2 receptors in the muscle around the airways. The muscle relaxes and the airway opens within minutes. The effect lasts a few hours. It does nothing for the swelling underneath.
how.zh: 它刺激气道周围肌肉上的 β2 受体。肌肉放松，气道几分钟内打开。效果维持几个小时。它对底下的炎症肿胀不起作用。

tells.zh: COPD（慢性支气管炎或肺气肿）

use.en: Relieve sudden wheeze and a tight chest
use.zh: 缓解突然的喘鸣和胸闷

use.en: Prevent wheeze before exercise
use.zh: 运动前预防喘鸣

use.en: Open the airways during a COPD flare
use.zh: COPD 加重时打开气道

no.en: Known allergy to salbutamol (the only contraindication in both BC monographs)
no.zh: 已知对 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过敏（两份 BC 药物专论里唯一的禁忌）

noFake.en: Having used their own puffer already
noFake.zh: 已经用过自己的急救吸入剂

noFake.en: Using a steroid inhaler as well

care.en: Heart disease: it can speed the heart and bring on palpitations or angina.
care.zh: 心脏病：它会让心跳加快，引起心悸或心绞痛。

care.en: Diabetes: large doses can raise blood sugar.
care.zh: 糖尿病：大剂量会升高血糖。

care.en: Needing it more and more often means the disease is out of control.
care.zh: 用得越来越频繁，说明病情没有控制住。

care.en: A beta-blocker works against it.
care.zh: β 阻滞剂会抵消它的作用。

medic.en: Ventolin is the same drug you carry. Ask how many puffs they took, when, and whether it helped.
medic.zh: Ventolin 和你车上带的是同一种药。问清楚喷了几下、什么时候喷的、有没有用。

medic.en: Puffs taken before you arrive are not a contraindication to your salbutamol. Expect a fast pulse and shaky hands from the start, and keep watching the heart rate.
medic.zh: 你到之前病人自己喷过，不是你给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的禁忌。一开始就会看到脉搏快、手抖，要一直盯着心率。

medic.en: Many puffs with no relief is a sign of a severe attack, not of a broken puffer. A chest that goes quiet is worse than a noisy one.
medic.zh: 喷了很多下都不缓解，说明发作很重，不是喷雾坏了。胸部变安静比有喘鸣声更糟。

medic.en: Technique is often poor. A puffer fired in a panic without a spacer delivers little drug to the lungs.
medic.zh: 很多人用法不对。慌乱中不用储雾罐直接喷，进到肺里的药很少。

pearl.en: Count the puffs. 'I used it ten times and it did nothing' is the history of a dangerous attack.
pearl.zh: 数清楚喷了几下。「我喷了十下都没用」，这就是一次危险发作的病史。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Medications Affecting the Sympathetic Nervous System and Mucokinetic and Bronchodilator Medications; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Jake, 19, asthma, at a hockey rink in Kamloops. Speaking single words, RR 34, HR 128, SpO2 90%. He took about ten puffs of Ventolin with no relief.
stem.zh: Jake，19 岁，哮喘，在 Kamloops 的冰球场。只能一个字一个字地说话，呼吸 34 次/分，心率 128，SpO2 90%。他喷了大约十下 Ventolin，没有缓解。

ask.en: Do you still give salbutamol?
ask.zh: 你还给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇吗？

opts.en: Yes: his own puffs are not a contraindication, and he needs treatment now
opts.zh: 给：他自己喷过不是禁忌，而且他现在就需要治疗

opts.en: No: he has already had the maximum for today
opts.zh: 不给：他今天已经用到上限了

opts.en: No: wait and see if his own puffs start to work
opts.zh: 不给：等等看他自己喷的会不会起效

why.en: The only contraindication in the BC monographs is allergy to salbutamol. It may be repeated as required. Watch his heart rate.
why.zh: BC 药物专论里唯一的禁忌是对 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过敏。可以按需要重复给。盯住他的心率。

bad.en: You wait, he tires, and his breathing fails.
bad.zh: 你在等，他越来越累，最后呼吸衰竭。

stem.en: Chloe, 28, collapsed at a gym in Burnaby. Friends saw her gasping and using a blue puffer again and again. Now drowsy, RR 36, chest almost silent.
stem.zh: Chloe，28 岁，在 Burnaby 的健身房倒下。朋友看到她喘不上气，一遍又一遍地用蓝色喷雾。现在嗜睡，呼吸 36 次/分，胸部几乎听不到声音。

ask.en: How do you read the quiet chest?
ask.zh: 胸部这么安静，说明什么？

opts.en: Very little air is moving: this is life-threatening asthma
opts.zh: 几乎没有气流进出：这是危及生命的哮喘

opts.en: The puffer worked and the wheeze has cleared
opts.zh: 喷雾起效了，喘鸣消失了

opts.en: Asthma is unlikely because there is no wheeze
opts.zh: 没有喘鸣，所以不太像哮喘

why.en: Wheeze needs air flow. A silent chest in a tiring asthmatic means almost no air is moving.
why.zh: 有气流才有喘鸣。越来越累的哮喘病人胸部没声音，说明几乎没有气流了。

stem.en: George, 71, COPD and angina. He used his Ventolin 'all night'. Now shaky hands, palpitations, HR 132, still wheezy.
stem.zh: George，71 岁，COPD 和心绞痛。他「整晚」都在用 Ventolin。现在手抖、心悸，心率 132，还在喘。

ask.en: What explains the pulse and the tremor?
ask.zh: 脉搏快和手抖怎么解释？

opts.en: Salbutamol side effects on top of a hard-working chest
opts.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇的副作用，加上呼吸费力

opts.en: An overdose of a beta-blocker taken by mistake
opts.zh: 误服了过量的 β 阻滞剂

opts.en: An allergic reaction to the salbutamol in the puffer
opts.zh: 对喷雾里的 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过敏

why.en: Tremor and tachycardia are the expected effects of a beta-2 agonist, more so with repeated doses. With his angina, watch for chest pain.
why.zh: 手抖和心动过速是 β2 激动剂的预期反应，反复用药时更明显。他有心绞痛，要留意胸痛。

s.en: Salbutamol treats the inflammation that causes asthma.
s.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇能治疗引起哮喘的炎症。

why.en: It only relaxes airway muscle. The swelling needs a steroid.
why.zh: 它只放松气道肌肉。炎症肿胀要靠激素。

s.en: Tremor and a fast pulse are expected side effects of a reliever inhaler.
s.zh: 手抖和脉搏快是急救吸入剂的预期副作用。

why.en: It stimulates beta receptors, with some effect on the heart.
why.zh: 它刺激 β 受体，对心脏也有一些作用。

s.en: If a patient has already used their own Ventolin, you must not give salbutamol.
s.zh: 病人已经用过自己的 Ventolin，你就不能再给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

why.en: Prior use is not a contraindication. Allergy is.
why.zh: 之前用过不是禁忌。过敏才是。

s.en: Using the reliever more and more often is a warning sign of poor control.
s.zh: 急救吸入剂用得越来越频繁，是病情控制不好的警告信号。

why.en: The airways are staying inflamed between doses.
why.zh: 两次用药之间，气道一直在发炎。

q.en: Which receptor does a reliever inhaler such as salbutamol stimulate?
q.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇这类急救吸入剂刺激的是哪种受体？

opts.en: Beta-2 receptors in the airway muscle
opts.zh: 气道肌肉上的 β2 受体

opts.en: Beta-1 receptors in the heart, to raise output
opts.zh: 心脏上的 β1 受体，用来增加心输出量

opts.en: Muscarinic receptors, which it blocks
opts.zh: 毒蕈碱受体，它起阻断作用

opts.en: Histamine receptors, which it blocks
opts.zh: 组胺受体，它起阻断作用

why.en: Beta-2 stimulation relaxes airway muscle. Blocking muscarinic receptors is how ipratropium works.
why.zh: 刺激 β2 受体让气道肌肉放松。阻断毒蕈碱受体是 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵的作用方式。

home.name: Opioid painkillers

cls.zh: 阿片类镇痛药

hook.en: Strong painkillers that also slow the breathing.
hook.zh: 强效止痛药，同时也会让呼吸变慢。

how.en: Opioids bind to opioid receptors in the brain and spinal cord and turn the pain signal down. The same receptors sit in the breathing centre, so a big dose slows the breathing or stops it. The gut slows too, and the pupils shrink.
how.zh: 阿片类药结合在大脑和脊髓的阿片受体上，把痛觉信号调低。呼吸中枢也有同样的受体，所以剂量大了，呼吸会变慢甚至停止。肠道也会变慢，瞳孔会缩小。

tells.en: Chronic pain, such as back pain or arthritis
tells.zh: 慢性疼痛，比如腰背痛或关节炎
近期做过手术或受过伤

use.en: Relieve moderate to severe pain
use.zh: 缓解中到重度疼痛

use.en: Ease pain and breathlessness at the end of life
use.zh: 减轻临终阶段的疼痛和气促

use.en: Suppress cough (codeine)
use.zh: 止咳（codeine 可待因）

no.en: Severe breathing problems, such as respiratory depression or a severe asthma attack
no.zh: 严重的呼吸问题，比如呼吸抑制或重度哮喘发作

no.en: Bowel obstruction
no.zh: 肠梗阻

no.en: Taking an MAO inhibitor
no.zh: 正在吃 MAO 抑制剂

care.en: With benzodiazepines, gabapentin, pregabalin or alcohol, breathing can slow much more.
care.zh: 和苯二氮䓬类、gabapentin 加巴喷丁、pregabalin 普瑞巴林或酒精一起用，呼吸可能慢得多。

care.en: Older adults and patients with kidney failure are more sensitive, and morphine builds up when the kidneys fail.
care.zh: 老年人和肾衰竭病人更敏感，肾功能不行时 morphine 吗啡会在体内蓄积。

care.en: Tolerance and dependence develop, and stopping suddenly causes withdrawal.
care.zh: 会产生耐受和依赖，突然停药会出现戒断。

care.en: Many tablets also contain acetaminophen, so the daily total adds up fast.
care.zh: 很多药片里还含有 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，所以一天的总量很快就累加上去。

medic.en: Overdose: hard to wake, slow shallow breathing, pinpoint pupils. Open the airway and ventilate first. Then give naloxone.
medic.zh: 过量：叫不醒、呼吸又慢又浅、针尖样瞳孔。先开放气道、通气。然后给 naloxone 纳洛酮。

medic.en: Slow-release tablets and fentanyl patches last longer than naloxone. The patient can wake up, then stop breathing again. Transport and keep watching.
medic.zh: 缓释片和 fentanyl 芬太尼贴剂的作用比 naloxone 纳洛酮持久。病人可能醒过来，然后又不呼吸了。转运，并且一直盯着。

medic.en: Look for patches on the back, chest and upper arms. Heat, such as a fever or a heating pad, speeds up absorption from a patch.
medic.zh: 在后背、胸口和上臂找贴剂。发热或热敷垫这类热源，会让贴剂里的药吸收得更快。

medic.en: Tylenol No. 3 and Percocet contain acetaminophen. Count what the patient already took before you give ours.
medic.zh: Tylenol No. 3 和 Percocet 里都含 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。给我们自己的之前，先把病人已经吃下去的算进去。

pearl.en: Breathing first, naloxone second. When the opioid is long-acting, the patient who wakes up is not yet safe.
pearl.zh: 先管呼吸，再给 naloxone 纳洛酮。如果是长效阿片类，病人醒了也还没安全。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Analgesics and Antagonists, the household medication list (Opioids) and ch.36 Narcotics, Opiates, and Opioids; standard pharmacology; BCEHS and EMALB naloxone and acetaminophen monographs; EMALB Suspected Narcotic Overdose protocol

stem.en: Bill, 71, a cancer patient in Abbotsford, is hard to wake. RR 6, SpO2 84%, pinpoint pupils. His daughter says the fentanyl patch dose was increased yesterday.
stem.zh: Bill，71 岁，Abbotsford 的癌症病人，很难叫醒。呼吸 6 次，SpO2 84%，针尖样瞳孔。女儿说昨天 fentanyl 芬太尼贴剂加了量。

ask.en: What do you do first?

opts.en: Open the airway and ventilate with oxygen
opts.zh: 开放气道，给氧通气

opts.en: Give naloxone before touching the airway
opts.zh: 先给 naloxone 纳洛酮，气道之后再管

opts.en: Peel off the patch and wait for him to wake
opts.zh: 把贴剂撕掉，等他自己醒

why.en: Airway and ventilation come first, then naloxone. For a palliative patient, BCEHS aims to reverse the respiratory depression without interfering with pain control.
why.zh: 气道和通气排第一，然后才是 naloxone 纳洛酮。对安宁疗护的病人，BCEHS 的目标是逆转呼吸抑制，同时不影响止痛。

bad.en: He stays hypoxic while you draw up a drug.
bad.zh: 你在抽药的时候，他一直缺氧。

stem.en: Rosa, 48, took extra slow-release oxycodone for back pain. After naloxone she is awake, breathing 16, and asks you to leave. Her husband agrees she looks fine.
stem.zh: Rosa，48 岁，因为腰背痛多吃了几片缓释 oxycodone 羟考酮。用了 naloxone 纳洛酮后她醒了，呼吸 16 次，叫你们走。她丈夫也觉得她看着没事。

ask.en: Why does she still need the hospital?
ask.zh: 她为什么还是要去医院？

opts.en: Slow-release oxycodone outlasts naloxone, so breathing can fail again
opts.zh: 缓释 oxycodone 羟考酮比 naloxone 纳洛酮持久，呼吸可能再次不行

opts.en: Naloxone harms the liver, so she needs blood tests
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮伤肝，所以她要验血

opts.en: She does not. Awake after naloxone means the overdose is over
opts.zh: 不用去。用了 naloxone 纳洛酮能醒，说明过量已经结束

why.en: BCEHS lists naloxone's duration as 30 to 45 minutes, and the exam monograph gives none. Slow-release oxycodone keeps working for many hours, so she can slide back into respiratory depression.
why.zh: BCEHS 写的 naloxone 纳洛酮作用时间是 30 到 45 分钟，考试用的药物说明没有给出时长。缓释 oxycodone 羟考酮却能持续作用很多个小时，所以她可能又滑回呼吸抑制。

stem.en: Gord, 66, has a sore knee after a fall in Chilliwack. Pain 5/10. He took two Tylenol No. 3 tablets an hour ago 'and they did nothing'.
stem.zh: Gord，66 岁，在 Chilliwack 摔了一跤，膝盖疼。疼痛 5/10。一小时前吃了两片 Tylenol No. 3，「一点用都没有」。

ask.en: What matters before you offer acetaminophen?
ask.zh: 给 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚之前，要注意什么？

opts.en: His tablets already contain acetaminophen, so count it
opts.zh: 他吃的药片里已经有 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，要算进去

opts.en: Codeine cancels acetaminophen, so give a double dose
opts.zh: codeine 可待因会抵消 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，所以给双倍

opts.en: Nothing. Tylenol No. 3 contains no acetaminophen
opts.zh: 不用注意。Tylenol No. 3 里没有 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

why.en: Tylenol No. 3 is codeine plus acetaminophen. Both BC sources say not to give acetaminophen if any was taken in the past 4 hours, from all sources.
why.zh: Tylenol No. 3 就是 codeine 可待因加 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。BC 的两份资料都写明：过去 4 小时内用过 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚（不管什么来源），就不能再给。

s.en: A fentanyl patch can cause an overdose that outlasts a dose of naloxone.
s.zh: fentanyl 芬太尼贴剂引起的过量，可以比一剂 naloxone 纳洛酮的作用更持久。

why.en: The patch keeps releasing drug while the naloxone wears off.
why.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮失效的时候，贴剂还在不断放药。

s.en: Pinpoint pupils with slow breathing call for naloxone before any ventilation.
s.zh: 针尖样瞳孔加呼吸慢，应该先给 naloxone 纳洛酮，再考虑通气。

why.en: Airway and ventilation come first, and naloxone follows.
why.zh: 气道和通气排第一，naloxone 纳洛酮在后。

s.en: Naloxone can throw a long-term opioid patient into withdrawal.
s.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮可能让长期用阿片类的病人进入戒断。

why.en: Both BC monographs warn about withdrawal symptoms and combativeness.
why.zh: BC 的两份药物说明都提醒会出现戒断症状和躁动。

s.en: Opioid tablets from a pharmacy are too weak to stop someone's breathing.
s.zh: 药房配的阿片类药片太弱，不会让人停止呼吸。

why.en: Any opioid can, especially with alcohol, a benzodiazepine or in an older patient.
why.zh: 任何阿片类都可以，尤其是加上酒精、苯二氮䓬类，或者病人年纪大。

q.en: Which three findings make up the classic opioid overdose?
q.zh: 典型的阿片过量由哪三项组成？

opts.en: Reduced consciousness, slow shallow breathing, pinpoint pupils
opts.zh: 意识下降、呼吸又慢又浅、针尖样瞳孔

opts.en: Agitation, large pupils, fast pulse
opts.zh: 烦躁、瞳孔大、脉搏快

opts.en: Fever, rigid muscles, confusion
opts.zh: 发热、肌肉强直、意识混乱

opts.en: Dry mouth, flushed skin, trouble passing urine
opts.zh: 口干、皮肤潮红、排尿困难

why.en: Opioids depress the brain and the drive to breathe, and they shrink the pupils.
why.zh: 阿片类抑制大脑和呼吸驱动，还会让瞳孔缩小。

q.en: Why does a large dose of an opioid stop the breathing?
q.zh: 为什么大剂量阿片类会让呼吸停止？

opts.en: It turns down the breathing centre in the brain
opts.zh: 它把大脑里的呼吸中枢调低了

opts.en: It sends the airway muscles into spasm
opts.zh: 它让气道肌肉痉挛

opts.en: It fills the lungs with fluid
opts.zh: 它让肺里充满液体

opts.en: It stops the blood from carrying oxygen
opts.zh: 它让血液没法携带氧气

why.en: Opioid receptors sit in the breathing centre. When they are switched on hard, the rate and depth of breathing both fall.
why.zh: 呼吸中枢里有阿片受体。被强力激活时，呼吸的频率和深度都会下降。

home.name: ED pills (PDE5 inhibitors)

cls.zh: 5 型磷酸二酯酶（PDE5）抑制剂（血管扩张药）

hook.en: Relaxes blood vessels for erections. Dangerous with nitroglycerin.
hook.zh: 放松血管帮助勃起。和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油一起用很危险。

how.en: It blocks an enzyme, PDE5, that normally switches off the 'relax' signal in blood-vessel muscle. Vessels in the penis and in the lungs stay relaxed and fill with blood. Nitroglycerin uses the same signal, so together they can collapse the blood pressure.
how.zh: 血管肌肉里有个「放松」信号，平时由 PDE5 这种酶把它关掉，这类药把酶挡住。阴茎和肺里的血管就一直放松、充血。nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油用的是同一个信号，所以两种药一起用，血压可能直接垮掉。

tells.en: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (women take it too)
tells.zh: 肺动脉高压（女性也会用）
前列腺增生（每天吃 tadalafil 他达拉非）

use.en: Treat erectile dysfunction
use.zh: 治疗勃起功能障碍

use.en: Lower the pressure in the lung arteries
use.zh: 降低肺动脉的压力

use.en: Ease the urinary symptoms of an enlarged prostate (daily tadalafil)
use.zh: 缓解前列腺增生的排尿症状（每天吃 tadalafil 他达拉非）

no.en: Any nitrate: nitroglycerin spray, tablets or patch, or isosorbide
no.zh: 任何硝酸酯类：nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油喷雾、片剂或贴片，或 isosorbide 异山梨酯

no.en: Heart disease so unstable that sex itself is unsafe
no.zh: 心脏病不稳定到连性生活本身都不安全

no.en: Allergy to the drug
no.zh: 对该药过敏

noFake.zh: 每天吃 ASA 阿司匹林

care.en: With an alpha-blocker for the prostate, such as tamsulosin, the pressure can drop on standing.
care.zh: 和治前列腺的 α 阻滞剂（如 tamsulosin 坦索罗辛）一起用，站起来时血压可能下降。

care.en: Other blood pressure medicines add to the fall in pressure.
care.zh: 其他降压药会让血压降得更多。

care.en: An erection that lasts for hours (priapism) is an emergency.
care.zh: 勃起持续好几个小时（阴茎异常勃起）是急症。

care.en: Patients borrow it or buy it online, and do not list it. Ask everyone with chest pain, including women and young men.
care.zh: 有人是借来的或网上买的，不会主动说。每个胸痛的病人都要问，包括女性和年轻男性。

care.en: Exam (EMALB) caution: if the patient has used Viagra at any time in the past, beyond the 24-hour limit, there may be cause for very careful monitoring of the blood pressure.
care.zh: 考试（EMALB）的注意事项：病人过去任何时候用过 Viagra，即使已经超过 24 小时的限制，也可能需要非常小心地监测血压。

fx.zh: 看东西发蓝或模糊（sildenafil 西地那非）

medic.en: Nitroglycerin is contraindicated if the patient used Viagra (sildenafil) or Levitra (vardenafil) in the past 24 hours, or Cialis (tadalafil) in the past 48 hours. EMALB and BCEHS agree.
medic.zh: 病人过去 24 小时内用过 Viagra（sildenafil 西地那非）或 Levitra（vardenafil 伐地那非），或过去 48 小时内用过 Cialis（tadalafil 他达拉非），nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油就是禁忌。EMALB 和 BCEHS 的说法一致。

medic.en: Ask before every first spray, in plain words, and in private if you need to: 'Any Viagra, Cialis, Levitra or a similar pill in the last two days, for erections, the prostate or lung pressure?'
medic.zh: 每次喷第一下之前都要问，用大白话问，必要时避开旁人：「这两天有没有吃过 Viagra、Cialis、Levitra 或同类的药？不管是为了勃起、前列腺还是肺动脉高压。」

medic.en: If the pill falls inside its window, nitroglycerin is out. ASA is not affected. Tell the hospital what was taken and when.
medic.zh: 只要那种药还在它的时间限制之内，nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油就不能用。ASA 阿司匹林不受影响。把吃了什么、什么时候吃的告诉医院。

medic.en: The two together can cause deep hypotension that is hard to reverse.
medic.zh: 两种药一起用，可能引起很深、很难纠正的低血压。

pearl.en: Before the first spray, check the vitals and ask about the pills. Viagra or Levitra 24 hours, Cialis 48.
pearl.zh: 喷第一下之前，除了查生命体征，还要问这类药。Viagra 或 Levitra 是 24 小时，Cialis 是 48 小时。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Medications and the Male Reproductive System; EMALB and BCEHS nitroglycerin monographs; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Gord, 61, crushing chest pain at a curling rink in Kelowna. BP 142/88, HR 88. His own nitro spray is in his pocket. He took Cialis about 30 hours ago.
stem.zh: Gord，61 岁，在 Kelowna 的冰壶馆里胸口压榨样疼痛。血压 142/88，心率 88。口袋里有他自己的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油喷雾。大约 30 小时前吃过 Cialis。

ask.en: Nitroglycerin?
ask.zh: 给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油吗？

opts.en: No: Cialis within the last 48 hours is a contraindication
opts.zh: 不给：48 小时内用过 Cialis 是禁忌

opts.en: Yes: the limit is 24 hours and he is past it
opts.zh: 给：限制是 24 小时，他已经过了

opts.en: Yes, because his pressure is high enough to cope
opts.zh: 给：他的血压够高，扛得住

why.en: Cialis (tadalafil) is the 48-hour one. Viagra and Levitra are 24 hours. A good pressure now does not cancel the rule.
why.zh: Cialis（tadalafil 他达拉非）是 48 小时。Viagra 和 Levitra 是 24 小时。现在血压好看，不等于这条规则可以不管。

bad.en: His pressure collapses and does not come back up.
bad.zh: 他的血压垮掉，而且升不回来。

stem.en: Liz, 49, pulmonary hypertension, chest tightness on the ferry to Nanaimo. BP 124/76, HR 92. Her list: Revatio three times a day, furosemide.
stem.zh: Liz，49 岁，肺动脉高压，在去 Nanaimo 的渡轮上胸闷。血压 124/76，心率 92。用药单：Revatio 每天三次，furosemide 呋塞米。

ask.en: Can she have nitroglycerin?
ask.zh: 她能用 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油吗？

opts.en: No: Revatio is sildenafil, taken within the last 24 hours
opts.zh: 不能：Revatio 就是 sildenafil 西地那非，而且是 24 小时内吃的

opts.en: Yes: the rule only applies to men with erectile dysfunction
opts.zh: 能：这条规则只针对勃起功能障碍的男性

opts.en: Yes: Revatio is a lung drug, not a PDE5 inhibitor
opts.zh: 能：Revatio 是治肺的药，不是 PDE5 抑制剂

why.en: Revatio is sildenafil, the same drug as Viagra. BCEHS writes the rule as Viagra (sildenafil) within 24 hours, and Revatio's own label forbids nitrates. She takes it every day, so she is always inside the window.
why.zh: Revatio 就是 sildenafil 西地那非，和 Viagra 是同一种药。BCEHS 的写法是「Viagra（sildenafil 西地那非）24 小时内」，而 Revatio 自己的说明书也禁止和硝酸酯类同用。她每天都吃，所以永远在这个时间限制之内。

stem.en: Sam, 57, cardiac chest pain, BP 150/90, HR 80. He used Viagra three nights ago. No Cialis, no Levitra.
stem.zh: Sam，57 岁，心源性胸痛，血压 150/90，心率 80。三天前的晚上用过 Viagra。没用过 Cialis，也没用过 Levitra。

ask.en: Does the Viagra stop you giving nitroglycerin?
ask.zh: 用过 Viagra，你就不能给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油了吗？

opts.en: No: it is beyond 24 hours, but monitor his pressure very carefully
opts.zh: 可以给：已经超过 24 小时，但要非常小心地监测血压

opts.en: Yes: any Viagra in the past week is a contraindication
opts.zh: 不能给：过去一周内用过 Viagra 就是禁忌

opts.en: Yes: the limit for Viagra is 48 hours
opts.zh: 不能给：Viagra 的限制是 48 小时

why.en: Viagra is a 24-hour contraindication. The exam (EMALB) adds that past Viagra use, even beyond the limit, may be cause for very careful blood pressure monitoring.
why.zh: Viagra 的禁忌期是 24 小时。考试（EMALB）还说，以前用过 Viagra，即使超过了这个限制，也可能需要非常小心地监测血压。

s.en: Drug names ending in -afil are PDE5 inhibitors.
s.zh: 药名以 -afil 结尾的是 PDE5 抑制剂。

why.en: Sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil.
why.zh: sildenafil 西地那非、tadalafil 他达拉非、vardenafil 伐地那非都是。

s.en: The nitroglycerin limit is 48 hours for Viagra and 24 hours for Cialis.
s.zh: nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的限制是：Viagra 48 小时，Cialis 24 小时。

why.en: It is the other way round. Viagra and Levitra 24 hours, Cialis 48 hours.
why.zh: 正好反了。Viagra 和 Levitra 是 24 小时，Cialis 是 48 小时。

s.en: Only men take PDE5 inhibitors.
s.zh: 只有男性才吃 PDE5 抑制剂。

why.en: Sildenafil and tadalafil also treat pulmonary hypertension, in women as well as men.
why.zh: sildenafil 西地那非和 tadalafil 他达拉非也用来治肺动脉高压，男女都用。

s.en: A PDE5 inhibitor together with nitroglycerin can cause severe hypotension.
s.zh: PDE5 抑制剂和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油一起用，可能引起严重低血压。

why.en: Both relax blood vessels through the same signal. The effects add up.
why.zh: 两种药通过同一个信号放松血管。效果会叠加。

q.en: Which pairing matches the nitroglycerin contraindication in the BC sources?
q.zh: 哪一组和 BC 资料里 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的禁忌一致？

opts.en: Viagra or Levitra 24 hours, Cialis 48 hours
opts.zh: Viagra 或 Levitra 24 小时，Cialis 48 小时

opts.en: Viagra or Levitra 48 hours, Cialis 24 hours
opts.zh: Viagra 或 Levitra 48 小时，Cialis 24 小时

opts.en: All three drugs: 24 hours
opts.zh: 三种药都是 24 小时

opts.en: All three drugs: 12 hours
opts.zh: 三种药都是 12 小时

why.en: Cialis (tadalafil) lasts longest in the body, so it gets the longer limit.
why.zh: Cialis（tadalafil 他达拉非）在体内停留最久，所以限制时间更长。

q.en: Why is a PDE5 inhibitor dangerous with nitroglycerin?
q.zh: PDE5 抑制剂和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油一起用为什么危险？

opts.en: Both relax blood vessels by the same pathway, so the pressure can collapse
opts.zh: 两种药走同一条通路放松血管，血压可能垮掉

opts.en: The PDE5 inhibitor blocks nitroglycerin, so the chest pain gets worse
opts.zh: PDE5 抑制剂会挡住 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，胸痛反而加重

opts.en: Together they thin the blood and cause bleeding
opts.zh: 两种药一起会让血变稀，引起出血

opts.en: Together they slow the heart until it stops
opts.zh: 两种药一起会让心跳越来越慢直到停止

why.en: Nitroglycerin raises the 'relax' signal and the PDE5 inhibitor stops it being cleared.
why.zh: nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油把「放松」信号调高，PDE5 抑制剂又不让这个信号被清除。

home.name: Warfarin

cls.zh: 口服抗凝药（维生素 K 拮抗剂）

hook.en: Blocks vitamin K, so the blood clots more slowly.
hook.zh: 挡住维生素 K，血就凝得慢。

how.en: The liver needs vitamin K to make several clotting factors. Warfarin blocks vitamin K, so fewer working factors are made and clots form more slowly. The effect takes days to build and days to fade. The dose is adjusted with a blood test called the INR.
how.zh: 肝脏要靠维生素 K 才能造出好几种凝血因子。warfarin 华法林挡住维生素 K，能用的凝血因子变少，血栓就形成得慢。药效要几天才起来，停药后也要几天才消退。剂量靠一项叫 INR 的血液检查来调整。

tells.en: A past clot in a leg vein or in the lung (DVT, PE)
tells.zh: 得过腿部静脉血栓或肺栓塞（DVT、PE）

use.en: Prevent stroke in atrial fibrillation
use.zh: 预防房颤引起的卒中

use.en: Treat and prevent clots in the leg veins and lungs
use.zh: 治疗和预防腿部静脉血栓和肺栓塞

use.en: Prevent clots on a mechanical heart valve
use.zh: 防止机械心脏瓣膜上长血栓

no.en: Active serious bleeding
no.zh: 活动性严重出血

no.en: Pregnancy
no.zh: 怀孕

no.en: Recent surgery on the brain, spine or eye
no.zh: 近期做过脑、脊柱或眼部手术

care.en: Many drugs change its effect. Antibiotics, amiodarone, ASA and NSAIDs are common causes.
care.zh: 很多药会改变它的作用。常见的有抗生素、amiodarone 胺碘酮、ASA 阿司匹林和 NSAID。

care.en: Big changes in diet matter: leafy green vegetables are rich in vitamin K.
care.zh: 饮食变化大也有影响：绿叶蔬菜富含维生素 K。

care.en: Falls: an older adult on warfarin who hits their head can bleed slowly inside the skull.
care.zh: 跌倒：吃 warfarin 华法林的老人撞到头，颅内可能慢慢出血。

fx.en: Blood in the urine or black stools

medic.en: A head injury on warfarin needs a hospital assessment, however well the patient looks. Bleeding inside the skull can be slow and show up hours later.
medic.zh: 吃 warfarin 华法林的人头部受伤，不管看着多好都需要去医院评估。颅内出血可能很慢，几个小时后才表现出来。

medic.en: Ketorolac and ibuprofen: use of an anticoagulant is a BCEHS contraindication to both. The exam monograph lists anticoagulants as a contraindication to ibuprofen.
medic.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸和 ibuprofen 布洛芬：在用抗凝药是 BCEHS 规定的禁忌证，两种药都是。考试专论也把抗凝药列为 ibuprofen 布洛芬的禁忌证。

medic.en: ASA for chest pain: an anticoagulant is a caution on the exam, not a contraindication. BCEHS recommends a CliniCall consult to weigh the bleeding risk against the benefit.
medic.zh: 胸痛给 ASA 阿司匹林：考试里抗凝药属于慎用，不是禁忌证。BCEHS 建议咨询 CliniCall，权衡出血风险和获益。

medic.en: BCEHS notes that dexamethasone raises the INR and the bleeding risk with warfarin.
medic.zh: BCEHS 提到，dexamethasone 地塞米松会让吃 warfarin 华法林的人 INR 升高、出血风险增加。

pearl.en: Warfarin plus a knock on the head means a hospital assessment, even if the patient is chatting and wants to stay home. Ask for the last INR result.
pearl.zh: 吃 warfarin 华法林又撞到头，就需要去医院评估，哪怕病人有说有笑、只想留在家里。问一下最近一次 INR 的结果。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Anticoagulants, Fibrinolytics, and Blood Components and ch.30 Anticoagulant Medications; standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS and EMALB monographs (ketorolac, ibuprofen, ASA, dexamethasone)

stem.en: Mabel, 84, slipped in her kitchen in Kerrisdale and hit her head on the counter. Small bruise, GCS 15, wants to stay home. She takes warfarin for a mechanical valve.
stem.zh: Mabel，84 岁，在 Kerrisdale 家里的厨房滑倒，头撞到台面。有一小块瘀青，GCS 15，想留在家里。她因为换了机械瓣膜在吃 warfarin 华法林。

ask.en: What do you tell her?

opts.en: She should be assessed in hospital, because bleeding in the head can be slow on warfarin
opts.zh: 她应该去医院评估，因为吃 warfarin 华法林的人颅内出血可能很慢

opts.en: She can stay home, because a GCS of 15 rules out a bleed
opts.zh: 她可以留在家里，因为 GCS 15 就排除了出血

opts.en: She should skip tonight's warfarin and rest in bed
opts.zh: 她今晚别吃 warfarin 华法林，卧床休息就行

why.en: Anticoagulated patients can bleed slowly inside the skull after a minor blow. A normal GCS now does not rule it out.
why.zh: 在抗凝的病人轻轻撞一下，颅内也可能慢慢出血。现在 GCS 正常并不能排除。

bad.en: She stays home, and the bleed shows itself at 3 a.m.
bad.zh: 她留在家里，凌晨 3 点出血才显现出来。

stem.en: Gord, 60, crushed a finger in a boat winch in Prince Rupert. Pain 8/10, bleeding controlled. He takes warfarin for atrial fibrillation.
stem.zh: Gord，60 岁，在 Prince Rupert 被船上的绞盘压伤了手指。疼痛 8/10，出血已经控制住。他因为房颤在吃 warfarin 华法林。

ask.en: Which of your analgesics does the warfarin rule out?
ask.zh: 因为 warfarin 华法林，你车上哪些止痛药不能用？

opts.en: Ketorolac and ibuprofen
opts.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸和 ibuprofen 布洛芬

opts.en: Acetaminophen and Entonox
opts.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚和 Entonox 笑气

opts.en: Methoxyflurane and acetaminophen
opts.zh: methoxyflurane 甲氧氟烷和 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

why.en: Use of an anticoagulant is a BCEHS contraindication to ketorolac and ibuprofen. The exam lists anticoagulants as a contraindication to ibuprofen as well.
why.zh: 在用抗凝药是 BCEHS 规定的 ketorolac 酮咯酸和 ibuprofen 布洛芬的禁忌证。考试里抗凝药同样是 ibuprofen 布洛芬的禁忌证。

stem.en: Leo, 72, has cardiac chest pain at home in Coquitlam. He takes warfarin for atrial fibrillation. No bleeding, no allergy, no asthma, no ASA taken.
stem.zh: Leo，72 岁，在 Coquitlam 家中出现心源性胸痛。他因为房颤在吃 warfarin 华法林。没有出血，不过敏，没有哮喘，还没吃过 ASA 阿司匹林。

ask.en: How does the warfarin affect ASA?
ask.zh: warfarin 华法林对给 ASA 阿司匹林有什么影响？

opts.en: It is a caution, not a contraindication, and BCEHS recommends a CliniCall consult
opts.zh: 属于慎用，不是禁忌证，BCEHS 建议咨询 CliniCall

opts.en: ASA is absolutely contraindicated in any patient on warfarin
opts.zh: 吃 warfarin 华法林的病人绝对禁用 ASA 阿司匹林

opts.en: Warfarin does the same job, so ASA adds nothing
opts.zh: warfarin 华法林的作用一样，所以 ASA 阿司匹林没有额外好处

why.en: The exam lists anticoagulants under cautions for ASA. BCEHS says to balance the bleeding risk against the benefit and recommends a CliniCall consult.
why.zh: 考试把抗凝药列在 ASA 阿司匹林的慎用里。BCEHS 说要权衡出血风险和获益，并建议咨询 CliniCall。

s.en: Vitamin K reverses the effect of warfarin.
s.zh: 维生素 K 可以逆转 warfarin 华法林的作用。

why.en: Warfarin works by blocking vitamin K, so giving vitamin K undoes it.
why.zh: warfarin 华法林靠挡住维生素 K 起作用，所以补维生素 K 就能抵消。

s.en: Warfarin dissolves clots that are already there.
s.zh: warfarin 华法林能溶解已经存在的血栓。

why.en: It only slows the forming of new clot. The body clears the old one.
why.zh: 它只是让新的血栓形成得慢。旧的血栓靠身体自己清除。

s.en: Many antibiotics can make warfarin act more strongly.
s.zh: 很多抗生素会让 warfarin 华法林的作用变强。

why.en: A new prescription is a common reason for a sudden bleed.
why.zh: 新开了一种药，是突然出血的常见原因。

s.en: After a head injury, a patient on warfarin with a normal GCS can safely stay home.
s.zh: 吃 warfarin 华法林的病人头部受伤后，只要 GCS 正常就可以放心留在家里。

why.en: Bleeding inside the skull can be slow. They need assessment.
why.zh: 颅内出血可能很慢。他们需要去医院评估。

q.en: How does warfarin work?
q.zh: warfarin 华法林是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: It blocks vitamin K, so the liver makes fewer working clotting factors
opts.zh: 挡住维生素 K，肝脏造出的有效凝血因子变少

opts.en: It stops platelets from clumping together in the arteries
opts.zh: 不让血小板在动脉里聚集

opts.en: It blocks clotting factor Xa directly in the blood
opts.zh: 在血液里直接阻断凝血因子 Xa

opts.en: It dissolves the fibrin inside an existing clot
opts.zh: 溶解已有血栓里的纤维蛋白

why.en: No vitamin K means fewer clotting factors. That is also why vitamin K is the antidote.
why.zh: 没有维生素 K，凝血因子就少。这也是为什么维生素 K 是解药。

q.en: Which blood test is used to adjust the warfarin dose?
q.zh: 调整 warfarin 华法林剂量靠哪项血液检查？

opts.en: INR
opts.zh: INR（国际标准化比值）

opts.en: Blood glucose
opts.zh: 血糖

opts.en: Troponin
opts.zh: 肌钙蛋白

opts.en: Hemoglobin A1c
opts.zh: 糖化血红蛋白

why.en: The INR measures how slowly the blood clots. A high INR means a high bleeding risk.
why.zh: INR 反映血凝得有多慢。INR 高，出血风险就高。

home.name: Antiplatelets

examples.zh: 双嘧达莫＋阿司匹林（复方）

cls.zh: 抗血小板药

hook.en: Makes platelets less sticky, so arteries stay open.
hook.zh: 让血小板没那么黏，动脉就不容易堵。

how.en: Platelets clump together to plug a damaged vessel. Inside a diseased artery that clump can block the flow. These drugs stop platelets from sticking to each other. ASA and the '-grel' drugs hit different targets on the platelet, so they are often used together.
how.zh: 血小板会聚在一起，堵住破损的血管。但在有病变的动脉里，这一团东西会把血流堵死。这类药不让血小板互相黏住。ASA 阿司匹林和「格雷」类作用在血小板的不同靶点，所以常常一起用。

tells.en: Coronary artery disease or a previous heart attack
A coronary stent (often ASA plus a '-grel' drug)
tells.zh: 放过冠脉支架（常常是 ASA 阿司匹林加一种「格雷」类）

tells.en: Poor circulation in the legs (peripheral artery disease)
tells.zh: 腿部血液循环差（外周动脉疾病）

tellsFake.en: A clot in a leg vein or in the lung (DVT, PE)
tellsFake.zh: 腿部静脉血栓或肺栓塞（DVT、PE）

use.en: Prevent heart attack and stroke in patients with diseased arteries
use.zh: 给动脉有病变的病人预防心梗和卒中

use.en: Keep a coronary stent from clotting
use.zh: 防止冠脉支架里长血栓

use.en: Limit clot growth during a heart attack
use.zh: 心梗时限制血栓继续长大

no.en: Active bleeding, such as a bleeding ulcer or a bleed in the brain
no.zh: 活动性出血，比如溃疡出血或脑出血

no.en: ASA: allergy, or asthma set off by ASA or NSAIDs
no.zh: ASA 阿司匹林：过敏，或由 ASA 阿司匹林、NSAID 诱发的哮喘

no.en: ASA: children and teenagers with a viral illness (Reye's syndrome)
no.zh: ASA 阿司匹林：患病毒感染的儿童和青少年（Reye 综合征）

care.en: Surgery and dental work: bleeding takes longer to stop.
care.zh: 手术和牙科操作：出血要更久才能止住。

care.en: Stopping suddenly after a stent can let the stent clot.
care.zh: 放了支架后突然停药，支架里可能长血栓。

care.en: NSAIDs, anticoagulants and alcohol add to the bleeding risk, mostly in the stomach.
care.zh: NSAID、抗凝药和酒精会增加出血风险，主要是胃出血。

fx.en: Nosebleeds and cuts that keep oozing
fx.zh: 流鼻血，小伤口渗血不止

medic.en: Any trauma bleeds more and longer. Treat a head injury as serious even when the patient looks well, and say 'on antiplatelets' at handover.
medic.zh: 任何外伤都会出血更多、更久。头部受伤就算病人看着没事也要当真，交接时说一句「在吃抗血小板药」。

medic.en: Chest pain: neither source lists clopidogrel or ticagrelor as a contraindication to ASA. Ask what ASA the patient already took. The exam (EMALB) contraindication reads: patient has already taken their recommended Aspirin dose prior to your arrival.
medic.zh: 胸痛：两套标准都没有把 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷或 ticagrelor 替格瑞洛列为 ASA 阿司匹林的禁忌证。问清楚病人自己已经吃了多少 ASA 阿司匹林。考试（EMALB）的禁忌证原文是：病人在你到达之前已经服用了推荐剂量的 ASA 阿司匹林。

medic.en: BCEHS: antiplatelets, alone or together, are not a caution or a contraindication for ketorolac or ibuprofen. Active bleeding is a contraindication. Anticoagulants are a different story.
medic.zh: BCEHS：抗血小板药不管是一种还是两种一起吃，都不是 ketorolac 酮咯酸或 ibuprofen 布洛芬的慎用或禁忌。活动性出血才是禁忌证。抗凝药则完全是另一回事。

medic.en: ASA plus a '-grel' drug is the standard treatment after a coronary stent or a heart attack. Ask what it is for and when.
medic.zh: ASA 阿司匹林加一种「格雷」类，是放冠脉支架或心梗之后的标准治疗。问清楚是为什么吃、从什么时候开始。

pearl.en: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant are different words for different drugs. On the road, clopidogrel does not rule out ketorolac. Apixaban does.
pearl.zh: 抗血小板和抗凝是两个词，指的是两类药。出车时，clopidogrel 氯吡格雷不妨碍用 ketorolac 酮咯酸。apixaban 阿哌沙班就不行。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Anticoagulants, Fibrinolytics, and Blood Components (antiplatelet agents) and ch.30 Antiplatelet Medications; standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS and EMALB ASA monographs and the BCEHS ketorolac monograph and FAQ

stem.en: Sam, 64, twisted his shoulder at a warehouse in Delta. Pain 7/10, no bleeding, no chest pain, healthy kidneys. He takes clopidogrel and ASA since a stent last year.
stem.zh: Sam，64 岁，在 Delta 的仓库里扭伤了肩膀。疼痛 7/10，没有出血，没有胸痛，肾功能正常。去年放了支架后一直吃 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷和 ASA 阿司匹林。

ask.en: On the road (BCEHS), do his pills rule out ketorolac?
ask.zh: 出车时（BCEHS），他吃的药会让 ketorolac 酮咯酸不能用吗？

opts.en: No, antiplatelets are not a caution or a contraindication
opts.zh: 不会，抗血小板药既不是慎用也不是禁忌

opts.en: Yes, any blood thinner is a contraindication to ketorolac
opts.zh: 会，只要是「稀释血液的药」就是 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌证

opts.en: Yes, ketorolac is contraindicated after any coronary stent
opts.zh: 会，放过冠脉支架的人一律禁用 ketorolac 酮咯酸

why.en: BCEHS draws the line at anticoagulants and active bleeding. Clopidogrel and ASA are antiplatelets. Active chest pain would be a caution, and he has none.
why.zh: BCEHS 的界线划在抗凝药和活动性出血上。clopidogrel 氯吡格雷和 ASA 阿司匹林是抗血小板药。正在胸痛才算慎用，而他没有胸痛。

stem.en: Monique, 58, fainted in a pharmacy line in Burnaby and is now alert. Her purse holds ticagrelor and low-dose ASA. Nothing else.
stem.zh: Monique，58 岁，在 Burnaby 的药房排队时晕倒，现在清醒。手袋里有 ticagrelor 替格瑞洛和小剂量 ASA 阿司匹林。没有别的药。

ask.en: What history do you expect?

opts.en: A heart attack or a coronary stent
opts.zh: 得过心梗或放过冠脉支架

opts.en: A clot in a leg vein treated with blood thinners
opts.zh: 腿部静脉血栓，在用抗凝药治疗

opts.en: Atrial fibrillation that needs rate control
opts.zh: 房颤，需要控制心室率

why.en: ASA with a second antiplatelet is the standard treatment after a stent or a heart attack. Ask when it happened.
why.zh: ASA 阿司匹林加第二种抗血小板药，是放支架或心梗之后的标准治疗。问清楚是什么时候的事。

stem.en: Earl, 70, has cardiac chest pain at a curling rink in Kelowna. He takes clopidogrel every day. No ASA today, no allergy, no asthma, no bleeding.
stem.zh: Earl，70 岁，在 Kelowna 的冰壶馆出现心源性胸痛。他每天吃 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷。今天没吃 ASA 阿司匹林，不过敏，没有哮喘，没有出血。

ask.en: Does the clopidogrel stop you giving ASA?
ask.zh: 他在吃 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷，你还能给 ASA 阿司匹林吗？

opts.en: No, clopidogrel is not a contraindication to ASA
opts.zh: 能，clopidogrel 氯吡格雷不是 ASA 阿司匹林的禁忌证

opts.en: Yes, two antiplatelet drugs are never combined
opts.zh: 不能，两种抗血小板药从来不一起用

opts.en: Yes, clopidogrel has already done the job of ASA
opts.zh: 不能，clopidogrel 氯吡格雷已经把 ASA 阿司匹林的活干完了

why.en: Neither source lists clopidogrel as a contraindication to ASA. The two are often prescribed together. He has not had ASA, so he gets it.
why.zh: 两套标准都没有把 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷列为 ASA 阿司匹林的禁忌证。这两种药本来就常常一起开。他还没吃过 ASA 阿司匹林，所以要给。

bad.en: He misses the drug that matters most in a heart attack.
bad.zh: 他错过了心梗时最要紧的那个药。

s.en: Clopidogrel and ASA are often prescribed together after a coronary stent.
s.zh: 放了冠脉支架后，常常同时开 clopidogrel 氯吡格雷和 ASA 阿司匹林。

why.en: The pair keeps platelets from clotting the stent.
why.zh: 两种药一起用，防止血小板在支架里形成血栓。

s.en: Clopidogrel is an anticoagulant, like warfarin.
s.zh: clopidogrel 氯吡格雷和 warfarin 华法林一样，是抗凝药。

why.en: It is an antiplatelet. The rules for your drugs are different.
why.zh: 它是抗血小板药。你车上那些药对它的规定不一样。

s.en: A patient on antiplatelets bruises easily and bleeds longer from small cuts.
s.zh: 吃抗血小板药的病人容易瘀青，小伤口出血时间也更长。

why.en: Platelets are needed for the first plug in any wound.
why.zh: 任何伤口最先堵上去的那一层都要靠血小板。

s.en: Antiplatelet drugs dissolve clots that have already formed.
s.zh: 抗血小板药能溶解已经形成的血栓。

why.en: They only stop more platelets from joining the clot.
why.zh: 它们只是不让更多血小板加进去。

q.en: What do antiplatelet drugs do?
q.zh: 抗血小板药是做什么的？

opts.en: They stop platelets from clumping together
opts.zh: 不让血小板聚在一起

opts.en: They block the clotting factors that need vitamin K
opts.zh: 阻断依赖维生素 K 的凝血因子

opts.en: They dissolve the fibrin in an existing clot
opts.zh: 溶解已有血栓里的纤维蛋白

opts.en: They lower the cholesterol that builds plaque
opts.zh: 降低形成斑块的胆固醇

why.en: No clumping means a smaller chance of a clot blocking a narrowed artery.
why.zh: 血小板不聚集，变窄的动脉被血栓堵住的机会就小了。

q.en: On the road (BCEHS), which home drug is a contraindication to ketorolac?
q.zh: 出车时（BCEHS），哪种家用药是 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌证？

opts.en: Apixaban
opts.zh: apixaban 阿哌沙班

opts.en: Clopidogrel
opts.zh: clopidogrel 氯吡格雷

opts.en: Ticagrelor
opts.zh: ticagrelor 替格瑞洛

opts.en: Low-dose ASA
opts.zh: 小剂量 ASA 阿司匹林

why.en: Apixaban is an anticoagulant. The other three are antiplatelets, which BCEHS does not count as a caution or a contraindication.
why.zh: apixaban 阿哌沙班是抗凝药。另外三种是抗血小板药，BCEHS 不把它们算作慎用或禁忌。

home.name: Loop diuretics

cls.zh: 袢利尿剂

hook.en: The strong water pill. Salt and water out, fast.
hook.zh: 强效利尿药。盐和水很快排出去。

how.en: It blocks salt reabsorption in the loop of Henle, a part of the kidney's filter tube. The salt stays in the urine and water follows it. Blood volume falls, so less fluid backs up into the lungs and legs. Potassium is lost in the urine as well.
how.zh: 它在肾小管的髓袢这一段挡住盐的重吸收。盐留在尿里，水也跟着走。血容量减少，积到肺里和腿上的液体就少了。钾也会随尿丢掉。

tells.en: Swelling from kidney disease or liver cirrhosis
tells.zh: 肾病或肝硬化引起的水肿

use.en: Remove extra fluid in heart failure
use.zh: 排掉心衰时多出来的液体

use.en: Reduce swelling in kidney or liver disease
use.zh: 减轻肾病或肝病引起的水肿

use.en: Sometimes lower blood pressure
use.zh: 有时用来降血压

no.en: No urine output (anuria)
no.zh: 无尿

no.en: Severe dehydration or low blood volume
no.zh: 严重脱水或血容量不足

no.en: Severe low potassium or low sodium
no.zh: 严重低血钾或低血钠

care.en: Digoxin: low potassium from the diuretic makes digoxin toxicity more likely.
care.zh: digoxin 地高辛：利尿药造成的低血钾会让 digoxin 地高辛更容易中毒。

care.en: Vomiting, diarrhea or hot weather: the patient dries out fast.
care.zh: 呕吐、腹泻或天气热：病人很快就会脱水。

care.en: Older adults: dizziness on standing and falls.
care.zh: 老年人：一站起来就头晕，容易跌倒。

fx.en: Ringing in the ears or hearing loss at high doses
fx.zh: 大剂量时耳鸣或听力下降

medic.en: This bottle usually means heart failure. In a breathless patient ask about missed doses, weight gain and how many pillows they sleep on.
medic.zh: 看到这个药瓶，多半是心衰。病人气促时，问有没有漏服、体重有没有增加、睡觉要垫几个枕头。

medic.en: Low potassium shows up as weakness, cramps, palpitations and an irregular pulse. It is more dangerous if the patient also takes digoxin.
medic.zh: 低血钾表现为乏力、抽筋、心悸和脉搏不齐。病人同时吃 digoxin 地高辛的话更危险。

medic.en: The dry patient: a water pill plus vomiting, diarrhea or a heat wave. Expect a low pressure and a drop on sitting up. BCEHS lists uncorrected hypovolemia as a contraindication to nitroglycerin.
medic.zh: 脱水的病人：利尿药再加上呕吐、腹泻或热浪。血压会偏低，一坐起来还会再掉。BCEHS 把未纠正的低血容量列为 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的禁忌证。

medic.en: The exam monograph says to use dexamethasone with caution in heart failure, because it has been associated with fluid retention. BCEHS says to use it with caution in decompensated heart failure.
medic.zh: 考试专论说心衰病人要慎用 dexamethasone 地塞米松，因为它和水钠潴留有关。BCEHS 说失代偿的心衰要慎用。

pearl.en: Furosemide in the bag means heart failure until proven otherwise. Then ask two things: have you missed doses, and has your weight gone up?
pearl.zh: 药袋里有 furosemide 呋塞米，先当成心衰。然后问两件事：有没有漏服？体重有没有增加？

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihypertensive Medications (diuretics) and ch.30 Diuretics (Table 30-25); standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS nitroglycerin monograph and the BCEHS and EMALB dexamethasone monographs

stem.en: Stan, 80, has been short of breath since last night. Crackles in both lungs, swollen ankles. His furosemide ran out two weeks ago and he never refilled it.
stem.zh: Stan，80 岁，从昨晚开始气促。双肺湿啰音，脚踝水肿。他的 furosemide 呋塞米两周前吃完了，一直没去配。

ask.en: What is the most likely story?

opts.en: Heart failure that got worse after he stopped his water pill
opts.zh: 停了利尿药以后心衰加重

opts.en: An asthma attack, because furosemide is an asthma medicine
opts.zh: 哮喘发作，因为 furosemide 呋塞米是治哮喘的药

opts.en: An allergic reaction to the furosemide he used to take
opts.zh: 对以前吃的 furosemide 呋塞米过敏

why.en: Furosemide keeps the fluid of heart failure under control. Without it the fluid backs up into the lungs and the legs.
why.zh: furosemide 呋塞米把心衰的液体控制住。停了药，液体就积到肺里和腿上。

stem.en: Margaret, 77, takes furosemide twice a day and has barely eaten for a week. Leg cramps, weakness, palpitations. Her pulse is irregular.
stem.zh: Margaret，77 岁，每天吃两次 furosemide 呋塞米，这一周几乎没吃东西。腿抽筋、乏力、心悸。脉搏不齐。

ask.en: Which electrolyte problem do you suspect?
ask.zh: 你怀疑哪种电解质问题？

opts.en: Low potassium
opts.zh: 低血钾

opts.en: High potassium
opts.zh: 高血钾

opts.en: High sodium
opts.zh: 高血钠

why.en: Loop diuretics wash potassium out in the urine. Low potassium causes cramps, weakness and rhythm problems.
why.zh: 袢利尿剂让钾随尿排掉。低血钾会引起抽筋、乏力和心律问题。

stem.en: Heat wave in Kamloops. Olga, 83, takes furosemide. Dry mouth, dizzy. Lying: BP 116/70, HR 100. Sitting: BP 90/54 and she nearly faints.
stem.zh: Kamloops 正值热浪。Olga，83 岁，在吃 furosemide 呋塞米。口干、头晕。躺着：血压 116/70，心率 100。坐起来：血压 90/54，差点晕过去。

ask.en: How do you read these vitals?
ask.zh: 这些生命体征你怎么判断？

opts.en: She is volume depleted: the heat and the water pill have dried her out
opts.zh: 她体液不足：天热加上利尿药，把她抽干了

opts.en: Her furosemide dose is too low and she is holding fluid
opts.zh: 她的 furosemide 呋塞米剂量太低，体内积了水

opts.en: The lying pressure is normal, so she can walk to the stretcher
opts.zh: 躺着的血压正常，所以她可以自己走到担架

why.en: A water pill keeps pulling fluid even when the patient is losing it another way. The drop on sitting up gives it away.
why.zh: 就算病人已经在通过别的途径丢水，利尿药还是照样往外排。一坐起来血压就掉，就是证据。

bad.en: You stand her up and she goes down on the patio.
bad.zh: 你让她站起来，她倒在露台上。

s.en: Loop diuretics make the kidneys lose potassium.
s.zh: 袢利尿剂会让肾脏丢钾。

why.en: Potassium follows the salt and water into the urine.
why.zh: 钾跟着盐和水一起进了尿里。

s.en: A patient on furosemide cannot get dehydrated, because the pill only removes extra fluid.
s.zh: 吃 furosemide 呋塞米的病人不会脱水，因为药只排掉多余的液体。

why.en: It removes fluid whether it is extra or not.
why.zh: 不管液体是不是多余的，它都照排。

s.en: Low potassium from a diuretic makes digoxin toxicity more likely.
s.zh: 利尿药引起的低血钾会让 digoxin 地高辛更容易中毒。

why.en: A heart that is short of potassium is more sensitive to digoxin.
why.zh: 缺钾的心脏对 digoxin 地高辛更敏感。

s.en: Furosemide is a weak diuretic used mainly as a gentle blood pressure pill.
s.zh: furosemide 呋塞米是弱效利尿药，主要当作温和的降压药用。

why.en: It is the strong one. The gentle blood pressure pill is a thiazide.
why.zh: 它是强效的那个。温和的降压药是噻嗪类。

q.en: Where does furosemide act?
q.zh: furosemide 呋塞米作用在哪里？

opts.en: In the loop of Henle, where it blocks salt reabsorption
opts.zh: 髓袢，在那里挡住盐的重吸收

opts.en: On the beta receptors of the heart, where it slows the rate
opts.zh: 心脏的 β 受体，在那里减慢心率

opts.en: On the aldosterone receptor, where it saves potassium
opts.zh: 醛固酮受体，在那里保住钾

opts.en: On the bladder muscle, where it forces emptying
opts.zh: 膀胱肌肉，在那里逼膀胱排空

why.en: Salt that is not reabsorbed stays in the urine and takes water with it.
why.zh: 没被重吸收的盐留在尿里，把水也一起带走。

home.name: Metformin

cls.zh: 双胍类（口服降糖药）

hook.en: The first pill for type 2 diabetes.
hook.zh: 2 型糖尿病的第一颗药。

how.en: It makes the liver release less sugar and helps the body respond better to its own insulin. It does not push the pancreas to make more insulin. So on its own it rarely causes low blood sugar.
how.zh: 它让肝脏少放糖，也让身体对自己的胰岛素更敏感。它不逼胰腺多分泌胰岛素，所以单用很少引起低血糖。

tells.zh: 糖尿病前期（有时用来推迟 2 型糖尿病）

use.en: Lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
use.zh: 降低 2 型糖尿病的血糖

use.en: Help the body's own insulin work better
use.zh: 让身体自己的胰岛素更好用

use.en: Work alongside other diabetes drugs when one is not enough
use.zh: 一种药不够时，和其他降糖药一起用

no.en: Severe kidney disease
no.zh: 严重肾病

no.en: Metabolic acidosis, including diabetic ketoacidosis
no.zh: 代谢性酸中毒，包括糖尿病酮症酸中毒

no.en: Severe liver disease or heavy alcohol use
no.zh: 严重肝病或大量饮酒

care.en: The kidneys clear it, so kidney function is checked regularly.
care.zh: 它靠肾脏排出，所以要定期查肾功能。

care.en: It is usually paused during a dehydrating illness, a serious infection, and around X-ray contrast dye.
care.zh: 脱水的病、严重感染、做造影检查前后，通常要暂停。

care.en: Alone it rarely causes low sugar. With insulin or a sulfonylurea, low sugar can happen.
care.zh: 单用很少低血糖。和胰岛素或磺脲类一起用，就可能低血糖。

fx.en: Nausea and diarrhea, mostly in the first weeks
fx.zh: 恶心、腹泻，多在刚开始的几周

fx.en: Belly discomfort and a metallic taste
fx.zh: 腹部不适，嘴里有金属味

fx.en: Low vitamin B12 after years of use
fx.zh: 用了多年后维生素 B12 偏低
乳酸酸中毒（少见，但危险）

medic.en: It almost always means type 2 diabetes, even if the patient says they are healthy. Some younger women take it for polycystic ovary syndrome instead. Check a glucose on anyone confused, weak or 'not right'.
medic.zh: 它几乎总是说明病人有 2 型糖尿病，哪怕他说自己没病。也有些年轻女性是因为多囊卵巢综合征才吃它。只要糊涂、乏力或「不对劲」，就测血糖。

medic.en: Metformin alone rarely causes hypoglycemia. If the sugar is low, look for insulin, a sulfonylurea, missed meals or alcohol.
medic.zh: 单用 metformin 二甲双胍很少低血糖。血糖低了，就去找胰岛素、磺脲类、没吃饭或喝了酒。

medic.en: Lactic acidosis is rare and deadly. Picture a dehydrated patient with weak kidneys: fast deep breathing, vomiting, belly pain, weakness, low pressure.
medic.zh: 乳酸酸中毒少见但要命。典型的样子是脱水、肾又不好的病人：呼吸又快又深、呕吐、腹痛、乏力、血压低。

medic.en: In an overdose the main danger is lactic acidosis, not low sugar. A normal glucose does not mean the patient is fine.
medic.zh: 过量时最主要的危险是乳酸酸中毒，不是低血糖。血糖正常不代表病人没事。

pearl.en: Metformin on the shelf almost always means type 2 diabetes. A low sugar means something else is in the bag: look for insulin or a sulfonylurea.
pearl.zh: 架子上有 metformin 二甲双胍，几乎都是 2 型糖尿病。血糖低，说明药袋里还有别的：去找胰岛素或磺脲类。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Medications Affecting the Pancreas (biguanides) and the household medications list (Oral Antidiabetics); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Linda, 61, slipped on ice in Prince George. Sore wrist only. She says she has no medical problems. Her purse holds metformin.
stem.zh: Linda，61 岁，在 Prince George 的冰上滑倒，只有手腕痛。她说自己没什么病。包里有 metformin 二甲双胍。

ask.en: What do you now know about her history?
ask.zh: 关于她的病史，你现在知道了什么？

opts.en: She very likely has type 2 diabetes
opts.zh: 她很可能有 2 型糖尿病

opts.en: She has type 1 diabetes and needs insulin
opts.zh: 她有 1 型糖尿病，需要胰岛素

opts.en: She has an underactive thyroid
opts.zh: 她有甲状腺功能减退

why.en: Metformin is the usual first drug for type 2 diabetes. Many patients do not count it as a medical problem. Read the bottles.
why.zh: metformin 二甲双胍是 2 型糖尿病最常用的第一种药。很多病人不把它当成「有病」。要看药瓶。

stem.en: Raj, 58, sweaty and confused in his restaurant kitchen in Surrey. Glucose 2.6 mmol/L. He follows commands and can swallow. Bottles: metformin and gliclazide.
stem.zh: Raj，58 岁，在 Surrey 自家餐馆的厨房里出汗、糊涂。血糖 2.6 mmol/L。能听指令，能吞咽。药瓶：metformin 二甲双胍和 gliclazide 格列齐特。

ask.en: What do you give?

opts.en: Oral glucose: he is awake and can protect his airway
opts.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖：他清醒，能保护气道

opts.en: Nothing: metformin cannot cause low sugar, so the meter is wrong
opts.zh: 什么都不给：metformin 二甲双胍不会低血糖，所以是血糖仪错了

opts.en: Glucagon first, because he takes pills and not insulin
opts.zh: 先给 glucagon 胰高血糖素，因为他吃的是药片不是胰岛素

why.en: A low sugar is treated whatever caused it. Awake and swallowing means oral glucose. The likely cause is the gliclazide, not the metformin.
why.zh: 不管什么原因，低血糖都要处理。清醒、能吞咽，就用 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖。原因多半是 gliclazide 格列齐特，不是 metformin 二甲双胍。

bad.en: You doubt the meter and he seizes on the kitchen floor.
bad.zh: 你怀疑血糖仪，结果他在厨房地上抽搐。

stem.en: Walter, 79, three days of vomiting and diarrhea. Weak, breathing fast and deep, RR 30, BP 94/58, glucose 7.2 mmol/L. Takes metformin. Says his kidneys are 'bad'.
stem.zh: Walter，79 岁，上吐下泻三天。乏力，呼吸又快又深，呼吸 30 次/分，血压 94/58，血糖 7.2 mmol/L。吃 metformin 二甲双胍。他说自己的肾「不好」。

ask.en: Which metformin problem fits this picture?
ask.zh: 这个表现符合 metformin 二甲双胍的哪种问题？

opts.en: Lactic acidosis: dehydration and weak kidneys let the drug build up
opts.zh: 乳酸酸中毒：脱水加上肾不好，药在体内蓄积

opts.en: Hypoglycemia: metformin has pushed his sugar too low
opts.zh: 低血糖：metformin 二甲双胍把血糖压得太低

opts.en: No problem: metformin is harmless during any illness
opts.zh: 没问题：生什么病吃 metformin 二甲双胍都无害

why.en: Fast deep breathing in a dry patient with poor kidneys on metformin suggests acidosis. His sugar is normal. He is sick and needs hospital.
why.zh: 脱水、肾不好、吃 metformin 二甲双胍的病人呼吸又快又深，要想到酸中毒。他的血糖是正常的。他病得不轻，需要去医院。

s.en: Metformin on its own often causes hypoglycemia.
s.zh: 单用 metformin 二甲双胍经常引起低血糖。

why.en: It does not raise insulin. Lows come from insulin or a sulfonylurea taken with it.
why.zh: 它不增加胰岛素。低血糖来自同时用的胰岛素或磺脲类。

s.en: Finding metformin tells you the patient probably has type 2 diabetes.
s.zh: 发现 metformin 二甲双胍，说明病人很可能有 2 型糖尿病。

why.en: It is the usual first drug for type 2 diabetes.
why.zh: 它是 2 型糖尿病最常用的第一种药。

s.en: Metformin works by making the pancreas release more insulin.
s.zh: metformin 二甲双胍靠让胰腺多分泌胰岛素来起效。

why.en: That is a sulfonylurea. Metformin acts on the liver and on insulin sensitivity.
why.zh: 那是磺脲类。metformin 二甲双胍作用在肝脏和胰岛素敏感性上。

s.en: Poor kidney function makes metformin more dangerous.
s.zh: 肾功能差会让 metformin 二甲双胍更危险。

why.en: The kidneys clear it. If it builds up, the risk of lactic acidosis rises.
why.zh: 它靠肾脏排出。蓄积起来，乳酸酸中毒的风险就上升。

q.en: How does metformin lower blood sugar?
q.zh: metformin 二甲双胍怎样降血糖？

opts.en: The liver releases less sugar and the body responds better to insulin
opts.zh: 肝脏少放糖，身体对胰岛素更敏感

opts.en: The pancreas is forced to release more insulin
opts.zh: 逼胰腺多分泌胰岛素

opts.en: The kidneys pass extra sugar into the urine
opts.zh: 让肾脏把多余的糖排进尿里

opts.en: It replaces the insulin the body cannot make
opts.zh: 替代身体造不出来的胰岛素

why.en: Less sugar from the liver and better insulin sensitivity. No extra insulin, so little risk of a low.
why.zh: 肝脏少放糖，胰岛素更好用。没有多出来的胰岛素，所以很少低血糖。

q.en: Which rare complication of metformin is the dangerous one?
q.zh: metformin 二甲双胍哪种少见的并发症最危险？

opts.en: Lactic acidosis
opts.zh: 乳酸酸中毒

opts.en: Severe hypoglycemia
opts.zh: 严重低血糖

opts.en: Internal bleeding
opts.zh: 内出血

opts.en: Heart block
opts.zh: 心脏传导阻滞

why.en: It is rare. It shows up in sick, dehydrated patients with poor kidney function.
why.zh: 它很少见。多发生在病重、脱水、肾功能差的病人身上。

home.name: Benzodiazepines and sleeping pills

cls.en: Sedative-hypnotic (benzodiazepines and the related sleeping pills)
cls.zh: 镇静催眠药（苯二氮䓬类及相关的安眠药）

hook.en: They press harder on the brain's own brake pedal.
hook.zh: 把大脑自带的刹车踩得更深。

how.en: GABA is the brain's calming messenger. A benzodiazepine makes GABA work better, so anxiety eases, muscles relax, seizures stop and sleep comes. Zopiclone is not a true benzodiazepine, but it acts on GABA in the same way.
how.zh: GABA 是大脑里负责镇静的信使。苯二氮䓬类让 GABA 的作用更强，于是焦虑减轻、肌肉放松、抽搐停止、睡意上来。zopiclone 佐匹克隆不算真正的苯二氮䓬类，但对 GABA 的作用是一样的。

use.en: Calm anxiety and panic
use.zh: 缓解焦虑和惊恐

use.en: Bring on sleep
use.zh: 帮助入睡

use.en: Stop and prevent seizures
use.zh: 终止和预防癫痫发作

use.en: Ease alcohol withdrawal
use.zh: 减轻酒精戒断症状

no.en: Severe breathing problems or sleep apnea
no.zh: 严重呼吸功能不全或睡眠呼吸暂停

no.en: Myasthenia gravis
no.zh: 重症肌无力

no.en: Acute narrow-angle glaucoma
no.zh: 急性闭角型青光眼

care.en: With opioids or alcohol the sedation stacks up and breathing can stop.
care.zh: 和阿片类或酒精一起用，镇静作用叠加，呼吸可能停止。

care.en: Older adults: confusion, unsteadiness, falls and hip fractures.
care.zh: 老年人：意识混乱、站不稳、跌倒、髋部骨折。

care.en: Long-term use causes dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause seizures.
care.zh: 长期使用会产生依赖，突然停药可能引起抽搐。

care.en: They impair driving and memory.
care.zh: 它们会影响驾驶和记忆。

fx.en: Slow breathing at high doses or with other sedatives
fx.zh: 大剂量或合用其他镇静药时呼吸变慢

medic.en: Overdose on its own: sleepy, slurred and unsteady, usually with decent vitals. Deep coma or slow breathing suggests something else was taken too. Think alcohol and opioids.
medic.zh: 单纯过量：犯困、口齿不清、走不稳，生命体征通常还过得去。深昏迷或呼吸慢，提示很可能还吃了别的。想到酒精和阿片类。

medic.en: Naloxone does not reverse a benzodiazepine. In a mixed overdose it can still reverse the opioid part. Ventilate first either way.
medic.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮逆转不了苯二氮䓬类。混合过量时，它仍然能逆转阿片类那一部分。不管哪种情况，先通气。

medic.en: A sudden stop after long use brings a fast pulse, tremor, confusion and sometimes seizures. Ask if the supply ran out.
medic.zh: 长期用药后突然停掉，会脉搏快、发抖、意识混乱，有时还会抽搐。问一问药是不是吃完了。

medic.en: Our sedating drugs stack on top. BCEHS warns that dimenhydrinate can potentiate benzodiazepines, and Entonox carries a caution with depressant drugs.
medic.zh: 我们带的有镇静作用的药也会叠上去。BCEHS 提醒 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明会增强苯二氮䓬类的作用，Entonox 笑气遇到中枢抑制药也要小心。

pearl.en: A benzodiazepine alone puts people to sleep. With an opioid or alcohol it can stop their breathing.
pearl.zh: 单用苯二氮䓬类只是让人睡着。加上阿片类或酒精，就可能让人停止呼吸。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antianxiety, Sedative, and Hypnotic Medications, the household medication list (Benzodiazepines) and ch.36 Benzodiazepines and Other Sedative-Hypnotics; standard pharmacology; BCEHS and EMALB monographs for naloxone, dimenhydrinate and Entonox

stem.en: Marcus, 41, is unresponsive in a Gastown hotel room. RR 6, SpO2 82%, pinpoint pupils. Empty blister packs of alprazolam. A burnt foil lies beside him.
stem.zh: Marcus，41 岁，在 Gastown 的旅馆房间里叫不醒。呼吸 6 次，SpO2 82%，针尖样瞳孔。旁边有空的 alprazolam 阿普唑仑铝箔板，还有一张烧过的锡纸。

ask.en: What comes first?

opts.en: Open the airway and ventilate, then give naloxone
opts.zh: 开放气道并通气，然后给 naloxone 纳洛酮

opts.en: Skip naloxone because the pills are alprazolam
opts.zh: 药是 alprazolam 阿普唑仑，所以不用给 naloxone 纳洛酮

opts.en: Let him sleep it off because benzodiazepines are safe
opts.zh: 苯二氮䓬类很安全，让他睡一觉就好

why.en: Slow breathing and pinpoint pupils say an opioid is on board too. Ventilation comes first, and naloxone treats the opioid part.
why.zh: 呼吸慢加针尖样瞳孔，说明体内还有阿片类。通气排第一，naloxone 纳洛酮处理的是阿片类那一部分。

bad.en: You trust the blister packs and he stays hypoxic.
bad.zh: 你只信那几板药，他就一直缺氧。

stem.en: Doris, 72, is shaky, sweaty and confused. HR 118. She has taken lorazepam every night for ten years. Her prescription ran out five days ago.
stem.zh: Doris，72 岁，发抖、出汗、意识混乱。心率 118。她每晚吃 lorazepam 劳拉西泮已经十年。五天前处方药吃完了。

ask.en: What is the likely cause?

opts.en: Benzodiazepine withdrawal
opts.zh: 苯二氮䓬类戒断

opts.en: Benzodiazepine overdose
opts.zh: 苯二氮䓬类过量

opts.en: An allergy to lorazepam
opts.zh: 对 lorazepam 劳拉西泮过敏

why.en: Stopping suddenly after long use causes a fast pulse, tremor and confusion. It can end in seizures.
why.zh: 长期用药后突然停掉，会脉搏快、发抖、意识混乱。最后可能抽搐。

stem.en: Henry, 84, fell on the way to the bathroom at 3 a.m. in his Burnaby condo. Hip pain. His doctor started zopiclone last week for sleep.
stem.zh: Henry，84 岁，凌晨 3 点在 Burnaby 的公寓里去厕所的路上跌倒。髋部疼。上周医生为了帮他睡觉开了 zopiclone 佐匹克隆。

ask.en: How does the new pill fit in?
ask.zh: 新加的这个药和这件事有什么关系？

opts.en: Sleeping pills can make older adults unsteady and cause falls
opts.zh: 安眠药可能让老年人站不稳，容易跌倒

opts.en: Zopiclone prevents falls because he sleeps more deeply
opts.zh: zopiclone 佐匹克隆让他睡得更沉，所以能防跌倒

opts.en: Zopiclone has no effect on balance or alertness
opts.zh: zopiclone 佐匹克隆不影响平衡和清醒程度

why.en: Sedative-hypnotics leave older adults drowsy and unsteady, and a night-time fall with a hip fracture is the classic result. Report the new pill.
why.zh: 镇静催眠药会让老年人昏沉、站不稳，夜里跌倒加髋部骨折是最典型的后果。把新加的药报告上去。

s.en: Zopiclone is not a benzodiazepine, but it acts on GABA in the same way.
s.zh: zopiclone 佐匹克隆不是苯二氮䓬类，但对 GABA 的作用方式一样。

why.en: It can cause the same sedation, dependence and withdrawal.
why.zh: 它同样会引起镇静、依赖和戒断。

s.en: Naloxone reverses a lorazepam overdose.
s.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮可以逆转 lorazepam 劳拉西泮过量。

why.en: Naloxone only reverses opioids.
why.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮只能逆转阿片类。

s.en: Stopping a benzodiazepine suddenly after long use can cause seizures.
s.zh: 长期吃苯二氮䓬类后突然停药，可能引起抽搐。

why.en: The brain has adapted to the drug, and withdrawal also brings tremor and a fast pulse.
why.zh: 大脑已经适应了这个药，戒断时还会发抖、脉搏快。

s.en: A benzodiazepine overdose on its own commonly stops the breathing.
s.zh: 单纯苯二氮䓬类过量常常会让呼吸停止。

why.en: Alone it mostly causes drowsiness, so severe respiratory depression suggests alcohol or opioids as well.
why.zh: 单用主要是嗜睡，所以严重呼吸抑制提示还有酒精或阿片类。

q.en: How does a benzodiazepine calm the brain?
q.zh: 苯二氮䓬类是怎样让大脑安静下来的？

opts.en: It makes GABA, the calming messenger, work better
opts.zh: 让负责镇静的信使 GABA 作用更强

opts.en: It blocks the dopamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断多巴胺受体

opts.en: It blocks the reuptake of serotonin
opts.zh: 阻断 5-羟色胺的再摄取

opts.en: It blocks the opioid receptors
opts.zh: 阻断阿片受体

why.en: More GABA effect means slower brain activity: less anxiety, relaxed muscles and sleep.
why.zh: GABA 作用强了，大脑活动就慢下来：焦虑减轻、肌肉放松、容易入睡。

q.en: Which combination with a benzodiazepine is the most dangerous?
q.zh: 苯二氮䓬类和下面哪一样合用最危险？

opts.en: An opioid painkiller or alcohol
opts.zh: 阿片类止痛药或酒精

opts.en: Acetaminophen
opts.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

opts.en: A cholesterol pill
opts.zh: 降胆固醇药

opts.en: A thyroid pill
opts.zh: 甲状腺药

why.en: All three depress the brain. Together they can stop the breathing.
why.zh: 这三样都抑制大脑。合在一起可能让呼吸停止。

home.name: SSRIs and SNRIs
home.zh: SSRI 与 SNRI 抗抑郁药

cls.en: Antidepressant: selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) or serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI)
cls.zh: 抗抑郁药：选择性 5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂（SSRI）或 5-羟色胺和去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂（SNRI）

hook.en: They keep serotonin working longer between brain cells.
hook.zh: 让 5-羟色胺在脑细胞之间多工作一会儿。

how.en: Brain cells talk using serotonin, then pull it back in. An SSRI blocks that return trip, and an SNRI does the same for norepinephrine as well. The effect on mood takes weeks to build.
how.zh: 脑细胞用 5-羟色胺传话，用完再收回去。SSRI 把回收这一步挡住，SNRI 对去甲肾上腺素也做同样的事。情绪上的效果要几周才显出来。

tells.en: Anxiety disorders: panic, obsessive-compulsive disorder, post-traumatic stress
tells.zh: 焦虑类疾病：惊恐障碍、强迫症、创伤后应激障碍
慢性神经痛或纤维肌痛（duloxetine 度洛西汀）

use.en: Treat depression
use.zh: 治疗抑郁症

use.en: Treat anxiety, panic and obsessive-compulsive disorder
use.zh: 治疗焦虑、惊恐和强迫症

use.en: Ease chronic nerve pain (duloxetine)
use.zh: 缓解慢性神经痛（duloxetine 度洛西汀）

no.en: Taking an MAO inhibitor: the mix can cause serotonin syndrome
no.zh: 正在吃 MAO 抑制剂：两者合用可引起 5-羟色胺综合征

no.en: Known long QT interval (citalopram, escitalopram)
no.zh: 已知 QT 间期延长（citalopram 西酞普兰、escitalopram 艾司西酞普兰）

care.en: Another serotonin drug on top, such as tramadol or an MAO inhibitor, raises the risk of serotonin syndrome.
care.zh: 再叠一种升高 5-羟色胺的药，比如 tramadol 曲马多或 MAO 抑制剂，5-羟色胺综合征的风险就上去了。

care.en: Bleeding risk goes up a little, more so with ASA, NSAIDs or blood thinners.
care.zh: 出血风险略有增加，和 ASA 阿司匹林、非甾体抗炎药或抗凝药同用时更明显。

care.en: Older adults: blood sodium can fall, causing confusion, falls or seizures.
care.zh: 老年人：血钠可能下降，引起意识混乱、跌倒或抽搐。

care.en: Never stop suddenly: dizziness, nausea and electric-shock feelings can follow.
care.zh: 不能突然停药：可能会头晕、恶心，还有触电一样的感觉。

fx.en: Raised blood pressure and pulse (venlafaxine, duloxetine)
fx.zh: 血压、脉搏升高（venlafaxine 文拉法辛、duloxetine 度洛西汀）
