medic.en: These bottles say depression or anxiety. Ask gently about self-harm and look for empty bottles of anything else.
medic.zh: 这些药瓶说明病人有抑郁或焦虑。温和地问有没有伤害自己的念头，再看看有没有别的空药瓶。

medic.en: An SSRI overdose alone is often mild, but seizures and rhythm problems can happen. Find out everything that was taken with it.
medic.zh: 单纯 SSRI 过量往往不重，但可能出现抽搐和心律问题。把一起吃下去的东西全问清楚。

medic.en: Serotonin syndrome: agitated, sweaty, hot, fast pulse, tremor or jerking muscles, soon after a new drug or dose change. Cool the hot patient and transport.
medic.zh: 5-羟色胺综合征：烦躁、出汗、体温高、脉搏快、发抖或肌肉抽动，出现在刚加新药或刚调剂量之后。体温高的要降温，然后转运。

medic.en: An older patient who is newly confused or seizing after starting an SSRI: think low sodium. Check a glucose too.
medic.zh: 老年病人开始吃 SSRI 后新出现意识混乱或抽搐：想到低钠。血糖也要测。

pearl.en: An SSRI alone is usually forgiving in overdose. Ask what was taken with it, and ask about self-harm.
pearl.zh: 单纯 SSRI 过量通常不算凶险。问清楚还一起吃了什么，再问有没有伤害自己的念头。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Psychotherapeutic Medications, the household medication list (Antidepressants) and ch.36 Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Jenna, 34, takes sertraline. Her dentist started tramadol yesterday. Tonight she is agitated, sweating and shaking. HR 128, temp 38.9. Her legs jerk when you touch her feet.
stem.zh: Jenna，34 岁，在吃 sertraline 舍曲林。昨天牙医给她开了 tramadol 曲马多。今晚她烦躁、出汗、发抖。心率 128，体温 38.9。你一碰她的脚，她的腿就抽动。

ask.en: What fits best?

opts.en: Serotonin syndrome from the drug combination
opts.zh: 两种药合用引起的 5-羟色胺综合征

opts.en: An opioid overdose from the tramadol
opts.zh: tramadol 曲马多引起的阿片过量

opts.en: A panic attack that needs reassurance only
opts.zh: 惊恐发作，只需要安抚

why.en: Two serotonin-raising drugs, then fever, a fast pulse, sweating and jerky muscles within a day. Cool her and transport.
why.zh: 两种升高 5-羟色胺的药叠在一起，一天之内就发热、脉搏快、出汗、肌肉抽动。给她降温，然后转运。

bad.en: You call it anxiety and her temperature keeps climbing at home.
bad.zh: 你说这是焦虑，她的体温在家里继续往上走。

stem.en: Kayla, 19, in a UBC dorm, says she swallowed 'all my escitalopram' two hours ago. Alert, HR 96, BP 118/74. She feels fine and wants to sleep.
stem.zh: Kayla，19 岁，在 UBC 宿舍，说两小时前把「所有的 escitalopram 艾司西酞普兰」都吞了。清醒，心率 96，血压 118/74。她说没事，只想睡觉。

ask.en: Your plan?

opts.en: Transport, monitor, and ask what else she took
opts.zh: 转运、监测，并问清她还吃了什么

opts.en: Leave her with her roommate since she looks well
opts.zh: 她看着没事，交给室友照看

opts.en: Give naloxone because she wants to sleep
opts.zh: 她想睡觉，所以给 naloxone 纳洛酮

why.en: Looking well early proves nothing: seizures and rhythm problems can come later, and other pills may be involved. She also needs a mental health assessment.
why.zh: 早期看着没事什么也说明不了：抽搐和心律问题可能晚些才来，还可能吃了别的药。她也需要精神健康评估。

stem.en: Arthur, 82, lives in a Victoria care home. Staff started citalopram three weeks ago. Today he is newly confused and had a brief seizure. Glucose is normal.
stem.zh: Arthur，82 岁，住在 Victoria 的护理院。三周前开始吃 citalopram 西酞普兰。今天新出现意识混乱，还短暂抽搐了一次。血糖正常。

ask.en: What could the new medicine have caused?
ask.zh: 新加的药可能造成了什么？

opts.en: Low blood sodium
opts.zh: 低血钠

opts.en: Low blood sugar
opts.zh: 低血糖

opts.en: High blood potassium
opts.zh: 高血钾

why.en: SSRIs can drop the sodium in older adults, which shows as confusion, falls and seizures. Report the new medicine.
why.zh: SSRI 会让老年人的血钠下降，表现就是意识混乱、跌倒和抽搐。把新加的药报告上去。

s.en: An SSRI takes weeks to lift the mood.
s.zh: SSRI 要几周才能改善情绪。

why.en: The side effects come first, and the benefit builds over several weeks.
why.zh: 先来的是副作用，疗效要几周才慢慢出来。

s.en: An SSRI overdose is as dangerous to the heart as a tricyclic overdose.
s.zh: SSRI 过量对心脏的危险和三环类过量一样大。

why.en: SSRIs have a much wider safety margin than tricyclics.
why.zh: SSRI 的安全范围比三环类宽得多。

s.en: Adding tramadol to an SSRI can cause serotonin syndrome.
s.zh: 在 SSRI 的基础上加 tramadol 曲马多，可能引起 5-羟色胺综合征。

why.en: Both raise serotonin activity.
why.zh: 两种药都会增强 5-羟色胺的作用。

s.en: A patient who feels better can stop the SSRI the same day.
s.zh: 病人觉得好了，当天就可以把 SSRI 停掉。

why.en: Stopping suddenly can cause dizziness, nausea and electric-shock feelings, so the dose is tapered.
why.zh: 突然停药可能头晕、恶心，有触电感，所以要慢慢减量。

q.en: What does an SSRI do at the gap between two brain cells?
q.zh: SSRI 在两个脑细胞之间的间隙做了什么？

opts.en: It blocks the reuptake of serotonin, so more stays in the gap
opts.zh: 阻断 5-羟色胺的再摄取，让更多留在间隙里

opts.en: It blocks the dopamine receptors on the next cell
opts.zh: 阻断下一个细胞上的多巴胺受体

opts.en: It stops acetylcholine from being broken down
opts.zh: 阻止乙酰胆碱被分解

opts.en: It makes the adrenal glands release adrenaline
opts.zh: 让肾上腺释放肾上腺素

why.en: Blocking the return trip leaves more serotonin available. An SNRI does the same for norepinephrine too.
why.zh: 把回收挡住，可用的 5-羟色胺就多了。SNRI 对去甲肾上腺素也做同样的事。

home.name: Anti-seizure medicines

cls.zh: 抗惊厥药（抗癫痫药）

hook.en: A volume knob that turns overexcited brain cells down.
hook.zh: 把过度兴奋的脑细胞调小声的旋钮。

how.en: A seizure is brain cells firing too much, all together. These medicines calm the cells in different ways. Some block sodium channels so a cell cannot fire again so fast, and some boost GABA, the brain's own brake.
how.zh: 癫痫发作就是一大片脑细胞同时过度放电。这些药用不同的办法让细胞安静下来。有的挡住钠通道，让细胞没法那么快再放电，有的增强 GABA，也就是大脑自带的刹车。

tells.zh: 癫痫或其他发作性疾病
双相情感障碍（valproic acid 丙戊酸、lamotrigine 拉莫三嗪、carbamazepine 卡马西平）

tells.en: Nerve pain such as trigeminal neuralgia (carbamazepine)
tells.zh: 神经痛，比如三叉神经痛（carbamazepine 卡马西平）
预防偏头痛（topiramate 托吡酯、valproic acid 丙戊酸）

use.en: Prevent seizures
use.zh: 预防癫痫发作

use.en: Steady the mood in bipolar disorder
use.zh: 稳定双相情感障碍的情绪

use.en: Calm nerve pain
use.zh: 缓解神经痛

use.en: Prevent migraine
use.zh: 预防偏头痛

no.en: A previous severe skin reaction to the same medicine or a closely related one
no.zh: 以前吃同一种药或相近的药出现过严重皮肤反应

no.en: Pregnancy (valproic acid): high risk of birth defects
no.zh: 怀孕（valproic acid 丙戊酸）：胎儿畸形风险高

no.en: Liver disease (valproic acid)
no.zh: 肝病（valproic acid 丙戊酸）

care.en: Never stop suddenly: seizures can come back hard, even as status epilepticus.
care.zh: 不能突然停药：发作会卷土重来，甚至变成癫痫持续状态。

care.en: Phenytoin has a narrow safe range: a little too much makes the patient look drunk.
care.zh: phenytoin 苯妥英的安全范围很窄：稍微多一点，病人看起来就像喝醉了。

care.en: Phenytoin and carbamazepine speed up the liver, so birth control pills may work less well.
care.zh: phenytoin 苯妥英和 carbamazepine 卡马西平会让肝脏代谢加快，所以避孕药的效果可能变差。

care.en: Drowsiness adds up with alcohol and other sedating medicines.
care.zh: 和酒精、其他镇静药一起用，困倦会叠加。

fx.zh: 易怒或情绪改变（levetiracetam 左乙拉西坦）
手抖、体重增加（valproic acid 丙戊酸）

medic.en: A known epileptic who seizes: ask about missed doses, illness, poor sleep and alcohol. Missed pills are a common reason.
medic.zh: 已知有癫痫的病人又发作了：问有没有漏服、生病、睡眠不足、喝酒。漏服是很常见的原因。

medic.en: The bottle is not proof of epilepsy. The same pills treat bipolar disorder, nerve pain and migraine. Ask what it is for.
medic.zh: 有药瓶不等于有癫痫。同样的药也治双相情感障碍、神经痛和偏头痛。问清楚是为什么吃的。

medic.en: Too much phenytoin or carbamazepine looks drunk: sleepy, slurred, unsteady, with jerking eyes (nystagmus). Check a glucose anyway.
medic.zh: phenytoin 苯妥英或 carbamazepine 卡马西平过量看着像喝醉：犯困、口齿不清、走不稳、眼球震颤。血糖照样要测。

medic.en: Bring the bottles. The hospital can measure the blood level. The BCEHS dexamethasone and hydrocortisone monographs say they may decrease the phenytoin level. The exam dexamethasone monograph does not mention it.
medic.zh: 把药瓶带上。医院可以测血药浓度。BCEHS 的 dexamethasone 地塞米松和 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松药物说明都写着：它们可能让 phenytoin 苯妥英的血药浓度下降。考试用的 dexamethasone 地塞米松药物说明没有提到这一点。

pearl.en: Seizure and a bottle of seizure pills: first ask when the last dose was. Then check the glucose anyway.
pearl.zh: 发作加上一瓶抗癫痫药：先问最后一次是什么时候吃的。然后血糖照样测。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Anticonvulsants and the household medication list; standard pharmacology; BCEHS dexamethasone and hydrocortisone monographs (phenytoin interaction)

stem.en: Dev, 28, had a two-minute seizure at a Burnaby gym. Now drowsy. His bag holds levetiracetam. His friend says he ran out last week.
stem.zh: Dev，28 岁，在 Burnaby 的健身房抽搐了两分钟。现在昏昏沉沉。包里有 levetiracetam 左乙拉西坦。朋友说他上周就把药吃完了。

ask.en: What best explains this seizure?
ask.zh: 这次发作最可能的原因是什么？

opts.en: Missed doses of his anti-seizure medicine
opts.zh: 抗癫痫药断了几天

opts.en: An overdose of his anti-seizure medicine
opts.zh: 抗癫痫药吃过量了

opts.en: An allergic reaction to the medicine
opts.zh: 对这个药过敏

why.en: Stopping an anti-seizure medicine suddenly can bring seizures back. He ran out a week ago.
why.zh: 抗癫痫药突然停掉，发作就可能回来。他一周前就断药了。

stem.en: Ruth, 61, is confused after a seizure in her Kelowna kitchen. Carbamazepine sits on the counter. She also takes insulin. Her skin is sweaty.
stem.zh: Ruth，61 岁，在 Kelowna 家里的厨房抽搐后意识模糊。台面上放着 carbamazepine 卡马西平。她还在用 insulin 胰岛素。皮肤出汗。

ask.en: Your next move?

opts.en: Check her blood glucose now
opts.zh: 马上测血糖

opts.en: Skip the glucose because epilepsy explains it
opts.zh: 癫痫已经能解释了，不用测血糖

opts.en: Give her next carbamazepine tablet by mouth
opts.zh: 让她口服下一片 carbamazepine 卡马西平

why.en: A seizure pill bottle does not rule out low sugar. Low sugar also causes seizures, and you can fix it.
why.zh: 有抗癫痫药瓶不能排除低血糖。低血糖也会引起抽搐，而且你能纠正它。

bad.en: You blame epilepsy and drive a hypoglycemic brain to hospital untreated.
bad.zh: 你认定是癫痫，结果把一个低血糖的大脑原样送去医院。

stem.en: Walter, 79, is staggering and slurring at a Richmond care home. No alcohol on site. His eyes jerk sideways. His phenytoin dose was raised last week.
stem.zh: Walter，79 岁，在 Richmond 的护理院里走路摇晃、口齿不清。院里没有酒。眼球向两侧跳动。上周他的 phenytoin 苯妥英加了量。

ask.en: What do you suspect first?

opts.en: Too much phenytoin in his blood
opts.zh: 血里的 phenytoin 苯妥英太多

opts.en: Too little phenytoin in his blood
opts.zh: 血里的 phenytoin 苯妥英太少

opts.en: Withdrawal from stopping phenytoin
opts.zh: 停用 phenytoin 苯妥英后的戒断

why.en: Too much phenytoin gives a drunk picture with nystagmus. Still do a stroke screen and a glucose.
why.zh: phenytoin 苯妥英过量就是醉酒样表现加眼球震颤。卒中筛查和血糖还是要做。

s.en: The same anti-seizure pill may be prescribed for bipolar disorder or nerve pain.
s.zh: 同一种抗癫痫药也可能是开来治双相情感障碍或神经痛的。

why.en: Valproic acid, lamotrigine and carbamazepine all have uses beyond epilepsy.
why.zh: valproic acid 丙戊酸、lamotrigine 拉莫三嗪、carbamazepine 卡马西平除了癫痫都另有用途。

s.en: A patient who has had no seizures for a month can stop the pills on their own.
s.zh: 病人一个月没发作，就可以自己把药停掉。

why.en: Stopping suddenly can bring seizures back, even status epilepticus.
why.zh: 突然停药会让发作回来，甚至出现癫痫持续状态。

s.en: Too much phenytoin can make a patient look drunk.
s.zh: phenytoin 苯妥英过量会让病人看起来像喝醉了。

why.en: Slurred speech, an unsteady walk and jerking eyes are the classic picture.
why.zh: 口齿不清、走路不稳、眼球震颤是典型表现。

s.en: Finding levetiracetam means you can skip the blood glucose after a seizure.
s.zh: 找到 levetiracetam 左乙拉西坦，抽搐后就不用测血糖了。

why.en: Low sugar also causes seizures, so check it every time.
why.zh: 低血糖也会引起抽搐，所以每次都要测。

q.en: How do many anti-seizure medicines stop a seizure from spreading?
q.zh: 很多抗癫痫药是怎样阻止发作扩散的？

opts.en: They calm overexcited brain cells, for example by blocking sodium channels
opts.zh: 让过度兴奋的脑细胞安静下来，比如阻断钠通道

opts.en: They raise blood sugar so brain cells have more fuel
opts.zh: 升高血糖，让脑细胞有更多能量

opts.en: They widen the blood vessels that feed the brain
opts.zh: 扩张供应大脑的血管

opts.en: They block pain signals at the opioid receptors
opts.zh: 在阿片受体上阻断痛觉信号

why.en: With less sodium entering, a cell cannot fire again as fast. Other medicines boost GABA, the brain's brake.
why.zh: 进入细胞的钠少了，细胞就没法那么快再放电。另一些药增强 GABA，也就是大脑的刹车。

q.en: Which side effect is a classic sign of long-term phenytoin?
q.zh: 哪个副作用是长期吃 phenytoin 苯妥英的典型表现？

opts.en: Swollen, overgrown gums
opts.zh: 牙龈增生

opts.en: A dry, tickly cough
opts.zh: 干咳

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔

opts.en: Swollen ankles
opts.zh: 脚踝水肿

why.en: Gum overgrowth is a well-known long-term effect of phenytoin.
why.zh: 牙龈增生是 phenytoin 苯妥英广为人知的长期副作用。

home.name: Oral steroids (prednisone)

cls.zh: 全身用糖皮质激素

hook.en: A copy of cortisol, the body's own stress hormone.
hook.zh: 仿造皮质醇，也就是身体自己的应激激素。

how.en: It acts like cortisol, the hormone the adrenal glands make. In higher amounts it switches off inflammation and quiets the immune system. Taken for weeks, it tells the adrenal glands to stop making their own cortisol.
how.zh: 它的作用和肾上腺分泌的皮质醇一样。量大一些，就能关掉炎症、压住免疫系统。连着吃几周，肾上腺就会收到信号，不再自己造皮质醇。

tells.en: A flare of asthma or COPD (a short course)
tells.zh: 哮喘或 COPD 急性加重（短疗程）

tells.en: Rheumatoid arthritis, lupus or another autoimmune disease
tells.zh: 类风湿关节炎、红斑狼疮或其他自身免疫病

tells.en: Adrenal insufficiency such as Addison's disease (usually hydrocortisone)
tells.zh: 肾上腺皮质功能不全，例如 Addison 病（通常用 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松）

use.en: Calm a flare of asthma or COPD
use.zh: 压住哮喘或 COPD 的急性加重

use.en: Hold down the immune system in autoimmune disease and after a transplant
use.zh: 在自身免疫病和器官移植后压制免疫系统

use.en: Replace cortisol when the adrenal glands cannot make it
use.zh: 肾上腺造不出皮质醇时，替它补上

no.en: Systemic fungal infection
no.zh: 全身性真菌感染

no.en: Allergy to corticosteroids
no.zh: 对糖皮质激素过敏

no.en: Live vaccines while on high doses
no.zh: 大剂量用药期间接种活疫苗

care.en: Never stop suddenly after long use. The adrenal glands need time to wake up.
care.zh: 长期用药后绝不能突然停。肾上腺需要时间重新「醒过来」。

care.en: Illness, injury or surgery: a long-term user may need extra steroid to cope with the stress.
care.zh: 生病、受伤或手术：长期用药的人可能需要加量，才能应付应激。

care.en: Diabetes: steroids raise blood sugar.
care.zh: 糖尿病：激素会升高血糖。

care.en: With NSAIDs, including ibuprofen and ketorolac, the risk of stomach ulcers and bleeding goes up.
care.zh: 和 NSAIDs（包括 ibuprofen 布洛芬和 ketorolac 酮咯酸）一起用，胃溃疡和出血的风险会上升。

care.en: Heart failure and high blood pressure: steroids hold on to salt and water.
care.zh: 心衰和高血压：激素会让身体留住盐和水。

fx.en: More infections and slow wound healing
Weight gain, a round face and thin skin that bruises
fx.zh: 体重增加、满月脸、皮肤变薄易淤青

medic.en: Adrenal crisis. A long-term user who stops the pills, or gets sick or injured, can crash: weakness, vomiting, belly pain, confusion and a low pressure that is hard to explain. Sometimes low sugar too.
medic.zh: 肾上腺危象。长期用药的人一旦停药、生病或受伤，就可能垮掉：乏力、呕吐、腹痛、糊涂，还有解释不通的低血压。有时还有低血糖。

medic.en: BCEHS PCPs carry hydrocortisone for acute adrenal crisis under BCEHS E02 (Adrenal Crisis). A CliniCall consultation is required before you give it. Hydrocortisone is not on the licensing exam.
medic.zh: BCEHS 的 PCP 带有 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松，用于急性肾上腺危象，对应 BCEHS E02（Adrenal Crisis 肾上腺危象）。给药前必须先咨询 CliniCall。hydrocortisone 氢化可的松不在执照考试范围内。

medic.en: Dexamethasone is not the drug for adrenal crisis. Both BC monographs say it has no mineralocorticoid activity.
medic.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松不是治肾上腺危象的药。两份 BC 药物专论都说它没有盐皮质激素活性。

medic.en: Steroids blunt fever and thin the tissues. Expect infection without much temperature, skin that tears, and fractures from small falls. Check a glucose too.
medic.zh: 激素会压住发热，也让组织变薄。要想到：感染了却不怎么发烧，皮肤一碰就破，轻轻一摔就骨折。还要测血糖。

pearl.en: Long-term prednisone, a new illness, and a low pressure that makes no sense. Say 'adrenal crisis' out loud and call CliniCall.
pearl.zh: 长期吃 prednisone 泼尼松，新得了病，血压低得说不通。把「肾上腺危象」说出口，然后打给 CliniCall。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Medications Affecting the Adrenal Cortex and Medications Affecting the Immunologic System; BCEHS hydrocortisone and dexamethasone monographs; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Margaret, 68, rheumatoid arthritis, prednisone every day for years. Stomach flu for three days, could not keep her pills down. Confused, BP 78/40, HR 118, glucose 3.4 mmol/L.
stem.zh: Margaret，68 岁，类风湿关节炎，每天吃 prednisone 泼尼松已经很多年。肠胃炎三天，药都吐了出来。糊涂，血压 78/40，心率 118，血糖 3.4 mmol/L。

ask.en: What must you think of?

opts.en: Adrenal crisis from missed steroids during an illness
opts.zh: 生病期间漏服激素引起的肾上腺危象

opts.en: A steroid overdose from years of prednisone
opts.zh: 多年吃 prednisone 泼尼松造成的激素过量

opts.en: Simple dehydration that needs nothing special
opts.zh: 单纯脱水，不需要特别处理

why.en: Years of prednisone switch off her own cortisol. Missed doses plus illness leave her with none. BCEHS PCPs can give hydrocortisone after CliniCall.
why.zh: 多年的 prednisone 泼尼松让她自己不再造皮质醇。漏服加上生病，她体内就没有皮质醇了。BCEHS 的 PCP 咨询 CliniCall 后可以给 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松。

bad.en: Treated as a stomach bug, her pressure keeps falling.
bad.zh: 当成肠胃炎处理，她的血压会一直往下掉。

stem.en: Dev, 31, Addison's disease, vomiting since yesterday at a camp near Tofino. He could not keep his hydrocortisone tablets down. Drowsy, BP 80/46.
stem.zh: Dev，31 岁，Addison 病，在 Tofino 附近的营地从昨天开始呕吐。hydrocortisone 氢化可的松片吃了就吐。嗜睡，血压 80/46。

ask.en: Which BCEHS drug is meant for this?
ask.zh: BCEHS 的哪种药是用来处理这个的？

opts.en: Hydrocortisone, after a CliniCall consultation
opts.zh: hydrocortisone 氢化可的松，先咨询 CliniCall

opts.en: Dexamethasone, because it is the stronger steroid
opts.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松，因为它是更强的激素

opts.en: Glucagon, because it raises cortisol
opts.zh: glucagon 胰高血糖素，因为它能升高皮质醇

why.en: Acute adrenal crisis is the BCEHS PCP indication for hydrocortisone, and CliniCall is required first. Dexamethasone has no mineralocorticoid activity.
why.zh: 急性肾上腺危象就是 BCEHS 的 PCP 用 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松的适应证，而且必须先咨询 CliniCall。dexamethasone 地塞米松没有盐皮质激素活性。

stem.en: Joan, 77, prednisone daily for polymyalgia. 'Just tired' for two days. Temp 37.4, HR 112, RR 24, BP 96/58, newly confused. Her daughter says no fever means no infection.
stem.zh: Joan，77 岁，因风湿性多肌痛每天吃 prednisone 泼尼松。两天来「就是累」。体温 37.4，心率 112，呼吸 24 次/分，血压 96/58，新出现糊涂。女儿说不发烧就不是感染。

ask.en: Does the normal temperature rule out sepsis?
ask.zh: 体温正常能排除脓毒症吗？

opts.en: No: steroids blunt fever and hide the signs of infection
opts.zh: 不能：激素会压住发热，把感染的表现盖住

opts.en: Yes: no fever means there is no serious infection
opts.zh: 能：不发烧就说明没有严重感染

opts.en: Yes: prednisone protects the patient against infection
opts.zh: 能：prednisone 泼尼松能保护病人不被感染

why.en: Steroids suppress the immune response, including fever. Fast pulse, fast breathing, low pressure and new confusion still say serious infection.
why.zh: 激素压制免疫反应，发热也被压住。脉搏快、呼吸快、血压低、新出现糊涂，仍然提示严重感染。

s.en: A patient who has taken prednisone for months can stop it at once without risk.
s.zh: 吃了几个月 prednisone 泼尼松的病人，可以马上停药，没有风险。

why.en: The adrenal glands are asleep. Stopping suddenly can cause adrenal crisis.
why.zh: 肾上腺还在「睡」。突然停药可能引起肾上腺危象。

s.en: Long-term steroids raise blood sugar.
s.zh: 长期用激素会升高血糖。

why.en: Check a glucose. Diabetics on steroids run high.
why.zh: 要测血糖。用激素的糖尿病人血糖会偏高。

s.en: Dexamethasone is the right drug for adrenal crisis.
s.zh: dexamethasone 地塞米松是治肾上腺危象的正确药物。

why.en: The BC monographs say it lacks mineralocorticoid activity. Hydrocortisone is the BCEHS drug for adrenal crisis.
why.zh: BC 药物专论说它没有盐皮质激素活性。BCEHS 治肾上腺危象用的是 hydrocortisone 氢化可的松。

s.en: Long-term steroid use can shut down the body's own cortisol production.
s.zh: 长期用激素会让身体不再自己分泌皮质醇。

why.en: The body sees plenty of steroid and stops making its own.
why.zh: 身体发现激素够多了，就不再自己造。

q.en: Why is it dangerous to stop long-term prednisone suddenly?
q.zh: 为什么突然停掉长期服用的 prednisone 泼尼松很危险？

opts.en: The adrenal glands have stopped making cortisol and need time to recover
opts.zh: 肾上腺已经不造皮质醇了，需要时间恢复

opts.en: The drug is stored in fat and released all at once
opts.zh: 药存在脂肪里，会一下子全放出来

opts.en: Blood sugar rises sharply when the drug is stopped
opts.zh: 一停药血糖就急剧升高

opts.en: The immune system rebounds and causes anaphylaxis
opts.zh: 免疫系统反弹，引起严重过敏反应

why.en: With no pills and no cortisol of their own, the patient cannot cope with stress. That is adrenal crisis.
why.zh: 既没有药，也没有自己的皮质醇，病人就扛不住应激。这就是肾上腺危象。

home.name: Calcium channel blockers

cls.zh: 钙通道阻滞剂

hook.en: Keeps calcium out of muscle, so arteries relax.
hook.zh: 不让钙进入肌肉，动脉就松开。

how.en: Muscle in the artery wall and in the heart needs calcium to contract. These drugs block the calcium channels, so the arteries relax and the heart squeezes a little less hard. The '-dipine' drugs act mostly on the arteries. Diltiazem and verapamil also slow the heart rate and the AV node.
how.zh: 动脉壁和心脏的肌肉要靠钙才能收缩。这类药挡住钙通道，动脉放松，心脏收缩也稍微轻一点。「地平」类主要作用在动脉。diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米还会减慢心率和房室结的传导。

tells.en: Angina, including spasm of a coronary artery
tells.zh: 心绞痛，包括冠状动脉痉挛

tells.en: Atrial fibrillation (rate control with diltiazem or verapamil)
tells.zh: 房颤（用 diltiazem 地尔硫䓬或 verapamil 维拉帕米控制心室率）

use.en: Lower blood pressure
use.zh: 降血压

use.en: Prevent angina, including coronary artery spasm
use.zh: 预防心绞痛，包括冠状动脉痉挛

use.en: Slow the heart rate in atrial fibrillation (diltiazem, verapamil)
use.zh: 房颤时减慢心率（diltiazem 地尔硫䓬、verapamil 维拉帕米）

no.en: Diltiazem and verapamil: very slow heart rate or heart block
no.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米：心率过慢或房室传导阻滞

no.en: Diltiazem and verapamil: heart failure with a weak pump
no.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米：心脏泵血无力的心衰

no.en: Very low blood pressure or cardiogenic shock
no.zh: 血压很低或心源性休克

care.en: Diltiazem or verapamil together with a beta-blocker: the heart rate can fall too far.
care.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬或 verapamil 维拉帕米和 β 阻滞剂一起吃：心率可能掉得太低。

care.en: Grapefruit juice raises the blood level of some of them.
care.zh: 西柚汁会让其中几种药的血药浓度升高。

care.en: Older adults: dizziness on standing and falls.
care.zh: 老年人：一站起来就头晕，容易跌倒。

fx.zh: 心率慢（diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米）

medic.en: Diltiazem and verapamil hold the heart rate down, much as a beta-blocker does. A patient in shock may not show a fast pulse.
medic.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米会把心率压住，和 β 阻滞剂差不多。休克的病人可能心率并不快。

medic.en: Overdose is slow and low: bradycardia and hypotension. The blood sugar can run high, where a beta-blocker overdose can run it low. Slow-release tablets can hit hours later.
medic.zh: 过量的样子是又慢又低：心动过缓、低血压。血糖可能偏高，而 β 阻滞剂过量时血糖可能偏低。缓释片可能过了几个小时才发作。

medic.en: It adds to nitroglycerin. Check the systolic before every dose.
medic.zh: 它会和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油叠加。每一次给药前都要量收缩压。

medic.en: Swollen ankles on amlodipine are usually the pill. Do not call it heart failure on the ankles alone. Listen to the chest.
medic.zh: 吃 amlodipine 氨氯地平的人脚踝肿，多半是药的作用。不要只凭脚踝肿就说是心衰。听一听肺。

pearl.en: One class, two families. A '-dipine' is an artery drug. Diltiazem and verapamil are heart-rate drugs as well. Check which one is in the bottle.
pearl.zh: 一类药，两个家族。「地平」是管动脉的药。diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米同时还管心率。看清瓶子里是哪一种。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihypertensive Medications and ch.30 Calcium Channel Blockers (Table 30-23); standard pharmacology; own-drug rule from the BCEHS nitroglycerin monograph

stem.en: Baljit, 70, called about ankle swelling for a month. Breathing easy, lungs clear, sleeps flat, SpO2 97%. Amlodipine was started six weeks ago.
stem.zh: Baljit，70 岁，脚踝肿了一个月。呼吸轻松，双肺清，能平躺睡觉，SpO2 97%。六周前开始吃 amlodipine 氨氯地平。

ask.en: What is the most likely cause of the swelling?
ask.zh: 脚踝肿最可能的原因是什么？

opts.en: A side effect of the amlodipine
opts.zh: amlodipine 氨氯地平的副作用

opts.en: Acute heart failure, despite the clear lungs
opts.zh: 急性心衰，虽然肺是清的

opts.en: A blood clot in both legs at once
opts.zh: 两条腿同时有血栓

why.en: Ankle swelling is a common effect of the '-dipine' drugs. Clear lungs and sleeping flat argue against heart failure. Report it and let the doctor decide.
why.zh: 脚踝水肿是「地平」类常见的作用。肺清、能平躺睡觉，不像心衰。如实报告，让医生判断。

stem.en: An empty verapamil bottle lies beside Tanya, 45, who is drowsy on her kitchen floor in Nanaimo.
stem.zh: Tanya，45 岁，在 Nanaimo 家里的厨房地上，人很嗜睡。身边有一个空的 verapamil 维拉帕米药瓶。

ask.en: Which picture do you expect?

opts.en: Slow pulse and low pressure, sometimes with a high blood sugar
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、血压低，有时血糖偏高

opts.en: Fast pulse, high pressure and a low blood sugar
opts.zh: 脉搏快、血压高，血糖偏低

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils and slow breathing with normal vitals
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔、呼吸慢，其他生命体征正常

why.en: Calcium channel blocker overdose is slow and low. A high sugar can go with it. Slow-release tablets can get worse for hours.
why.zh: 钙通道阻滞剂过量就是又慢又低。血糖偏高也可能一起出现。缓释片可能在几个小时里越来越重。

bad.en: You relax because she is talking, and her pressure falls during transport.
bad.zh: 你看她还能说话就放松了，结果转运途中血压掉下来。

stem.en: George, 77, has passed black, tarry stools all day. Pale and clammy, BP 88/50, HR 72. He takes diltiazem for atrial fibrillation.
stem.zh: George，77 岁，一整天都在拉黑色柏油样便。面色苍白、皮肤湿冷，血压 88/50，心率 72。他因为房颤在吃 diltiazem 地尔硫䓬。

ask.en: What does a heart rate of 72 tell you?

opts.en: Not much: diltiazem can hold the rate down even in shock
opts.zh: 说明不了什么：diltiazem 地尔硫䓬在休克时也能把心率压住

opts.en: He is compensating well and is stable for now
opts.zh: 他代偿得很好，目前稳定

opts.en: The bleeding must be small, or his pulse would be fast
opts.zh: 出血量一定不大，不然脉搏会很快

why.en: Diltiazem slows the AV node and hides the fast pulse of shock. Low pressure and pale, clammy skin say he is bleeding hard.
why.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬减慢房室结传导，把休克该有的快脉搏压住了。低血压加上苍白湿冷的皮肤，说明他出血很凶。

bad.en: You trust the pulse, take your time, and he arrives in deeper shock.
bad.zh: 你相信了脉搏，慢慢来，到医院时休克更重了。

s.en: Amlodipine commonly causes swollen ankles.
s.zh: amlodipine 氨氯地平常常引起脚踝水肿。

why.en: Ankle swelling is the best known side effect of the '-dipine' drugs.
why.zh: 脚踝水肿是「地平」类最出名的副作用。

s.en: All calcium channel blockers slow the heart rate.
s.zh: 所有钙通道阻滞剂都会减慢心率。

why.en: Only diltiazem and verapamil do. The '-dipine' drugs mainly relax arteries.
why.zh: 只有 diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米会。「地平」类主要是松开动脉。

s.en: Diltiazem can be prescribed to control the heart rate in atrial fibrillation.
s.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬可以用来控制房颤的心率。

why.en: It slows conduction through the AV node.
why.zh: 它减慢房室结的传导。

s.en: Calcium channel blockers tighten the airways and are avoided in asthma.
s.zh: 钙通道阻滞剂会让气道收紧，哮喘病人要避免。

why.en: They do not tighten the airways. That worry belongs to beta-blockers.
why.zh: 它们不会让气道收紧。那是 β 阻滞剂要担心的事。

q.en: How do calcium channel blockers relieve angina?
q.zh: 钙通道阻滞剂怎样缓解心绞痛？

opts.en: They prevent coronary spasm and lower the heart's oxygen demand
opts.zh: 防止冠状动脉痉挛，并降低心脏的需氧量

opts.en: They dissolve the clot inside the coronary artery
opts.zh: 溶解冠状动脉里的血栓

opts.en: They block adrenaline at the beta receptors
opts.zh: 在 β 受体上挡住肾上腺素

opts.en: They remove salt and water through the kidneys
opts.zh: 通过肾脏排出盐和水

why.en: The coronary arteries stay open and the heart works less hard, so it needs less oxygen.
why.zh: 冠状动脉保持通畅，心脏干活也轻一些，需要的氧就少了。

q.en: Which calcium channel blockers also slow the heart rate?
q.zh: 哪些钙通道阻滞剂还会减慢心率？

opts.en: Diltiazem and verapamil
opts.zh: diltiazem 地尔硫䓬和 verapamil 维拉帕米

opts.en: Amlodipine and nifedipine
opts.zh: amlodipine 氨氯地平和 nifedipine 硝苯地平

opts.en: Felodipine and amlodipine
opts.zh: felodipine 非洛地平和 amlodipine 氨氯地平

opts.en: Nifedipine and felodipine
opts.zh: nifedipine 硝苯地平和 felodipine 非洛地平

why.en: These two act on the AV node. The '-dipine' drugs act mostly on the arteries.
why.zh: 这两种作用在房室结。「地平」类主要作用在动脉。

home.name: ARBs
home.zh: 血管紧张素受体拮抗剂（沙坦类）

cls.zh: 血管紧张素 II 受体阻滞剂（ARB）

hook.en: Same job as an ACE inhibitor, minus the cough.
hook.zh: 干的活和 ACE 抑制剂一样，只是不咳嗽。

how.en: Angiotensin II is the hormone that tightens the arteries. An ARB sits on its receptor, so the hormone cannot act. The arteries relax and the pressure falls. It leaves the ACE enzyme alone, which is why the dry cough is uncommon.
how.zh: 血管紧张素 II 是让动脉收紧的激素。ARB 占住它的受体，激素就起不了作用。动脉放松，血压下降。它不碰 ACE 这个酶，所以很少引起干咳。

tells.en: Often a patient who coughed on an ACE inhibitor
tells.zh: 常常是吃 ACE 抑制剂咳嗽、后来换药的病人

tellsFake.en: A fast heart rate in atrial fibrillation

use.en: Lower blood pressure
use.zh: 降血压

use.en: Long-term treatment of heart failure
use.zh: 心力衰竭的长期治疗

use.en: Slow kidney damage in diabetes
use.zh: 延缓糖尿病对肾脏的损害

no.en: Pregnancy
no.zh: 怀孕

no.en: Narrowing of the arteries to both kidneys
no.zh: 双侧肾动脉狭窄

noFake.en: A dry cough on an ACE inhibitor
noFake.zh: 吃 ACE 抑制剂时干咳

care.en: Potassium can climb, more so with kidney disease, spironolactone or potassium pills.
care.zh: 血钾可能升高，有肾病、同时吃 spironolactone 螺内酯或补钾药时更明显。

care.en: Vomiting, diarrhea or poor drinking: the pressure can drop and the kidneys can suffer.
care.zh: 呕吐、腹泻或喝水少的时候：血压可能掉下来，肾脏也可能受损。

care.en: Angioedema on an ACE inhibitor in the past: it is rare with an ARB, but it can happen.
care.zh: 以前吃 ACE 抑制剂出现过血管性水肿：换成 ARB 后很少见，但还是可能发生。

medic.en: Read it like an ACE inhibitor. Same diseases, same low pressure, same high potassium. Only the cough is missing.
medic.zh: 把它当成 ACE 抑制剂来看。同样的病，同样的低血压，同样的高血钾。只是没有干咳。

medic.en: It adds to nitroglycerin. Check the systolic before every dose.
medic.zh: 它会和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油叠加。每一次给药前都要量收缩压。

medic.en: Falls and dizziness in an older adult: check the pressure lying and then sitting. A new or increased dose is a common cause.
medic.zh: 老人跌倒、头晕：先躺着量血压，再坐起来量。新加的药或刚加量是常见原因。

medic.en: NSAIDs such as ibuprofen can raise blood pressure and make blood pressure pills work less well.
medic.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬这类 NSAID 可能让血压升高，也可能让降压药的效果变差。

pearl.en: A '-sartan' and a '-pril' tell you the same story about the patient. If you know one card, you know most of the other.
pearl.zh: 「沙坦」和「普利」说的是同一类病人。会了一张卡，另一张也就会了大半。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihypertensive Medications and ch.30 Antihypertensive Medications (Table 30-26); standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS monographs (nitroglycerin, ibuprofen)

stem.en: Priya, 58, fainted at a temple in Surrey and is now alert. Her bag holds candesartan. Her daughter says the old pill, ramipril, made her cough.
stem.zh: Priya，58 岁，在 Surrey 的寺庙里晕倒，现在清醒。包里有 candesartan 坎地沙坦。女儿说她以前吃 ramipril 雷米普利，老是咳嗽。

ask.en: What does the candesartan tell you?
ask.zh: candesartan 坎地沙坦说明什么？

opts.en: She has high blood pressure or heart failure and was switched because of the cough
opts.zh: 她有高血压或心衰，因为咳嗽才换的药

opts.en: She has a chronic cough, and candesartan is the treatment for it
opts.zh: 她有慢性咳嗽，candesartan 坎地沙坦是治咳嗽的

opts.en: She has an irregular heart rhythm that candesartan keeps under control
opts.zh: 她有心律不齐，靠 candesartan 坎地沙坦控制

why.en: An ARB treats the same conditions as an ACE inhibitor. Cough on the ACE inhibitor is the usual reason for the switch.
why.zh: ARB 治的病和 ACE 抑制剂一样。吃 ACE 抑制剂咳嗽是换药最常见的原因。

stem.en: Agnes, 84, fell getting out of bed. Irbesartan was added to her water pill last week. Lying: BP 124/70. Sitting: BP 96/58 and she feels faint.
stem.zh: Agnes，84 岁，下床时跌倒。上周在利尿药之外又加了 irbesartan 厄贝沙坦。躺着：血压 124/70。坐起来：血压 96/58，感觉要晕。

ask.en: What is the likely reason she fell?
ask.zh: 她跌倒最可能的原因是什么？

opts.en: Her pressure drops when she gets up, because of the new pill
opts.zh: 新加的药让她一起身血压就往下掉

opts.en: A seizure, because irbesartan is known to trigger them
opts.zh: 癫痫发作，因为 irbesartan 厄贝沙坦会诱发癫痫

opts.en: Low blood sugar, because irbesartan works like insulin
opts.zh: 低血糖，因为 irbesartan 厄贝沙坦的作用像 insulin 胰岛素

why.en: Blood pressure pills often cause a drop on standing. Measuring lying and then sitting is how you find it.
why.zh: 降压药常常让人一站起来血压就下降。先躺着量、再坐起来量，才能发现。

bad.en: You record one normal lying pressure and miss the reason she will fall again.
bad.zh: 你只记了一个躺着的正常血压，漏掉了她还会再跌倒的原因。

stem.en: Chloe, 29, is nine weeks pregnant and vomiting. She mentions that she still takes valsartan for her blood pressure.
stem.zh: Chloe，29 岁，怀孕九周，一直呕吐。她提到自己还在吃 valsartan 缬沙坦控制血压。

ask.en: What do you do with that information?

opts.en: Report it clearly at handover, because ARBs are contraindicated in pregnancy
opts.zh: 交接时讲清楚，因为怀孕禁用 ARB

opts.en: Nothing, because ARBs are the preferred pressure pills in pregnancy
opts.zh: 不用管，因为 ARB 是孕期首选的降压药

opts.en: Tell her to double it, because pregnancy raises the pressure
opts.zh: 让她加倍吃，因为怀孕会让血压升高

why.en: ARBs and ACE inhibitors can harm the fetus. Her doctor needs to change the pill, so the hospital must hear about it.
why.zh: ARB 和 ACE 抑制剂都可能伤害胎儿。需要医生给她换药，所以一定要让医院知道。

s.en: Drug names ending in -sartan are ARBs.
s.zh: 药名以 -sartan 结尾的是 ARB。

why.en: Candesartan, irbesartan, losartan, telmisartan, valsartan.
why.zh: candesartan 坎地沙坦、irbesartan 厄贝沙坦、losartan 氯沙坦、telmisartan 替米沙坦、valsartan 缬沙坦都是。

s.en: ARBs cause a dry cough as often as ACE inhibitors do.
s.zh: ARB 引起干咳的机会和 ACE 抑制剂一样多。

why.en: Cough is uncommon with an ARB. That is why patients are switched to one.
why.zh: ARB 很少引起咳嗽。病人就是因为这个才换成它。

s.en: An ARB can raise the potassium level.
s.zh: ARB 可以让血钾升高。

why.en: Like an ACE inhibitor, it makes the body hold on to potassium.
why.zh: 和 ACE 抑制剂一样，它会让身体留住钾。

s.en: An ARB is safe to continue through pregnancy.
s.zh: 怀孕期间可以放心继续吃 ARB。

why.en: ARBs can harm the fetus and are contraindicated in pregnancy.
why.zh: ARB 可能伤害胎儿，怀孕禁用。

q.en: Where does an ARB act?
q.zh: ARB 作用在哪里？

opts.en: On the receptor that angiotensin II uses
opts.zh: 血管紧张素 II 要用的受体

opts.en: On the enzyme that makes angiotensin II
opts.zh: 生成血管紧张素 II 的那个酶

opts.en: On the beta receptors of the heart
opts.zh: 心脏上的 β 受体

opts.en: On the calcium channels of the heart
opts.zh: 心脏上的钙通道

why.en: It blocks the receptor. An ACE inhibitor blocks the enzyme one step earlier.
why.zh: 它挡住的是受体。ACE 抑制剂挡的是前一步的那个酶。

home.name: Nitrates at home

cls.zh: 硝酸酯类（抗心绞痛药、血管扩张药）

hook.en: Angina medicine. Relaxes the vessels so the heart works less.
hook.zh: 治心绞痛的药。把血管松开，让心脏少干点活。

how.en: Nitrates relax the muscle in the vessel walls, mostly the veins. Less blood returns to the heart, so the heart does less work and needs less oxygen. A spray or tablet under the tongue works within minutes to stop an attack. Patches and long-acting pills prevent attacks.
how.zh: 硝酸酯类让血管壁的肌肉放松，主要是静脉。回到心脏的血变少，心脏干的活少了，需要的氧也少了。舌下喷雾或舌下片几分钟内起效，用来终止发作。贴片和长效片用来预防发作。

tells.en: A previous heart attack or stent

use.en: Stop an angina attack (spray or tablet under the tongue)
use.zh: 终止心绞痛发作（舌下喷雾或舌下片）

use.en: Prevent angina (patch or long-acting pill)
use.zh: 预防心绞痛（贴片或长效片）

use.en: Sometimes part of heart failure treatment
use.zh: 有时是心衰治疗的一部分

no.en: Erectile dysfunction pills: sildenafil (Viagra), vardenafil (Levitra), tadalafil (Cialis)
no.zh: 壮阳药：sildenafil 西地那非（Viagra）、vardenafil 伐地那非（Levitra）、tadalafil 他达拉非（Cialis）

no.en: Low blood pressure or low blood volume
no.zh: 低血压或血容量不足

no.en: Severe anemia
no.zh: 严重贫血

noFake.zh: 每天吃 ASA 阿司匹林

care.en: Tolerance: a patch worn day and night stops working, so many patients take it off overnight.
care.zh: 耐受：贴片白天黑夜一直贴着就不管用了，所以很多病人晚上会揭下来。

care.en: Blood pressure pills and alcohol add to the pressure drop.
care.zh: 降压药和酒精会让血压掉得更多。

care.en: Tablets lose strength after the bottle has been open for months.
care.zh: 药瓶打开几个月后，药片的药效会减弱。

care.en: Fainting is possible, so the patient should sit down before taking a dose.
care.zh: 可能晕倒，所以用药前应该先坐下。

medic.en: Ask how much they took and whether it helped. No relief with no headache and no burning suggests an old, weak supply. A headache with no relief suggests an infarction.
medic.zh: 问清楚用了多少、有没有缓解。没缓解，也没有头痛和烧灼感，说明药可能放久失效了。头痛了却没缓解，要怀疑心梗。

medic.en: Ask every patient about erectile dysfunction pills. Viagra or Levitra in the last 24 hours, or Cialis in the last 48 hours, rules out nitroglycerin in both sources.
medic.zh: 每个病人都要问有没有吃壮阳药。过去 24 小时内用过 Viagra（sildenafil 西地那非）或 Levitra（vardenafil 伐地那非），或过去 48 小时内用过 Cialis（tadalafil 他达拉非），两套标准都不许给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

medic.en: Exam (EMALB): a nitro patch does not change the protocol, and nitro the patient took before you arrived does not count toward your maximum. On the road (BCEHS): no prior nitroglycerin prescription means a CliniCall consult first.
medic.zh: 考试（EMALB）：身上贴着 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油贴片不改变流程，你到之前病人自己用的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油也不算进你的给药上限。出车（BCEHS）：病人以前没有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油处方的话，要先咨询 CliniCall。

medic.en: Entonox: nitroglycerin use in the last 5 minutes is a contraindication in both sources. Ask when the patient last used their own spray.
medic.zh: Entonox 笑气：过去 5 分钟内用过 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油是禁忌证，两套标准都这样写。问清楚病人自己最后一次喷药是什么时候。

pearl.en: Home nitro is a diagnosis in a bottle: coronary disease. It does not excuse you from pressure, pulse and the ED-pill question before every dose.
pearl.zh: 家里有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，等于瓶子上写着诊断：冠心病。但每次给药前，血压、脉搏、壮阳药这三问一样都不能省。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.30 Antianginal Agents: Nitrates (Table 30-21) and ch.7 (vasodilators, erectile dysfunction medications); standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS and EMALB monographs (nitroglycerin, Entonox)

stem.en: Hank, 66, has cardiac chest pain on a fishing boat in Steveston. BP 132/80, HR 88, no ED pills. His own prescribed nitro spray is in his jacket, unused.
stem.zh: Hank，66 岁，在 Steveston 的渔船上出现心源性胸痛。血压 132/80，心率 88，没吃壮阳药。医生开给他的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油喷雾在外套口袋里，还没用。

ask.en: On the road (BCEHS), what does his own spray tell you?
ask.zh: 出车时（BCEHS），他自己带的喷雾说明什么？

opts.en: He has a prescription, so no CliniCall consult is needed before the first dose
opts.zh: 他有处方，所以第一次给药前不需要咨询 CliniCall

opts.en: He has a prescription, so the blood pressure check can be skipped
opts.zh: 他有处方，所以可以不量血压

opts.en: He already owns nitroglycerin, so you must not give him any of yours
opts.zh: 他自己已经有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油，所以不能再给你车上的

why.en: BCEHS requires a CliniCall consult when the patient has no prior nitroglycerin prescription. He has one. Pressure, pulse and the ED-pill question still apply.
why.zh: 病人以前没有 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油处方时，BCEHS 要求先咨询 CliniCall。他有处方。血压、脉搏、壮阳药这三问照样要做。

stem.en: Ray, 58, has chest pain in a Whistler hotel room. His nitro spray sits unused beside a blister pack of tadalafil. He took one last night.
stem.zh: Ray，58 岁，在 Whistler 的酒店房间里胸痛。他的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油喷雾没用过，旁边放着一板 tadalafil 他达拉非。他昨晚吃了一片。

ask.en: What about nitroglycerin?

opts.en: None, his or yours: Cialis within 48 hours is a contraindication
opts.zh: 他的和你的都不能用：48 小时内用过 Cialis（tadalafil 他达拉非）是禁忌证

opts.en: Yours is fine, because the rule only covers Viagra
opts.zh: 你车上的可以用，因为规定只管 Viagra（sildenafil 西地那非）

opts.en: Have him use his own spray, since it was prescribed for him
opts.zh: 让他用自己的喷雾，因为那是医生开给他的

why.en: Tadalafil (Cialis) within 48 hours rules out nitroglycerin. Whose bottle it comes from makes no difference. The rest of the chest pain care goes ahead.
why.zh: 48 小时内用过 tadalafil 他达拉非（Cialis）就不能给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。是谁的药瓶都一样。胸痛的其他处理照常进行。

bad.en: The pressure can crash and be very hard to bring back.
bad.zh: 血压可能一下子垮掉，而且很难拉回来。

stem.en: Lucille, 82, has had chest pain for 40 minutes. She took three of her own tablets from a bottle opened two years ago. No headache, no burning, no relief.
stem.zh: Lucille，82 岁，胸痛 40 分钟。她从一瓶两年前打开的药里拿了三片自己含了。没有头痛，没有烧灼感，也没有缓解。

ask.en: What do you make of her three tablets?
ask.zh: 她含的这三片药，你怎么看？

opts.en: They were probably too old to work, so go by your own assessment
opts.zh: 药多半放太久失效了，按你自己的评估来

opts.en: She has had her limit, so nitroglycerin is now off the table
opts.zh: 她已经用到上限，不能再给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油

opts.en: No relief after three tablets proves the pain is not cardiac
opts.zh: 含了三片都没缓解，说明不是心脏的痛

why.en: Old tablets lose their strength. No headache and no burning point to a weak supply. On the exam, doses taken before you arrived do not count against yours.
why.zh: 药片放久了药效会减弱。没有头痛、没有烧灼感，说明药不行了。考试里，你到之前病人自己用的次数不算在你的次数里。

s.en: A throbbing headache after nitroglycerin is a sign that the drug is active.
s.zh: 用了 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油后出现搏动性头痛，说明药是有效的。

why.en: Fresh nitroglycerin widens vessels in the head too. No headache may mean an old supply.
why.zh: 新鲜的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油也会扩张头部的血管。不头痛可能说明药放久了。

s.en: On the exam, a nitro patch on the chest means you must hold your nitroglycerin.
s.zh: 考试里，病人胸前贴着 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油贴片，就不能再给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

why.en: The exam monograph says a patch does not change the nitroglycerin protocol.
why.zh: 考试专论写明，贴片不改变 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油的流程。

s.en: Sildenafil (Viagra) in the last 24 hours rules out nitroglycerin.
s.zh: 过去 24 小时内用过 sildenafil 西地那非（Viagra），就不能给 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油。

why.en: Together they can cause a deep, stubborn drop in blood pressure.
why.zh: 两个药加在一起，血压可能掉得又深又难纠正。

s.en: Chest pain that does not ease with the patient's own nitroglycerin is unlikely to be cardiac.
s.zh: 病人用了自己的 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油胸痛没缓解，就不太可能是心脏的问题。

why.en: It may be an infarction, or the supply may be old and weak.
why.zh: 可能是心梗，也可能是药放久失效了。

q.en: How do nitrates relieve angina?
q.zh: 硝酸酯类怎样缓解心绞痛？

opts.en: They relax the vessels, so the heart works less and needs less oxygen
opts.zh: 松开血管，心脏少干活，需要的氧就少了

opts.en: They slow the heart by blocking beta receptors
opts.zh: 阻断 β 受体，让心跳变慢

opts.en: They thin the blood so it slips past the blockage
opts.zh: 让血变稀，好从堵塞的地方流过去

opts.en: They dissolve the plaque in the coronary artery
opts.zh: 溶解冠状动脉里的斑块

why.en: Less blood returning to the heart means less work and less oxygen demand.
why.zh: 回到心脏的血少了，心脏干的活少了，需氧量也就降了。

q.en: Why do many patients take their nitro patch off at night?
q.zh: 为什么很多病人晚上要把 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油贴片揭下来？

opts.en: A break without nitrate keeps the drug working
opts.zh: 空出一段不用药的时间，药才能一直有效

opts.en: The patch causes bad dreams and poor sleep
opts.zh: 贴片会让人做噩梦、睡不好

opts.en: The glue stops holding after half a day
opts.zh: 贴片的胶过了半天就不粘了

opts.en: Nitrates are dangerous while lying flat
opts.zh: 平躺时用硝酸酯类有危险

why.en: The body gets used to constant nitrate. A daily break prevents that tolerance.
why.zh: 身体会对持续的硝酸酯产生耐受。每天空出一段时间，就能避免。

home.name: Sulfonylureas

cls.zh: 磺脲类（促胰岛素分泌的口服降糖药）

hook.en: It squeezes more insulin out of the pancreas.
hook.zh: 把胰腺里的胰岛素多挤一些出来。

how.en: It makes the beta cells of the pancreas release more insulin, whether or not the patient has eaten. It only works if the pancreas can still make insulin. That is why it can push the sugar too low.
how.zh: 它让胰腺的 β 细胞多放胰岛素，不管病人吃没吃饭。只有胰腺还能造胰岛素，它才有用。所以它会把血糖压得太低。

tells.en: Usually diabetes that needed more than metformin alone
tells.zh: 通常是单用 metformin 二甲双胍控制不住的糖尿病

use.en: Lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
use.zh: 降低 2 型糖尿病的血糖

use.en: Add to metformin when one drug is not enough
use.zh: 单用 metformin 二甲双胍不够时加用

no.en: Type 1 diabetes
no.zh: 1 型糖尿病

no.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis
no.zh: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒

no.en: Severe kidney or liver disease
no.zh: 严重肾病或肝病

noFake.zh: 同时在吃 metformin 二甲双胍

care.en: A missed meal after the pill is the classic set-up for a low.
care.zh: 吃了药却没吃饭，是低血糖最经典的原因。

care.en: Older patients and patients with poor kidneys get lows more easily, and the lows last longer.
care.zh: 老年人和肾不好的病人更容易低血糖，而且持续更久。

care.en: Alcohol makes a low more likely.
care.zh: 喝酒会让低血糖更容易发生。

care.en: A beta-blocker can hide the warning signs of a low.
care.zh: β 阻滞剂会盖住低血糖的预警信号。

medic.en: This is the diabetes pill that causes real hypoglycemia. Confused, sweaty, seizing or 'stroke-like' with this bottle: check a glucose first.
medic.zh: 这才是真会引起低血糖的降糖药。有这个药瓶，人又糊涂、出汗、抽搐或「像中风」：先测血糖。

medic.en: Treat the low the usual way: oral glucose if awake and able to swallow safely, D10W if you have an IV, glucagon if you cannot get one.
medic.zh: 低血糖照常处理：清醒、能安全吞咽，用 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖。有 IV，用 D10W 10% 葡萄糖。打不上 IV，用 glucagon 胰高血糖素。

medic.en: The low can come back. The pill keeps working for many hours after you correct the sugar. Recheck the glucose and recommend hospital.
medic.zh: 低血糖会再来。你把血糖纠正之后，药还要起效很多个小时。要复测血糖，并建议去医院。

medic.en: In a small child even one tablet can cause hypoglycemia, and the low may come hours later. An adult overdose means deep lows that keep returning.
medic.zh: 小孩哪怕只吃了一片，也可能低血糖，而且可能几小时后才出现。成人过量则是很深、反复出现的低血糖。

pearl.en: Metformin does not drop the sugar. The gli- pill beside it does, and it can do it again after you have fixed it.
pearl.zh: 让血糖掉下去的不是 metformin 二甲双胍，是它旁边那瓶 gli- 开头的药。而且你纠正之后，它还能再来一次。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Medications Affecting the Pancreas (sulfonylureas) and the household medications list (Oral Antidiabetics); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Dorothy, 82, confused at 10:00 in her Richmond care home. She skipped breakfast. Glucose 2.1 mmol/L. Drowsy, cannot swallow safely. Medication record: glyburide. Your IV is running.
stem.zh: Dorothy，82 岁，上午 10:00 在 Richmond 的护理院里神志不清。她没吃早饭。血糖 2.1 mmol/L。嗜睡，不能安全吞咽。用药记录：glyburide 格列本脲。你的 IV 已经通了。

ask.en: What do you give?

opts.en: D10W by IV: she cannot protect her airway for oral glucose
opts.zh: IV 给 D10W 10% 葡萄糖：她保护不了气道，不能用 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖

opts.en: Oral glucose gel squeezed into the back of her mouth
opts.zh: 把 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖凝胶挤到她嘴里深处

opts.en: Nothing yet: wait for the glyburide to wear off
opts.zh: 先不给：等 glyburide 格列本脲药效过去

why.en: Oral glucose is for a patient awake enough to keep their own airway. She is not. With an IV in place, the PCP answer is D10W.
why.zh: oral glucose 口服葡萄糖只给清醒到能自己保护气道的病人。她不是。IV 已经在，PCP 的答案就是 D10W 10% 葡萄糖。

bad.en: Gel in a drowsy mouth ends up in the lungs.
bad.zh: 凝胶挤进嗜睡病人的嘴里，最后进的是肺。

stem.en: Gurpreet, 70, takes gliclazide and has kidney disease. His family fixed a low with juice an hour ago. Glucose now 6.1 mmol/L. He feels fine and wants to stay home.
stem.zh: Gurpreet，70 岁，吃 gliclazide 格列齐特，有肾病。一小时前家人用果汁纠正了一次低血糖。现在血糖 6.1 mmol/L。他觉得没事，想留在家里。

ask.en: What is the risk if he stays home?
ask.zh: 他留在家里有什么风险？

opts.en: The pill is still working, so his sugar can fall again
opts.zh: 药还在起效，血糖可能再掉下去

opts.en: None: a normal reading means the episode is over
opts.zh: 没有风险：读数正常说明这次已经过去了

opts.en: High blood sugar from the juice he drank
opts.zh: 喝了果汁会高血糖

why.en: A sulfonylurea acts for many hours, longer with poor kidneys. One normal reading is not the end. Recheck and recommend hospital.
why.zh: 磺脲类要起效很多个小时，肾不好时更久。一次正常读数不等于结束。要复测，并建议去医院。

stem.en: Mia, 2, sleepy and floppy at her grandmother's home in Burnaby. One gliclazide tablet is missing from the weekly pill box.
stem.zh: Mia，2 岁，在 Burnaby 的外婆家里又困又软。一周药盒里少了一片 gliclazide 格列齐特。

ask.en: What do you expect?

opts.en: Low blood sugar, possibly severe and possibly delayed
opts.zh: 低血糖，可能很重，也可能来得晚

opts.en: Nothing serious from a single adult tablet
opts.zh: 只是一片成人药，不会有大事

opts.en: High blood sugar with fast deep breathing
opts.zh: 高血糖，呼吸又快又深

why.en: A sulfonylurea releases insulin in a child too. One tablet can be enough. Check the glucose now and keep checking.
why.zh: 磺脲类在小孩身上同样会放出胰岛素。一片就可能够了。现在就测血糖，而且要反复测。

s.en: Sulfonylureas can cause hypoglycemia even when taken exactly as prescribed.
s.zh: 磺脲类即使完全按医嘱吃，也可能引起低血糖。

why.en: A missed meal or failing kidneys is enough.
why.zh: 少吃一顿饭，或者肾功能变差，就够了。

s.en: Once the glucose is back to normal, a sulfonylurea low cannot return.
s.zh: 血糖恢复正常后，磺脲类引起的低血糖就不会再来。

why.en: The drug outlasts your treatment. Lows can recur for hours.
why.zh: 药效比你的处理更持久。低血糖可以在之后几小时里反复出现。

s.en: Sulfonylureas work in type 1 diabetes.
s.zh: 磺脲类对 1 型糖尿病有效。

why.en: They need a pancreas that can still make insulin.
why.zh: 它们需要一个还能造胰岛素的胰腺。

s.en: Gliclazide, glyburide and glimepiride all belong to this class.
s.zh: gliclazide 格列齐特、glyburide 格列本脲、glimepiride 格列美脲都属于这一类。

why.en: Look for a name that starts with gli- or gly-.
why.zh: 认名字开头的 gli- 或 gly-。

q.en: How does a sulfonylurea lower blood sugar?
q.zh: 磺脲类怎样降血糖？

opts.en: It makes the pancreas release more insulin
opts.zh: 让胰腺多分泌胰岛素

opts.en: It makes the kidneys pass sugar into the urine
opts.zh: 让肾脏把糖排进尿里

opts.en: It slows the stomach and reduces appetite
opts.zh: 让胃排空变慢、食欲下降

opts.en: It replaces insulin by injection
opts.zh: 用注射来替代胰岛素

why.en: More insulin, with or without food. That is also why it causes lows.
why.zh: 胰岛素变多，不管有没有吃饭。这也是它会引起低血糖的原因。

home.name: Inhaled steroids and combination inhalers
home.zh: 吸入激素与复方吸入剂

cls.en: Inhaled corticosteroid (ICS), alone or combined with a LABA
cls.zh: 吸入性糖皮质激素（ICS），单用或与 LABA 合用

hook.en: The preventer. Calms airway swelling slowly, every day.
hook.zh: 预防用的吸入剂。每天用，慢慢把气道的炎症压下去。

how.en: The steroid settles the inflammation and swelling in the airway wall. It works over days to weeks, not minutes. A combination inhaler adds a long-acting bronchodilator (LABA) to keep the airway muscle relaxed.
how.zh: 激素把气道壁的炎症和肿胀压下去。它要几天到几周才起效，不是几分钟。复方吸入剂另外加了长效支气管扩张剂（LABA），让气道肌肉保持放松。

tells.en: COPD with frequent flare-ups (usually a combination inhaler)
tells.zh: 经常急性加重的 COPD（通常是复方吸入剂）

use.en: Prevent asthma attacks by keeping the airways calm
use.zh: 让气道保持平稳，预防哮喘发作

use.en: Cut down flare-ups in COPD (combination inhalers)
use.zh: 减少 COPD 的急性加重（复方吸入剂）

use.en: Daily control, taken even when the patient feels well
use.zh: 日常控制，病人感觉良好时也要用

no.en: As the first treatment of a sudden attack (a plain steroid inhaler does not open the airway)
no.zh: 当作突然发作时的首选治疗（单纯的激素吸入剂打不开气道）

no.en: Untreated lung infection such as tuberculosis
no.zh: 没有治疗的肺部感染，例如肺结核

no.en: Allergy to the drug or its ingredients
no.zh: 对药物或其成分过敏

noFake.zh: 同时在用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇

care.en: Rinse the mouth after each use to prevent thrush.
care.zh: 每次用完要漱口，预防鹅口疮。

care.en: It only works if taken every day. Many patients stop when they feel well, and then flare.
care.zh: 每天用才有效。很多病人感觉好了就停，然后就发作。

care.en: Budesonide with formoterol (Symbicort) is the exception: some asthma plans use it as the reliever too, because formoterol works fast.
care.zh: budesonide 布地奈德加 formoterol 福莫特罗（Symbicort）是例外：有些哮喘方案也把它当急救吸入剂用，因为 formoterol 福莫特罗起效快。

fx.zh: COPD 病人更容易得肺炎

fx.en: Tremor and palpitations from the LABA in a combination inhaler
fx.zh: 复方吸入剂里的 LABA 引起的手抖和心悸

medic.en: A steroid inhaler tells you asthma or COPD. For dexamethasone, BCEHS wants a known diagnosis of one of them. Regular inhaler use is one way to establish it.
medic.zh: 有激素吸入剂，说明是哮喘或 COPD。BCEHS 用 dexamethasone 地塞米松时，要求病人已确诊这两种病之一。规律使用吸入剂就是确认诊断的一种方式。

medic.en: It is not a rescue drug. Flovent or Advair taken during an attack has treated nothing yet. Give your salbutamol.
medic.zh: 它不是急救药。发作时吸了 Flovent 或 Advair，等于还没治疗。给你的 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

medic.en: Ask if they really take it. A flare often starts with a preventer that ran out or was stopped.
medic.zh: 问清楚是不是真的在用。很多急性发作都是从预防用的吸入剂用完了或停了开始的。

medic.en: At usual doses an inhaled steroid causes far fewer whole-body effects than steroid tablets. The problems of long-term prednisone are much less likely.
medic.zh: 常规剂量下，吸入激素引起的全身反应比口服激素少得多。长期吃 prednisone 泼尼松的那些问题，出现的可能性小得多。

pearl.en: Preventer every day, reliever for trouble. A patient who has them the wrong way round has just told you why you were called.
pearl.zh: 预防的每天用，急救的出事时用。病人把两支用反了，你就知道这趟车是为什么来的。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Mucokinetic and Bronchodilator Medications (steroids suppress airway inflammation); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Lily, 9, asthma, wheezing hard at school in Coquitlam. Her teacher gave four puffs of Flovent from her backpack ten minutes ago. No change. SpO2 91%.
stem.zh: Lily，9 岁，哮喘，在 Coquitlam 的学校里喘得厉害。十分钟前老师从她书包里拿出 Flovent 给她喷了四下。没有变化。SpO2 91%。

ask.en: What has Lily had so far?
ask.zh: 到现在为止，Lily 得到了什么治疗？

opts.en: No rescue treatment: a steroid inhaler does not open the airway quickly
opts.zh: 没有急救治疗：激素吸入剂不能很快打开气道

opts.en: The correct rescue drug, so wait a little longer
opts.zh: 用的就是正确的急救药，再等一会儿

opts.en: Too much steroid: this is now an overdose
opts.zh: 激素用多了：现在是过量

why.en: Fluticasone works over days. It does nothing in the first minutes of an attack. She needs salbutamol.
why.zh: fluticasone 氟替卡松要几天才起效。发作的头几分钟里它什么都做不了。她需要 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

bad.en: Everyone waits for the wrong puffer to work while she tires.
bad.zh: 大家都在等那支用错的吸入剂起效，她却越来越累。

stem.en: Tom, 44, asthma, wheezy for three days. His Advair ran out two weeks ago and he 'felt fine'. Now using Ventolin every two hours. HR 110.
stem.zh: Tom，44 岁，哮喘，喘了三天。他的 Advair 两周前用完了，当时「感觉挺好」。现在每两小时就要用一次 Ventolin。心率 110。

ask.en: Why is he flaring?

opts.en: The airway inflammation came back after the preventer stopped
opts.zh: 预防用的吸入剂停了以后，气道炎症又回来了

opts.en: Ventolin stops working after two weeks of use
opts.zh: Ventolin 用了两周就失效了

opts.en: Stopping Advair causes wheeze as a withdrawal effect
opts.zh: 停 Advair 会有戒断反应，引起喘鸣

why.en: The steroid was holding the inflammation down. Without it the airways swell again, and the reliever cannot keep up.
why.zh: 炎症原本是靠激素压着的。没有了它，气道又肿起来，急救吸入剂就顶不住了。

stem.en: Olga, 66, wheezy and short of breath, still tight after salbutamol and ipratropium. She says she has no lung disease. Half-used Symbicort and Spiriva sit on the counter.
stem.zh: Olga，66 岁，喘鸣、气短，用了 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵后还是很紧。她说自己没有肺病。台面上放着用了一半的 Symbicort 和 Spiriva。

ask.en: What do the inhalers tell you?
ask.zh: 这些吸入剂说明了什么？

opts.en: She almost certainly has diagnosed asthma or COPD
opts.zh: 她几乎肯定已经被诊断为哮喘或 COPD

opts.en: Nothing: inhalers are handed out for any cough
opts.zh: 说明不了什么：什么咳嗽都会开吸入剂

opts.en: She has heart failure, not lung disease
opts.zh: 她是心衰，不是肺病

why.en: Regular inhaler use is one of the ways BCEHS lets you establish a known diagnosis when you consider dexamethasone.
why.zh: 考虑用 dexamethasone 地塞米松时，BCEHS 认可的确认诊断方式之一，就是病人规律使用吸入剂。

s.en: A plain steroid inhaler relieves an asthma attack within minutes.
s.zh: 单纯的激素吸入剂能在几分钟内缓解哮喘发作。

why.en: It works over days. Relief in minutes comes from salbutamol.
why.zh: 它要几天才起效。几分钟内缓解靠的是 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

s.en: Patients should rinse their mouth after using a steroid inhaler.
s.zh: 用完激素吸入剂后应该漱口。

why.en: Steroid left in the mouth causes thrush and a hoarse voice.
why.zh: 留在嘴里的激素会引起鹅口疮和声音嘶哑。

s.en: Advair and Symbicort each contain a steroid plus a long-acting bronchodilator.
s.zh: Advair 和 Symbicort 都是一种激素加一种长效支气管扩张剂。

why.en: Fluticasone with salmeterol, and budesonide with formoterol.
why.zh: 一个是 fluticasone 氟替卡松加 salmeterol 沙美特罗，一个是 budesonide 布地奈德加 formoterol 福莫特罗。

s.en: A patient who feels well can safely stop the preventer inhaler.
s.zh: 病人感觉良好时，可以放心停掉预防用的吸入剂。

why.en: Feeling well is the preventer working. Stopping it invites a flare.
why.zh: 感觉好正是因为它在起作用。停掉就容易发作。

q.en: Which side effect is typical of an inhaled steroid?
q.zh: 哪种副作用是吸入激素的典型表现？

opts.en: Thrush in the mouth and a hoarse voice
opts.zh: 口腔鹅口疮和声音嘶哑

opts.en: A slow heart rate and low blood pressure
opts.zh: 心率慢、血压低

opts.en: Low blood sugar and sweating
opts.zh: 低血糖、出汗

opts.en: Constipation and trouble passing urine
opts.zh: 便秘、排尿困难

why.en: The steroid that lands in the mouth and throat causes local problems. Rinsing after each use prevents most of them.
why.zh: 落在口腔和咽喉的激素会引起局部问题。每次用完漱口，大部分都能避免。

home.name: Long-acting bronchodilators (LABA, LAMA)

cls.en: Long-acting bronchodilators: beta-2 agonists (LABA) and anticholinergics (LAMA)
cls.zh: 长效支气管扩张剂：长效 β2 激动剂（LABA）和长效抗胆碱药（LAMA）

hook.en: The every-day airway openers. Not for an attack.
hook.zh: 每天用来撑开气道的药。发作时不靠它。

how.en: A LABA stimulates beta-2 receptors, like salbutamol but for many hours. A LAMA blocks the acetylcholine signal that tightens the airway, like ipratropium but much longer. Both are taken on a schedule to keep the airways open.
how.zh: LABA 刺激 β2 受体，和 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇一样，但能维持很多个小时。LAMA 挡住让气道收紧的乙酰胆碱信号，和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵一样，但时间长得多。两种都是按时用，让气道一直开着。

tells.en: COPD (the usual reason, especially for a LAMA such as Spiriva)
tells.zh: COPD（最常见的原因，尤其是 Spiriva 这类 LAMA）

tells.en: Asthma that needs more than a steroid inhaler (a LABA, together with the steroid)
tells.zh: 单用激素吸入剂不够的哮喘（LABA，和激素一起用）

use.en: Keep the airways open all day in COPD
use.zh: 让 COPD 病人的气道全天保持通畅

use.en: Cut down breathlessness and flare-ups in COPD
use.zh: 减少 COPD 的气短和急性加重

use.en: Add to a steroid inhaler in asthma (LABA)
use.zh: 哮喘时加在激素吸入剂上（LABA）

no.en: A LABA on its own, without an inhaled steroid, in asthma
no.zh: 哮喘病人单用 LABA、不配吸入激素

no.en: Rescue treatment of a sudden attack (salmeterol and the LAMAs start too slowly)
no.zh: 用来急救突然的发作（salmeterol 沙美特罗和 LAMA 起效太慢）

no.en: Allergy to the drug or its ingredients
no.zh: 对药物或其成分过敏

noFake.en: Using a salbutamol reliever as well
noFake.zh: 同时在用 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇急救吸入剂

care.en: LAMA: caution with narrow-angle glaucoma and with an enlarged prostate (urine retention).
care.zh: LAMA：闭角型青光眼和前列腺增生（尿潴留）的病人要小心。

care.en: LABA: caution with heart disease and fast heart rhythms.
care.zh: LABA：心脏病和快速心律失常的病人要小心。

care.en: They are taken on a schedule, not when the patient feels short of breath.
care.zh: 它们是按时用的，不是觉得气短了才用。

medic.en: It is a history clue. Spiriva on the table usually means COPD. A LABA with a steroid means asthma or COPD that a reliever alone could not control.
medic.zh: 它是病史线索。桌上有 Spiriva，多半是 COPD。LABA 加激素，说明是单靠急救吸入剂控制不住的哮喘或 COPD。

medic.en: It is not a rescue drug. A patient who puffed Spiriva or Serevent during an attack has had no real treatment yet. Give your salbutamol.
medic.zh: 它不是急救药。发作时吸了 Spiriva 或 Serevent 的病人，其实还没得到真正的治疗。给你的 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

medic.en: Tiotropium is a cousin of your ipratropium. Both BC monographs list allergy as the only contraindication to ipratropium. Neither one mentions a home LAMA.
medic.zh: tiotropium 噻托溴铵和你的 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵是一家的。两份 BC 药物专论里，ipratropium 异丙托溴铵唯一的禁忌是过敏。两份都没有提到病人在家用 LAMA 的情况。

medic.en: Too much LABA looks like too much salbutamol: fast pulse, tremor, palpitations, low potassium.
medic.zh: LABA 过量就像 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇过量：脉搏快、手抖、心悸、低钾。

pearl.en: Ask 'which puffer do you use when you cannot breathe?' If they hold up the Spiriva, nothing has been treated yet.
pearl.zh: 问一句「喘不上气的时候你用哪一支？」如果举起来的是 Spiriva，那就等于还没治疗。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Mucokinetic and Bronchodilator Medications and Anticholinergic Medications; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Ed, 73, COPD, on a fishing boat in Steveston. Wheezy, RR 28, SpO2 86%. He says, 'I took my Spiriva twice and it did nothing.'
stem.zh: Ed，73 岁，COPD，在 Steveston 的渔船上。喘鸣，呼吸 28 次/分，SpO2 86%。他说：「我吸了两次 Spiriva，一点用都没有。」

ask.en: What has he had for this attack so far?
ask.zh: 到现在为止，他这次发作得到了什么治疗？

opts.en: No rescue drug: tiotropium is a slow, all-day maintenance drug
opts.zh: 没有急救药：tiotropium 噻托溴铵是起效慢、管一整天的维持药

opts.en: A full rescue treatment, so salbutamol will add nothing
opts.zh: 已经是完整的急救治疗，再给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇也没用

opts.en: A dangerous overdose that must be treated first
opts.zh: 危险的过量，必须先处理

why.en: Tiotropium keeps airways open over the day. It does not relieve an attack. He still needs salbutamol.
why.zh: tiotropium 噻托溴铵是让气道全天保持通畅的。它不能缓解发作。他还是需要 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇。

bad.en: You hold the salbutamol and his oxygen level keeps falling.
bad.zh: 你不给 salbutamol 沙丁胺醇，他的血氧继续往下掉。

stem.en: Nora, 35, asthma. Her night cough is worse. Her only inhaler is salmeterol (Serevent). She stopped the steroid inhaler months ago.
stem.zh: Nora，35 岁，哮喘。夜里咳嗽加重。她唯一的吸入剂是 salmeterol 沙美特罗（Serevent）。激素吸入剂几个月前就停了。

ask.en: What is wrong with this picture?

opts.en: A LABA without an inhaled steroid is unsafe in asthma
opts.zh: 哮喘病人只用 LABA、不用吸入激素，是不安全的

opts.en: Nothing: salmeterol alone is ideal for asthma
opts.zh: 没问题：哮喘单用 salmeterol 沙美特罗最合适

opts.en: Salmeterol should be swapped for tiotropium alone
opts.zh: 应该把 salmeterol 沙美特罗换成单用 tiotropium 噻托溴铵

why.en: A LABA relaxes the muscle but leaves the inflammation untreated. Used alone in asthma it is linked to severe attacks.
why.zh: LABA 只放松肌肉，炎症没人管。哮喘病人单用它，和严重发作有关。

stem.en: Arthur, 80, COPD, uses umeclidinium (Incruse). Enlarged prostate. He has not passed urine since last night. Lower belly swollen and painful.
stem.zh: Arthur，80 岁，COPD，用 umeclidinium 乌美溴铵（Incruse）。前列腺增生。从昨晚到现在没排尿。下腹又胀又痛。

ask.en: Which of his medicines can add to this?
ask.zh: 他的哪种药可能加重这个问题？

opts.en: The LAMA: anticholinergics can cause urine retention
opts.zh: LAMA：抗胆碱药会引起尿潴留

opts.en: His salbutamol reliever: beta-2 agonists block the bladder
opts.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇急救吸入剂：β2 激动剂会堵住膀胱

opts.en: His vitamin D tablets: they swell the prostate
opts.zh: 维生素 D 片：会让前列腺肿大

why.en: Anticholinergic drugs relax the bladder muscle. With an enlarged prostate that can tip a man into retention. Ipratropium carries the same caution.
why.zh: 抗胆碱药让膀胱肌肉放松。加上前列腺增生，就可能尿不出来。ipratropium 异丙托溴铵也有同样的注意事项。

s.en: Tiotropium (Spiriva) is a good rescue inhaler for a sudden attack.
s.zh: tiotropium 噻托溴铵（Spiriva）是突然发作时很好的急救吸入剂。

why.en: It is a slow, all-day maintenance drug.
why.zh: 它是起效慢、管一整天的维持药。

s.en: In asthma, a LABA should not be used without an inhaled steroid.
s.zh: 哮喘病人不应该只用 LABA 而不用吸入激素。

why.en: Alone it hides the symptoms while the inflammation gets worse.
why.zh: 单用会把症状盖住，炎症却越来越重。

s.en: Finding Spiriva suggests the patient has COPD.
s.zh: 发现 Spiriva，提示病人有 COPD。

why.en: A LAMA is a mainstay of daily COPD treatment.
why.zh: LAMA 是 COPD 日常治疗的主力。

s.en: A LAMA opens the airways by stimulating beta-2 receptors.
s.zh: LAMA 靠刺激 β2 受体来打开气道。

why.en: It blocks acetylcholine at muscarinic receptors. The LABA is the beta-2 drug.
why.zh: 它在毒蕈碱受体上阻断乙酰胆碱。刺激 β2 受体的是 LABA。

q.en: How does a LAMA such as tiotropium open the airways?
q.zh: tiotropium 噻托溴铵这类 LAMA 怎样打开气道？

opts.en: It blocks acetylcholine at muscarinic receptors in the airway muscle
opts.zh: 在气道肌肉的毒蕈碱受体上阻断乙酰胆碱

opts.en: It stimulates beta-2 receptors in the airway muscle
opts.zh: 刺激气道肌肉上的 β2 受体

opts.en: It reduces airway inflammation like a steroid
opts.zh: 像激素一样减轻气道炎症

opts.en: It thins the mucus so it can be coughed up
opts.zh: 把痰变稀，方便咳出来

why.en: Same idea as ipratropium, but it lasts much longer.
why.zh: 和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵是一个道理，只是作用时间长得多。

home.name: Methadone and Suboxone (OAT)
home.zh: 美沙酮与 Suboxone（阿片替代治疗）

cls.en: Long-acting opioid for opioid use disorder (opioid agonist therapy, OAT)
cls.zh: 治疗阿片使用障碍的长效阿片类药（阿片受体激动剂治疗，OAT）

hook.en: A steady, long-acting opioid that replaces the street supply.
hook.zh: 用稳定的长效阿片类，顶替街头的货。

how.en: Both keep the opioid receptors occupied all day, so there is no withdrawal and less craving. Methadone is a full, long-acting opioid. Buprenorphine is a partial one: it grips the receptor tightly but switches it on only part way.
how.zh: 两种药都让阿片受体整天被占着，所以不会戒断，渴求也少了。methadone 美沙酮是完全激动、长效的阿片类。buprenorphine 丁丙诺啡是部分激动剂：它把受体抓得很紧，却只打开一部分。

tells.zh: 阿片使用障碍，正在接受治疗

tells.en: Chronic pain (methadone is sometimes used for it)
tells.zh: 慢性疼痛（有时会用 methadone 美沙酮）

use.en: Prevent opioid withdrawal
use.zh: 防止阿片戒断

use.en: Reduce cravings and the use of street opioids
use.zh: 减少渴求和街头阿片类的使用

use.en: Lower the risk of death from overdose
use.zh: 降低过量死亡的风险

no.en: Severe breathing problems (respiratory depression)
no.zh: 严重的呼吸问题（呼吸抑制）

no.en: Bowel obstruction
no.zh: 肠梗阻

no.en: Taking an MAO inhibitor
no.zh: 正在吃 MAO 抑制剂

care.en: Methadone builds up over the first days of treatment, when the overdose risk is highest.
care.zh: methadone 美沙酮在治疗头几天会逐渐蓄积，那时候过量风险最高。

care.en: Benzodiazepines, alcohol and other sedatives on top make an overdose far more likely.
care.zh: 再加上苯二氮䓬类、酒精或其他镇静药，过量的可能性大得多。

care.en: Methadone can lengthen the QT interval.
care.zh: methadone 美沙酮可能延长 QT 间期。

care.en: After missed days tolerance falls, and the usual dose can then be an overdose.
care.zh: 停了几天之后耐受会下降，这时候原来的剂量就可能是过量。

fx.en: Slow breathing if the dose is too high

medic.en: A methadone overdose is an opioid overdose: ventilate first, then naloxone. Methadone lasts far longer than naloxone, so the patient can stop breathing again. Always transport.
medic.zh: methadone 美沙酮过量就是阿片过量：先通气，再给 naloxone 纳洛酮。methadone 美沙酮的作用比 naloxone 纳洛酮长得多，病人可能再次停止呼吸。一定要转运。

medic.en: Naloxone can cause withdrawal in a patient on OAT. Expect vomiting and agitation. The goal is breathing, not a wide-awake patient.
medic.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮可能让接受 OAT 的病人出现戒断。要预料到呕吐和躁动。目标是恢复呼吸，不是让病人完全清醒。

medic.en: Buprenorphine holds its receptor tightly, so naloxone may work less well. Airway and ventilation matter even more.
medic.zh: buprenorphine 丁丙诺啡把受体抓得很紧，所以 naloxone 纳洛酮的效果可能差一些。气道和通气就更重要了。

medic.en: One adult dose of methadone can kill a child. Ask where the take-home doses are kept.
medic.zh: 成人一次剂量的 methadone 美沙酮就能要一个孩子的命。问清楚带回家的药放在哪里。

pearl.en: Suboxone contains naloxone, and the patient can still overdose. Methadone outlasts your naloxone.
pearl.zh: Suboxone 里虽然有 naloxone 纳洛酮，病人照样可能过量。methadone 美沙酮比你手里的 naloxone 纳洛酮撑得久。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), household medication list (buprenorphine, Suboxone), ch.7 Analgesics and Antagonists and ch.36 Narcotics, Opiates, and Opioids; standard pharmacology; BCEHS and EMALB naloxone monographs; EMALB Suspected Narcotic Overdose protocol

stem.en: Kyle, 33, on daily methadone, is found slumped in a Surrey stairwell. RR 5, pinpoint pupils. After ventilation and naloxone he wakes, swears and tries to walk away.
stem.zh: Kyle，33 岁，每天喝 methadone 美沙酮，被发现瘫在 Surrey 的楼梯间。呼吸 5 次，针尖样瞳孔。通气并给了 naloxone 纳洛酮后他醒了，骂骂咧咧想走。

ask.en: What is the risk if he leaves?
ask.zh: 他要是走了，风险是什么？

opts.en: The naloxone wears off first and he may stop breathing again
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮先失效，他可能再次停止呼吸

opts.en: None. Methadone is a treatment, so it cannot overdose him
opts.zh: 没有风险。methadone 美沙酮是治疗用药，不会让他过量

opts.en: The naloxone will keep building up in his body
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮会在他体内越积越多

why.en: Methadone keeps working for many hours, often a day or more. BCEHS lists naloxone's duration as 30 to 45 minutes. He needs transport and observation.
why.zh: methadone 美沙酮的作用能持续很多个小时，常常一天甚至更久。BCEHS 写的 naloxone 纳洛酮作用时间是 30 到 45 分钟。他需要转运和观察。

bad.en: He walks off, sits down around the corner and stops breathing with nobody watching.
bad.zh: 他走了，在拐角坐下，没人看着的时候呼吸停了。

stem.en: Mia, 2, is sleepy and breathing 10 a minute in an East Vancouver apartment. Her father keeps his take-home methadone in the fridge door. One bottle is open.
stem.zh: Mia，2 岁，在 East Vancouver 的公寓里昏昏欲睡，每分钟呼吸 10 次。她父亲把带回家的 methadone 美沙酮放在冰箱门上。有一瓶是开着的。

ask.en: How serious is this?

opts.en: Life-threatening: one adult dose can kill a toddler
opts.zh: 危及生命：成人一次的量就能要幼儿的命

opts.en: Minor: the methadone is diluted in juice
opts.zh: 问题不大：methadone 美沙酮是用果汁稀释过的

opts.en: Unlikely: toddlers do not absorb methadone well
opts.zh: 不太可能：幼儿对 methadone 美沙酮吸收不好

why.en: Methadone is long-acting, and a small amount is a huge dose for a child. Support her breathing and treat it as an opioid overdose.
why.zh: methadone 美沙酮是长效药，一点点对孩子来说就是极大的剂量。支持她的呼吸，按阿片过量处理。

stem.en: Dana, 29, takes Suboxone daily. Tonight she also took 'a few' of a friend's clonazepam and drank wine. Hard to rouse, RR 8, SpO2 88%.
stem.zh: Dana，29 岁，每天含服 Suboxone。今晚她还吃了朋友的「几片」clonazepam 氯硝西泮，又喝了葡萄酒。很难叫醒，呼吸 8 次，SpO2 88%。

ask.en: Which statement is true?

opts.en: Suboxone with sedatives and alcohol can still stop her breathing
opts.zh: Suboxone 加上镇静药和酒精，照样能让她停止呼吸

opts.en: The naloxone in Suboxone protects her from an overdose
opts.zh: Suboxone 里的 naloxone 纳洛酮能保护她不过量

opts.en: Buprenorphine cannot depress breathing at any dose
opts.zh: buprenorphine 丁丙诺啡不管多大剂量都不会抑制呼吸

why.en: Buprenorphine alone has a ceiling on respiratory depression, but benzodiazepines and alcohol remove that safety margin. Ventilate first.
why.zh: 单用 buprenorphine 丁丙诺啡时，呼吸抑制有个封顶，但加上苯二氮䓬类和酒精，这层保险就没了。先通气。

s.en: Methadone stays in the body much longer than naloxone.
s.zh: methadone 美沙酮在体内停留的时间比 naloxone 纳洛酮长得多。

why.en: That is why a methadone overdose can return after the naloxone wears off.
why.zh: 所以 naloxone 纳洛酮失效后，methadone 美沙酮过量的表现可能卷土重来。

s.en: Suboxone contains naloxone, so the patient cannot overdose on opioids.
s.zh: Suboxone 里有 naloxone 纳洛酮，所以病人不可能阿片过量。

why.en: Under the tongue the naloxone is barely absorbed, and it is only there to discourage injecting.
why.zh: 含在舌下时 naloxone 纳洛酮几乎不被吸收，加它只是为了防止有人拿去注射。

s.en: Buprenorphine taken too soon after another opioid can trigger sudden withdrawal.
s.zh: 刚用过别的阿片类就吃 buprenorphine 丁丙诺啡，可能突然引发戒断。

why.en: It pushes the other opioid off the receptor but switches the receptor on only part way.
why.zh: 它把别的阿片类从受体上挤走，自己却只把受体打开一部分。

s.en: A methadone patient who is hard to wake is just showing a normal effect of the dose.
s.zh: 喝 methadone 美沙酮的病人叫不醒，只是这个剂量的正常反应。

why.en: A stable dose should not sedate, so treat it as an overdose.
why.zh: 稳定的剂量不应该让人昏睡，所以按过量处理。

q.en: Why is buprenorphine called a partial agonist?
q.zh: 为什么说 buprenorphine 丁丙诺啡是部分激动剂？

opts.en: It binds the opioid receptor tightly but switches it on only part way
opts.zh: 它紧紧结合阿片受体，却只把受体打开一部分

opts.en: It blocks the opioid receptor completely, as naloxone does
opts.zh: 它像 naloxone 纳洛酮一样把阿片受体完全阻断

opts.en: It works in only half of the patients who take it
opts.zh: 只有一半吃它的病人有效

opts.en: It acts for only part of the day
opts.zh: 它一天里只起一部分时间的作用

why.en: That is enough effect to stop withdrawal, with less respiratory depression than a full opioid.
why.zh: 这点作用足够防止戒断，而呼吸抑制比完全激动的阿片类轻。

q.en: What sets a methadone overdose apart from a heroin overdose?
q.zh: methadone 美沙酮过量和 heroin 海洛因过量相比，不同在哪里？

opts.en: It lasts much longer than a dose of naloxone
opts.zh: 它持续的时间比一剂 naloxone 纳洛酮长得多

opts.en: It does not respond to naloxone at all
opts.zh: 它对 naloxone 纳洛酮完全没有反应

opts.en: It never slows the breathing
opts.zh: 它从不让呼吸变慢

opts.en: It makes the pupils large
opts.zh: 它让瞳孔变大

why.en: Naloxone works, but methadone outlasts it. The patient needs transport and repeated checks.
why.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮有效，但 methadone 美沙酮撑得更久。病人需要转运和反复评估。

home.name: Tricyclic antidepressants

cls.zh: 三环类抗抑郁药（TCA）

hook.en: An old antidepressant, now often used for nerve pain.
hook.zh: 老一代抗抑郁药，现在常用来治神经痛。

how.en: It blocks the reuptake of norepinephrine and serotonin in the brain. It also blocks acetylcholine, which dries the mouth and speeds the heart, and alpha-1 receptors, which drops the standing blood pressure. In overdose it blocks sodium channels in the heart.
how.zh: 它在大脑里阻断去甲肾上腺素和 5-羟色胺的再摄取。它还阻断乙酰胆碱，所以口干、心跳快，又阻断 α1 受体，所以站起来血压会掉。过量时它会阻断心脏的钠通道。

tells.en: Nerve pain or other chronic pain (a low dose at bedtime)
tells.zh: 神经痛或其他慢性疼痛（睡前小剂量）

use.en: Ease nerve pain
use.zh: 缓解神经痛

use.en: Prevent migraine
use.zh: 预防偏头痛

use.en: Treat depression
use.zh: 治疗抑郁症

use.en: Help with sleep
use.zh: 帮助睡眠

no.en: Recent heart attack
no.zh: 近期心梗

no.en: Taking an MAO inhibitor
no.zh: 正在吃 MAO 抑制剂

no.en: Heart block or a serious rhythm problem
no.zh: 传导阻滞或严重心律失常

care.en: Older adults: confusion, constipation, trouble passing urine and falls.
care.zh: 老年人：意识混乱、便秘、排尿困难、跌倒。

care.en: Narrow-angle glaucoma and an enlarged prostate get worse with its anticholinergic effect.
care.zh: 闭角型青光眼和前列腺增生会因为它的抗胆碱作用而加重。

care.en: Seizure disorder: it lowers the seizure threshold.
care.zh: 癫痫：它会降低发作阈值。

care.en: A small supply can be lethal, which makes it a dangerous pill for a suicidal patient.
care.zh: 不多的药量就可能致命，所以对有自杀念头的病人来说，这是很危险的药。

medic.en: Overdose is one of the deadliest. First it looks anticholinergic: fast pulse, large pupils, dry flushed skin, confusion. Then come drowsiness, seizures, low pressure and a wide QRS.
medic.zh: 它是过量最凶险的药之一。开始像抗胆碱中毒：脉搏快、瞳孔大、皮肤干而潮红、意识混乱。接着是嗜睡、抽搐、低血压和 QRS 增宽。

medic.en: It turns fast. A drowsy patient with stable vitals can be seizing or in arrest minutes later. Treat every tricyclic overdose as time-critical.
medic.zh: 变化很快。嗜睡但生命体征平稳的病人，几分钟后就可能抽搐或心跳骤停。每一个三环类过量都按分秒必争来处理。

medic.en: At normal doses the resting pulse can run a little fast and the standing pressure can drop. Think of it when an older patient falls.
medic.zh: 正常剂量下，静息脉搏可能偏快，站立血压可能偏低。老年病人跌倒时要想到它。

medic.en: Dimenhydrinate is anticholinergic too. BCEHS notes that its effects add up with tricyclics. Watch for more confusion and more trouble passing urine.
medic.zh: dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明也有抗胆碱作用。BCEHS 提到它和三环类的作用会叠加。留意意识混乱和排尿困难是否加重。

pearl.en: A tricyclic overdose that looks fine has not finished yet. Fast pulse and large pupils now, wide QRS and seizures next.
pearl.zh: 三环类过量的病人看着没事，只是还没演完。现在是脉搏快、瞳孔大，接下来是 QRS 增宽和抽搐。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Psychotherapeutic Medications, the household medication list (TCAs) and ch.36 Tricyclic Antidepressants; standard pharmacology; BCEHS and EMALB dimenhydrinate monographs

stem.en: Brooke, 17, is found at a Coquitlam school with an empty amitriptyline bottle. Drowsy but talking. HR 132, BP 104/62. Pupils large, skin hot and dry.
stem.zh: Brooke，17 岁，在 Coquitlam 的学校被发现，身边有个空的 amitriptyline 阿米替林药瓶。嗜睡但能说话。心率 132，血压 104/62。瞳孔大，皮肤又热又干。

ask.en: How urgent is this?

opts.en: Time-critical: she can seize or arrest without warning
opts.zh: 分秒必争：她随时可能毫无预兆地抽搐或心跳骤停

opts.en: Stable: her pressure is fine, so routine transport
opts.zh: 稳定：血压还行，按常规转运

opts.en: Mild: tricyclics are as safe as SSRIs in overdose
opts.zh: 不重：三环类过量和 SSRI 一样安全

why.en: Fast pulse, large pupils and dry skin are the early anticholinergic stage. Seizures, low pressure and a wide QRS can follow suddenly.
why.zh: 脉搏快、瞳孔大、皮肤干是早期的抗胆碱阶段。抽搐、低血压和 QRS 增宽可能突然跟上来。

bad.en: You take your time on scene and she seizes on the stairs.
bad.zh: 你在现场慢慢来，她在楼梯上抽了起来。

stem.en: Stan, 76, is nauseated on a BC Ferries crossing. He takes nortriptyline for nerve pain and has an enlarged prostate. He already struggles to pass urine.
stem.zh: Stan，76 岁，在 BC Ferries 的渡轮上恶心。他因为神经痛在吃 nortriptyline 去甲替林，还有前列腺增生。平时排尿就费劲。

ask.en: What should you remember about dimenhydrinate for him?
ask.zh: 给他用 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明，要记住什么？

opts.en: Its anticholinergic effects add to the nortriptyline
opts.zh: 它的抗胆碱作用会和 nortriptyline 去甲替林叠加

opts.en: It cancels out the effect of the nortriptyline
opts.zh: 它会抵消 nortriptyline 去甲替林的作用

opts.en: It has no effect on the bladder or the mind
opts.zh: 它对膀胱和意识都没有影响

why.en: BCEHS says tricyclics act synergistically with dimenhydrinate, and prostate enlargement is a caution. Watch for retention and confusion.
why.zh: BCEHS 写明三环类和 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明有协同作用，前列腺增生是需要小心的情况。留意尿潴留和意识混乱。

stem.en: Lena, 58, has shingles scars on her chest and no history of depression. Her only bedtime pill is a small dose of amitriptyline.
stem.zh: Lena，58 岁，胸口有带状疱疹留下的疤，没有抑郁病史。她睡前只吃一种药：小剂量 amitriptyline 阿米替林。

ask.en: What is it most likely for?
ask.zh: 这个药最可能是治什么的？

opts.en: Nerve pain after shingles
opts.zh: 带状疱疹后的神经痛

opts.en: Severe depression
opts.zh: 重度抑郁

opts.en: High blood pressure
opts.zh: 高血压

why.en: A low dose of amitriptyline at bedtime is a common treatment for nerve pain. The bottle alone does not mean depression.
why.zh: 睡前小剂量 amitriptyline 阿米替林是神经痛的常用治疗。光凭药瓶不能说她有抑郁。

s.en: A tricyclic overdose can widen the QRS and cause seizures.
s.zh: 三环类过量会让 QRS 增宽，还会引起抽搐。

why.en: In high doses it blocks sodium channels.
why.zh: 大剂量时它会阻断钠通道。

s.en: Amitriptyline on the bedside table means the patient is being treated for depression.
s.zh: 床头柜上有 amitriptyline 阿米替林，说明病人在治抑郁症。

why.en: Today it is often used at a low dose for nerve pain, migraine and sleep.
why.zh: 现在它常常是小剂量用来治神经痛、偏头痛和失眠。

s.en: Dry mouth, constipation and a fast pulse are typical tricyclic side effects.
s.zh: 口干、便秘、脉搏快是三环类的典型副作用。

why.en: It blocks acetylcholine.
why.zh: 因为它阻断乙酰胆碱。

s.en: A tricyclic overdose patient who is awake with a normal blood pressure is out of danger.
s.zh: 三环类过量的病人只要清醒、血压正常，就脱离危险了。

why.en: Deterioration can be sudden: seizures, arrhythmias and arrest.
why.zh: 恶化可以很突然：抽搐、心律失常、心跳骤停。

q.en: Which early picture fits a tricyclic overdose?
q.zh: 三环类过量的早期表现是哪一组？

opts.en: Fast pulse, large pupils, dry flushed skin, confusion
opts.zh: 脉搏快、瞳孔大、皮肤干而潮红、意识混乱

opts.en: Slow pulse, pinpoint pupils, slow shallow breathing
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、针尖样瞳孔、呼吸又慢又浅

opts.en: Slow pulse, drooling, vomiting and diarrhea
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、流口水、呕吐、腹泻

opts.en: Normal pulse, coarse tremor, great thirst
opts.zh: 脉搏正常、粗大震颤、非常口渴

why.en: The early stage is anticholinergic. Pinpoint pupils with slow breathing point to an opioid instead.
why.zh: 早期是抗胆碱表现。针尖样瞳孔加呼吸慢，指向的是阿片类。

q.en: Why does a tricyclic drop the blood pressure when the patient stands up?
q.zh: 为什么吃三环类的病人一站起来血压就掉？

opts.en: It blocks alpha-1 receptors, so the vessels do not tighten
opts.zh: 它阻断 α1 受体，血管收不紧

opts.en: It blocks beta-1 receptors and slows the heart
opts.zh: 它阻断 β1 受体，让心跳变慢

opts.en: It removes extra fluid through the kidneys
opts.zh: 它通过肾脏排掉多余的水

opts.en: It releases histamine from the mast cells
opts.zh: 它让肥大细胞释放组胺

why.en: With alpha-1 blocked, the vessels cannot squeeze when the patient stands, so the pressure falls.
why.zh: α1 被阻断，病人站起来时血管收不紧，血压就掉下来。

home.name: Antipsychotics

cls.zh: 抗精神病药（多巴胺受体阻滞剂）

hook.en: They turn dopamine down to quiet voices and racing thoughts.
hook.zh: 把多巴胺调低，让幻听和飞转的念头安静下来。

how.en: Psychosis involves too much dopamine signalling in parts of the brain. Antipsychotics block dopamine receptors, and the newer ones also act on serotonin receptors. Blocking dopamine in the movement centres is what causes the stiffness, tremor and odd movements.
how.zh: 精神病性症状和大脑某些部位多巴胺信号过强有关。抗精神病药阻断多巴胺受体，新一代的还作用于 5-羟色胺受体。运动中枢的多巴胺也被阻断，所以会出现僵硬、震颤和怪异动作。

tells.zh: 精神分裂症或其他精神病性疾病
重度抑郁（作为辅助用药）

tells.en: Severe agitation or aggression in dementia (short-term use)
tells.zh: 痴呆伴严重激越或攻击行为（短期使用）

use.en: Quiet hallucinations and delusions
use.zh: 减轻幻觉和妄想

use.en: Steady mania in bipolar disorder
use.zh: 稳定双相情感障碍的躁狂

use.en: Boost an antidepressant that is not enough
use.zh: 抗抑郁药效果不够时加强疗效

use.en: Calm severe agitation
use.zh: 控制严重激越

no.en: Parkinson's disease (haloperidol is contraindicated, and many others make it worse)
no.zh: 帕金森病（haloperidol 氟哌啶醇禁用，其他很多也会让它加重）

no.en: Coma or heavy sedation from other drugs
no.zh: 昏迷或已被其他药物深度镇静

care.en: Older adults with dementia: a higher risk of stroke and death.
care.zh: 有痴呆的老年人：卒中和死亡的风险更高。

care.en: Diabetes and weight: olanzapine and clozapine raise both blood sugar and weight.
care.zh: 糖尿病和体重：olanzapine 奥氮平和 clozapine 氯氮平会让血糖和体重都上升。

care.en: They can lengthen the QT interval.
care.zh: 它们可能延长 QT 间期。

care.en: Clozapine can wipe out white blood cells, so a fever or sore throat is urgent.
care.zh: clozapine 氯氮平可能让白细胞大量减少，所以发热或咽痛都要紧急处理。

fx.en: Sudden muscle spasm of the neck, jaw or eyes (acute dystonia)
fx.zh: 颈部、下颌或眼部肌肉突然痉挛（急性肌张力障碍）

fx.en: Weight gain and high blood sugar
Lip-smacking and tongue movements after long use
fx.zh: 长期使用后出现咂嘴、伸舌等动作

medic.en: Acute dystonia: twisted neck, locked jaw or eyes rolled up in an awake, frightened patient who just started or increased the drug. It is a drug reaction. It is not a seizure.
medic.zh: 急性肌张力障碍：病人清醒、害怕，脖子扭着、下颌锁住或眼球上翻，而且刚开始吃药或刚加量。这是药物反应，不是癫痫发作。

medic.en: Neuroleptic malignant syndrome: high fever, rigid muscles, confusion, unstable pulse and pressure. Rare and deadly. Cool the patient and transport.
medic.zh: 神经阻滞剂恶性综合征：高热、肌肉强直、意识混乱、脉搏和血压不稳。少见但致命。给病人降温并转运。

medic.en: Many sedate and drop the standing pressure, so expect falls. BCEHS notes that psychotropic medicines add to the sedating effect of Entonox.
medic.zh: 很多会让人昏沉、站立血压下降，所以要想到跌倒。BCEHS 提到精神科药物会加重 Entonox 笑气的镇静作用。

medic.en: Overdose: sleepy to comatose, fast pulse, low pressure, sometimes seizures or rhythm problems. Support the airway and monitor.
medic.zh: 过量：从嗜睡到昏迷，脉搏快、血压低，有时抽搐或心律失常。保护气道并持续监测。

pearl.en: Stiff and hot is an emergency, and twisted but awake is a drug reaction. Neither one is bad behaviour.
pearl.zh: 又僵又烫是急症，扭着身子但人清醒是药物反应。两样都不是病人在闹。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Psychotherapeutic Medications; standard pharmacology; BCEHS nitrous oxide monograph (drug interactions)

stem.en: Tyler, 22, was started on risperidone two days ago. His neck is twisted hard to one side and his eyes are stuck looking up. He is awake and scared.
stem.zh: Tyler，22 岁，两天前开始吃 risperidone 利培酮。他的脖子使劲扭向一侧，眼睛向上翻着回不来。他清醒，很害怕。

ask.en: What is this?

opts.en: Acute dystonia, a reaction to the antipsychotic
opts.zh: 急性肌张力障碍，抗精神病药的反应

opts.en: A generalized seizure that needs treatment
opts.zh: 需要处理的全身性癫痫发作

opts.en: A panic attack that he can control
opts.zh: 他自己能控制的惊恐发作

why.en: A fixed neck and upturned eyes in an awake patient soon after starting an antipsychotic is acute dystonia. It is painful and real, and the hospital can reverse it quickly.
why.zh: 刚开始吃抗精神病药，人清醒但脖子固定、眼球上翻，就是急性肌张力障碍。这是真的，而且很疼，医院可以很快把它解除。

stem.en: Grace, 45, has schizophrenia. Her olanzapine dose was doubled last week. Family says she is 'stiff as a board' and confused. Temp 40.1, HR 134, BP 168/98, drenched in sweat.
stem.zh: Grace，45 岁，有精神分裂症。上周 olanzapine 奥氮平的剂量加倍了。家人说她「硬得像块板」，还糊里糊涂。体温 40.1，心率 134，血压 168/98，浑身是汗。

ask.en: What do you suspect?

opts.en: Neuroleptic malignant syndrome
opts.zh: 神经阻滞剂恶性综合征

opts.en: Acute dystonia
opts.zh: 急性肌张力障碍

opts.en: Opioid overdose
opts.zh: 阿片过量

why.en: High fever, rigid muscles, confusion and unstable vitals after a dose change point to neuroleptic malignant syndrome. Cool her and transport urgently.
why.zh: 调了剂量之后出现高热、肌肉强直、意识混乱、生命体征不稳，指向神经阻滞剂恶性综合征。给她降温，紧急转运。

bad.en: You treat it as a psychiatric episode and her temperature keeps rising.
bad.zh: 你把它当成精神症状发作，她的体温继续往上升。

stem.en: Omar, 38, takes clozapine. He has had a sore throat and fever for two days. Temp 38.8. He says it is just a cold and wants to stay home.
stem.zh: Omar，38 岁，在吃 clozapine 氯氮平。咽痛、发热两天了。体温 38.8。他说只是感冒，想留在家里。

ask.en: Why does he need the hospital?
