opts.en: Clozapine can wipe out white cells, so infections turn serious
opts.zh: clozapine 氯氮平可能让白细胞大量减少，感染会变得很重

opts.en: Clozapine causes strep throat in most patients
opts.zh: clozapine 氯氮平会让大多数病人得链球菌性咽炎

opts.en: Fever means he has taken too much clozapine
opts.zh: 发热说明他 clozapine 氯氮平吃多了

why.en: Clozapine can cause a dangerous fall in white blood cells. A fever or sore throat needs a blood count without delay.
why.zh: clozapine 氯氮平可能引起危险的白细胞减少。发热或咽痛都要尽快查血常规。

s.en: Antipsychotics can cause stiffness and tremor that look like Parkinson's disease.
s.zh: 抗精神病药引起的僵硬和震颤，看起来可以很像帕金森病。

why.en: They block dopamine in the brain's movement centres.
why.zh: 它们阻断了大脑运动中枢的多巴胺。

s.en: A twisted neck and upturned eyes after a new antipsychotic is the patient acting out.
s.zh: 刚吃上抗精神病药就脖子扭着、眼球上翻，是病人在装。

why.en: That is acute dystonia, a real and painful drug reaction.
why.zh: 那是急性肌张力障碍，真实而且疼痛的药物反应。

s.en: Olanzapine can raise blood sugar and body weight.
s.zh: olanzapine 奥氮平会让血糖和体重上升。

why.en: Check a glucose in a confused patient who takes it.
why.zh: 吃这个药的病人意识不清时，要测血糖。

s.en: Quetiapine in a pill box always means schizophrenia.
s.zh: 药盒里有 quetiapine 喹硫平，就一定是精神分裂症。

why.en: It is also prescribed for bipolar disorder and as an add-on in depression.
why.zh: 它也用于双相情感障碍，还可以作为抑郁症的辅助用药。

q.en: What do antipsychotics block to reduce hallucinations?
q.zh: 抗精神病药阻断什么来减轻幻觉？

opts.en: Dopamine receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 大脑里的多巴胺受体

opts.en: Opioid receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 大脑里的阿片受体

opts.en: Sodium channels in the heart
opts.zh: 心脏的钠通道

opts.en: The enzyme that breaks down acetylcholine
opts.zh: 分解乙酰胆碱的酶

why.en: Most work by blocking dopamine receptors. The same block causes the movement side effects.
why.zh: 大多数是靠阻断多巴胺受体起作用的。同样的阻断也带来了运动方面的副作用。

q.en: Which finding points to neuroleptic malignant syndrome?
q.zh: 哪一组表现指向神经阻滞剂恶性综合征？

opts.en: High fever with rigid muscles and confusion
opts.zh: 高热、肌肉强直、意识混乱

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils with slow breathing
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔、呼吸慢

opts.en: Low blood sugar with heavy sweating
opts.zh: 低血糖、大汗

opts.en: A slow pulse with drooling and diarrhea
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、流口水、腹泻

why.en: Fever, rigidity, a changed mental state and unstable vitals are the hallmarks.
why.zh: 发热、强直、意识改变和生命体征不稳是它的标志。

home.name: Digoxin

cls.zh: 强心苷

hook.en: An old heart drug with a narrow safety margin.
hook.zh: 一种老牌心脏药，安全范围很窄。

how.en: It makes each heartbeat a little stronger and slows the signals passing through the AV node. In atrial fibrillation fewer impulses reach the ventricles, so the heart rate comes down. The gap between a helpful dose and a toxic one is small.
how.zh: 它让每一次心跳更有力一点，同时减慢通过房室结的电信号。房颤时传到心室的冲动变少，心率就降下来。有效剂量和中毒剂量之间的距离很小。

tells.zh: 房颤或房扑（控制心室率）

use.en: Slow the heart rate in atrial fibrillation or flutter
use.zh: 房颤或房扑时减慢心率

use.en: Strengthen the heartbeat in chronic heart failure
use.zh: 慢性心衰时增强心脏收缩

no.en: Heart block without a pacemaker
no.zh: 没有装起搏器的房室传导阻滞

no.en: Ventricular fibrillation or ventricular tachycardia
no.zh: 室颤或室速

care.en: Low potassium makes toxicity much more likely. Water pills are the usual cause.
care.zh: 低血钾会让中毒的可能性大大增加。通常是利尿药造成的。

care.en: Kidney disease and old age: the drug builds up in the body.
care.zh: 肾病和高龄：药会在体内蓄积。

care.en: Amiodarone and verapamil raise the digoxin level.
care.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮和 verapamil 维拉帕米会让 digoxin 地高辛的浓度升高。

care.en: Vomiting, diarrhea or dehydration can tip a stable patient into toxicity.
care.zh: 呕吐、腹泻或脱水可以让原本稳定的病人中毒。

fx.en: Loss of appetite, nausea and vomiting

fx.zh: 视物模糊或看东西发黄

fx.en: Slow heart rate or heart block

fx.zh: 几乎任何一种心律失常

medic.en: Any rhythm problem in a patient on digoxin: ask whether the drug is the cause. Toxicity can produce almost any dysrhythmia.
medic.zh: 吃 digoxin 地高辛的病人出现任何心律问题：都要想一想是不是药引起的。中毒几乎可以造成任何一种心律失常。

medic.en: Toxicity often starts in the gut and the eyes: no appetite, nausea, vomiting, blurred or yellow vision. In an older adult it may only look like confusion.
medic.zh: 中毒常常先从肠胃和眼睛开始：没胃口、恶心、呕吐、视物模糊或发黄。老年人可能只表现为意识混乱。

medic.en: The usual set-up is an older patient on digoxin and a water pill, with failing kidneys or a few days of vomiting or diarrhea.
medic.zh: 最常见的情况是：老年病人同时吃 digoxin 地高辛和利尿药，肾功能在变差，或者吐了、拉了好几天。

medic.en: Nausea in this patient is a clue, not just a symptom. If you treat it, still report it as possible digoxin toxicity.
medic.zh: 这种病人的恶心是一条线索，不只是一个症状。就算你给了止吐药，交接时还是要报告可能是 digoxin 地高辛中毒。

pearl.en: Nausea plus a slow or odd pulse plus digoxin in the bag is toxicity until the hospital says otherwise. Ask about yellow or blurry vision.
pearl.zh: 恶心，加上脉搏慢或不对劲，药袋里又有 digoxin 地高辛：在医院排除之前都当成中毒。问一问看东西有没有发黄或模糊。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.30 Digoxin and Antidysrhythmic Medications (Table 30-24), ch.7 cardiac glycosides; standard pharmacology

stem.en: Evelyn, 86, lives in a care home in Richmond. Three days of no appetite and vomiting. She says everything looks yellowish. HR 44, irregular. She takes digoxin and furosemide.
stem.zh: Evelyn，86 岁，住在 Richmond 的护理院。三天没胃口，一直吐。她说看什么都发黄。心率 44，不齐。她在吃 digoxin 地高辛和 furosemide 呋塞米。

ask.en: What do you suspect?

opts.en: Digoxin toxicity
opts.zh: digoxin 地高辛中毒

opts.en: A stomach bug and nothing more
opts.zh: 只是肠胃炎，没别的

opts.en: A furosemide overdose with high potassium
opts.zh: furosemide 呋塞米过量引起高血钾

why.en: Gut symptoms, yellow vision and a slow irregular pulse are the classic picture. The furosemide may have lowered her potassium, which makes it worse.
why.zh: 肠胃症状、看东西发黄、脉搏又慢又不齐，就是经典表现。furosemide 呋塞米可能把她的血钾拉低了，这会让情况更糟。

bad.en: You call it gastroenteritis and her rhythm gets worse on the way in.
bad.zh: 你当成肠胃炎，路上她的心律越来越差。

stem.en: Albert, 79, takes digoxin for atrial fibrillation. His furosemide was doubled two weeks ago. Now he has cramps, weakness and a pulse that keeps skipping.
stem.zh: Albert，79 岁，因为房颤在吃 digoxin 地高辛。两周前他的 furosemide 呋塞米加了一倍。现在他抽筋、乏力，脉搏老是漏跳。

ask.en: Why does the furosemide matter?
ask.zh: furosemide 呋塞米为什么重要？

opts.en: It lowers potassium, and low potassium makes digoxin toxic
opts.zh: 它让血钾降低，而低血钾会让 digoxin 地高辛中毒

opts.en: It blocks digoxin from being absorbed in the gut
opts.zh: 它让 digoxin 地高辛在肠道里吸收不了

opts.en: It raises potassium, which cancels out the digoxin
opts.zh: 它让血钾升高，把 digoxin 地高辛的作用抵消了

why.en: Diuretics waste potassium. A heart short of potassium is far more sensitive to digoxin, so rhythm problems appear.
why.zh: 利尿药让钾丢失。缺钾的心脏对 digoxin 地高辛敏感得多，于是出现心律问题。

stem.en: Rose, 81, has atrial fibrillation and takes digoxin. She tripped and hurt her hip. Alert, no nausea. Pulse 62 and irregularly irregular, BP 128/76.
stem.zh: Rose，81 岁，有房颤，在吃 digoxin 地高辛。她绊倒伤了髋部。清醒，不恶心。脉搏 62，绝对不齐，血压 128/76。

ask.en: How do you read her pulse?

opts.en: An irregular pulse at a controlled rate is her usual atrial fibrillation
opts.zh: 脉搏不齐但心率控制得住，这是她平时的房颤

opts.en: An irregular pulse always means digoxin toxicity
opts.zh: 脉搏不齐就一定是 digoxin 地高辛中毒

opts.en: A rate of 62 means the digoxin has stopped working
opts.zh: 心率 62 说明 digoxin 地高辛已经不起作用了

why.en: Digoxin slows the rate in atrial fibrillation. It does not make the rhythm regular. With no nausea, no visual change and a steady rate, this is her baseline.
why.zh: digoxin 地高辛让房颤的心率慢下来，但不会让节律变齐。没有恶心，视力没变化，心率平稳，这就是她的基础状态。

s.en: Yellow or blurred vision can be a sign of digoxin toxicity.
s.zh: 看东西发黄或模糊可能是 digoxin 地高辛中毒的表现。

why.en: Visual changes, nausea and loss of appetite are classic early signs.
why.zh: 视觉改变、恶心、没胃口是经典的早期表现。

s.en: Digoxin is prescribed to lower blood pressure.
s.zh: 开 digoxin 地高辛是为了降血压。

why.en: It is for rate control in atrial fibrillation and for heart failure.
why.zh: 它用来控制房颤的心率，也用于心衰。

s.en: Low potassium raises the risk of digoxin toxicity.
s.zh: 低血钾会增加 digoxin 地高辛中毒的风险。

why.en: That is why digoxin plus a water pill needs watching.
why.zh: 所以 digoxin 地高辛加利尿药的组合要特别留意。

s.en: Digoxin toxicity always shows up as a fast heart rate.
s.zh: digoxin 地高辛中毒总是表现为心率快。

why.en: It can cause almost any rhythm, and often a slow one.
why.zh: 它几乎可以造成任何一种心律，而且常常是慢的。

q.en: What does digoxin do to the heart?
q.zh: digoxin 地高辛对心脏有什么作用？

opts.en: Stronger contraction and slower conduction through the AV node
opts.zh: 收缩更有力，房室结传导变慢

opts.en: Weaker contraction and faster conduction through the AV node
opts.zh: 收缩变弱，房室结传导变快

opts.en: Wider coronary arteries and a lower blood pressure
opts.zh: 冠状动脉扩张，血压下降

opts.en: Blocked beta receptors and a lower oxygen demand
opts.zh: β 受体被阻断，需氧量下降

why.en: A stronger squeeze helps heart failure. A slower AV node controls the rate in atrial fibrillation.
why.zh: 收缩更有力，对心衰有帮助。房室结变慢，房颤的心率就控制住了。

q.en: Which early symptoms suggest digoxin toxicity?
q.zh: 哪些早期症状提示 digoxin 地高辛中毒？

opts.en: Loss of appetite, nausea and visual changes
opts.zh: 没胃口、恶心和视觉改变

opts.en: Dry cough and swollen lips
opts.zh: 干咳和嘴唇肿胀

opts.en: Swollen ankles and flushing
opts.zh: 脚踝水肿和面部潮红

opts.en: Muscle pain and dark urine
opts.zh: 肌肉痛和深色尿

why.en: The gut and the eyes often complain before the rhythm does.
why.zh: 肠胃和眼睛常常比心律先出问题。

home.name: Statins

cls.zh: HMG-CoA 还原酶抑制剂（降胆固醇药）

hook.en: Turns down the liver's cholesterol factory.
hook.zh: 把肝脏的胆固醇工厂调慢。

how.en: The liver makes most of the body's cholesterol. A statin blocks a key enzyme in that process, called HMG-CoA reductase. The LDL cholesterol in the blood falls and fatty plaque builds up more slowly in the arteries. Over years that means fewer heart attacks and strokes.
how.zh: 身体里的胆固醇大部分是肝脏造的。他汀挡住这个过程里的一个关键酶，叫 HMG-CoA 还原酶。血里的 LDL 胆固醇下降，动脉里的脂肪斑块长得更慢。坚持多年，心梗和卒中就少了。

tells.en: Coronary artery disease, a previous heart attack or a stent
tells.zh: 冠心病、得过心梗或放过支架

use.en: Lower LDL cholesterol
use.zh: 降低 LDL 胆固醇

use.en: Prevent a first heart attack or stroke in people at risk
use.zh: 给高危人群预防第一次心梗或卒中

use.en: Prevent another one after a heart attack, stent or stroke
use.zh: 心梗、支架或卒中之后预防再发

no.en: Pregnancy and breastfeeding
no.zh: 怀孕和哺乳

no.en: Active liver disease
no.zh: 活动性肝病

care.en: New muscle pain or weakness should be reported to the doctor.
care.zh: 新出现的肌肉痛或无力，应该告诉医生。

care.en: Grapefruit juice raises the blood level of some statins.
care.zh: 西柚汁会让某些他汀的血药浓度升高。

care.en: Some antibiotics and antifungal drugs raise the statin level and the risk of muscle damage.
care.zh: 有些抗生素和抗真菌药会让他汀浓度升高，肌肉损伤的风险也跟着升高。

fx.en: Rare severe muscle breakdown (rhabdomyolysis) with dark urine
fx.zh: 少见的严重肌肉溶解（横纹肌溶解），尿色变深

medic.en: A statin is a marker, not a problem. It says this patient has, or is at risk of, coronary disease or stroke. Take chest pain seriously.
medic.zh: 他汀是个标记，本身不是问题。它说明这个病人有冠心病或卒中，或者是高危人群。胸痛要认真对待。

medic.en: It does not change the vital signs and it does not cause bleeding. It is not a blood thinner, whatever the family calls it.
medic.zh: 它不改变生命体征，也不会引起出血。不管家属怎么叫，它都不是「稀释血液的药」。

medic.en: The rare emergency is rhabdomyolysis: severe muscle pain, weakness and dark, cola-coloured urine. That patient needs the hospital.
medic.zh: 少见的急症是横纹肌溶解：肌肉剧痛、无力，尿像可乐一样深色。这样的病人要去医院。

pearl.en: The most common bottle in the bag and the least dramatic. Read it as 'vascular risk', then look for the bottles that matter tonight.
pearl.zh: 药袋里最常见、也最不起眼的一瓶。把它读成「血管病高危」，然后去找今晚真正要紧的那几瓶。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihyperlipidemic Medications; standard pharmacology; own-drug rule from the BCEHS ketorolac monograph

stem.en: Doug, 62, has an aching jaw, sweating and nausea on the Skytrain. He says his heart is fine. His bag holds rosuvastatin and low-dose ASA.
stem.zh: Doug，62 岁，在 Skytrain 上下巴酸痛、出汗、恶心。他说自己心脏没问题。包里有 rosuvastatin 瑞舒伐他汀和小剂量 ASA 阿司匹林。

ask.en: What do the two bottles tell you?

opts.en: His doctor is treating him as a coronary risk, so take this seriously
opts.zh: 医生是按冠心病高危在治他，所以要认真对待

opts.en: He has a muscle disease that explains the jaw ache
opts.zh: 他有肌肉病，下巴酸痛就是这个原因

opts.en: He has a bleeding disorder and the jaw is a dental problem
opts.zh: 他有出血性疾病，下巴痛是牙的问题

why.en: A statin with low-dose ASA is a common pair in patients with vascular disease. Jaw ache with sweating and nausea can be cardiac.
why.zh: 他汀加小剂量 ASA 阿司匹林是血管病病人常见的搭配。下巴酸痛加上出汗、恶心，可能是心脏的问题。

bad.en: You accept 'my heart is fine' and miss an infarction.
bad.zh: 你信了「我心脏没问题」，漏掉一个心梗。

stem.en: Karen, 67, has had three days of severe thigh and shoulder pain and weakness. Her urine looks like cola. She takes simvastatin and started clarithromycin last week.
stem.zh: Karen，67 岁，大腿和肩膀剧痛、无力已经三天。尿的颜色像可乐。她在吃 simvastatin 辛伐他汀，上周开始吃 clarithromycin 克拉霉素。

ask.en: What do you suspect?

opts.en: Muscle breakdown (rhabdomyolysis) from the statin
opts.zh: 他汀引起的肌肉溶解（横纹肌溶解）

opts.en: A bladder infection that the statin made worse
opts.zh: 被他汀加重的膀胱感染

opts.en: A statin overdose that has dropped her blood sugar
opts.zh: 他汀过量导致低血糖

why.en: Muscle pain, weakness and dark urine in a patient on a statin is rhabdomyolysis until proven otherwise. Some antibiotics raise the statin level.
why.zh: 吃他汀的病人出现肌肉痛、无力和深色尿，先当成横纹肌溶解。有些抗生素会让他汀浓度升高。

stem.en: Liang, 71, twisted his ankle on a curb in Richmond. Pain 7/10, healthy kidneys. His wife says he takes a blood thinner. His only bottle is atorvastatin.
stem.zh: Liang，71 岁，在 Richmond 的路沿上扭伤了脚踝。疼痛 7/10，肾功能正常。太太说他在吃「稀释血液的药」。他唯一的一瓶药是 atorvastatin 阿托伐他汀。

ask.en: On the road (BCEHS), does this pill rule out ketorolac?
ask.zh: 出车时（BCEHS），这个药会让 ketorolac 酮咯酸不能用吗？

opts.en: No, a statin is not an anticoagulant and does not affect clotting
opts.zh: 不会，他汀不是抗凝药，不影响凝血

opts.en: Yes, every heart pill counts as a blood thinner
opts.zh: 会，所有心脏药都算「稀释血液的药」

opts.en: Yes, a statin blocks platelets the way ASA does
opts.zh: 会，他汀和 ASA 阿司匹林一样抑制血小板

why.en: Families often call any heart pill a blood thinner. A statin is not one. Check every bottle, because a real anticoagulant would rule out ketorolac.
why.zh: 家属常常把所有心脏药都叫「稀释血液的药」。他汀不是。把每一瓶药都看过，因为真正的抗凝药才会让 ketorolac 酮咯酸不能用。

s.en: A statin in the bag suggests the patient has, or is at risk of, coronary disease.
s.zh: 药袋里有他汀，说明病人有冠心病或者是高危人群。

why.en: Statins are prescribed to prevent heart attacks and strokes.
why.zh: 开他汀就是为了预防心梗和卒中。

s.en: Statins thin the blood and raise the risk of bleeding.
s.zh: 他汀会让血变稀，增加出血风险。

why.en: They lower cholesterol. They do not affect clotting.
why.zh: 它们降胆固醇，不影响凝血。

s.en: Severe muscle pain with dark urine in a patient on a statin needs hospital assessment.
s.zh: 吃他汀的病人出现肌肉剧痛和深色尿，需要去医院评估。

why.en: It can be rhabdomyolysis, which can damage the kidneys.
why.zh: 可能是横纹肌溶解，会损伤肾脏。

s.en: A statin relieves chest pain during an angina attack.
s.zh: 心绞痛发作时，他汀可以缓解胸痛。

why.en: It works over months and years. It does nothing in the moment.
why.zh: 它的作用要几个月、几年才显出来。当下什么也做不了。

q.en: What does a statin do?
q.zh: 他汀是做什么的？

opts.en: It blocks the liver enzyme that makes cholesterol
opts.zh: 阻断肝脏里合成胆固醇的酶

opts.en: It blocks platelets from sticking together
opts.zh: 不让血小板聚集

opts.en: It widens the coronary arteries within minutes
opts.zh: 几分钟内扩张冠状动脉

opts.en: It removes cholesterol through the kidneys
opts.zh: 通过肾脏把胆固醇排掉

why.en: Less cholesterol made in the liver means less LDL in the blood.
why.zh: 肝脏造的胆固醇少了，血里的 LDL 就少了。

q.en: Which side effect of statins is rare but serious?
q.zh: 他汀哪种副作用少见但严重？

opts.en: Muscle breakdown with dark urine
opts.zh: 肌肉溶解，尿色变深

opts.en: Swelling of the lips and tongue
opts.zh: 嘴唇和舌头肿胀

opts.en: Slow heart rate and heart block
opts.zh: 心率慢、传导阻滞

opts.en: Bleeding in the stomach
opts.zh: 胃出血

why.en: Rhabdomyolysis is rare. Ordinary muscle aches are much more common.
why.zh: 横纹肌溶解很少见。普通的肌肉酸痛常见得多。

home.name: Thiazide diuretics

cls.zh: 噻嗪类及类噻嗪利尿剂

hook.en: The gentle water pill. Mostly a blood pressure drug.
hook.zh: 温和的利尿药。主要用来降血压。

how.en: It blocks salt reabsorption in a later part of the kidney tube than a loop diuretic does. A little more salt and water leave in the urine, and over weeks the blood pressure comes down. It is weaker than furosemide. Potassium and sodium are lost in the urine.
how.zh: 它挡住盐重吸收的位置，比袢利尿剂靠后一段。尿里多排一点盐和水，几周下来血压就降了。它比 furosemide 呋塞米弱。钾和钠都会随尿丢掉。

tells.en: Heart failure, as an add-on to a loop diuretic (metolazone)
tells.zh: 心衰，作为袢利尿剂之外的加用药（metolazone 美托拉宗）

use.en: Lower blood pressure
use.zh: 降血压

use.en: Remove mild extra fluid
use.zh: 排掉少量多余的液体

use.en: Boost a loop diuretic in stubborn heart failure (metolazone)
use.zh: 心衰难控制时增强袢利尿剂的效果（metolazone 美托拉宗）

no.en: No urine output (anuria)
no.zh: 无尿

no.en: Severe low sodium or low potassium
no.zh: 严重低血钠或低血钾

care.en: Gout: it raises uric acid and can set off an attack.
care.zh: 痛风：它让尿酸升高，可能诱发痛风发作。

care.en: Diabetes: it can push the blood sugar up a little.
care.zh: 糖尿病：它可能让血糖升高一点。

care.en: Older adults: sodium can drift low and cause confusion and falls.
care.zh: 老年人：血钠可能慢慢变低，引起意识混乱和跌倒。

care.en: Digoxin: low potassium makes digoxin toxicity more likely.
care.zh: digoxin 地高辛：低血钾会让 digoxin 地高辛更容易中毒。

medic.en: New confusion, weakness, a fall or a seizure in an older adult on a thiazide: think low sodium. Thiazides are a classic cause.
medic.zh: 吃噻嗪类的老人新出现意识混乱、乏力、跌倒或抽搐：想到低血钠。噻嗪类是经典的原因。

medic.en: Low potassium shows up as cramps, weakness and palpitations. It is more dangerous if the patient also takes digoxin.
medic.zh: 低血钾表现为抽筋、乏力和心悸。病人同时吃 digoxin 地高辛的话更危险。

medic.en: Vomiting, diarrhea or heat on top of a water pill dries the patient out. Check the pressure lying and then sitting.
medic.zh: 吃着利尿药，又碰上呕吐、腹泻或天热，病人就会脱水。先躺着量血压，再坐起来量。

medic.en: BCEHS lists severe volume depletion as a caution for ibuprofen and ketorolac. A dried-out patient on a water pill fits that line.
medic.zh: BCEHS 把严重体液不足列为 ibuprofen 布洛芬和 ketorolac 酮咯酸的慎用情况。吃利尿药又脱水的病人正好符合。

pearl.en: 'HCT' or 'HCTZ' on a blood pressure label stands for hydrochlorothiazide, added to the main drug. Some brands say 'Plus' instead, such as Atacand Plus.
pearl.zh: 降压药标签上的「HCT」或「HCTZ」指的是 hydrochlorothiazide 氢氯噻嗪，说明主药之外又加了它。有些品牌改用「Plus」，例如 Atacand Plus。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Antihypertensive Medications (diuretics, thiazides) and ch.30 Diuretics (Table 30-25); standard pharmacology; own-drug rule from the BCEHS ibuprofen and ketorolac monographs

stem.en: Edith, 84, has been confused and unsteady for two days and fell this morning. No fever, glucose 6.1, no stroke signs. Hydrochlorothiazide was started three weeks ago.
stem.zh: Edith，84 岁，这两天意识混乱、走路不稳，今天早上跌倒了。不发烧，血糖 6.1，没有卒中体征。三周前开始吃 hydrochlorothiazide 氢氯噻嗪。

ask.en: Which drug effect belongs on your list?
ask.zh: 哪种药物作用要列入你的考虑？

opts.en: Low sodium from the thiazide
opts.zh: 噻嗪类引起的低血钠

opts.en: High potassium from the thiazide
opts.zh: 噻嗪类引起的高血钾

opts.en: Low blood sugar from the thiazide
opts.zh: 噻嗪类引起的低血糖

why.en: Thiazides can drain sodium, most often in older adults. Confusion and falls are how it shows up.
why.zh: 噻嗪类会让钠丢失，老年人最常见。表现出来就是意识混乱和跌倒。

stem.en: Ravi, 59, woke at 3 a.m. with a hot, red, very painful big toe. No injury. His doctor started indapamide for blood pressure last month.
stem.zh: Ravi，59 岁，凌晨 3 点痛醒，大脚趾又红又热，痛得厉害。没有受伤。上个月医生给他开了 indapamide 吲达帕胺降血压。

ask.en: How could the new pill be involved?
ask.zh: 新加的药可能有什么关系？

opts.en: Thiazides raise uric acid and can set off gout
opts.zh: 噻嗪类让尿酸升高，可能诱发痛风

opts.en: Thiazides cause blood clots in the small toe arteries
opts.zh: 噻嗪类会让脚趾的小动脉长血栓

opts.en: Thiazides lower uric acid, so this cannot be gout
opts.zh: 噻嗪类降尿酸，所以不可能是痛风

why.en: Thiazide diuretics make the body hold on to uric acid. A hot, red big toe is the classic gout attack.
why.zh: 噻嗪类利尿剂让身体留住尿酸。大脚趾又红又热，就是典型的痛风发作。

stem.en: Diane, 72, has vomited for two days. Dry tongue, dizzy sitting up, BP 98/60. She takes hydrochlorothiazide. Her back aches and she asks for Toradol.
stem.zh: Diane，72 岁，吐了两天。舌头干，坐起来头晕，血压 98/60。她在吃 hydrochlorothiazide 氢氯噻嗪。她腰背痛，想要 Toradol（ketorolac 酮咯酸）。

ask.en: On the road (BCEHS), why think twice about ketorolac?
ask.zh: 出车时（BCEHS），为什么给 ketorolac 酮咯酸前要多想一下？

opts.en: She is badly dehydrated, which BCEHS lists as a caution
opts.zh: 她脱水严重，BCEHS 把这一条列为慎用

opts.en: Ketorolac is contraindicated with every blood pressure pill
opts.zh: 只要在吃降压药就禁用 ketorolac 酮咯酸

opts.en: Ketorolac is never given to patients over 65
opts.zh: 65 岁以上的病人一律不给 ketorolac 酮咯酸

why.en: Severe volume depletion is a BCEHS caution for ketorolac and ibuprofen. A water pill plus two days of vomiting gets her there.
why.zh: 严重体液不足是 BCEHS 规定的 ketorolac 酮咯酸和 ibuprofen 布洛芬的慎用情况。利尿药再加上吐了两天，她已经到这一步了。

s.en: Thiazides can trigger an attack of gout.
s.zh: 噻嗪类可能诱发痛风发作。

why.en: They raise the uric acid level.
why.zh: 它们让尿酸升高。

s.en: Thiazides are stronger diuretics than furosemide.
s.zh: 噻嗪类的利尿作用比 furosemide 呋塞米强。

why.en: Loop diuretics are stronger. Thiazides are mainly blood pressure pills.
why.zh: 袢利尿剂更强。噻嗪类主要是降压药。

s.en: A thiazide can cause low sodium, especially in an older adult.
s.zh: 噻嗪类可能引起低血钠，老年人尤其容易。

why.en: Confusion, weakness and falls are the usual signs.
why.zh: 常见的表现是意识混乱、乏力和跌倒。

s.en: Thiazides raise the potassium level.
s.zh: 噻嗪类会让血钾升高。

why.en: They lower it, as loop diuretics do.
why.zh: 它们让血钾降低，和袢利尿剂一样。

q.en: Which set of problems fits a thiazide?
q.zh: 哪一组问题符合噻嗪类？

opts.en: Low potassium, low sodium and gout
opts.zh: 低血钾、低血钠和痛风

opts.en: High potassium and breast tenderness
opts.zh: 高血钾和乳房胀痛

opts.en: Dry cough and swollen lips
opts.zh: 干咳和嘴唇肿胀

opts.en: Slow pulse and wheeze
opts.zh: 脉搏慢和喘鸣

why.en: Thiazides lose potassium and sodium in the urine and hold on to uric acid.
why.zh: 噻嗪类让钾和钠随尿丢失，同时把尿酸留在体内。

home.name: Spironolactone (aldosterone blockers)

cls.zh: 醛固酮拮抗剂（保钾利尿剂）

hook.en: The water pill that keeps potassium in.
hook.zh: 把钾留在体内的利尿药。

how.en: Aldosterone is a hormone that tells the kidney to keep salt and water and to throw out potassium. This drug blocks aldosterone. A little salt and water leave, and the potassium stays. It is a weak diuretic, but it is a standard part of long-term heart failure treatment.
how.zh: 醛固酮是一种激素，它让肾脏留住盐和水、排掉钾。这类药挡住醛固酮。盐和水排出去一点，钾却留了下来。它的利尿作用弱，但在心衰的长期治疗里是标准用药。

tells.en: Liver cirrhosis with fluid in the belly (ascites)
High blood pressure that is hard to control
In a healthy young woman: possibly acne or unwanted hair growth
tells.zh: 健康的年轻女性：可能是痤疮或多毛

use.en: Long-term treatment of heart failure
use.zh: 心力衰竭的长期治疗

use.en: Remove fluid in liver cirrhosis (ascites)
use.zh: 排掉肝硬化的腹水

use.en: Lower stubborn high blood pressure
use.zh: 降低顽固的高血压

use.en: Offset the potassium loss caused by other diuretics
use.zh: 抵消其他利尿药造成的钾丢失

no.en: High potassium
no.zh: 高血钾

no.en: Severe kidney failure or no urine output
no.zh: 严重肾衰竭或无尿

no.en: Addison's disease (adrenal insufficiency)
no.zh: Addison 病（肾上腺皮质功能不全）

care.en: ACE inhibitors, ARBs and potassium pills push the potassium up further.
care.zh: ACE 抑制剂、ARB 和补钾药会让血钾升得更高。

care.en: Kidney disease and dehydration raise the risk of high potassium.
care.zh: 肾病和脱水会增加高血钾的风险。

care.en: Many salt substitutes are made with potassium.
care.zh: 很多代盐（低钠盐）是用钾做的。

fx.en: Breast swelling or tenderness in men

medic.en: High potassium is the danger. Weakness with a slow or irregular pulse in a patient on this pill: say the word potassium at handover.
medic.zh: 危险在高血钾。吃这种药的病人乏力，脉搏又慢或不齐：交接时要把「钾」这个字说出来。

medic.en: The risky set-up is spironolactone plus an ACE inhibitor or ARB, bad kidneys, and a few days of vomiting or diarrhea.
medic.zh: 最危险的组合是 spironolactone 螺内酯加 ACE 抑制剂或 ARB，肾又不好，再吐或拉上几天。

medic.en: It lowers blood pressure too, so it adds to nitroglycerin. Check the systolic before every dose.
medic.zh: 它也降血压，所以会和 nitroglycerin 硝酸甘油叠加。每一次给药前都要量收缩压。

medic.en: NSAIDs are hard on the kidneys and can push potassium higher. Kidney dysfunction is a BCEHS contraindication to ibuprofen and ketorolac, so ask.
medic.zh: NSAID 伤肾，还可能让血钾更高。肾功能不全是 BCEHS 规定的 ibuprofen 布洛芬和 ketorolac 酮咯酸的禁忌证，所以要问。

pearl.en: Other water pills lose potassium. This one keeps it. A weak patient with a slow pulse, bad kidneys and spironolactone in the bag has high potassium until proven otherwise.
pearl.zh: 别的利尿药丢钾，这个留钾。病人乏力、脉搏慢、肾不好，药袋里又有 spironolactone 螺内酯，先当成高血钾。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.30 Diuretics (Table 30-25 lists spironolactone, the text notes that potassium loss depends on the diuretic); standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS monographs (nitroglycerin, ibuprofen, ketorolac)

stem.en: Giuseppe, 79, has heart failure and kidney disease. Three days of fever, barely drinking. Very weak, HR 42 and irregular, BP 98/60. Pills: spironolactone and perindopril.
stem.zh: Giuseppe，79 岁，有心衰和肾病。发烧三天，几乎没喝水。非常乏力，心率 42 而且不齐，血压 98/60。吃的药：spironolactone 螺内酯和 perindopril 培哚普利。

ask.en: Which problem should lead your handover?
ask.zh: 交接时最先要讲哪个问题？

opts.en: Possible high potassium
opts.zh: 可能是高血钾

opts.en: Possible low potassium
opts.zh: 可能是低血钾

opts.en: Possible high blood sugar
opts.zh: 可能是高血糖

why.en: Both pills raise potassium. Bad kidneys and dehydration finish the job. Weakness with a slow, irregular pulse fits.
why.zh: 两种药都让血钾升高。肾不好再加脱水，就凑齐了。乏力加上又慢又不齐的脉搏，正好对得上。

bad.en: You report a fever and nobody looks for the potassium until he arrests.
bad.zh: 你只报了发烧，没人去查血钾，直到他心脏骤停。

stem.en: Jenna, 24, twisted her ankle at a climbing gym in Squamish. She is healthy. Her only medicine is spironolactone.
stem.zh: Jenna，24 岁，在 Squamish 的攀岩馆扭伤了脚踝。身体健康。唯一在吃的药是 spironolactone 螺内酯。

ask.en: What is the most likely reason she takes it?
ask.zh: 她吃这个药最可能的原因是什么？

opts.en: Acne or unwanted hair growth, because it also blocks male hormones
opts.zh: 痤疮或多毛，因为它还能阻断雄激素

opts.en: Severe heart failure, because nothing else explains the pill
opts.zh: 严重心衰，因为没有别的理由吃这个药

opts.en: A seizure disorder, because it calms the brain
opts.zh: 癫痫，因为它能让大脑安静下来

why.en: Spironolactone also blocks androgen receptors, so it is used for acne and unwanted hair growth in women. That fits a healthy 24-year-old far better than heart failure. Ask her, do not assume.
why.zh: spironolactone 螺内酯还能阻断雄激素受体，所以也用来治女性的痤疮和多毛。对一个健康的 24 岁女性来说，这比心衰合理得多。直接问她，不要想当然。

stem.en: Marco, 74, fell and hurt his wrist. Pain 7/10. He takes spironolactone and ramipril and says his kidneys work poorly. Your partner reaches for ketorolac.
stem.zh: Marco，74 岁，跌倒伤了手腕。疼痛 7/10。他吃 spironolactone 螺内酯和 ramipril 雷米普利，说自己肾功能不好。搭档伸手去拿 ketorolac 酮咯酸。

ask.en: Why is ketorolac off the table?
ask.zh: 为什么不能用 ketorolac 酮咯酸？

opts.en: He reports kidney dysfunction, a BCEHS contraindication
opts.zh: 他自己说肾功能不好，这是 BCEHS 的禁忌证

opts.en: Ketorolac is contraindicated with every heart pill
opts.zh: 只要在吃心脏药就禁用 ketorolac 酮咯酸

opts.en: Ketorolac would drop his potassium too low
opts.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸会让他的血钾降得太低

why.en: BCEHS rules out ketorolac and ibuprofen when the patient identifies as having kidney dysfunction. NSAIDs can also raise his potassium further.
why.zh: 病人自己说肾功能不好时，BCEHS 就不让用 ketorolac 酮咯酸和 ibuprofen 布洛芬。NSAID 还可能让他的血钾更高。

s.en: Spironolactone can cause breast enlargement in men.
s.zh: spironolactone 螺内酯可能让男性乳房增大。

why.en: It blocks male hormones as well as aldosterone.
why.zh: 它除了阻断醛固酮，还阻断雄激素。

s.en: Like furosemide, spironolactone lowers the potassium level.
s.zh: spironolactone 螺内酯和 furosemide 呋塞米一样，会让血钾降低。

why.en: It is potassium-sparing. Potassium goes up, not down.
why.zh: 它是保钾的。血钾是升高，不是降低。

s.en: Spironolactone together with an ACE inhibitor raises the risk of high potassium.
s.zh: spironolactone 螺内酯和 ACE 抑制剂一起吃，高血钾的风险会增加。

why.en: Both drugs make the body hold on to potassium.
why.zh: 两种药都让身体留住钾。

s.en: Spironolactone is a strong, fast diuretic for clearing wet lungs.
s.zh: spironolactone 螺内酯是强效、起效快的利尿药，用来排掉肺里的水。

why.en: It is weak and slow. Its value is long term.
why.zh: 它又弱又慢。它的价值在长期。

q.en: How does spironolactone work?
q.zh: spironolactone 螺内酯是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: It blocks aldosterone, so salt and water leave and potassium stays
opts.zh: 阻断醛固酮，盐和水排出去，钾留下来

opts.en: It blocks salt reabsorption in the loop of Henle
opts.zh: 在髓袢挡住盐的重吸收

opts.en: It blocks the enzyme that makes angiotensin II
opts.zh: 阻断生成血管紧张素 II 的酶

opts.en: It blocks calcium channels in the artery wall
opts.zh: 阻断动脉壁上的钙通道

why.en: Aldosterone normally saves salt and wastes potassium. Blocking it does the opposite.
why.zh: 醛固酮平时是留盐、排钾。把它挡住，结果正好相反。

home.name: Amiodarone and other antiarrhythmics
home.zh: 胺碘酮等抗心律失常药

cls.zh: 抗心律失常药

hook.en: Keeps a misbehaving heart rhythm in line.
hook.zh: 让不守规矩的心律老实下来。

how.en: These drugs change how electrical signals start and travel in the heart muscle. Different ones block sodium channels, potassium channels or beta receptors. That calms irritable tissue and helps the heart hold a normal rhythm. The same action can sometimes set off a new rhythm problem.
how.zh: 这类药改变心肌里电信号产生和传导的方式。不同的药分别阻断钠通道、钾通道或 β 受体。这样可以让过度兴奋的组织安静下来，帮心脏维持正常节律。同样的作用有时也会引出新的心律问题。

tells.en: A past ventricular tachycardia or other dangerous ventricular rhythm
tells.zh: 以前发生过室速或其他危险的室性心律

use.en: Keep the heart in a normal rhythm in atrial fibrillation
use.zh: 让房颤病人维持正常心律

use.en: Stop dangerous ventricular rhythms from coming back
use.zh: 防止危险的室性心律再次发作

no.en: Heart block or a very slow heart rate without a pacemaker
no.zh: 没有装起搏器的传导阻滞或心率过慢

no.en: Sotalol: a long QT interval
no.zh: sotalol 索他洛尔：QT 间期延长

no.en: Sotalol: asthma, because it is a beta-blocker
no.zh: sotalol 索他洛尔：哮喘，因为它是 β 阻滞剂

no.en: Flecainide and propafenone: a previous heart attack or a weak heart muscle
no.zh: flecainide 氟卡尼和 propafenone 普罗帕酮：得过心梗或心肌收缩无力

care.en: Amiodarone: long-term use can damage the lungs, the thyroid and the liver.
care.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮：长期使用可能损伤肺、甲状腺和肝脏。

care.en: Amiodarone makes warfarin and digoxin act more strongly.
care.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮会让 warfarin 华法林和 digoxin 地高辛的作用变强。

care.en: Other drugs that lengthen the QT interval add to the risk of a dangerous rhythm.
care.zh: 其他会延长 QT 间期的药，会让危险心律的风险叠加。

care.en: Amiodarone stays in the body for weeks to months after the last dose.
care.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮停药后，还会在体内停留几周到几个月。

fx.en: New or worse dysrhythmias, including torsades de pointes
fx.zh: 新出现或加重的心律失常，包括尖端扭转型室速

fx.en: Amiodarone: lung scarring with cough and breathlessness
fx.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮：肺纤维化，表现为咳嗽和气促

fx.en: Amiodarone: an overactive or underactive thyroid
fx.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮：甲状腺功能亢进或减退

fx.en: Amiodarone: skin that burns easily in the sun or turns blue-grey
fx.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮：皮肤容易晒伤，或变成蓝灰色

medic.en: This bottle means the patient has had a significant dysrhythmia before. Put the monitor on early and keep it on.
medic.zh: 看到这个药瓶，说明病人以前有过严重的心律失常。尽早接上监护，一直不要摘。

medic.en: Sotalol is also a beta-blocker. Expect a slow pulse and the same hidden signs of shock and low sugar as with metoprolol.
medic.zh: sotalol 索他洛尔同时是 β 阻滞剂。脉搏会慢，休克和低血糖的信号也会像吃 metoprolol 美托洛尔那样被盖住。

medic.en: Sotalol and amiodarone lengthen the QT interval. BCEHS lists QT prolongation as an adverse effect of ondansetron, and congenital or acquired long QT syndrome as a contraindication. The exam (EMALB) lists only congenital long QT syndrome.
medic.zh: sotalol 索他洛尔和 amiodarone 胺碘酮会延长 QT 间期。BCEHS 把 QT 延长列为 ondansetron 昂丹司琼的不良反应，把先天性或获得性长 QT 综合征列为禁忌证。考试（EMALB）只列了先天性长 QT 综合征。

medic.en: BCEHS notes that arrhythmias can develop when epinephrine is given to a patient on antiarrhythmic drugs. In anaphylaxis there is still no absolute contraindication. Watch the monitor.
medic.zh: BCEHS 提到，吃抗心律失常药的病人用 epinephrine 肾上腺素后可能出现心律失常。过敏性休克时依然没有绝对禁忌证。盯住监护。

pearl.en: An antiarrhythmic in the bag means this heart has misbehaved before. Monitor on early, and ask what happened last time.
pearl.zh: 药袋里有抗心律失常药，说明这颗心脏以前出过乱子。尽早接监护，问清楚上一次发生了什么。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.30 Antidysrhythmic Medications (Table 30-24) and ch.7 antidysrhythmic classes; standard pharmacology; own-drug rules from the BCEHS monographs (ondansetron, dimenhydrinate, epinephrine)

stem.en: Peter, 69, had a dizzy spell while gardening in Victoria and now feels fine. HR 58, BP 124/78. His pills are amiodarone and apixaban.
stem.zh: Peter，69 岁，在 Victoria 家里的花园干活时一阵头晕，现在感觉没事。心率 58，血压 124/78。他吃的药是 amiodarone 胺碘酮和 apixaban 阿哌沙班。

ask.en: What do the two bottles suggest?

opts.en: Atrial fibrillation: one drug for the rhythm, one against clots
opts.zh: 房颤：一个管心律，一个防血栓

opts.en: High blood pressure and high cholesterol
opts.zh: 高血压和高胆固醇

opts.en: A seizure disorder and a clot in the leg
opts.zh: 癫痫和腿部血栓

why.en: An antiarrhythmic with an anticoagulant is the classic atrial fibrillation pair. A dizzy spell in this patient may be a rhythm problem, so monitor him.
why.zh: 抗心律失常药加抗凝药，是房颤的经典搭配。这种病人一阵头晕，可能是心律出了问题，所以要接监护。

stem.en: Nadia, 63, is vomiting on a ferry to Nanaimo. She takes sotalol. Her cardiologist has told her that she now has acquired long QT syndrome.
stem.zh: Nadia，63 岁，在去 Nanaimo 的渡轮上呕吐。她在吃 sotalol 索他洛尔。心脏科医生告诉过她，她现在有获得性长 QT 综合征。

ask.en: On the road (BCEHS), which antiemetic fits?
ask.zh: 出车时（BCEHS），哪种止吐药合适？

opts.en: Dimenhydrinate, because acquired long QT syndrome is a contraindication to ondansetron
opts.zh: dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明，因为获得性长 QT 综合征是 ondansetron 昂丹司琼的禁忌证

opts.en: Ondansetron, because it has no effect on the heart
opts.zh: ondansetron 昂丹司琼，因为它对心脏没有影响

opts.en: Neither, because every antiemetic is contraindicated with sotalol
opts.zh: 都不行，因为吃 sotalol 索他洛尔的人禁用所有止吐药

why.en: BCEHS lists congenital or acquired long QT syndrome as a contraindication to ondansetron. Dimenhydrinate is its choice when ondansetron is contraindicated, and for motion sickness. The exam (EMALB) lists only congenital long QT syndrome.
why.zh: BCEHS 把先天性或获得性长 QT 综合征列为 ondansetron 昂丹司琼的禁忌证。ondansetron 昂丹司琼禁用时，以及晕动病，BCEHS 选的是 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明。考试（EMALB）只列了先天性长 QT 综合征。

bad.en: You stretch an already long QT and risk torsades de pointes.
bad.zh: 你把本来就长的 QT 拉得更长，可能引出尖端扭转型室速。

stem.en: Helen, 72, has taken amiodarone for two years. For months she has had a dry cough and worsening breathlessness. Fine crackles, no fever, no leg swelling.
stem.zh: Helen，72 岁，吃 amiodarone 胺碘酮两年了。这几个月一直干咳，气促越来越重。双肺细湿啰音，不发烧，腿不肿。

ask.en: Which drug effect belongs on your list?
ask.zh: 哪种药物作用要列入你的考虑？

opts.en: Lung damage from long-term amiodarone
opts.zh: 长期吃 amiodarone 胺碘酮造成的肺损伤

opts.en: Airway spasm, because amiodarone is a bronchodilator
opts.zh: 气道痉挛，因为 amiodarone 胺碘酮是支气管扩张药

opts.en: Fluid overload, because amiodarone is a diuretic
opts.zh: 液体过多，因为 amiodarone 胺碘酮是利尿药

why.en: Amiodarone can scar the lungs after long use. A slow dry cough with breathlessness is how it shows. Tell the hospital how long she has taken it.
why.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮长期使用可能让肺纤维化。表现就是慢慢出现的干咳和气促。告诉医院她吃了多久。

s.en: Sotalol is both a beta-blocker and an antiarrhythmic.
s.zh: sotalol 索他洛尔既是 β 阻滞剂，又是抗心律失常药。

why.en: The name ends in -lol, and it also lengthens the QT interval.
why.zh: 它的名字以 -lol 结尾，同时还会延长 QT 间期。

s.en: A patient who takes amiodarone no longer needs cardiac monitoring.
s.zh: 吃 amiodarone 胺碘酮的病人就不需要心电监护了。

why.en: The bottle means past dysrhythmias. That is a reason to monitor.
why.zh: 这瓶药说明以前有过心律失常。这正是要监护的理由。

s.en: Drugs that treat dysrhythmias can also cause them.
s.zh: 治疗心律失常的药，本身也可能引起心律失常。

why.en: They change conduction in the heart, and that can go either way.
why.zh: 它们改变心脏的传导，结果可能好也可能坏。

s.en: Amiodarone leaves the body within a day of the last dose.
s.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮停药后一天之内就从体内清除。

why.en: It stays for weeks to months.
why.zh: 它会在体内停留几周到几个月。

q.en: Long-term amiodarone is known for damage to which organs?
q.zh: 长期吃 amiodarone 胺碘酮，出名的是损伤哪些器官？

opts.en: Lungs, thyroid and liver
opts.zh: 肺、甲状腺和肝脏

opts.en: Kidneys, bladder and prostate
opts.zh: 肾脏、膀胱和前列腺

opts.en: Stomach, pancreas and spleen
opts.zh: 胃、胰腺和脾脏

opts.en: Bone marrow, joints and muscles
opts.zh: 骨髓、关节和肌肉

why.en: Lung scarring, thyroid problems and liver injury are the classic long-term harms.
why.zh: 肺纤维化、甲状腺问题和肝损伤是经典的长期损害。

q.en: Amiodarone makes which two home drugs act more strongly?
q.zh: amiodarone 胺碘酮会让哪两种家用药的作用变强？

opts.en: Warfarin and digoxin
opts.zh: warfarin 华法林和 digoxin 地高辛

opts.en: Salbutamol and ipratropium
opts.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 ipratropium 异丙托溴铵

opts.en: Metformin and insulin
opts.zh: metformin 二甲双胍和 insulin 胰岛素

opts.en: Acetaminophen and ibuprofen
opts.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚和 ibuprofen 布洛芬

why.en: It raises the effect of both, so bleeding on warfarin and digoxin toxicity become more likely.
why.zh: 它让这两种药的作用都增强，所以吃 warfarin 华法林更容易出血，吃 digoxin 地高辛更容易中毒。

home.name: SGLT2 inhibitors

cls.zh: SGLT2 抑制剂（钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白 2 抑制剂）

hook.en: It makes the kidneys pass sugar into the urine.
hook.zh: 让肾脏把糖从尿里排出去。

how.en: It blocks a pump in the kidney that normally pulls sugar back into the blood. The sugar leaves in the urine and takes water with it. So the patient loses sugar, some fluid and a little blood pressure.
how.zh: 肾脏里有个泵，平时把糖重新吸回血里，这类药把它挡住。糖就随尿排出，还带走水分。于是病人少了糖，少了一些水，血压也降一点。

tells.en: Heart failure, with or without diabetes (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin)
tells.zh: 心力衰竭，不管有没有糖尿病（dapagliflozin 达格列净、empagliflozin 恩格列净）

use.en: Lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
use.zh: 降低 2 型糖尿病的血糖

use.en: Keep heart failure patients out of hospital
use.zh: 让心衰病人少住院

use.en: Slow the loss of kidney function in chronic kidney disease
use.zh: 延缓慢性肾病的肾功能下降

no.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis
no.zh: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒

no.en: Type 1 diabetes
no.zh: 1 型糖尿病

no.en: Kidney failure on dialysis
no.zh: 正在透析的肾衰竭

noFake.zh: 同时在吃 metformin 二甲双胍

care.en: Sick days: it is usually paused when the patient is vomiting, dehydrated or about to have surgery.
care.zh: 生病的日子：病人呕吐、脱水或要做手术时，通常要暂停。

care.en: With a diuretic it can dry the patient out and drop the blood pressure.
care.zh: 和利尿剂一起用，可能让病人脱水、血压下降。

care.en: Alone it rarely causes low sugar. With insulin or a sulfonylurea, low sugar can happen.
care.zh: 单用很少低血糖。和胰岛素或磺脲类一起用，就可能低血糖。

fx.en: Ketoacidosis with a near-normal or only mildly raised glucose (rare, dangerous)
fx.zh: 血糖接近正常或只是略高的酮症酸中毒（少见，但危险）

medic.en: Ketoacidosis can hide behind a near-normal glucose. A vomiting, weak patient who breathes fast and deep may be in ketoacidosis even when the meter looks fine.
medic.zh: 酮症酸中毒可以躲在接近正常的血糖后面。呕吐、乏力、呼吸又快又深的病人，就算血糖仪读数看着还行，也可能是酮症酸中毒。

medic.en: Do not assume diabetes. Some patients take it for heart failure or kidney disease.
medic.zh: 别默认是糖尿病。有些病人吃它是因为心衰或肾病。

medic.en: Expect a slightly dry patient: more urine, lower pressure, dizzy on standing. Worse with heat, vomiting or a diuretic.
medic.zh: 病人往往偏「干」：尿多、血压偏低、一站起来就头晕。天热、呕吐或加上利尿剂时更明显。

medic.en: On its own it rarely causes hypoglycemia. A low sugar usually means insulin or a sulfonylurea is also on board.
medic.zh: 单用很少低血糖。血糖低，多半说明还用了胰岛素或磺脲类。

pearl.en: On a -gliflozin, a near-normal glucose does not rule out ketoacidosis. Look at the breathing, not only the meter.
pearl.zh: 吃 -gliflozin（列净类）的病人，血糖接近正常也排除不了酮症酸中毒。看呼吸，别只看血糖仪。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), household medications list (Oral Antidiabetics: canagliflozin, empagliflozin); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Priya, 54, type 2 diabetic on empagliflozin. Two days of vomiting. Weak, RR 30 and deep, HR 118, glucose 10.2 mmol/L.
stem.zh: Priya，54 岁，2 型糖尿病，吃 empagliflozin 恩格列净。呕吐两天。乏力，呼吸 30 次/分而且很深，心率 118，血糖 10.2 mmol/L。

ask.en: What must you consider?

opts.en: Ketoacidosis with a near-normal glucose, linked to her SGLT2 inhibitor
opts.zh: 和 SGLT2 抑制剂有关的、血糖接近正常的酮症酸中毒

opts.en: Not ketoacidosis: her glucose is far too low for that
opts.zh: 不是酮症酸中毒：她的血糖远远不够高

opts.en: Hypoglycemia: she needs oral glucose now
opts.zh: 低血糖：她现在需要 oral glucose 口服葡萄糖

why.en: This class can cause ketoacidosis without a high sugar. Deep fast breathing and vomiting are the clues. She needs hospital.
why.zh: 这类药可以在血糖不高的情况下引起酮症酸中毒。呼吸又深又快、呕吐就是线索。她需要去医院。

bad.en: You are reassured by the meter and she gets sicker at home.
bad.zh: 你被血糖仪的读数安抚了，她在家里越来越重。

stem.en: Bill, 68, short of breath with swollen ankles. Bottles: furosemide, bisoprolol, dapagliflozin. His wife says he has never had diabetes.
stem.zh: Bill，68 岁，气短、脚踝肿。药瓶：furosemide 呋塞米、bisoprolol 比索洛尔、dapagliflozin 达格列净。妻子说他从来没有糖尿病。

ask.en: Why is he on dapagliflozin?
ask.zh: 他为什么吃 dapagliflozin 达格列净？

opts.en: Heart failure: this class is used for it, even without diabetes
opts.zh: 心衰：这类药可以治心衰，没有糖尿病也用

opts.en: A pharmacy error: it is only a diabetes drug
opts.zh: 药房发错了：它只是降糖药

opts.en: Hidden type 1 diabetes that his wife does not know about
opts.zh: 他有妻子不知道的 1 型糖尿病

why.en: SGLT2 inhibitors are used to treat heart failure. The other two bottles tell the same story.
why.zh: SGLT2 抑制剂可以用来治心衰。另外两瓶药说的是同一件事。

stem.en: Helen, 76, dizzy when she stands, hot July day in Kelowna. Lying BP 104/62, HR 104, glucose 6.8 mmol/L. Takes canagliflozin and hydrochlorothiazide.
stem.zh: Helen，76 岁，7 月的 Kelowna 很热，她一站起来就头晕。平卧血压 104/62，心率 104，血糖 6.8 mmol/L。吃 canagliflozin 卡格列净和 hydrochlorothiazide 氢氯噻嗪。

ask.en: Most likely explanation?

opts.en: Fluid loss: both pills make her pass more urine
opts.zh: 体液丢失：两种药都让她尿得更多

opts.en: Hypoglycemia caused by the canagliflozin she takes
opts.zh: 她吃的 canagliflozin 卡格列净引起的低血糖

opts.en: An allergic reaction to the canagliflozin she takes
opts.zh: 对她吃的 canagliflozin 卡格列净过敏

why.en: An SGLT2 inhibitor plus a diuretic plus heat is a recipe for volume loss. Her glucose is normal.
why.zh: SGLT2 抑制剂加利尿剂再加高温，很容易丢失体液。她的血糖是正常的。

s.en: Drug names ending in -gliflozin are SGLT2 inhibitors.
s.zh: 药名以 -gliflozin 结尾的是 SGLT2 抑制剂。

why.en: Empagliflozin, dapagliflozin, canagliflozin.
why.zh: empagliflozin 恩格列净、dapagliflozin 达格列净、canagliflozin 卡格列净都是。

s.en: A near-normal glucose rules out ketoacidosis in a patient on an SGLT2 inhibitor.
s.zh: 吃 SGLT2 抑制剂的病人，血糖接近正常就可以排除酮症酸中毒。

why.en: This class can cause ketoacidosis without a high sugar.
why.zh: 这类药可以在血糖不高时引起酮症酸中毒。

s.en: SGLT2 inhibitors are prescribed only for diabetes.
s.zh: SGLT2 抑制剂只用于糖尿病。

why.en: They are also used for heart failure and chronic kidney disease.
why.zh: 它们也用于心衰和慢性肾病。

s.en: These drugs make the patient pass more sugar and water in the urine.
s.zh: 这类药让病人从尿里排出更多的糖和水。

why.en: That is how they work. It is also why patients can get dry.
why.zh: 这就是它们的作用方式。也是病人容易脱水的原因。

q.en: Where does an SGLT2 inhibitor act?
q.zh: SGLT2 抑制剂作用在哪里？

opts.en: In the kidney: it stops sugar being pulled back into the blood
opts.zh: 在肾脏：不让糖被重新吸回血里

opts.en: In the pancreas: it makes the beta cells release insulin
opts.zh: 在胰腺：让 β 细胞放出胰岛素

opts.en: In the liver: it blocks the release of stored sugar
opts.zh: 在肝脏：不让储存的糖放出来

opts.en: In the gut: it slows the emptying of the stomach
opts.zh: 在胃肠道：让胃排空变慢

why.en: Sugar that is not pulled back leaves in the urine, and water follows it.
why.zh: 没被吸回去的糖随尿排出，水也跟着走。

home.name: GLP-1 agonists

cls.en: GLP-1 receptor agonist (incretin mimetic, mostly injected)
cls.zh: GLP-1 受体激动剂（肠促胰素类似物，多为注射）

hook.en: A copy of a gut hormone: more insulin after meals, less appetite.
hook.zh: 仿造一种肠道激素：饭后多放胰岛素，胃口变小。

how.en: It copies a gut hormone released after eating. The pancreas releases more insulin only when the sugar is high. The stomach empties more slowly and the brain feels full sooner. Sugar and weight both come down.
how.zh: 它仿造的是吃饭后肠道放出的一种激素。只有血糖高的时候，胰腺才多放胰岛素。胃排空变慢，大脑更早觉得饱。血糖和体重都往下走。

tells.en: Obesity, with or without diabetes (weight management with semaglutide or liraglutide)
tells.zh: 肥胖，不管有没有糖尿病（用 semaglutide 司美格鲁肽或 liraglutide 利拉鲁肽做体重管理）

use.en: Lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
use.zh: 降低 2 型糖尿病的血糖

use.en: Help with long-term weight loss
use.zh: 帮助长期减重

no.en: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid cancer
no.zh: 本人或家族有甲状腺髓样癌病史

no.en: Pregnancy
no.zh: 怀孕

no.en: A serious allergic reaction to the drug before
no.zh: 以前对该药有过严重过敏反应

noFake.zh: 同时在吃 metformin 二甲双胍

care.en: Past pancreatitis: used with caution. New severe belly pain needs checking.
care.zh: 得过胰腺炎：要谨慎使用。新出现的剧烈腹痛要查清楚。

care.en: It slows stomach emptying, so food stays in the stomach longer. Nausea and vomiting are common.
care.zh: 它让胃排空变慢，食物在胃里停留更久。恶心、呕吐很常见。

care.en: Alone it rarely causes low sugar. With insulin or a sulfonylurea, low sugar can happen.
care.zh: 单用很少低血糖。和胰岛素或磺脲类一起用，就可能低血糖。

care.en: Days of vomiting or diarrhea can dehydrate the patient and stress the kidneys.
care.zh: 连着几天呕吐或腹泻，会让病人脱水、肾脏受累。

fx.en: Nausea and vomiting, most when starting or raising the dose
fx.zh: 恶心、呕吐，刚开始用或加量时最明显

medic.en: Nausea, vomiting and belly pain are common with this drug. Severe constant upper belly pain going through to the back makes you think of pancreatitis.
medic.zh: 用这类药，恶心、呕吐、腹痛都很常见。上腹持续剧痛、一直痛到后背，就要想到胰腺炎。

medic.en: On its own it rarely causes hypoglycemia. If the sugar is low, look for insulin or a sulfonylurea in the same bag.
medic.zh: 单用很少低血糖。血糖低了，就在同一个药袋里找胰岛素或磺脲类。

medic.en: A once-a-week pen is easy to forget. Ask about injections, not only pills.
medic.zh: 一周打一次的笔，病人很容易忘了说。除了药片，还要问有没有打针。

medic.en: Days of vomiting on this drug mean a dry patient: fast pulse, low pressure, dizzy on standing.
medic.zh: 用这类药又吐了好几天，病人就是脱水的：脉搏快、血压低、一站起来就头晕。

pearl.en: Not every semaglutide pen means diabetes. Ask why they take it. And a -glutide by itself should not make the sugar low.
pearl.zh: 有 semaglutide 司美格鲁肽的笔不等于有糖尿病。问清楚为什么用。另外，单用 -glutide 这类药不该让血糖变低。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), household medications list (dulaglutide, listed under Oral Antidiabetics); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Karen, 46, no diabetes, injects semaglutide weekly for weight loss. Vomiting for two days since a dose increase. Dizzy on standing, HR 112, BP 100/64, glucose 5.4 mmol/L.
stem.zh: Karen，46 岁，没有糖尿病，每周打一次 semaglutide 司美格鲁肽减重。加量后吐了两天。一站起来就头晕，心率 112，血压 100/64，血糖 5.4 mmol/L。

ask.en: Best reading of this picture?
ask.zh: 这个表现最合理的解释是什么？

opts.en: Dehydration from a common side effect of the drug
opts.zh: 这类药常见副作用引起的脱水

opts.en: Hypoglycemia caused by the semaglutide she injected this week
opts.zh: 这周打的 semaglutide 司美格鲁肽引起的低血糖

opts.en: Diabetic ketoacidosis caused by the weekly semaglutide injection
opts.zh: 每周打的 semaglutide 司美格鲁肽引起的糖尿病酮症酸中毒

why.en: Nausea and vomiting are common side effects, especially after a dose increase. Her sugar is normal. Her pulse and pressure say she is dry.
why.zh: 恶心、呕吐是常见的副作用，加量后尤其明显。她的血糖正常。脉搏和血压说明她脱水了。

stem.en: Mohammed, 59, type 2 diabetic, confused and sweaty. Glucose 2.5 mmol/L. His bag holds a liraglutide pen, glyburide and metformin.
stem.zh: Mohammed，59 岁，2 型糖尿病，糊涂、出汗。血糖 2.5 mmol/L。药袋里有 liraglutide 利拉鲁肽笔、glyburide 格列本脲和 metformin 二甲双胍。

ask.en: Which medicine most likely caused the low?
ask.zh: 最可能是哪种药引起的低血糖？

opts.en: Glyburide, the sulfonylurea
opts.zh: glyburide 格列本脲，磺脲类

opts.en: Liraglutide, the GLP-1 agonist
opts.zh: liraglutide 利拉鲁肽，GLP-1 受体激动剂

opts.en: Metformin, the biguanide
opts.zh: metformin 二甲双胍，双胍类

why.en: A sulfonylurea releases insulin whatever the sugar is. A GLP-1 agonist and metformin rarely cause a low on their own.
why.zh: 磺脲类不管血糖多少都会放出胰岛素。GLP-1 受体激动剂和 metformin 二甲双胍单用很少引起低血糖。

stem.en: Sandra, 52, uses dulaglutide. Sudden severe upper belly pain going through to her back, repeated vomiting, lying curled up. HR 110.
stem.zh: Sandra，52 岁，用 dulaglutide 度拉糖肽。突然上腹剧痛、痛到后背，反复呕吐，蜷着身子躺着。心率 110。

ask.en: Which listed complication of her medicine fits?
ask.zh: 这符合她这种药的哪一种已知并发症？

opts.en: Pancreatitis
opts.zh: 胰腺炎

opts.en: Hypoglycemia
opts.zh: 低血糖

opts.en: A bleeding stomach ulcer
opts.zh: 胃溃疡出血

why.en: Pancreatitis is a rare, listed warning for this class. Severe upper belly pain through to the back is the classic story. She needs hospital.
why.zh: 胰腺炎是这类药少见但写明的警示。上腹剧痛、痛到后背是典型表现。她需要去医院。

s.en: Everyone who uses semaglutide has diabetes.
s.zh: 用 semaglutide 司美格鲁肽的人都有糖尿病。

why.en: It is also prescribed for weight management.
why.zh: 它也用于体重管理。

s.en: GLP-1 agonists slow the emptying of the stomach.
s.zh: GLP-1 受体激动剂会让胃排空变慢。

why.en: That is part of how they work, and why nausea is so common.
why.zh: 这是它们起效的一部分，也是恶心这么常见的原因。

s.en: A GLP-1 agonist taken alone commonly causes severe hypoglycemia.
s.zh: 单用 GLP-1 受体激动剂经常引起严重低血糖。

why.en: It boosts insulin only when the sugar is high.
why.zh: 只有血糖高的时候，它才促进胰岛素分泌。

s.en: Stomach and gut upset, such as nausea, vomiting and diarrhea, is the most common side effect.
s.zh: 胃肠道反应（恶心、呕吐、腹泻等）是最常见的副作用。

why.en: It is worst when starting or raising the dose.
why.zh: 刚开始用或加量时最严重。

q.en: How does a GLP-1 agonist lower blood sugar?
q.zh: GLP-1 受体激动剂怎样降血糖？

opts.en: It boosts insulin release after meals and slows the stomach
opts.zh: 饭后促进胰岛素分泌，并让胃排空变慢

opts.en: It makes the kidneys pass sugar into the urine
opts.zh: 让肾脏把糖排进尿里

opts.en: It replaces the insulin the body cannot make
opts.zh: 替代身体造不出来的胰岛素

opts.en: It forces insulin out whether or not the sugar is high
opts.zh: 不管血糖高不高，都把胰岛素逼出来

why.en: It copies a gut hormone. The insulin effect depends on the sugar level, so lows are rare.
why.zh: 它仿造一种肠道激素。促胰岛素的作用取决于血糖水平，所以很少低血糖。

home.name: NSAIDs at home

cls.zh: 非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）

hook.en: They block the chemical behind pain, fever and swelling.
hook.zh: 挡住制造疼痛、发热和肿胀的那种化学物质。

how.en: NSAIDs block the COX enzymes that make prostaglandins, so there is less pain, fever and inflammation. But prostaglandins also protect the stomach lining and keep blood flowing through the kidneys. That is where the trouble comes from.
how.zh: 非甾体抗炎药阻断制造前列腺素的 COX 酶，疼痛、发热和炎症就轻了。可是前列腺素还负责保护胃黏膜、维持肾脏的血流。麻烦就出在这里。

tells.en: Arthritis or other joint and muscle pain
tells.zh: 关节炎或其他关节、肌肉疼痛

tells.en: Back pain, sprains and other injuries
tells.zh: 腰背痛、扭伤和其他外伤

use.en: Relieve pain
use.zh: 止痛

use.en: Reduce inflammation and swelling
use.zh: 消炎消肿

use.en: Bring down a fever
use.zh: 退烧

no.en: Active stomach ulcer or bleeding in the gut
no.zh: 活动性胃溃疡或消化道出血

no.en: Severe kidney disease
no.zh: 严重肾病

no.en: Asthma or allergy triggered by ASA or another NSAID
no.zh: ASA 阿司匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药诱发过哮喘或过敏

no.en: Pregnancy, especially the last three months
no.zh: 怀孕，尤其是最后三个月

noFake.zh: 同时在吃 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

care.en: Heart failure and high blood pressure: NSAIDs hold on to salt and water and blunt blood pressure pills.
care.zh: 心衰和高血压：非甾体抗炎药会让身体留住盐和水，还会削弱降压药的效果。

care.en: Blood thinners such as warfarin or apixaban: the bleeding risk climbs.
care.zh: 抗凝药，比如 warfarin 华法林或 apixaban 阿哌沙班：出血风险上升。

care.en: Dehydration plus an ACE inhibitor, a water pill and an NSAID can shut the kidneys down.
care.zh: 脱水，再加上 ACE 抑制剂、利尿药和非甾体抗炎药，可以让肾脏停摆。

care.en: Older adults bleed and lose kidney function more easily.
care.zh: 老年人更容易出血，肾功能也更容易受损。

fx.en: Fluid retention and higher blood pressure
Higher risk of heart attack and stroke with long-term use
fx.zh: 长期使用会增加心梗和卒中风险

medic.en: Black stools, coffee-ground vomit or a pale, dizzy patient on a daily NSAID: think bleeding from the gut.
medic.zh: 每天吃非甾体抗炎药的病人出现黑便、咖啡渣样呕吐物，或者面色苍白、头晕：要想到消化道出血。

medic.en: Ask what they took today and when. BCEHS lists a recent anti-inflammatory as a caution, not a contraindication, before our ibuprofen or ketorolac. Its ketorolac FAQ says to consider alternatives such as acetaminophen.
medic.zh: 问清今天吃了什么、什么时候吃的。BCEHS 把近期用过抗炎药列为慎用而不是禁忌，这时再给我们的 ibuprofen 布洛芬或 ketorolac 酮咯酸要小心。BCEHS 的 ketorolac 酮咯酸问答建议考虑 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚这类替代选择。

medic.en: Ibuprofen or naproxen taken at home does not replace ASA in a suspected heart attack. They do not act on platelets the way ASA does.
medic.zh: 怀疑心梗时，在家吃过 ibuprofen 布洛芬或 naproxen 萘普生不能代替 ASA 阿司匹林。它们对血小板的作用和 ASA 阿司匹林不一样。

medic.en: Wheeze after ASA or any NSAID in the past, or a known ASA allergy, means none of them from us: no ASA, no ibuprofen, no ketorolac.
medic.zh: 以前吃 ASA 阿司匹林或任何非甾体抗炎药后喘过，或者已知对 ASA 阿司匹林过敏，我们这三样就都不能给：ASA 阿司匹林、ibuprofen 布洛芬、ketorolac 酮咯酸。

pearl.en: Over the counter does not mean harmless. Ask every patient with belly pain, black stools or new swelling what they take for their joints.
pearl.zh: 非处方不等于无害。凡是肚子痛、黑便或新出现水肿的病人，都问一句关节痛平时吃什么药。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Medications and Analgesics and Antagonists, the household medication list (NSAIDs); standard pharmacology; BCEHS ketorolac monograph and FAQ; BCEHS and EMALB ibuprofen, ASA and acetaminophen monographs

stem.en: Ivan, 72, feels faint in his Penticton kitchen. Pale, HR 112, BP 98/60. Black, tarry stools for two days. He takes naproxen twice daily for his knees.
stem.zh: Ivan，72 岁，在 Penticton 家里的厨房觉得要晕倒。面色苍白，心率 112，血压 98/60。拉了两天柏油样黑便。他因为膝盖痛每天吃两次 naproxen 萘普生。

ask.en: What is the most likely problem?

opts.en: Bleeding from a stomach ulcer caused by the naproxen
opts.zh: naproxen 萘普生引起的胃溃疡出血

opts.en: An allergy to naproxen with low blood pressure
opts.zh: 对 naproxen 萘普生过敏导致低血压

opts.en: Low blood sugar caused by the naproxen
opts.zh: naproxen 萘普生引起的低血糖

why.en: NSAIDs strip the stomach of its protection. Black stools with a fast pulse and low pressure mean he is bleeding.
why.zh: 非甾体抗炎药让胃失去保护。黑便加上脉搏快、血压低，说明他在出血。

bad.en: You treat a simple faint and miss a patient in hemorrhagic shock.
bad.zh: 你按普通晕厥处理，漏掉了一个失血性休克的病人。

stem.en: Priya, 35, rolled her ankle at a Whistler trailhead. Pain 6/10. No allergies, not pregnant, healthy kidneys. Her only medicine today was two ibuprofen tablets forty minutes ago.
stem.zh: Priya，35 岁，在 Whistler 的步道口崴了脚。疼痛 6/10。没有过敏史，没怀孕，肾脏健康。今天只吃过一次药：四十分钟前的两片 ibuprofen 布洛芬。

ask.en: Which option from your kit avoids a BCEHS caution?
ask.zh: 你药包里的哪个选择能避开 BCEHS 的慎用情况？

opts.en: Acetaminophen, because she has just had an NSAID
opts.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚，因为她刚吃过非甾体抗炎药

opts.en: Ketorolac, because the ibuprofen has not worked yet
opts.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸，因为 ibuprofen 布洛芬还没起效

opts.en: More ibuprofen, because a second dose is stronger
opts.zh: 再给 ibuprofen 布洛芬，因为第二剂更强

why.en: BCEHS lists a recent anti-inflammatory as a caution, not a contraindication, for ibuprofen and ketorolac, and suggests considering acetaminophen. Both BC sources allow acetaminophen together with ibuprofen.
why.zh: BCEHS 把「近期用过抗炎药」列为 ibuprofen 布洛芬和 ketorolac 酮咯酸的慎用情况，不是禁忌，并建议考虑 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚。BC 的两份资料都允许 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚和 ibuprofen 布洛芬同时用。

stem.en: Don, 58, has crushing chest pain at a Vernon hardware store. He says he already took two ibuprofen 'for the heart' ten minutes ago. No allergies, no bleeding history.
stem.zh: Don，58 岁，在 Vernon 的五金店里胸口压榨样疼。他说十分钟前已经「为了心脏」吃了两片 ibuprofen 布洛芬。没有过敏史，没有出血史。

ask.en: Does the ibuprofen replace your ASA?
ask.zh: 他吃的 ibuprofen 布洛芬能代替你的 ASA 阿司匹林吗？

opts.en: No. Ibuprofen does not do the job of ASA here
opts.zh: 不能。这里 ibuprofen 布洛芬干不了 ASA 阿司匹林的活

opts.en: Yes. Any NSAID thins the blood the same way
opts.zh: 能。所有非甾体抗炎药抗血小板的方式都一样

opts.en: Yes. ASA is now contraindicated for him
opts.zh: 能。现在他已经禁用 ASA 阿司匹林了

why.en: ASA blocks platelets in a way ibuprofen does not, so the two cannot be swapped. He has not taken ASA, so yours is still indicated.
why.zh: ASA 阿司匹林抑制血小板的方式是 ibuprofen 布洛芬做不到的，所以两者不能互换。他没吃过 ASA 阿司匹林，所以你的 ASA 阿司匹林仍然有指征。

s.en: NSAIDs can raise blood pressure and make blood pressure pills work less well.
s.zh: 非甾体抗炎药会升高血压，还会让降压药效果变差。

why.en: They make the body hold on to salt and water.
why.zh: 它们让身体留住盐和水。

s.en: Ibuprofen from the drugstore shelf cannot cause a stomach bleed.
s.zh: 药店货架上买的 ibuprofen 布洛芬不会引起胃出血。

why.en: Any NSAID can, and the risk rises with dose, duration and age.
why.zh: 任何非甾体抗炎药都可以，剂量越大、吃得越久、年纪越大，风险越高。

s.en: A patient who wheezes after ASA may also react to ibuprofen.
s.zh: 吃 ASA 阿司匹林会喘的病人，吃 ibuprofen 布洛芬也可能有反应。

why.en: The sensitivity crosses over between ASA and the other NSAIDs.
why.zh: ASA 阿司匹林和其他非甾体抗炎药之间存在交叉敏感。

s.en: Naproxen can stand in for ASA during a heart attack.
s.zh: 心梗时可以用 naproxen 萘普生顶替 ASA 阿司匹林。

why.en: Other NSAIDs do not give the antiplatelet effect of ASA.
why.zh: 其他非甾体抗炎药没有 ASA 阿司匹林那样的抗血小板作用。

q.en: How do NSAIDs reduce pain and fever?
q.zh: 非甾体抗炎药是怎样止痛退烧的？

opts.en: They block the COX enzymes that make prostaglandins
opts.zh: 阻断制造前列腺素的 COX 酶

opts.en: They bind to opioid receptors in the brain
opts.zh: 结合大脑里的阿片受体

opts.en: They block sodium channels in the nerves
opts.zh: 阻断神经上的钠通道

opts.en: They boost GABA in the brain
opts.zh: 增强大脑里的 GABA

why.en: Prostaglandins promote pain, fever and inflammation. They also protect the stomach and the kidneys, which explains the side effects.
why.zh: 前列腺素促进疼痛、发热和炎症。它们也保护胃和肾，副作用就是这么来的。

q.en: Which patient is at the greatest risk from a daily NSAID?
q.zh: 哪个病人每天吃非甾体抗炎药的风险最大？

opts.en: An 80-year-old on warfarin with kidney disease
opts.zh: 80 岁、在吃 warfarin 华法林、有肾病

opts.en: A 25-year-old with a sprained ankle
opts.zh: 25 岁、脚踝扭伤

opts.en: A 30-year-old with period pain
opts.zh: 30 岁、痛经

opts.en: A 40-year-old with a tension headache
opts.zh: 40 岁、紧张性头痛

why.en: Age, a blood thinner and weak kidneys each raise the risk of bleeding and kidney failure.
why.zh: 年纪大、抗凝药、肾功能差，每一样都会增加出血和肾衰竭的风险。

home.name: Lithium

cls.zh: 心境稳定剂

hook.en: A simple salt that keeps bipolar mood swings in check.
hook.zh: 一种简单的盐，把双相的情绪起伏稳住。

how.en: Lithium is a salt, a close cousin of sodium, and how it steadies mood is not fully understood. The kidneys clear it, and the safe range is narrow. When the body is short of water or salt, the kidneys hold on to lithium and the level climbs.
how.zh: lithium 锂盐是一种盐，和钠是近亲，它怎样稳定情绪还没完全弄清。它靠肾脏排出，安全范围很窄。身体缺水或缺盐时，肾脏会把 lithium 锂盐留住，血药浓度就往上升。

tells.en: Depression that did not respond to an antidepressant alone
tells.zh: 单用抗抑郁药效果不好的抑郁症

use.en: Prevent the highs and lows of bipolar disorder
use.zh: 预防双相情感障碍的躁狂和抑郁发作

use.en: Treat acute mania
use.zh: 治疗急性躁狂

use.en: Boost an antidepressant
use.zh: 增强抗抑郁药的疗效

no.en: Severe kidney disease
no.zh: 严重肾病

no.en: Dehydration or low sodium
no.zh: 脱水或低钠

no.en: Significant heart disease
no.zh: 明显的心脏病

care.en: The safe range is narrow, so blood levels are checked regularly.
care.zh: 安全范围很窄，所以要定期查血药浓度。

care.en: Vomiting, diarrhea, fever, heavy sweating or poor fluid intake can raise the level.
care.zh: 呕吐、腹泻、发热、大量出汗或喝水少，都可能让浓度升高。

care.en: Thiazide water pills, ACE inhibitors and NSAIDs can raise the level.
care.zh: 噻嗪类利尿药、ACE 抑制剂和非甾体抗炎药可能让浓度升高。

care.en: Long-term use can harm the thyroid and the kidneys.
care.zh: 长期服用可能损害甲状腺和肾脏。

fx.en: Thirst and passing a lot of urine

medic.en: Toxicity can come without an overdose. A few days of vomiting, diarrhea, fever or hot weather can be enough.
medic.zh: 不用吃过量也会中毒。几天的呕吐、腹泻、发热或高温天气就可能引起中毒。

medic.en: The picture: vomiting, coarse tremor, slurred speech, unsteady walk, twitching and confusion. Later seizures and coma. It can pass for drunk or for a stroke.
medic.zh: 表现是：呕吐、粗大震颤、口齿不清、走路不稳、肌肉抽动、意识混乱。再往后是抽搐和昏迷。容易被当成醉酒或卒中。

medic.en: NSAIDs slow the kidneys' clearance of lithium and can push the level toxic. Ibuprofen and ketorolac are NSAIDs, and acetaminophen does not do this. The BC monographs do not mention lithium, so weigh it as a consideration, not a rule.
medic.zh: 非甾体抗炎药会让肾脏排 lithium 锂盐变慢，可能把浓度推到中毒水平。ibuprofen 布洛芬和 ketorolac 酮咯酸都是非甾体抗炎药，acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚没有这个问题。BC 的药物说明里没有提到 lithium 锂盐，所以这是你要权衡的一点，不是硬性规定。

medic.en: Watch the heart rhythm in suspected toxicity. Bring the bottle and ask about new medicines. The hospital will measure the level.
medic.zh: 怀疑中毒时要盯着心律。把药瓶带上，问有没有新加的药。医院会测血药浓度。

pearl.en: Lithium plus a stomach bug can equal lithium toxicity. Ask about vomiting, diarrhea and new pills before you call it drunk.
pearl.zh: lithium 锂盐加上一场肠胃炎，就可能等于 lithium 锂盐中毒。先问呕吐、腹泻和新加的药，再考虑是不是喝醉了。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.36 Lithium and ch.36 Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (lithium interaction); standard pharmacology

stem.en: Carol, 59, has taken lithium for years. After three days of vomiting and diarrhea she is slurring and staggering, with a coarse tremor. No alcohol. Glucose 5.8.
stem.zh: Carol，59 岁，吃 lithium 锂盐很多年了。呕吐腹泻三天后，她口齿不清、走路摇晃，手抖得很粗大。没喝酒。血糖 5.8。

ask.en: What is the most likely problem?

opts.en: Lithium toxicity brought on by dehydration
opts.zh: 脱水引起的 lithium 锂盐中毒

opts.en: A low lithium level because of the vomiting
opts.zh: 呕吐导致 lithium 锂盐浓度过低

opts.en: Alcohol intoxication that she is hiding
opts.zh: 她瞒着你其实喝醉了

why.en: Fluid loss makes the kidneys hold on to lithium, so the level climbs without any extra pills. Slurred speech, an unsteady walk and a coarse tremor are the signs.
why.zh: 体液丢失让肾脏把 lithium 锂盐留住，所以一片药都没多吃，浓度也会上升。口齿不清、走路不稳、粗大震颤就是信号。

bad.en: She is written off as drunk and the level keeps climbing toward seizures.
bad.zh: 她被当成醉酒处理，浓度继续往上升，直到抽搐。

stem.en: Ben, 44, twisted his ankle on the Grouse Grind. Pain 6/10. He takes lithium for bipolar disorder. No allergies. No kidney problems.
stem.zh: Ben，44 岁，在 Grouse Grind 步道上扭伤了脚踝。疼痛 6/10。他因为双相情感障碍在吃 lithium 锂盐。没有过敏史。肾脏没问题。

ask.en: Which pain option avoids a known interaction with lithium?
ask.zh: 哪种止痛药能避开和 lithium 锂盐的已知相互作用？

opts.en: Acetaminophen
opts.zh: acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

opts.en: Ibuprofen
opts.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬

opts.en: Ketorolac
opts.zh: ketorolac 酮咯酸

why.en: NSAIDs slow the clearance of lithium and can raise it to a toxic level. Acetaminophen does not. This comes from the textbook, not from a BC monograph, so it is a consideration and not a rule.
why.zh: 非甾体抗炎药会让 lithium 锂盐排得慢，可能把浓度升到中毒水平。acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚不会。这一条出自教科书，不是 BC 药物说明里的规定，所以是需要权衡的一点，不是硬性规则。

stem.en: Irene, 70, has taken lithium for decades. Her doctor added hydrochlorothiazide two weeks ago. Today she is confused, twitching and vomiting. HR 52, irregular.
stem.zh: Irene，70 岁，吃 lithium 锂盐几十年了。两周前医生加了 hydrochlorothiazide 氢氯噻嗪。今天她意识混乱、肌肉抽动、呕吐。心率 52，不齐。

ask.en: What links the new pill to today?
ask.zh: 新加的药和今天的情况有什么关系？

opts.en: The water pill raised her lithium level
opts.zh: 利尿药让她的 lithium 锂盐浓度升高了

opts.en: The water pill cancelled out her lithium
opts.zh: 利尿药把她的 lithium 锂盐抵消了

opts.en: The water pill caused a lithium allergy
opts.zh: 利尿药让她对 lithium 锂盐过敏了

why.en: Thiazide water pills make the kidneys hold on to lithium, and the level rises over days to weeks. Watch her rhythm on the way in.
why.zh: 噻嗪类利尿药让肾脏把 lithium 锂盐留住，浓度在几天到几周里慢慢上升。路上盯着她的心律。

s.en: Lithium has a narrow safe range, so patients have regular blood tests.
s.zh: lithium 锂盐的安全范围很窄，所以病人要定期验血。

why.en: The gap between a helpful level and a toxic level is small.
why.zh: 有效浓度和中毒浓度之间的距离很小。

s.en: Vomiting protects a lithium patient from toxicity because less drug is absorbed.
s.zh: 呕吐能保护吃 lithium 锂盐的病人不中毒，因为吸收的药少了。

why.en: Fluid loss makes the kidneys keep lithium, so the level rises.
why.zh: 体液丢失让肾脏把 lithium 锂盐留住，浓度反而升高。

s.en: Ibuprofen can raise the lithium level.
s.zh: ibuprofen 布洛芬会让 lithium 锂盐浓度升高。

why.en: NSAIDs slow the kidneys' clearance of lithium.
why.zh: 非甾体抗炎药会让肾脏排 lithium 锂盐变慢。

s.en: A fine hand tremor on lithium always means toxicity.
s.zh: 吃 lithium 锂盐的人手有细微震颤，就一定是中毒。

why.en: A fine tremor is common at normal levels, while a coarse tremor with slurred speech and unsteadiness is the warning.
why.zh: 正常浓度下细微震颤很常见，粗大震颤加上口齿不清、走路不稳才是警报。

q.en: Which set of signs suggests lithium toxicity?
q.zh: 哪一组表现提示 lithium 锂盐中毒？

opts.en: Coarse tremor, slurred speech, unsteady walk, confusion
opts.zh: 粗大震颤、口齿不清、走路不稳、意识混乱

opts.en: Pinpoint pupils, slow breathing, deep sleep
opts.zh: 针尖样瞳孔、呼吸慢、昏睡

opts.en: Dry mouth, large pupils, fast pulse, flushed skin
opts.zh: 口干、瞳孔大、脉搏快、皮肤潮红

opts.en: Twisted neck, locked jaw, eyes rolled up
opts.zh: 脖子扭转、下颌锁住、眼球上翻

why.en: Lithium toxicity hits the nervous system: tremor, slurring, unsteadiness, twitching, then seizures and coma.
why.zh: lithium 锂盐中毒打击的是神经系统：震颤、口齿不清、走不稳、肌肉抽动，然后是抽搐和昏迷。

q.en: Which of these can push a lithium level up?
q.zh: 下面哪一项会让 lithium 锂盐浓度升高？

opts.en: Dehydration, a thiazide water pill or an NSAID
opts.zh: 脱水、噻嗪类利尿药或非甾体抗炎药

opts.en: Drinking plenty of water every day
opts.zh: 每天多喝水

opts.en: A single dose of acetaminophen
opts.zh: 吃一次 acetaminophen 对乙酰氨基酚

opts.en: Eating a salty meal
opts.zh: 吃一顿很咸的饭

why.en: Anything that makes the kidneys hold on to sodium and water makes them hold on to lithium too.
why.zh: 凡是让肾脏留住钠和水的情况，也会让它把 lithium 锂盐留住。

home.name: ADHD stimulants

cls.zh: 中枢神经兴奋剂

hook.en: Stimulants that help a distracted brain stay on task.
hook.zh: 帮分心的大脑把注意力留在正事上的兴奋剂。

how.en: They raise dopamine and norepinephrine between brain cells. In ADHD that improves focus and self-control. The same boost reaches the rest of the body: the heart beats faster, blood pressure rises, appetite falls and sleep gets harder.
how.zh: 它们让脑细胞之间的多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素增多。对 ADHD 来说，这能改善专注力和自控力。同样的作用也传到全身：心跳加快、血压升高、食欲下降、更难入睡。

tells.en: ADHD in a child, teenager or adult
tells.zh: 儿童、青少年或成人的 ADHD（注意缺陷多动障碍）
暴食症（lisdexamfetamine 赖右苯丙胺）

use.en: Improve attention and reduce impulsive behaviour in ADHD
use.zh: 改善 ADHD 的注意力，减少冲动行为

use.en: Keep a patient with narcolepsy awake
use.zh: 让发作性睡病的病人保持清醒

no.en: Serious heart disease or uncontrolled high blood pressure
no.zh: 严重心脏病或没控制住的高血压

no.en: Taking an MAO inhibitor
no.zh: 正在吃 MAO 抑制剂

no.en: Overactive thyroid
no.zh: 甲状腺功能亢进

no.en: Glaucoma
no.zh: 青光眼

care.en: They usually raise the pulse and blood pressure a little.
care.zh: 吃这类药的人，脉搏和血压通常都会升高一点。

care.en: Anxiety, tics and poor sleep can get worse.
care.zh: 焦虑、抽动和睡眠不好可能加重。

care.en: Appetite drops, so children may lose weight or grow more slowly.
care.zh: 食欲下降，所以孩子可能体重减轻或长得慢。

care.en: They are misused and shared, so the pills do not always reach the patient named on the bottle.
care.zh: 这类药会被滥用、被转手，所以药不一定都进了药瓶上写的那个人嘴里。

fx.en: Fast pulse and raised blood pressure

medic.en: A slightly fast pulse and raised pressure can be the pill. Ask when the last dose was before you read the vitals.
medic.zh: 脉搏偏快、血压偏高可能就是药的作用。解读生命体征之前，先问最后一次是什么时候吃的。

medic.en: Too much looks like adrenaline overload: agitated, sweaty, hot, large pupils, fast pulse, high pressure. It can go on to seizures and psychosis.
medic.zh: 吃多了就像肾上腺素过载：烦躁、出汗、发热、瞳孔大、脉搏快、血压高。再发展下去会抽搐、出现精神病性症状。

medic.en: Salbutamol and epinephrine can speed the heart too, so the pulse may climb further. The BC monographs set no rule about stimulants, so this is something to watch, not a reason to hold them. Anaphylaxis still gets epinephrine.
medic.zh: salbutamol 沙丁胺醇和 epinephrine 肾上腺素本身也会让心跳加快，所以脉搏可能更快。BC 的药物说明没有针对兴奋剂的规定，所以这是要留意的地方，不是不给药的理由。严重过敏反应照样给 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

medic.en: Ask whose pills they are. A toddler may find a sibling's bottle, and some students share them before exams.
medic.zh: 问清楚药是谁的。幼儿可能翻到哥哥姐姐的药瓶，有些学生考试前会互相分着吃。

pearl.en: With a stimulant on board, a fast pulse may be this patient's normal. A hot, agitated patient may have taken too many.
pearl.zh: 体内有兴奋剂时，脉搏快可能就是这个病人的常态。又热又烦躁的病人，可能是吃多了。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), ch.7 CNS Stimulants and ch.36 Amphetamine, Methamphetamine, and Amphetaminelike Drugs; standard pharmacology; BCEHS and EMALB epinephrine and salbutamol monographs

stem.en: Ethan, 16, bumped his head in gym class in Kamloops. Alert and calm. HR 104, BP 132/84. He took his lisdexamfetamine at breakfast.
stem.zh: Ethan，16 岁，在 Kamloops 上体育课时撞到了头。清醒、平静。心率 104，血压 132/84。早饭时吃了 lisdexamfetamine 赖右苯丙胺。

ask.en: How do you read the pulse and pressure?

opts.en: Probably the stimulant, but keep reassessing
opts.zh: 多半是兴奋剂的作用，但要持续复查

opts.en: Proof of serious internal bleeding
opts.zh: 证明有严重内出血

opts.en: A sign that he is having a panic attack
opts.zh: 说明他正在惊恐发作

why.en: Stimulants raise the pulse and pressure a little. Note the dose time and trend the vitals instead of trusting one set.
why.zh: 兴奋剂会让脉搏和血压升高一点。记下服药时间，看生命体征的变化趋势，别只信一组数字。

stem.en: Zoe, 3, is found beside her brother's open methylphenidate bottle. Restless, flushed and sweaty. HR 168, pupils large. Several tablets are missing.
stem.zh: Zoe，3 岁，被发现坐在哥哥打开的 methylphenidate 哌甲酯药瓶旁边。躁动、脸红、出汗。心率 168，瞳孔大。少了好几片药。

ask.en: What picture is this?

opts.en: Stimulant poisoning with sympathetic overdrive
opts.zh: 兴奋剂中毒，交感神经过度兴奋

opts.en: Opioid poisoning with slow breathing
opts.zh: 阿片类中毒，呼吸变慢

opts.en: A simple tantrum that will settle
opts.zh: 只是闹脾气，一会儿就好

why.en: Agitation, sweating, large pupils and a racing pulse fit a stimulant overdose, and seizures can follow. Keep her cool and calm and transport.
why.zh: 躁动、出汗、瞳孔大、脉搏飞快，符合兴奋剂过量，接下来可能抽搐。让她保持凉爽、安静，然后转运。

bad.en: She is left at home and seizes an hour later.
bad.zh: 她被留在家里，一小时后抽搐了。

stem.en: Liam, 20, a UVic student on amphetamine mixed salts, has hives, wheeze and a swollen tongue after eating shrimp. HR 126, BP 88/54.
stem.zh: Liam，20 岁，UVic 的学生，在吃 amphetamine mixed salts 混合苯丙胺盐。吃了虾以后出现荨麻疹、喘鸣、舌头肿。心率 126，血压 88/54。

ask.en: Does the stimulant stop you giving epinephrine?
ask.zh: 因为他在吃兴奋剂，就不能给 epinephrine 肾上腺素了吗？

opts.en: No. Anaphylaxis has no absolute contraindication to epinephrine
opts.zh: 不是。严重过敏反应用 epinephrine 肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌

opts.en: Yes. Epinephrine is contraindicated with any stimulant
opts.zh: 是的。吃任何兴奋剂都禁用 epinephrine 肾上腺素

opts.en: Yes. Wait until his heart rate comes down
opts.zh: 是的。等他心率降下来再说

why.en: Both BC sources say there are no absolute contraindications to epinephrine in anaphylaxis. Expect a faster pulse and monitor him.
why.zh: BC 的两份资料都写明：严重过敏反应时 epinephrine 肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌。预计脉搏会更快，注意监测。

bad.en: You hesitate over a pill bottle while his airway swells shut.
bad.zh: 你盯着药瓶犹豫，他的气道越肿越窄。

s.en: ADHD stimulants can raise the heart rate and blood pressure.
s.zh: ADHD 兴奋剂会让心率和血压升高。

why.en: They increase norepinephrine as well as dopamine.
why.zh: 它们除了增加多巴胺，也增加去甲肾上腺素。

s.en: Methylphenidate is a sedative that calms hyperactive children.
s.zh: methylphenidate 哌甲酯是一种镇静药，用来让多动的孩子安静下来。

why.en: It is a stimulant, and better focus is what makes the child look calmer.
why.zh: 它是兴奋剂，孩子看起来安静是因为专注力变好了。

s.en: A stimulant overdose can cause seizures and psychosis.
s.zh: 兴奋剂过量可以引起抽搐和精神病性症状。

why.en: Too much dopamine and norepinephrine overdrives the brain and the heart.
why.zh: 多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素太多，大脑和心脏都被过度驱动。

s.en: Epinephrine is contraindicated in anaphylaxis if the patient takes an ADHD stimulant.
s.zh: 病人在吃 ADHD 兴奋剂，严重过敏反应时就禁用 epinephrine 肾上腺素。

why.en: There is no absolute contraindication to epinephrine in anaphylaxis.
why.zh: 严重过敏反应时 epinephrine 肾上腺素没有绝对禁忌。

q.en: How do ADHD stimulants work?
q.zh: ADHD 兴奋剂是怎么起作用的？

opts.en: They raise dopamine and norepinephrine in the brain
opts.zh: 增加大脑里的多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素

opts.en: They boost GABA, the brain's own brake
opts.zh: 增强 GABA，也就是大脑的刹车

opts.en: They block the dopamine receptors
opts.zh: 阻断多巴胺受体

opts.en: They block the reuptake of serotonin only
opts.zh: 只阻断 5-羟色胺的再摄取

why.en: More dopamine and norepinephrine improves attention. It also drives the pulse and pressure up.
why.zh: 多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素多了，注意力变好。脉搏和血压也跟着上去。

q.en: Which finding fits a stimulant overdose?
q.zh: 哪一组表现符合兴奋剂过量？

opts.en: Agitation, large pupils, sweating and a fast pulse
opts.zh: 烦躁、瞳孔大、出汗、脉搏快

opts.en: Sleepiness, pinpoint pupils and slow breathing
opts.zh: 嗜睡、针尖样瞳孔、呼吸慢

opts.en: Slow pulse, low pressure and low blood sugar
opts.zh: 脉搏慢、血压低、血糖低

opts.en: Dry skin, slow pulse and deep drowsiness
opts.zh: 皮肤干、脉搏慢、深度嗜睡

why.en: A stimulant overdose is sympathetic overdrive. Sleepy with pinpoint pupils is the opioid picture.
why.zh: 兴奋剂过量就是交感神经过度兴奋。嗜睡加针尖样瞳孔是阿片类的表现。

home.name: Gabapentin and pregabalin

cls.en: Gabapentinoid (an anti-seizure medicine used mostly for nerve pain)
cls.zh: 加巴喷丁类（抗癫痫药，主要用来治神经痛）

hook.en: A dimmer switch for irritated nerves.
hook.zh: 给受刺激的神经装个调光开关。

how.en: They bind to calcium channels on overactive nerve cells, so the cells send out fewer pain and seizure signals. Despite the name, they do not act on GABA receptors. The kidneys clear them unchanged.
how.zh: 它们结合在过度活跃的神经细胞的钙通道上，细胞发出的疼痛和发作信号就少了。名字里虽然有 GABA，其实不作用在 GABA 受体上。它们原样经肾脏排出。

tells.en: Nerve pain, for example from diabetes or after shingles
tells.zh: 神经痛，比如糖尿病引起的，或带状疱疹之后的
纤维肌痛（pregabalin 普瑞巴林）

tells.en: A seizure disorder, as an add-on medicine

use.en: Calm nerve pain
use.zh: 缓解神经痛

use.en: Help control seizures as an add-on
use.zh: 作为辅助用药帮助控制癫痫发作

use.en: Ease fibromyalgia pain (pregabalin)
use.zh: 减轻纤维肌痛（pregabalin 普瑞巴林）

no.en: Known allergy to gabapentin or pregabalin
no.zh: 已知对 gabapentin 加巴喷丁或 pregabalin 普瑞巴林过敏

care.en: With opioids, benzodiazepines or alcohol the sedation stacks up and breathing can slow.
care.zh: 和阿片类、苯二氮䓬类或酒精一起用，镇静作用叠加，呼吸可能变慢。

care.en: Older adults: dizziness and unsteadiness lead to falls.
care.zh: 老年人：头晕、站不稳，容易跌倒。

care.en: Kidney disease: the drug can build up and make the patient sleepy and confused.
care.zh: 肾病：药可能在体内蓄积，让病人嗜睡、意识混乱。

care.en: Do not stop suddenly: withdrawal symptoms and seizures are possible.
care.zh: 不能突然停药：可能出现戒断症状和癫痫发作。

medic.en: Sleepy, unsteady and slurred on gabapentin or pregabalin: think too much drug, a new dose or failing kidneys.
medic.zh: 吃 gabapentin 加巴喷丁或 pregabalin 普瑞巴林的病人犯困、站不稳、口齿不清：要想到药量过多、刚调过剂量，或者肾功能在变差。

medic.en: With an opioid on the same list, expect deeper sedation and slower breathing than the opioid alone would give.
medic.zh: 用药清单上还有阿片类时，镇静会更深，呼吸会比单用阿片类更慢。

medic.en: Naloxone reverses only the opioid. If the patient stays drowsy after it, the gabapentinoid may be why. Keep supporting the breathing.
medic.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮只能逆转阿片类。用了以后病人还是昏沉，可能就是加巴喷丁类药的缘故。继续支持呼吸。

medic.en: Our own sedating drugs add on top. Both BC sources list depressant drugs as a caution for Entonox. BCEHS says dimenhydrinate may potentiate other CNS depressants.
medic.zh: 我们自己带的有镇静作用的药也会往上叠。BC 的两份资料都把中枢抑制药列为 Entonox 笑气的慎用情况。BCEHS 写明 dimenhydrinate 茶苯海明可能增强其他中枢抑制药的作用。

pearl.en: Not a harmless nerve pill. On top of an opioid it makes a sleepy patient sleepier and a slow breather slower.
pearl.zh: 它不是一颗无害的神经药。叠在阿片类上面，困的病人更困，呼吸慢的更慢。

home.src: Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.), household medication list (Anticonvulsants/Antiseizure, footnote: also used for nerve pain); standard pharmacology; BCEHS and EMALB monographs for naloxone, Entonox and dimenhydrinate

stem.en: Tina, 52, is unresponsive on a Surrey couch. RR 6, pinpoint pupils. Bottles: hydromorphone and pregabalin. After ventilation and naloxone she breathes at 14 but stays very drowsy.
stem.zh: Tina，52 岁，在 Surrey 家里的沙发上叫不醒。呼吸 6 次，针尖样瞳孔。药瓶：hydromorphone 氢吗啡酮和 pregabalin 普瑞巴林。通气并给了 naloxone 纳洛酮后，呼吸恢复到 14 次，但人还是很昏沉。

ask.en: Why is she still so drowsy?

opts.en: Naloxone reverses the opioid, not the pregabalin
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮逆转的是阿片类，不是 pregabalin 普瑞巴林

opts.en: The naloxone has not started to work yet
opts.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮还没开始起效

opts.en: Naloxone itself is making her sleepy
opts.zh: 是 naloxone 纳洛酮本身让她犯困

why.en: Naloxone only competes at opioid receptors, so the pregabalin is still on board. Keep watching her breathing.
why.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮只在阿片受体上竞争，所以 pregabalin 普瑞巴林还在体内。继续盯着她的呼吸。

bad.en: You relax because the opioid is reversed, and her breathing slows again unnoticed.
bad.zh: 你觉得阿片已经逆转就放松了，她的呼吸又悄悄慢下来。

stem.en: Sam, 74, on dialysis, is confused and too sleepy to hold a cup. Glucose normal. His daughter says a walk-in clinic started gabapentin four days ago for foot pain.
stem.zh: Sam，74 岁，在做透析，现在意识混乱，困得连杯子都拿不住。血糖正常。女儿说四天前诊所因为脚痛给他开了 gabapentin 加巴喷丁。

ask.en: What do you suspect?

opts.en: Gabapentin building up because his kidneys cannot clear it
opts.zh: 肾脏排不掉，gabapentin 加巴喷丁在体内蓄积

opts.en: An allergic reaction to the new gabapentin
opts.zh: 对新开的 gabapentin 加巴喷丁过敏

opts.en: Gabapentin withdrawal after four days of use
opts.zh: 吃了四天 gabapentin 加巴喷丁后出现戒断

why.en: The kidneys remove gabapentin unchanged. In kidney failure an ordinary dose piles up and sedates.
why.zh: gabapentin 加巴喷丁是原样经肾脏排出的。肾衰竭时，普通剂量也会越积越多，把人镇静住。

stem.en: Maria, 63, diabetic, called after a fall at home in Prince George. No seizure history. On her table: metformin and pregabalin. She says her feet burn at night.
stem.zh: Maria，63 岁，有糖尿病，在 Prince George 家里跌倒后报警。没有癫痫史。桌上有 metformin 二甲双胍和 pregabalin 普瑞巴林。她说晚上双脚烧灼样疼。

ask.en: What is the pregabalin most likely for?
ask.zh: pregabalin 普瑞巴林最可能是治什么的？

opts.en: Nerve pain from her diabetes
opts.zh: 糖尿病引起的神经痛

opts.en: A seizure disorder she has not mentioned
opts.zh: 她没提过的癫痫

opts.en: High blood pressure
opts.zh: 高血压

why.en: Burning feet in a diabetic is nerve damage, and pregabalin is a standard treatment. Its dizziness may also explain the fall.
why.zh: 糖尿病人双脚烧灼痛是神经受损，pregabalin 普瑞巴林是常规用药。它引起的头晕也可能是这次跌倒的原因。

s.en: Despite their names, gabapentin and pregabalin do not work on GABA receptors.
s.zh: gabapentin 加巴喷丁和 pregabalin 普瑞巴林虽然名字里有 GABA，却不作用在 GABA 受体上。

why.en: They bind to calcium channels on nerve cells.
why.zh: 它们结合的是神经细胞上的钙通道。

s.en: Naloxone reverses the sedation caused by pregabalin.
s.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮可以逆转 pregabalin 普瑞巴林引起的镇静。

why.en: Naloxone only reverses opioids.
why.zh: naloxone 纳洛酮只能逆转阿片类。

s.en: Kidney failure makes gabapentin build up in the body.
s.zh: 肾衰竭会让 gabapentin 加巴喷丁在体内蓄积。

why.en: The kidneys remove it unchanged.
why.zh: 它是原样经肾脏排出的。

s.en: A gabapentin bottle proves the patient has epilepsy.
s.zh: 有 gabapentin 加巴喷丁的药瓶，就说明病人有癫痫。

why.en: It is very often prescribed for nerve pain instead.
why.zh: 它更常见的用途其实是治神经痛。

q.en: A patient takes pregabalin and an opioid. What is the main danger of the combination?
q.zh: 病人同时吃 pregabalin 普瑞巴林和阿片类。这个组合最主要的危险是什么？

opts.en: Deeper sedation and slower breathing
opts.zh: 镇静更深、呼吸更慢

opts.en: A dangerous rise in blood pressure
opts.zh: 血压危险地升高

opts.en: A sudden drop in blood sugar
opts.zh: 血糖突然下降

opts.en: Bleeding from the stomach
opts.zh: 胃出血

why.en: Both depress the central nervous system. Together the effect on breathing is stronger than either one alone.
why.zh: 两者都抑制中枢神经系统。合在一起，对呼吸的影响比单用任何一个都强。

home.name: Levodopa (Parkinson's)

examples.zh: 左旋多巴／卡比多巴／恩他卡朋

cls.zh: 多巴胺前体（抗帕金森病药）

hook.en: Raw material the brain turns into dopamine.
hook.zh: 给大脑送去做多巴胺的原料。

how.en: Parkinson's disease is a shortage of dopamine in the part of the brain that smooths movement. Dopamine cannot get into the brain, but levodopa can, and the brain turns it into dopamine. The partner drug (carbidopa or benserazide) keeps it from being used up on the way.
how.zh: 帕金森病就是大脑里负责让动作顺滑的部位缺多巴胺。多巴胺本身进不了大脑，levodopa 左旋多巴可以，进去后大脑把它变成多巴胺。搭档药（carbidopa 卡比多巴或 benserazide 苄丝肼）防止它在半路上被用掉。

tells.en: A Parkinson-like condition (parkinsonism) from another brain disease
tells.zh: 其他脑部疾病引起的帕金森样表现（帕金森综合征）

use.en: Replace the missing dopamine in Parkinson's disease
use.zh: 补上帕金森病缺少的多巴胺

use.en: Ease tremor, stiffness and slow movement
use.zh: 减轻震颤、僵硬和动作迟缓

no.en: Taking a non-selective MAO inhibitor antidepressant
no.zh: 正在吃非选择性 MAO 抑制剂类抗抑郁药

no.en: Narrow-angle glaucoma
no.zh: 闭角型青光眼

care.en: Timing matters: a late or missed dose can leave the patient stiff, slow and unable to swallow well.
care.zh: 时间很要紧：晚吃或漏吃一顿，病人就可能僵硬、动作慢、吞咽不好。

care.en: Never stop suddenly: severe stiffness with fever can follow.
care.zh: 不能突然停药：可能出现严重僵硬伴发热。

care.en: Dopamine-blocking medicines work against it: most antipsychotics and metoclopramide.
care.zh: 阻断多巴胺的药会和它对着干：大多数抗精神病药和 metoclopramide 甲氧氯普胺。

care.en: It can lower standing blood pressure, and falls are common.
care.zh: 它可能让站立时的血压下降，跌倒也很常见。

fx.en: Dizziness on standing (postural drop in blood pressure)
fx.zh: 站起来头晕（体位性低血压）

fx.en: Twisting, swaying movements the patient cannot control (dyskinesia)
fx.zh: 控制不住的扭动、摇摆（异动症）

medic.en: Ask when the last dose was and when the next is due. Tell the hospital. These doses run on a clock.
medic.zh: 问清上一顿什么时候吃的、下一顿什么时候该吃。告诉医院。这个药是按钟点吃的。

medic.en: A patient who is suddenly stiff, slow or frozen may simply be late for a dose. Do the stroke screen anyway.
medic.zh: 病人突然僵硬、迟缓或「冻住」，可能只是药吃晚了。卒中筛查照做。

medic.en: Twisting, dance-like movements in an awake, talking patient are usually dyskinesia from the drug, not a seizure.
medic.zh: 病人清醒、能说话，身体却像跳舞一样扭动，多半是药物引起的异动症，不是癫痫发作。

medic.en: Standing pressure can drop. Sit them up slowly and expect falls. Seeing things that are not there can also be the drug.
medic.zh: 站起来血压可能会掉。扶起来要慢，要想到跌倒。看见不存在的东西也可能是药的作用。

pearl.en: Parkinson's pills run on a clock. Find out when the last dose was and pass that on at the hospital.
pearl.zh: 帕金森的药是按钟点吃的。问清最后一顿的时间，到医院交接时说出来。

home.src: Standard pharmacology. Nancy Caroline's Emergency Care in the Streets (Canadian 8th ed.) ch.7 Medication Classifications does not cover Parkinson's medicines.

stem.en: Agnes, 77, has Parkinson's. Her family found her rigid and barely able to swallow. Her pill organizer shows yesterday's levodopa slots still full.
stem.zh: Agnes，77 岁，有帕金森病。家人发现她全身僵硬，几乎咽不下东西。药盒里昨天那几格 levodopa 左旋多巴还是满的。

ask.en: What is the most useful thing to pass on at triage?
ask.zh: 到分诊台最该交代的是什么？

opts.en: She missed levodopa doses, and when the last one was
opts.zh: 她漏服了 levodopa 左旋多巴，以及最后一次服药的时间

opts.en: Her levodopa should be held until a specialist sees her
opts.zh: 她的 levodopa 左旋多巴应该先停，等专科医生来看
